// 音の土台: 指を離した瞬間に鳴らし始める（iPhone）。BGM・効果音・声・画面の音は別々の音量。
// 立体音響（距離・左右・前後）、壁ごしはこもる、遠い銃声は音速で遅れて届く、屋内と屋外で残響が変わる。
import { SFX, renderSfx, gunKeys } from './synth.js';
import { WEAPONS } from '../engine/data/weapons.js';

const STEP = { hard: 'step_hard', tile: 'step_tile', wood: 'step_wood', soft: 'step_soft', grass: 'step_grass', dirt: 'step_dirt', metal: 'step_metal' };
const clamp = (v, a, b) => v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v;

export class AudioSys {
  constructor() {
    this.ctx = null; this.ok = false; this.buf = {}; this.voiceBuf = {}; this.voiceIdx = null; this.music = {};
    this.vol = { master: 0.9, bgm: 0.5, sfx: 0.9, voice: 1.0, ui: 0.7 };
    this.loops = {}; this.playSilent = false; this.suspended = false; this.genDone = false;
    this.L = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, yaw: 0 };
    this.occluder = null; // (x,y,z) → 0..1（1=壁の向こう）
    this.active = new Set(); this.maxActive = 32;
    this.indoor = 1; this.deafT = 0;
    this.pending = [];
    this.musicCur = null;
  }
  setSession(playSilent) {
    this.playSilent = !!playSilent;
    // 消音スイッチに従い、ロック画面に「再生中」を出さない（ambient）。消音でも鳴らすときだけ playback
    try { if (navigator.audioSession) navigator.audioSession.type = this.playSilent ? 'playback' : 'ambient'; } catch (e) { /* 無い端末 */ }
  }
  // 指を離した瞬間（pointerup / touchend / click / keydown）に呼ぶ
  unlock() {
    try {
      if (!this.ctx) {
        this.setSession(this.playSilent);
        const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AC) return;
        this.ctx = new AC({ latencyHint: 'interactive' });
        this._graph();
      }
      if (this.ctx.state !== 'running' && !this.suspended) this.ctx.resume();
      const b = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, 1, this.ctx.sampleRate);
      const s = this.ctx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = b; s.connect(this.ctx.destination); s.start();
      this.ok = true;
      if (!this.genDone) this._generate();
      const p = this.pending; this.pending = [];
      for (const f of p) { try { f(); } catch (e) { console.warn(e); } }
    } catch (e) { console.warn('audio unlock', e); }
  }
  get running() { return !!(this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'running'); }
  _graph() {
    const c = this.ctx;
    this.master = c.createGain();
    this.comp = c.createDynamicsCompressor();
    this.comp.threshold.value = -10; this.comp.knee.value = 6; this.comp.ratio.value = 5; this.comp.attack.value = 0.002; this.comp.release.value = 0.2;
    // 耳が遠くなる（閃光・爆発）ためのローパス
    this.muf = c.createBiquadFilter(); this.muf.type = 'lowpass'; this.muf.frequency.value = 20000; this.muf.Q.value = 0.5;
    this.master.connect(this.muf); this.muf.connect(this.comp); this.comp.connect(c.destination);
    this.bus = {};
    for (const k of ['bgm', 'sfx', 'voice', 'ui']) { const g = c.createGain(); g.connect(k === 'ui' || k === 'bgm' ? this.comp : this.master); this.bus[k] = g; }
    // 残響: 屋内（短く濃い）と屋外（長く、こだま）
    this.vIn = c.createConvolver(); this.vIn.buffer = this._ir(0.75, 9000, 0);
    this.vOut = c.createConvolver(); this.vOut.buffer = this._ir(2.4, 3500, 1);
    this.gIn = c.createGain(); this.gOut = c.createGain();
    this.vIn.connect(this.gIn); this.vOut.connect(this.gOut); this.gIn.connect(this.master); this.gOut.connect(this.master);
    this.sendIn = c.createGain(); this.sendOut = c.createGain();
    this.sendIn.connect(this.vIn); this.sendOut.connect(this.vOut);
    this.setEnv(this.indoor);
    this.applyVolumes();
  }
  _ir(dur, bright, echoes) {
    const c = this.ctx, sr = c.sampleRate, n = Math.floor(sr * dur), b = c.createBuffer(2, n, sr);
    for (let ch = 0; ch < 2; ch++) {
      const d = b.getChannelData(ch); let s = 12345 + ch * 777; let y = 0;
      const a = Math.exp(-2 * Math.PI * bright / sr);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;
        const r = s / 0x7fffffff * 2 - 1;
        const t = i / n;
        y = r * (1 - a) + y * a;
        d[i] = y * Math.pow(1 - t, echoes ? 2.2 : 3.4) * (i < sr * 0.004 ? 0 : 1);
      }
      if (echoes) for (const [t, g] of [[0.11, 0.5], [0.23, 0.35], [0.41, 0.25], [0.66, 0.15]]) { const k = Math.floor((t + ch * 0.013) * sr); for (let j = 0; j < 400 && k + j < n; j++) d[k + j] += (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * g * Math.exp(-j / 80); }
    }
    return b;
  }
  // 屋内らしさ 0..1（聞いている人の場所で変える）
  setEnv(indoor) {
    this.indoor = indoor;
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    this.gIn.gain.setTargetAtTime(0.55 * indoor, t, 0.3);
    this.gOut.gain.setTargetAtTime(0.42 * (1 - indoor) + 0.06, t, 0.3);
  }
  applyVolumes() {
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    this.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.vol.master, t, 0.05);
    for (const k of ['bgm', 'sfx', 'voice', 'ui']) this.bus[k].gain.setTargetAtTime(this.vol[k] * (k === 'ui' || k === 'bgm' ? this.vol.master : 1), t, 0.05);
  }
  setVolumes(v) { Object.assign(this.vol, v); this.applyVolumes(); }
  _generate() {
    const sr = Math.min(48000, this.ctx.sampleRate);
    const names = Object.keys(SFX);
    // よく使う音から先に（銃・足音・画面）
    names.sort((a, b) => pri(a) - pri(b));
    let k = 0;
    const step = () => {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      while (k < names.length && performance.now() - t0 < 10) {
        const nm = names[k++];
        const [, count] = SFX[nm];
        this.buf[nm] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const data = renderSfx(nm, i, sr);
          const b = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, data.length, sr);
          b.copyToChannel(data, 0);
          this.buf[nm].push(b);
        }
      }
      if (k < names.length) setTimeout(step, 0); else { this.genDone = true; if (this.onReady) this.onReady(); }
    };
    this.genDone = 'busy';
    step();
  }
  // ---- 声（話す人ごとに1つにまとめたm4a＋目次）
  loadVoices(index, get) {
    if (!this.ctx) { this.pending.push(() => this.loadVoices(index, get)); return; }
    this.voiceIdx = index;
    for (const spk of Object.keys(index.spk || {})) {
      (async () => {
        try { const ab = await get(spk); this.voiceBuf[spk] = await this.ctx.decodeAudioData(ab); }
        catch (e) { console.warn('voice', spk, e); }
      })();
    }
  }
  // BGM（m4a）。前後に「のりしろ」があるので、その内側をくり返す
  loadMusic(meta, get) {
    if (!this.ctx) { this.pending.push(() => this.loadMusic(meta, get)); return; }
    for (const [name, m] of Object.entries(meta)) {
      (async () => {
        try { const ab = await get(name); const b = await this.ctx.decodeAudioData(ab); this.music[name] = { buffer: b, start: m.pad, end: m.pad + m.len }; if (this.musicWant === name) this.playMusic(name, { fade: 1.5 }); }
        catch (e) { console.warn('music', name, e); }
      })();
    }
  }
  // 聞いている人（カメラ）
  listen(x, y, z, yaw, pitch) {
    this.L = { x, y, z, yaw };
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    const L = this.ctx.listener, t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    const fx = Math.sin(yaw), fz = Math.cos(yaw);
    if (L.positionX) {
      L.positionX.setTargetAtTime(x, t, 0.015); L.positionY.setTargetAtTime(y, t, 0.015); L.positionZ.setTargetAtTime(z, t, 0.015);
      L.forwardX.setTargetAtTime(fx, t, 0.015); L.forwardY.setTargetAtTime(0, t, 0.015); L.forwardZ.setTargetAtTime(fz, t, 0.015);
      L.upX.value = 0; L.upY.value = 1; L.upZ.value = 0;
    } else if (L.setPosition) { L.setPosition(x, y, z); L.setOrientation(fx, 0, fz, 0, 1, 0); }
    if (this.deafT > 0) this.deafT -= 1 / 60;
  }
  // 鳴らす。o: { pos, vol, rate, vary, bus, verb, lowpass, delay, ref, roll, loop, buffer, offset, dur, radio, hrtf }
  play(name, o = {}) {
    if (!this.ok || !this.ctx || this.ctx.state !== 'running') return null;
    const list = o.buffer ? [o.buffer] : this.buf[name];
    if (!list || !list.length) return null;
    const b = list[o.i != null ? o.i % list.length : Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)];
    const c = this.ctx;
    if (!o.loop && this.active.size >= this.maxActive) {
      // いちばん小さい（古い）音を止める
      const old = this.active.values().next().value;
      if (old) { this.active.delete(old); try { old.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, c.currentTime, 0.02); old.src.stop(c.currentTime + 0.08); } catch (e) { /* 止まっている */ } }
    }
    const src = c.createBufferSource();
    const nodes = [src];
    src.buffer = b;
    src.playbackRate.value = (o.rate || 1) * (o.vary ? 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * o.vary : 1);
    src.loop = !!o.loop;
    if (o.loop && o.loopStart != null) { src.loopStart = o.loopStart; src.loopEnd = o.loopEnd; }
    const g = c.createGain(); g.gain.value = o.vol ?? 1; nodes.push(g);
    let node = src;
    // 壁ごし（こもる）・遠い（高い音が減る）
    let occ = 0;
    if (o.pos && this.occluder) { try { occ = this.occluder(o.pos[0], o.pos[1], o.pos[2]) || 0; } catch (e) { occ = 0; } }
    const lpF = Math.min(o.lowpass || 20000, occ > 0 ? 700 + 9000 * (1 - occ) * (1 - occ) : 20000);
    if (lpF < 18000) { const f = c.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'lowpass'; f.frequency.value = lpF; f.Q.value = 0.5; node.connect(f); node = f; nodes.push(f); g.gain.value *= 1 - 0.45 * occ; }
    if (o.radio) {
      // 無線: 帯域を狭くして少し歪ませる
      const h = c.createBiquadFilter(); h.type = 'highpass'; h.frequency.value = 420;
      const l = c.createBiquadFilter(); l.type = 'lowpass'; l.frequency.value = 2900;
      const ws = c.createWaveShaper(); ws.curve = this._radioCurve || (this._radioCurve = makeCurve(2.4)); ws.oversample = 'none';
      node.connect(h); h.connect(l); l.connect(ws); node = ws; nodes.push(h, l, ws);
    }
    node.connect(g);
    let out = g;
    if (o.pos) {
      const p = c.createPanner();
      p.panningModel = o.hrtf ? 'HRTF' : 'equalpower'; p.distanceModel = 'inverse'; p.refDistance = o.ref || 2; p.maxDistance = 400; p.rolloffFactor = o.roll ?? 1.0;
      if (p.positionX) { p.positionX.value = o.pos[0]; p.positionY.value = o.pos[1]; p.positionZ.value = o.pos[2]; } else p.setPosition(o.pos[0], o.pos[1], o.pos[2]);
      g.connect(p); out = p; nodes.push(p);
    }
    out.connect(this.bus[o.bus || 'sfx']);
    const vb = o.verb ?? (o.bus === 'ui' ? 0 : 0.5);
    if (vb > 0) {
      const sI = c.createGain(); sI.gain.value = vb; out.connect(sI); sI.connect(this.sendIn); nodes.push(sI);
      const sO = c.createGain(); sO.gain.value = vb; out.connect(sO); sO.connect(this.sendOut); nodes.push(sO);
    }
    const h = { src, g };
    src.onended = () => { this.active.delete(h); setTimeout(() => { for (const n of nodes) { try { n.disconnect(); } catch (e) { /* 外れている */ } } }, 80); };
    if (!o.loop) this.active.add(h);
    const at = c.currentTime + (o.delay || 0);
    if (o.offset != null) src.start(at, o.offset, o.dur); else src.start(at);
    return { src, gain: g, stop: (t = 0.1) => { try { g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, c.currentTime, t); src.stop(c.currentTime + t * 4); } catch (e) { /* 止まっている */ } } };
  }
  _dist(pos) { const L = this.L; return pos ? Math.hypot(pos[0] - L.x, pos[1] - L.y, pos[2] - L.z) : 0; }
  // 効果音（位置があれば立体音響）
  sfx(name, pos, o = {}) {
    if (name === 'ui_back') return this.ui('back');
    const d = this._dist(pos);
    if (pos && d > (o.maxD || 70)) return null;
    return this.play(name, { pos, vol: o.vol ?? 1, rate: o.rate, vary: o.vary ?? 0.06, verb: o.verb ?? 0.5, hrtf: pos && d < 12, delay: pos ? d / 343 : 0, ref: o.ref || 2.2 });
  }
  ui(name) { return this.play('ui_' + name, { bus: 'ui', verb: 0, vol: 0.9 }); }
  // 銃声: 近い音と遠い音を距離で混ぜる。自分の銃は耳元
  gun(wid, pos, o = {}) {
    const W = WEAPONS[wid]; if (!W) return;
    const K = gunKeys(W.snd);
    if (o.local || !pos) {
      this.play(o.supp ? K.supp : K.near, { vol: o.supp ? 0.7 : 1.0, vary: 0.05, verb: o.supp ? 0.35 : 0.9 });
      return;
    }
    const d = this._dist(pos);
    const loud = o.supp ? 0.35 : 1;
    const delay = d / 343;
    const nearK = o.supp ? K.supp : K.near;
    const k = clamp((d - 18) / 40, 0, 1); // 0=近い、1=遠い
    if (k < 1) this.play(nearK, { pos, vol: (1 - k) * loud * 1.1, vary: 0.06, verb: 0.8, delay, ref: 4, roll: 0.9, hrtf: d < 15 });
    if (k > 0 && !o.supp) this.play(K.far, { pos, vol: k * 1.2, vary: 0.05, verb: 0.9, delay, ref: 6, roll: 0.6 });
  }
  step(f, pos, loud = 1) {
    const nm = STEP[f] || 'step_hard';
    if (!pos) { this.play(nm, { vol: 0.32 * loud, vary: 0.12, verb: 0.15 }); return; }
    const d = this._dist(pos);
    if (d > 32) return;
    this.play(nm, { pos, vol: 0.9 * loud, vary: 0.12, verb: 0.35, hrtf: d < 14, ref: 1.6, roll: 1.25 });
  }
  // 声: line の idx 番目を、話す人 spk の声で
  voice(line, idx, spk, pos, o = {}) {
    const I = this.voiceIdx; if (!I) return null;
    const S = I.spk[spk] ? spk : (I.alias && I.alias[spk]) || null;
    if (!S || !this.voiceBuf[S]) return null;
    const clip = (I.clips[S] || {})[line + '.' + idx] || (I.clips[S] || {})[line + '.0'];
    if (!clip) return null;
    if (o.radio) { this.play('radioOn', { bus: 'voice', verb: 0, vol: 0.5 }); this.play('radioOff', { bus: 'voice', verb: 0, vol: 0.5, delay: clip[1] + 0.05 }); }
    const d = this._dist(pos);
    return this.play(null, { buffer: this.voiceBuf[S], offset: clip[0], dur: clip[1], pos: o.radio ? null : pos, bus: 'voice', vol: (o.vol ?? 1) * (o.radio ? 0.85 : 1), verb: o.radio ? 0 : 0.45, radio: !!o.radio, hrtf: pos && d < 15, ref: 3, roll: 0.9, delay: pos && !o.radio ? d / 343 : 0 });
  }
  // 閃光や爆発で耳が遠くなる（sec 秒で戻る）＋耳鳴り
  deafen(sec) {
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    const c = this.ctx, t = c.currentTime;
    this.muf.frequency.cancelScheduledValues(t);
    this.muf.frequency.setValueAtTime(350, t);
    this.muf.frequency.setTargetAtTime(20000, t + Math.min(1.5, sec * 0.3), sec / 2.5);
    this.deafT = sec;
    if (sec > 1.2) this.play('ring', { bus: 'ui', verb: 0, vol: Math.min(0.5, sec / 10) });
  }
  // 環境音（屋外・屋内）と BGM
  ambience(on, indoor = 1) {
    if (!on) { this.loop('amb_out', false); this.loop('amb_in', false); return; }
    this.loop('amb_out', true, { vol: 0.32 * (1 - indoor) + 0.04, fadeIn: 2 });
    this.loop('amb_in', true, { vol: 0.16 * indoor, fadeIn: 2 });
    this.loopVol('amb_out', 0.32 * (1 - indoor) + 0.04, 0.5); this.loopVol('amb_in', 0.16 * indoor, 0.5);
  }
  playMusic(name, o = {}) {
    this.musicWant = name;
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    if (this.musicCur && this.musicCur.name === name) return;
    if (this.musicCur) { this.musicCur.h.stop(o.fade ?? 1.2); this.musicCur = null; }
    const m = this.music[name]; if (!m) return;
    const h = this.play(null, { buffer: m.buffer, loop: true, loopStart: m.start, loopEnd: m.end, offset: m.start, bus: 'bgm', verb: 0, vol: 0 });
    if (!h) return;
    h.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(o.vol ?? 1, this.ctx.currentTime, (o.fade ?? 1.2) / 3);
    this.musicCur = { name, h };
  }
  musicVol(v, t = 1) { if (this.musicCur && this.ctx) this.musicCur.h.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(v, this.ctx.currentTime, t / 3); }
  stopMusic(fade = 1.2) { this.musicWant = null; if (this.musicCur) { this.musicCur.h.stop(fade); this.musicCur = null; } }
  loop(name, on, o = {}) {
    const cur = this.loops[name];
    if (on && !cur) {
      const target = o.vol ?? 1;
      const h = this.play(o.sound || name, { ...o, vol: o.fadeIn ? 0 : target, loop: true, verb: o.verb ?? 0 });
      if (h) { this.loops[name] = h; if (o.fadeIn) h.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(target, this.ctx.currentTime, o.fadeIn / 3); }
      return h;
    }
    if (!on && cur) { cur.stop(o.fade ?? 0.6); delete this.loops[name]; }
    return cur;
  }
  loopVol(name, v, t = 0.3) { const h = this.loops[name]; if (h && this.ctx) h.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(v, this.ctx.currentTime, t); }
  stopAll() { for (const k of Object.keys(this.loops)) this.loop(k, false, { fade: 0.2 }); if (this.ctx) { this.muf.frequency.cancelScheduledValues(this.ctx.currentTime); this.muf.frequency.setTargetAtTime(20000, this.ctx.currentTime, 0.05); } }
  // 画面が裏に回ったら止める
  suspend() { this.suspended = true; if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'running') this.ctx.suspend(); }
  resume() { this.suspended = false; if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state !== 'running') this.ctx.resume(); }
}
function pri(n) { return n.startsWith('ui_') ? 0 : n.startsWith('step_') ? 1 : /^(r|p|h)\d|^sg$|^sup_|^far_/.test(n) ? 2 : 3; }
function makeCurve(k) { const n = 1024, c = new Float32Array(n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = i / (n - 1) * 2 - 1; c[i] = Math.tanh(x * k) / Math.tanh(k); } return c; }

// 効果音を手続きで作る（外部の音素材は使わない）。DOMを使わないので Node でも書き出して検査できる。
// 銃声は「銃口の爆風（広い帯域の破裂）」「胴の響き（低い山）」「超音速の弾のクラック（小銃）」「機関部の金属音」の重ね合わせ。
// 残響（屋内・屋外）は再生側（audio.js）で付ける。
function rng(seed) { let s = (seed * 2654435761) >>> 0 || 1; return () => { s ^= s << 13; s >>>= 0; s ^= s >>> 17; s ^= s << 5; s >>>= 0; return s / 4294967296; }; }
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

function lp(x, fc, sr) { const a = Math.exp(-TAU * fc / sr); let y = 0; for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { y = x[i] * (1 - a) + y * a; x[i] = y; } return x; }
function hp(x, fc, sr) { const a = Math.exp(-TAU * fc / sr); let y = 0, px = 0; for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { y = a * (y + x[i] - px); px = x[i]; x[i] = y; } return x; }
function bp(x, f, q, sr) {
  const w = TAU * f / sr, al = Math.sin(w) / (2 * q), cw = Math.cos(w);
  const b0 = al, b2 = -al, a0 = 1 + al, a1 = -2 * cw, a2 = 1 - al;
  let x1 = 0, x2 = 0, y1 = 0, y2 = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { const v = x[i]; const y = (b0 * v + b2 * x2 - a1 * y1 - a2 * y2) / a0; x2 = x1; x1 = v; y2 = y1; y1 = y; x[i] = y; }
  return x;
}
// 時間で変わるローパス（f0 → f1）
function lpSweep(x, f0, f1, sr) { let y = 0; for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { const f = f0 * Math.pow(f1 / f0, i / x.length); const a = Math.exp(-TAU * f / sr); y = x[i] * (1 - a) + y * a; x[i] = y; } return x; }
function env(n, sr, a, d, curve = 3) { const e = new Float32Array(n); const na = Math.max(1, Math.floor(a * sr)); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) e[i] = i < na ? i / na : Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - (i - na) / Math.max(1, d * sr)), curve); return e; }
// 指数の減衰（tau 秒で 1/e）
function expEnv(n, sr, a, tau) { const e = new Float32Array(n); const na = Math.max(1, Math.floor(a * sr)); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) e[i] = i < na ? i / na : Math.exp(-(i - na) / (tau * sr)); return e; }
function mixInto(dst, src, at = 0, g = 1) { at = Math.max(0, Math.floor(at)); for (let i = 0; i < src.length && at + i < dst.length; i++) dst[at + i] += src[i] * g; return dst; }
function noise(n, r) { const x = new Float32Array(n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) x[i] = r() * 2 - 1; return x; }
function normalize(x, peak = 0.9) { let m = 0; for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { const v = Math.abs(x[i]); if (v > m) m = v; } if (m > 0) for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= peak / m; return x; }
function sine(n, sr, f0, f1 = f0, ph = 0) { const x = new Float32Array(n); let p = ph; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const f = f0 * Math.pow(f1 / f0, i / n); p += TAU * f / sr; x[i] = Math.sin(p); } return x; }
function mulEnv(x, e) { for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= e[i]; return x; }
function sat(x, drive) { const k = Math.tanh(drive); for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] = Math.tanh(x[i] * drive) / k; return x; }
function buf(sr, dur) { return new Float32Array(Math.max(1, Math.floor(sr * dur))); }
const S = (sr, t) => Math.floor(sr * t);
// 端をなめらかに（プツッと鳴らないように）
function fadeEdges(x, sr, a = 0.0005, b = 0.01) { const na = Math.max(1, S(sr, a)), nb = Math.max(1, S(sr, b)); for (let i = 0; i < na && i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= i / na; for (let i = 0; i < nb && i < x.length; i++) x[x.length - 1 - i] *= i / nb; return x; }

// ---- 部品
// 金属のカチッ（共鳴する小さな部品）
function clack(sr, r, f = 2400, dur = 0.05, g = 1) {
  const n = S(sr, dur), out = new Float32Array(n);
  const nz = noise(n, r); hp(nz, 1500, sr); mulEnv(nz, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0003, 0.004)); mixInto(out, nz, 0, 0.8 * g);
  for (const m of [1, 1.47, 2.31, 3.1]) { const s = sine(n, sr, f * m * (0.97 + r() * 0.06)); mulEnv(s, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0002, 0.006 + r() * 0.01)); mixInto(out, s, 0, 0.25 * g / m); }
  return out;
}
// 低い山（胴の響き）
function thump(sr, r, f0, f1, dur, g = 1) { const n = S(sr, dur); const s = sine(n, sr, f0, f1, r() * TAU); mulEnv(s, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0015, dur * 0.28)); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) s[i] *= g; return s; }
// 破裂（爆風）: 広い帯域、立ち上がりが鋭い
function blast(sr, r, dur, bright, tau) { const n = S(sr, dur); const x = noise(n, r); lpSweep(x, bright, Math.max(300, bright * 0.12), sr); hp(x, 90, sr); mulEnv(x, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0002, tau)); return x; }
// 超音速の弾のクラック（N字の波）
function crack(sr, r, len = 0.0016) { const n = S(sr, 0.02), out = new Float32Array(n), m = Math.max(4, S(sr, len)); for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) out[i] = 1 - 2 * i / m; const t = noise(n, r); hp(t, 3000, sr); mulEnv(t, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0001, 0.0025)); mixInto(out, t, 0, 0.5); return out; }

// ---- 銃声。o: { blast:秒, bright:Hz, boom:[f0,f1,秒,強さ], crack:超音速か, mech:機関部の周波数, tail:尾の長さ, loud }
const GUNS = {

  p45: { b: 0.11, br: 5600, tau: 0.011, boom: [150, 60, 0.15, 0.85], crack: false, mech: 2700, tail: 0.24, sat: 1.4 },

function gunNear(sr, seed, k) {
  const g = GUNS[k], r = rng(seed);
  const out = buf(sr, 0.5);
  mixInto(out, blast(sr, r, g.b, g.br * (0.92 + r() * 0.16), g.tau * (0.9 + r() * 0.2)), 0, 1.0);
  // 2つ目の短い破裂（銃口の跳ね返り）で厚みを出す
  mixInto(out, blast(sr, r, g.b * 0.6, g.br * 0.5, g.tau * 1.8), S(sr, 0.0015), 0.45);
  const [f0, f1, bd, bg] = g.boom;
  mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, f0 * (0.95 + r() * 0.1), f1, bd, bg), 0, 1.0);
  if (g.crack) mixInto(out, crack(sr, r), 0, 0.55);
  mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, g.mech, 0.06, 0.35), S(sr, 0.028 + r() * 0.012), 1);
  // 短い尾（銃の近くの空気の揺れ）
  const tn = S(sr, g.tail); const tl = noise(tn, r); lp(tl, 1400, sr); hp(tl, 120, sr); mulEnv(tl, expEnv(tn, sr, 0.004, g.tail * 0.22)); mixInto(out, tl, S(sr, 0.004), 0.22);
  sat(out, g.sat);
  return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.95), sr);
}
// 遠くの銃声: 高い音が抜けて、尾が長い。小銃はクラックが先に届く
function gunFar(sr, seed, kind) {
  const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 1.4);
  const rifle = kind === 'r', sg = kind === 's';
  if (rifle) mixInto(out, crack(sr, r, 0.0011), 0, 0.5);
  const at = rifle ? S(sr, 0.012) : 0;
  const n = S(sr, 0.35); const b = noise(n, r); lp(b, sg ? 700 : rifle ? 1300 : 1000, sr); hp(b, 60, sr); mulEnv(b, expEnv(n, sr, 0.003, sg ? 0.07 : 0.05)); mixInto(out, b, at, 1);
  mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, sg ? 80 : 100, 40, 0.35, 1.1), at, 1);
  // こだま
  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { const m = S(sr, 0.5); const e = noise(m, r); lp(e, 500 - k * 70, sr); mulEnv(e, expEnv(m, sr, 0.01, 0.12)); mixInto(out, e, at + S(sr, 0.12 + k * 0.17 + r() * 0.05), 0.35 / (k + 1)); }
  return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.9), sr, 0.0005, 0.05);
}
// 消音器付き: 爆風は弱く「パシュッ」、機関部の音が目立つ。小銃は弾のクラックが残る
function gunSupp(sr, seed, kind) {
  const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.35);
  const n = S(sr, 0.08); const p = noise(n, r); bp(p, kind === 'r' ? 1500 : 1100, 0.8, sr); mulEnv(p, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0006, 0.012)); mixInto(out, p, 0, 1);
  mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 140, 70, 0.08, 0.5), 0, 1);
  if (kind === 'r') mixInto(out, crack(sr, r), 0, 0.5);
  mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, kind === 'r' ? 2500 : 3100, 0.07, 0.8), S(sr, 0.018), 1);
  mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1900, 0.05, 0.45), S(sr, 0.05), 1);
  return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.75), sr);
}
// ビーンバッグ（弱い装薬の散弾）・ペッパーボール（圧縮空気）・テーザー
function beanShot(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.35); mixInto(out, blast(sr, r, 0.1, 3800, 0.012), 0, 1); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 120, 50, 0.18, 1), 0, 1); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1800, 0.05, 0.3), S(sr, 0.03), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(sat(out, 1.3), 0.85), sr); }
// M320（40mm）: 低い「ポン」と、筒の響き
function launchShot(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.6); mixInto(out, blast(sr, r, 0.12, 2400, 0.02), 0, 0.8); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 85, 38, 0.32, 1.4), 0, 1); const n = S(sr, 0.4); const t = noise(n, r); bp(t, 420, 2.5, sr); mulEnv(t, expEnv(n, sr, 0.004, 0.12)); mixInto(out, t, S(sr, 0.01), 0.5); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1500, 0.06, 0.4), S(sr, 0.04), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(sat(out, 1.4), 0.9), sr); }
function airShot(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.22); const n = S(sr, 0.09); const p = noise(n, r); bp(p, 1800, 0.7, sr); mulEnv(p, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0008, 0.02)); mixInto(out, p, 0, 1); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 220, 120, 0.05, 0.4), 0, 1); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 2800, 0.04, 0.4), S(sr, 0.03), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.7), sr); }
function taserShot(sr, seed) {
  const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 1.4);
  mixInto(out, airShot(sr, seed + 1), 0, 0.6);
  // バチバチという電気の音（19回/秒のパルス）
  for (let k = 0; k < 24; k++) { const m = S(sr, 0.02); const z = noise(m, r); hp(z, 2000, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(m, sr, 0.0002, 0.003)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.08 + k / 19 + r() * 0.004), 0.8); }
  const hn = S(sr, 1.3); const hm = sine(hn, sr, 2600); for (let i = 0; i < hn; i++) hm[i] = Math.sign(hm[i]) * 0.15; mulEnv(hm, env(hn, sr, 0.05, 1.2, 1)); mixInto(out, hm, S(sr, 0.08), 0.3);
  return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.8), sr);
}

// ---- 足音（材質ごと）: かかと→つま先＋装備がこすれる音
function step(sr, seed, kind) {
  const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.32);
  const P = { hard: [1900, 1.3, 90, 0.9], tile: [2600, 1.6, 110, 1], wood: [900, 1.0, 85, 1], soft: [700, 0.7, 70, 0.45], grass: [2400, 0.6, 60, 0.5], dirt: [1200, 0.8, 70, 0.6], metal: [1500, 2.5, 120, 1.1] }[kind] || [1500, 1, 90, 1];
  const [f, q, tf, g] = P;
  for (const [t, gg] of [[0, 1], [0.04 + r() * 0.025, 0.55]]) {
    const m = S(sr, 0.09);
    const nz = noise(m, r); bp(nz, f * (0.85 + r() * 0.3), q, sr); mulEnv(nz, expEnv(m, sr, 0.0008, kind === 'soft' ? 0.02 : 0.012));
    mixInto(out, nz, S(sr, t), gg * g);
    mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, tf * (0.9 + r() * 0.2), tf * 0.6, 0.07, 0.6), S(sr, t), gg);
  }
  if (kind === 'grass' || kind === 'dirt') { const m = S(sr, 0.15); const z = noise(m, r); hp(z, 3000, sr); mulEnv(z, env(m, sr, 0.02, 0.12, 2)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.01), 0.35); }
  if (kind === 'wood' && r() < 0.5) { const m = S(sr, 0.12); const s = sine(m, sr, 420 + r() * 200, 380); mulEnv(s, env(m, sr, 0.02, 0.1, 2)); mixInto(out, s, S(sr, 0.05), 0.12); }
  if (kind === 'metal') mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 900 + r() * 300, 0.12, 0.5), 0, 1);
  // 装備のこすれ（ポーチ・スリング）
  const m = S(sr, 0.12); const z = noise(m, r); bp(z, 3500, 1.2, sr); mulEnv(z, env(m, sr, 0.01, 0.1, 2)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.02 + r() * 0.04), 0.12);
  return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.8), sr);
}

// ---- 当たった音
function impact(sr, seed, kind) {
  const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, kind === 'metal' ? 0.4 : 0.25);
  if (kind === 'metal') { mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1800 + r() * 1500, 0.35, 1), 0, 1); const n = S(sr, 0.3); const s = sine(n, sr, 3000 + r() * 2500, 2500); mulEnv(s, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0005, 0.06)); mixInto(out, s, 0, 0.3); }
  else if (kind === 'wood') { const n = S(sr, 0.12); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 800 + r() * 400, 1.1, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0005, 0.018)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 1); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 220, 120, 0.06, 0.5), 0, 1); }
  else if (kind === 'glass') { for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const n = S(sr, 0.05); const s = sine(n, sr, 3500 + r() * 5000); mulEnv(s, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0003, 0.01)); mixInto(out, s, S(sr, r() * 0.12), 0.4); } const n = S(sr, 0.05); const z = noise(n, r); hp(z, 4000, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0003, 0.008)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 0.8); }
  else if (kind === 'soft') { const n = S(sr, 0.08); const z = noise(n, r); lp(z, 900, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0008, 0.015)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 1); }
  else { // 硬い（コンクリ・レンガ）: 欠ける音と砂の落ちる音
    const n = S(sr, 0.06); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 2200 + r() * 1200, 0.9, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0003, 0.007)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 1);
    const m = S(sr, 0.2); const g = noise(m, r); hp(g, 2500, sr); mulEnv(g, env(m, sr, 0.01, 0.18, 2)); mixInto(out, g, S(sr, 0.01), 0.18);
  }
  return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.75), sr);
}
function fleshHit(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.18); const n = S(sr, 0.1); const z = noise(n, r); lp(z, 1200, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0006, 0.018)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 1); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 110, 60, 0.1, 0.9), 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(sat(out, 1.5), 0.8), sr); }
function plateHit(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.3); mixInto(out, fleshHit(sr, seed), 0, 0.6); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1300 + r() * 400, 0.25, 1.1), 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.85), sr); }
// 弾がそばを抜ける（パシッ＋ヒュン）
function whiz(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.25); mixInto(out, crack(sr, r, 0.0009), 0, 0.9); const n = S(sr, 0.18); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 2600 + r() * 1500, 2.5, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.01, 0.16, 2)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.004), 0.6); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.8), sr); }
function shellCase(sr, seed, sg) {
  const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.5);
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { const n = S(sr, 0.12); const t = S(sr, k * (0.07 + r() * 0.05)); if (sg) { const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 700, 1.5, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0005, 0.015)); mixInto(out, z, t, 0.8 / (k + 1)); } else { const s = sine(n, sr, 4200 + r() * 2200); mulEnv(s, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0002, 0.03)); mixInto(out, s, t, 0.6 / (k + 1)); const s2 = sine(n, sr, 7900 + r() * 1500); mulEnv(s2, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0002, 0.015)); mixInto(out, s2, t, 0.25 / (k + 1)); } }
  return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.6), sr);
}
// ---- 扉
function latch(sr, r) { const o = buf(sr, 0.12); mixInto(o, clack(sr, r, 1500, 0.06, 1), 0, 1); mixInto(o, clack(sr, r, 2100, 0.05, 0.7), S(sr, 0.05), 1); return o; }
function creak(sr, r, dur, base) {
  const n = S(sr, dur), out = new Float32Array(n);
  let t = 0, k = 0;
  while (t < dur - 0.02) { const f = base * (0.85 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 7 + r()) ); const m = S(sr, 0.012); const s = sine(m, sr, f * 3, f * 2.7); mulEnv(s, expEnv(m, sr, 0.0005, 0.004)); mixInto(out, s, S(sr, t), 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t / dur * Math.PI)); t += 1 / (f * 0.12) * (0.8 + r() * 0.4); if (++k > 4000) break; }
  bp(out, base * 3, 1.3, sr);
  return out;
}
function doorOpen(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 1.0); mixInto(out, latch(sr, r), 0, 1); if (r() < 0.7) mixInto(out, creak(sr, r, 0.7, 260 + r() * 140), S(sr, 0.08), 0.35); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.7), sr); }
function doorClose(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.4); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 120, 60, 0.15, 1), 0, 1); const n = S(sr, 0.1); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 600, 1, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(n, sr, 0.001, 0.02)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 0.7); mixInto(out, latch(sr, r), S(sr, 0.01), 0.7); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.8), sr); }
function woodBang(sr, r, g = 1, dur = 0.5) { const out = buf(sr, dur); const n = S(sr, 0.2); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 500, 0.8, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0005, 0.03)); mixInto(out, z, 0, g); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 90, 45, 0.3, 1.2 * g), 0, 1); for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { const m = S(sr, 0.05); const s = noise(m, r); bp(s, 1500 + r() * 2000, 3, sr); mulEnv(s, expEnv(m, sr, 0.0005, 0.01)); mixInto(out, s, S(sr, 0.02 + r() * 0.15), 0.3 * g); } return out; }
function doorKick(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.9); mixInto(out, woodBang(sr, r, 1.2, 0.6), 0, 1); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1200, 0.1, 0.8), S(sr, 0.01), 1); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 100, 50, 0.2, 0.8), S(sr, 0.3), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(sat(out, 1.4), 0.92), sr); }
function doorKickFail(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.5); mixInto(out, woodBang(sr, r, 0.9, 0.5), 0, 1); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 900, 0.08, 0.5), 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.85), sr); }
function doorRam(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.9); mixInto(out, woodBang(sr, r, 1.4, 0.7), 0, 1); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 700, 0.2, 1.2), 0, 1); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 70, 35, 0.35, 1.2), 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(sat(out, 1.6), 0.95), sr); }
function doorBreach(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 1.0); mixInto(out, gunNear(sr, seed + 7, 'sg'), 0, 1); mixInto(out, woodBang(sr, r, 1, 0.7), S(sr, 0.02), 0.8); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1000, 0.15, 0.9), S(sr, 0.03), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.95), sr); }
function doorLocked(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.45); for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1300 + r() * 300, 0.07, 0.8), S(sr, k * 0.11 + r() * 0.02), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.7), sr); }
function lockPick(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.8); for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 3500 + r() * 2000, 0.03, 0.4 + r() * 0.4), S(sr, k * 0.07 + r() * 0.03), 1); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1600, 0.08, 1), S(sr, 0.68), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.6), sr); }
function wedge(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.4); const n = S(sr, 0.25); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 1200, 1.2, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.03, 0.2, 1.5)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 0.6); mixInto(out, woodBang(sr, r, 0.4, 0.3), S(sr, 0.18), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.65), sr); }

// ---- 爆発物・投げ物
function boom(sr, seed, big) {
  const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, big ? 2.4 : 1.6);
  mixInto(out, blast(sr, r, 0.6, 5000, big ? 0.08 : 0.05), 0, 1);
  mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, big ? 55 : 70, 25, big ? 1.6 : 1.0, 1.6), 0, 1);
  const n = S(sr, big ? 2.2 : 1.4); const rb = noise(n, r); lp(rb, 300, sr); mulEnv(rb, expEnv(n, sr, 0.02, big ? 0.5 : 0.3)); mixInto(out, rb, S(sr, 0.02), 0.9);
  for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) { const m = S(sr, 0.04); const z = noise(m, r); bp(z, 1000 + r() * 3000, 2, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(m, sr, 0.0005, 0.01)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.1 + r() * 0.9), 0.25); }
  return fadeEdges(normalize(sat(out, 2.2), 0.98), sr, 0.0005, 0.1);
}
function flashBang(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 1.6); mixInto(out, blast(sr, r, 0.35, 12000, 0.03), 0, 1.2); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 90, 40, 0.5, 1.3), 0, 1); const n = S(sr, 1.4); const rb = noise(n, r); lp(rb, 900, sr); mulEnv(rb, expEnv(n, sr, 0.01, 0.25)); mixInto(out, rb, 0, 0.5); return fadeEdges(normalize(sat(out, 2.5), 0.98), sr); }
function stingerBang(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 1.4); mixInto(out, flashBang(sr, seed), 0, 0.8); for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) { const m = S(sr, 0.03); const z = noise(m, r); bp(z, 2000 + r() * 3000, 3, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(m, sr, 0.0003, 0.006)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.03 + r() * 0.5), 0.3); } return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.95), sr); }
function gasPop(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 2.5); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1100, 0.1, 1), 0, 1); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 160, 90, 0.1, 0.6), 0, 1); const n = S(sr, 2.3); const h = noise(n, r); hp(h, 1800, sr); bp(h, 4500, 0.7, sr); mulEnv(h, env(n, sr, 0.15, 2.0, 1.2)); mixInto(out, h, S(sr, 0.12), 0.7); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.75), sr); }
function nadeBounce(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.2); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 900 + r() * 500, 0.12, 1), 0, 1); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 180, 100, 0.05, 0.4), 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.6), sr); }
function throwW(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.35); const n = S(sr, 0.3); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 900, 0.9, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.12, 0.17, 2)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.5), sr); }
// ---- 銃の扱い
function magOut(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.35); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1700, 0.05, 1), 0, 1); const n = S(sr, 0.18); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 2400, 1.5, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.02, 0.15, 2)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.04), 0.5); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.6), sr); }
function magIn(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.45); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1400, 0.06, 1), 0, 1); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 200, 120, 0.05, 0.5), 0, 1); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 2300, 0.07, 1.1), S(sr, 0.25), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.65), sr); }
function pump(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.45); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1100, 0.08, 1), 0, 1); const n = S(sr, 0.12); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 1600, 1.2, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.01, 0.1, 2)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.02), 0.5); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1300, 0.08, 1.1), S(sr, 0.2), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.7), sr); }
function shellIn(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.25); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1200 + r() * 200, 0.06, 0.8), 0, 1); const n = S(sr, 0.08); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 1800, 1.5, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.01, 0.07, 2)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.03), 0.4); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.55), sr); }
function dry(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.12); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 2200, 0.08, 1), 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.5), sr); }
function cloth(sr, seed, dur = 0.3, f = 2600) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, dur); const n = S(sr, dur); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, f, 1.1, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, dur * 0.25, dur * 0.7, 2)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.4), sr); }
function draw(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.4); mixInto(out, cloth(sr, seed, 0.25), 0, 0.8); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 1900, 0.06, 0.7), S(sr, 0.22), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.5), sr); }
function cuffs(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.7); for (let k = 0; k < 14; k++) { const m = S(sr, 0.015); const z = noise(m, r); bp(z, 3000 + k * 60, 4, sr); mulEnv(z, expEnv(m, sr, 0.0002, 0.003)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.05 + k * 0.035), 0.8); } return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.55), sr); }
function bandage(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.8); const n = S(sr, 0.6); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 2000, 0.8, sr); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) z[i] *= 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(i / sr * 60 + r()); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.05, 0.55, 1.2)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.5), sr); }
function sprayS(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.7); const n = S(sr, 0.6); const z = noise(n, r); hp(z, 2500, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.03, 0.55, 1.2)); mixInto(out, z, 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.55), sr); }
function glassBreak(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 1.0); mixInto(out, impact(sr, seed, 'glass'), 0, 1); for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) { const n = S(sr, 0.06); const s = sine(n, sr, 2500 + r() * 6500); mulEnv(s, expEnv(n, sr, 0.0003, 0.012)); mixInto(out, s, S(sr, 0.05 + r() * 0.7), 0.25 * (1 - k / 40)); } return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.8), sr); }
function wallBreak(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.9); mixInto(out, impact(sr, seed, 'hard'), 0, 1); const n = S(sr, 0.8); const z = noise(n, r); lp(z, 1800, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.02, 0.75, 2)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.03), 0.6); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 120, 60, 0.2, 0.6), 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.85), sr); }
function reinforce(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.9); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 600, 0.4, 1.3), 0, 1); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 800, 0.3, 1), S(sr, 0.35), 1); const n = S(sr, 0.3); const z = noise(n, r); hp(z, 3000, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.02, 0.28, 2)); mixInto(out, z, S(sr, 0.5), 0.4); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.75), sr); }
function hammer(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 1.1); for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) mixInto(out, woodBang(sr, r, 0.6, 0.25), S(sr, k * 0.26), 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.7), sr); }
function droneLoop(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 1.0); const n = out.length; const a = sine(n, sr, 180, 180); const b = sine(n, sr, 362, 362); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = (Math.sign(a[i]) * 0.3 + b[i] * 0.2) * (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(i / sr * TAU * 8)); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 900, 2, sr); mixInto(out, z, 0, 0.3); lp(out, 2500, sr); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const t = i / sr; out[i] *= Math.min(1, t / 0.06) * Math.min(1, (1.0 - t) / 0.3); } return normalize(out, 0.4); }
function nvgWhine(sr, seed) { const out = buf(sr, 0.6); const n = out.length; const s = sine(n, sr, 3000, 9000); mulEnv(s, env(n, sr, 0.3, 0.3, 1)); mixInto(out, s, 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.18), sr); }
function ring(sr) { const out = buf(sr, 4.0); const n = out.length; const s = sine(n, sr, 4100, 3950); mulEnv(s, env(n, sr, 0.05, 3.9, 1.6)); mixInto(out, s, 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.5), sr); }
function landS(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.3); mixInto(out, thump(sr, r, 90, 45, 0.2, 1), 0, 1); mixInto(out, step(sr, seed, 'hard'), 0, 0.6); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.8), sr); }
function radioClick(sr, seed, on) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 0.18); const n = S(sr, on ? 0.1 : 0.16); const z = noise(n, r); bp(z, 2200, 0.7, sr); mulEnv(z, env(n, sr, 0.003, n / sr - 0.004, on ? 4 : 1)); mixInto(out, z, 0, on ? 0.6 : 0.9); mixInto(out, clack(sr, r, 2600, 0.03, 0.5), 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, 0.45), sr); }
function beep(sr, f = 1500, d = 0.08, g = 0.5) { const out = buf(sr, d + 0.02); const n = S(sr, d); const s = sine(n, sr, f); mulEnv(s, env(n, sr, 0.004, d - 0.004, 1)); mixInto(out, s, 0, 1); return fadeEdges(normalize(out, g), sr); }
function tones(sr, list, g = 0.5) { const tot = list.reduce((m, [, t, d]) => Math.max(m, t + d), 0) + 0.05; const out = buf(sr, tot); for (const [f, t, d, gg = 1] of list) { const n = S(sr, d); const s = sine(n, sr, f); const s2 = sine(n, sr, f * 2); mixInto(s, s2, 0, 0.25); mulEnv(s, env(n, sr, 0.006, d - 0.006, 1.6)); mixInto(out, s, S(sr, t), gg); } return fadeEdges(normalize(out, g), sr); }
// 環境音（ループ）: 屋外の夜（虫と遠くの車）・屋内の蛍光灯と空調
function ambOut(sr, seed) {
  const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 6.0), n = out.length;
  const z = noise(n, r); lp(z, 400, sr); mixInto(out, z, 0, 0.5);
  for (let k = 0; k < 90; k++) { const m = S(sr, 0.05); const s = sine(m, sr, 4200 + r() * 600); for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) s[i] *= Math.max(0, Math.sin(i / m * Math.PI)) * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sign(Math.sin(i / sr * TAU * 60))); mixInto(out, s, S(sr, r() * 5.9), 0.05); }
  // 端を重ねてつなぎ目をなくす
  return loopify(normalize(out, 0.35), sr);
}
function ambIn(sr, seed) { const r = rng(seed), out = buf(sr, 4.0), n = out.length; const h = sine(n, sr, 120); const h2 = sine(n, sr, 240); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = h[i] * 0.25 + h2[i] * 0.12; const z = noise(n, r); lp(z, 600, sr); hp(z, 80, sr); mixInto(out, z, 0, 0.5); return loopify(normalize(out, 0.3), sr); }
function loopify(x, sr) { const L = S(sr, 0.25), n = x.length; for (let i = 0; i < L; i++) { const t = i / L; x[i] = x[i] * t + x[n - L + i] * (1 - t); } return x.subarray(0, n - L); }

export function gunKeys(snd) {
  const rifle = snd && snd[0] === 'r' || snd === 'p46' || snd === 'p57' || snd === 'h57' || snd === 'h357';
  if (snd === 'sup9') return { near: 'sup_p', far: 'sup_p', supp: 'sup_p' };
  if (snd === 'bean') return { near: 'bean', far: 'far_s', supp: 'bean' };
  if (snd === 'air') return { near: 'air', far: 'air', supp: 'air' };
  if (snd === 'taser') return { near: 'taser', far: 'taser', supp: 'taser' };
  return { near: GUNS[snd] ? snd : 'p9', far: snd === 'sg' ? 'far_s' : rifle ? 'far_r' : 'far_p', supp: rifle && snd[0] === 'r' ? 'sup_r' : 'sup_p' };
}

// 人（隊員・容疑者・市民・ボット・プレイヤー）。状態は関数を含まないデータだけ。
import { WEAPONS, attachOptions } from './data/weapons.js';
import { PLATE, HELMET, GEAR, LONG } from './data/equipment.js';

export const KIND = { SWAT: 'swat', SUS: 'sus', CIV: 'civ', BOT: 'bot' };

// 武器を1丁持たせる
export function makeWeapon(o) {
  if (!o || !o.id || !WEAPONS[o.id]) return null;
  const W = WEAPONS[o.id];
  const am = o.ammo && W.ammo.includes(o.ammo) ? o.ammo : W.ammo[0];
  // 付けられないアタッチメントは外す（通信で来た装備も同じ）
  const ao = attachOptions(o.id);
  const okA = (k, v, d) => (v && ao[k] && ao[k].includes(v) ? v : d);
  const w = { id: o.id, att: { sight: okA('sight', o.sight, 'iron'), muzzle: W.integral ? W.integral : okA('muzzle', o.muzzle, 'none'), grip: okA('grip', o.grip, 'none'), light: o.light !== false }, am, mode: 0, lightOn: false };
  if (W.tube || W.breakAction) { w.mag = W.mag; w.ch = W.chamber ? 1 : 0; w.res = W.spare; w.mags = null; }
  else { w.mag = W.mag; w.ch = W.chamber ? 1 : 0; w.mags = []; for (let i = 0; i < (o.spare ?? W.spare); i++) w.mags.push(W.mag); w.res = 0; }
  return w;
}

// 装備の定義から持ち物を作る
export function makeInventory(lo) {
  const inv = {
    w: [makeWeapon(lo.primary), makeWeapon(lo.secondary)],
    gear: [], long: lo.long && LONG[lo.long] ? lo.long : 'none', longN: 0,
    always: { cuffs: 99, chem: 8 },
  };
  for (const [id, n] of (lo.gear || [])) if (GEAR[id] && n > 0) inv.gear.push({ id, n: Math.min(n, GEAR[id].max) });
  if (inv.long === 'm320') inv.m320 = { ...LONG.m320.rounds, sel: 'flash' };
  return inv;
}

export function makeArmor(lo) {
  const vest = lo.vest || 'none', plate = PLATE[lo.plate] ? lo.plate : 'ceramic';
  const P = PLATE[plate];
  return { vest, plate, pf: P.hits || 0, pb: P.hits || 0, helm: (HELMET[lo.helmet] || HELMET.none).dur, helmet: lo.helmet || 'none', head: lo.head || 'none', face: lo.head === 'facemask' ? 2 : 0 };
}

    stun: 0, flash: 0, gas: 0, tased: 0, deaf: 0, supp: 0, bleed: 0, inj: { arm: 0, leg: 0, head: 0 }, flinch: 0,

  if (!a.inv.w[0] && a.inv.w[1]) a.ws.slot = 1;

export function curWeapon(a) { const s = a.ws.slot; return s >= 0 ? a.inv.w[s] : null; }
export function curW(a) { const w = curWeapon(a); return w ? WEAPONS[w.id] : null; }
export function holdOf(a) {
  if (a.cuffed || a.comply || a.down || a.dead) return 'none';
  if (a.ws.slot === 2) return 'none';
  // 特殊装備: オプティワンドは片手、ほかは両手で
  if (a.ws.slot === 3) return a.inv.long === 'wand' ? 'pistol' : 'rifle';
  const W = curW(a);
  if (!W) return 'none';
  return W.cat === 'pistol' || (W.cat === 'less' && W.model === 'taser') ? 'pistol' : W.cat === 'shotgun' ? 'shotgun' : W.cat === 'smg' ? 'smg' : 'rifle';
}
// 体の状態 → 姿勢の名前
export function poseState(a) {
  if (a.dead) return 'dead';
  if (a.down) return 'down';
  if (a.cuffed) return 'cuffed';
  if (a.comply === 2) return 'kneel';
  if (a.comply === 1) return 'hands';
  if (a.stun > 0 || a.flash > 0.4 || a.tased > 0) return 'stun';
  if (a.ai && a.ai.cower) return 'cower';
  if (a.inv.long === 'shield' && a.ws.slot === 1 && !a.vault) return 'shield';
  return 'normal';
}
// 立っている高さ
export function bodyHeight(a) { return a.st < 1 ? 1.8 - 0.6 * a.st : 1.2 - 0.7 * (a.st - 1); }
export function isThreatCapable(a) { return a.alive && !a.down && !a.cuffed && !a.comply; }
// 弾倉の合計
export function ammoCount(w) {
  if (!w) return [0, 0];
  if (w.mags) return [w.mag + (w.ch || 0), w.mags.reduce((s, m) => s + m, 0)];
  return [w.mag + (w.ch || 0), w.res];
}

// 対戦のボット: TDM（敵を探して撃つ）、殲滅戦（慎重に）、爆弾（攻撃: 場所へ行って設置・守る／防衛: 準備で補強とバリケード、場所を守る、解除）
import { baseInput, pushAct, visibility, detect, lastSeen, seenAgo, goTo, aimAt, trigger, hearNearest, randomCellInRoom, roomAtPos, angDiff, yawTo, turnToward, SKILL } from './common.js';
import { navCell, cellCenter, buildNav, roomGraph } from './nav.js';
import { eyeOf } from '../combat.js';
import { curW, curWeapon, ammoCount } from '../actor.js';
import { hrand } from '../rng.js';
import { CS, LH, NB, C, levelOfY } from '../world.js';
import { M } from '../data/materials.js';
import { isOpen, isClosed, sideOf } from '../doors.js';
import { doorOps, reachOK } from '../interact.js';

const sec = (S, t0) => (S.t - t0) * S.dt;

export function thinkBot(S, w, a, dt, ctx) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  const inp = baseInput(a);
  if (!a.alive) return inp;
  const sk = SKILL['bot' + (S.rules.botLevel || 2)] || SKILL.bot2;
  const m = S.m || {};
  if (a.down) { inp.mx = 0; inp.mz = 0; return inp; } // ダウン中は這わない（簡単に）
  ai.stT = (ai.stT || 0) + dt;
  // 敵を見る
  let tgt = null, td = 1e9;
  for (const b of ctx.enemies) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    const v = visibility(S, w, a, b, { fov: 90, maxD: 60 });
    if (detect(S, a, b, v, dt)) {
      const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
      if (d < td) { td = d; tgt = b; }
      // 味方に知らせる
      const intel = m.intel || (m.intel = {});
      intel[a.team] = { x: b.x, y: b.y, z: b.z, t: S.t, id: b.id };
    }
  }
  if (tgt) {
    if (ai.engId !== tgt.id) {
      ai.engId = tgt.id; ai.engT = S.t; ai.engD = sk.react[0] + (sk.react[1] - sk.react[0]) * hrand(a.id, S.t, 201);
      // 角を押さえて待っている（止まって、その方向を見ていた）側は早く正確に撃てる（覗き込む側が不利）
      const ang = Math.abs(angDiff(a.yaw, yawTo(tgt.x - a.x, tgt.z - a.z)));
      ai.holdK = ang < 0.45 && Math.hypot(a.vx, a.vz) < 0.5 ? 0.6 : 1;
      ai.engD *= ai.holdK;
    }
    const ty = tgt.y + (tgt.down ? 0.25 : tgt.st > 1.5 ? 0.3 : tgt.st > 0.5 ? 0.95 : 1.3);
    // 頭か胴か（腕前で頭を狙う割合）
    const head = hrand(a.id, Math.floor(S.t / 60), 202) < (S.rules.botLevel >= 3 ? 0.35 : 0.15);
    const off = aimAt(S, a, inp, tgt.x, head ? tgt.y + bodyHead(tgt) : ty, tgt.z, sk, dt, { id: tgt.id, errMul: sec(S, ai.engT) < 1.5 ? (ai.holdK || 1) : 1 });
    inp.ads = td > 4;
    if (sec(S, ai.engT) >= ai.engD) trigger(S, a, inp, sk, off < 0.07 + (td < 5 ? 0.1 : 0));
    // 動き: 横へ、遠ければしゃがむ
    if (sec(S, ai.engT) > 0.6) {
      const ph = Math.floor(S.t / 45);
      const side = hrand(a.id, ph, 203) < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
      if (hrand(a.id, ph, 204) < 0.55) inp.mx = side * 0.7;
      if (td > 14 && hrand(a.id, ph, 205) < 0.4) inp.stance = 1;
    }
    ai.lastEnemy = [tgt.x, tgt.y, tgt.z];
    return inp;
  }
  ai.engId = null;
  // 弾が少なければ安全なうちにリロード
  const wi = curWeapon(a), W = curW(a);
  if (wi && W) { const [mag] = ammoCount(wi); if (mag < Math.max(1, W.mag * 0.4) && a.ws.st === 'ready') pushAct(inp, { a: 'reload' }); }
  // モードの目的
  if (m.kind === 'bomb') return bombThink(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx, sk);
  return huntThink(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx, m.kind === 'elim');
}
function bodyHead(b) { return b.down ? 0.3 : b.st > 1.5 ? 0.42 : b.st > 0.5 ? 1.1 : 1.62; }

// 敵を探す: 味方の目撃・聞こえた銃声・最後に見た所・マップのあちこち
function huntThink(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx, careful) {
  const ai = a.ai, m = S.m;
  let goal = null;
  const intel = m.intel && m.intel[a.team];
  if (intel && sec(S, intel.t) < 10) goal = [intel.x, intel.y, intel.z];
  const h = hearNearest(S, w, a, 40, (x) => x.k === 'shot' && x.team !== a.team);
  if (h && (!goal || hrand(a.id, S.t, 210) < 0.5)) goal = [h.x, h.y, h.z];
  if (!goal && ai.lastEnemy) { goal = ai.lastEnemy; if (Math.hypot(goal[0] - a.x, goal[2] - a.z) < 2) ai.lastEnemy = null; }
  if (!goal) {
    if (!ai.wander || sec(S, ai.wanderT) > 30) {
      const rooms = w.rooms.filter(r => r.cells.length > 10);
      const r = rooms[Math.floor(hrand(a.id, S.t, 211) * rooms.length)];
      const c = r ? randomCellInRoom(S, w, r.id, a.id) : null;
      ai.wander = c ? [c[0], c[1], c[2]] : null; ai.wanderT = S.t;
    }
    goal = ai.wander;
  }
  if (!goal) return inp;
  const far = Math.hypot(goal[0] - a.x, goal[2] - a.z) > 14;
  const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, goal[0], goal[1], goal[2], { speed: careful ? 0.75 : 1, r: 1.0, unlock: true });
  if (r === 'arrived' || r === 'blocked') { ai.wander = null; if (ai.lastEnemy && goal === ai.lastEnemy) ai.lastEnemy = null; }
  inp.sprint = !careful && far && r === 'moving' && a.hp > 50;
  // 慎重なとき: ときどき止まって見回す
  if (careful && hrand(a.id, Math.floor(S.t / 90), 212) < 0.25) { inp.mx = inp.mz = 0; inp.yaw = a.yaw + 0.9 * dt; }
  return inp;
}

// 爆弾
function bombThink(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx, sk) {
  const ai = a.ai, m = S.m;
  const att = a.team === m.att;
  if (m.phase === 'prep') {
    if (att) { inp.mx = inp.mz = 0; inp.yaw = a.yaw + Math.sin(S.t * 0.02 + a.id) * 0.01; return inp; }
    return defendPrep(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx);
  }
  if (att) {
    const def = m.defuser || {};
    if (def.planted) return holdNear(S, w, a, inp, dt, def.x, def.y, def.z, 6);
    // 解除装置を持っている、または落ちている
    const item = S.items.find(it => it.kind === 'defuser' && !it.gone);
    if (item && !a.carry) {
      const nearest = S.actors.filter(b => b.team === a.team && b.alive && !b.down).sort((p, q) => Math.hypot(p.x - item.x, p.z - item.z) - Math.hypot(q.x - item.x, q.z - item.z))[0];
      if (nearest === a) {
        const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, item.x, item.y, item.z, { r: 0.5, unlock: true });
        if (Math.hypot(item.x - a.x, item.z - a.z) < 0.95) { inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(item.x - a.x, item.z - a.z), 6 * dt); pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'item', id: item.id, op: 'pickup' }); }
        return inp;
      }
    }
    const site = m.sites[m.target ?? (m.target = Math.floor(hrand(m.round || 1, 7, 220) * m.sites.length))];
    if (!site) return inp;
    if (a.carry === 'defuser') {
      const dd = Math.hypot(site.x - a.x, site.z - a.z);
      if (dd < site.r * 0.7 && levelOfY(a.y + 0.2) === site.L) {
        if (!a.act) pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'site', id: site.id, op: 'plant' });
        inp.mx = inp.mz = 0; inp.stance = 1;
        return inp;
      }
      // 味方が先に入ってから
      const ahead = S.actors.filter(b => b.team === a.team && b !== a && b.alive && Math.hypot(b.x - site.x, b.z - site.z) < dd);
      const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, site.x, site.y, site.z, { speed: ahead.length ? 0.85 : 0.6, r: 0.6, unlock: true, breakBar: true });
      return inp;
    }
    // 運び手を守りながら場所へ
    const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, site.x + (hrand(a.id, 3, 221) - 0.5) * 3, site.y, site.z + (hrand(a.id, 4, 222) - 0.5) * 3, { speed: 0.9, r: 1.2, unlock: true, breakBar: true });
    inp.sprint = r === 'moving' && Math.hypot(site.x - a.x, site.z - a.z) > 18;
    return inp;
  }
  // 防衛
  const def = m.defuser || {};
  if (def.planted && !def.disabled) {
    const nearest = S.actors.filter(b => b.team === a.team && b.alive && !b.down).sort((p, q) => Math.hypot(p.x - def.x, p.z - def.z) - Math.hypot(q.x - def.x, q.z - def.z))[0];
    // 取り返し: 近くの敵を片づけてから外す（敵を見て2.5秒たつか、残りが少なくなったら外しに行く）
    const intel = m.intel && m.intel[a.team];
    const clear = !intel || sec(S, intel.t) > 2.5 || Math.hypot(intel.x - def.x, intel.z - def.z) > 12 || (def.t || 0) > 30;
    if (nearest === a && clear) {
      const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, def.x, def.y, def.z, { r: 0.75, unlock: true });
      if (Math.hypot(def.x - a.x, def.z - a.z) < 1.1) { inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(def.x - a.x, def.z - a.z), 6 * dt); if (!a.act) pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'site', id: -1, op: 'defuse' }); inp.mx = inp.mz = 0; inp.stance = 1; }
      return inp;
    }
    // ほかの隊員（と、まだ外しに行かない一番近い人）は、敵の見えた方へ寄って押し返す
    if (intel && sec(S, intel.t) < 6 && Math.hypot(intel.x - def.x, intel.z - def.z) < 14) {
      const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, intel.x, intel.y, intel.z, { speed: 0.7, r: 3.0, unlock: true });
      if (r !== 'moving') { inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(intel.x - a.x, intel.z - a.z), 5 * dt); inp.ads = true; }
      return inp;
    }
    return holdNear(S, w, a, inp, dt, def.x, def.y, def.z, 5);
  }
  const site = m.sites[a.ai.siteIdx ?? (a.ai.siteIdx = (a.ai.slot || 0) % m.sites.length)];
  return holdNear(S, w, a, inp, dt, site.x, site.y, site.z, 4.5);
}
// 場所の近くで角を見張る
function holdNear(S, w, a, inp, dt, x, y, z, R) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  if (!ai.hold || Math.hypot(ai.hold[0] - x, ai.hold[2] - z) > R + 2) {
    const room = roomAtPos(w, x, y, z);
    const rg = roomGraph(w);
    const ps = room >= 0 ? (rg.adj[room] || []).filter(p => p.type === 'door' || p.type === 'open') : [];
    const c = room >= 0 ? randomCellInRoom(S, w, room, a.id * 3 + 1) : null;
    ai.hold = c ? [c[0], c[1], c[2]] : [x, y, z];
    // 見る向き: 部屋の入口（扉）の1つ
    const p = ps.length ? ps[Math.floor(hrand(a.id, 5, 230) * ps.length)] : null;
    ai.watch = p ? [p.x, y + 1.3, p.z] : null;
  }
  const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, ai.hold[0], ai.hold[1], ai.hold[2], { r: 0.5, unlock: true });
  if (r !== 'moving') {
    inp.mx = inp.mz = 0;
    if (ai.watch) { inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(ai.watch[0] - a.x, ai.watch[2] - a.z), 3 * dt); inp.ads = true; }
    if (hrand(a.id, Math.floor(S.t / 120), 231) < 0.35) inp.stance = 1;
  }
  return inp;
}
// 防衛の準備: 場所のまわりの壁を補強し、扉にバリケード、罠
function defendPrep(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx) {
  const ai = a.ai, m = S.m;
  if (a.act) { inp.mx = inp.mz = 0; return inp; }
  const site = m.sites[ai.siteIdx ?? (ai.siteIdx = (ai.slot || 0) % m.sites.length)];
  // 仕事を決める: 補強できる壁 → バリケード → 罠
  if (!ai.job || ai.job.done) ai.job = pickPrepJob(S, w, a, site);
  const j = ai.job;
  if (!j) return holdNear(S, w, a, inp, dt, site.x, site.y, site.z, 4);
  const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, j.x, j.y, j.z, { r: 0.45, unlock: true, noDoors: j.kind !== 'wall' });
  // 手が届く所に来てから、向いて行う（届かないまま止まったら、その仕事はしばらく後回し）
  const can = j.kind === 'wall' ? reachOK(S, w, a, 'wall', j.k, 'reinforce') : reachOK(S, w, a, 'door', j.id, j.kind);
  if (can && (r !== 'moving' || Math.hypot(j.x - a.x, j.z - a.z) < 0.6)) {
    inp.mx = inp.mz = 0;
    inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(j.lx - a.x, j.lz - a.z), 6 * dt);
    inp.pitch = turnToward(a.pitch, 0, 3 * dt);
    if (Math.abs(angDiff(a.yaw, yawTo(j.lx - a.x, j.lz - a.z))) < 0.2) {
      if (j.kind === 'wall') pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'wall', id: j.k, q: 1, op: 'reinforce' });
      else pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'door', id: j.id, op: j.kind });
      j.done = true;
    }
  } else if (r === 'blocked' || (r !== 'moving' && !can && Math.hypot(j.x - a.x, j.z - a.z) < 0.6) || (j.t0 != null && (S.t - j.t0) * S.dt > 15)) {
    j.done = true;
    (ai.badJobs || (ai.badJobs = {}))[j.key] = S.t + Math.round(20 / S.dt);
  }
  if (j.t0 == null) j.t0 = S.t;
  return inp;
}
function pickPrepJob(S, w, a, site) {
  const m = S.m;
  const taken = new Set(S.actors.filter(b => b !== a && b.ai && b.ai.job && !b.ai.job.done).map(b => b.ai.job.key));
  // 届かなかった仕事はしばらく選ばない
  const bad = a.ai.badJobs || {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(bad)) if (S.t < bad[k]) taken.add(k);
  const room = roomAtPos(w, site.x, site.y, site.z);
  if (room < 0) return null;
  const r = w.rooms[room];
  // 補強: 部屋の外周の石膏・木の壁
  if ((m.reinfLeft ?? 0) > 0) {
    let best = null, bd = 1e9;
    for (let j = r.z0 - 1; j <= r.z1 + 1; j++) for (let i = r.x0 - 1; i <= r.x1 + 1; i++) {
      if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) continue;
      const k = w.idx(r.L, i, j);
      if (w.cell[k] !== C.WALL || S.reinf[k] || taken.has('w' + k)) continue;
      const mat = w.blocks[k * NB + 1];
      if (mat !== M.DRYWALL && mat !== M.WOOD) continue;
      // 部屋の内側の隣のマス
      let ni = -1, nj = -1;
      for (const [di, dj] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) { const k2 = w.idx(r.L, i + di, j + dj); if (i + di >= 0 && j + dj >= 0 && i + di < w.W && j + dj < w.D && w.roomAt[k2] === room) { ni = i + di; nj = j + dj; break; } }
      if (ni < 0) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot((i + 0.5) * CS - site.x, (j + 0.5) * CS - site.z) + hrand(a.id, k, 240) * 2;
      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = { kind: 'wall', k, key: 'w' + k, x: (ni + 0.5) * CS, y: r.L * LH, z: (nj + 0.5) * CS, lx: (i + 0.5) * CS, lz: (j + 0.5) * CS }; }
    }
    if (best) return best;
  }
  // バリケード: 部屋の扉
  const rg = roomGraph(w);
  for (const p of rg.adj[room] || []) {
    if (p.type !== 'door' || p.door < 0 || taken.has('d' + p.door)) continue;
    const ds = S.doors[p.door];
    if (!ds || ds.bar > 0 || ds.broken) continue;
    const d = w.doors[p.door];
    // 部屋の内側に立つ
    const inSide = sideOf(d, r.cx, r.cz);
    return { kind: 'bar', id: p.door, key: 'd' + p.door, x: d.cx + d.nx * inSide * 0.7, y: d.L * LH, z: d.cz + d.nz * inSide * 0.7, lx: d.cx, lz: d.cz };
  }
  return null;
}

// AI の入口: 命令を配り、種類ごとに考えて入力を作る。考えるのは数ステップに1回ずつ（交代で）、間は前の入力を少し続ける
import { thinkSuspect, thinkCiv } from './sus.js';
import { thinkSwat, takeOrders } from './swat.js';
import { thinkBot } from './bot.js';
import { baseInput, steerToward } from './common.js';
import { buildNav } from './nav.js';
import { leadThink } from './lead.js';

export function thinkAll(S, w, dt, ev) {
  const out = {};
  buildNav(w);
  leadThink(S, w, ev);
  takeOrders(S, w);
  const police = [], civs = [];
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    if (a.isDrone) continue;
    if (a.kind === 'swat' && a.alive && !a.down) police.push(a);
    else if (a.kind === 'civ') civs.push(a);
  }
  const ctx = { police, civs, others: S.actors };
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    if (!a.ai || a.pid != null || a.isDrone) continue;
    if (!a.alive) continue;
    let inp;
    const t = a.ai.type;
    if (t === 'sus') inp = thinkSuspect(S, w, a, dt, ctx);
    else if (t === 'civ') inp = thinkCiv(S, w, a, dt, ctx);
    else if (t === 'swat') inp = thinkSwat(S, w, a, dt, ctx);
    else if (t === 'bot') { ctx.enemies = S.actors.filter(b => b.team !== a.team && b.alive && !b.isDrone && b.kind !== 'civ'); inp = thinkBot(S, w, a, dt, ctx); }
    else inp = baseInput(a);
    // 味方の手の届く所をふさいでいる: 少しのあいだ脇へよける
    const y = a.ai.yieldTo;
    if (y) { if (S.t > y.until || a.act) a.ai.yieldTo = null; else if (a.ai.engId == null) makeWay(a, inp, y); }
    out[a.id] = inp;
  }
  S.shouts.length = 0;
  return out;
}

// 線分（よけてほしい人 → 手を当てる所）から垂直に 0.75m 離れる
function makeWay(a, inp, y) {
  const vx = y.tx - y.ax, vz = y.tz - y.az, L2 = vx * vx + vz * vz || 1;
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((a.x - y.ax) * vx + (a.z - y.az) * vz) / L2));
  const qx = y.ax + vx * t, qz = y.az + vz * t;
  let nx = a.x - qx, nz = a.z - qz, l = Math.hypot(nx, nz);
  if (l < 0.02) { const L = Math.sqrt(L2); nx = -vz / L; nz = vx / L; l = 1; }
  if (l > 0.75) { inp.mx = inp.mz = 0; return; }
  steerToward(a, inp, a.x + nx / l * (0.8 - l), a.z + nz / l * (0.8 - l), 0.7, false);
  inp.act = null;
}
// 前のステップの出来事から、聞こえる音を作る（AI の耳）
export function collectNoise(S, ev) {
  const H = [];
  for (const e of ev) {
    switch (e.e) {
      case 'shot': H.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, z: e.z, k: 'shot', loud: e.supp ? 0.35 : (e.loud || 1) * 1.6, id: e.id, team: S.byId[e.id] ? S.byId[e.id].team : -1 }); break;
      case 'step': if (e.loud > 0.4) H.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, z: e.z, k: 'step', loud: e.loud * 0.35, id: e.id, team: S.byId[e.id] ? S.byId[e.id].team : -1 }); break;
      case 'door': if (e.loud) { const a = S.byId[e.id]; H.push({ x: a ? a.x : 0, y: a ? a.y : 0, z: a ? a.z : 0, k: e.k === 'kickopen' || e.k === 'ram' || e.k === 'breach' ? 'breach' : 'door', loud: e.loud, id: e.id, team: a ? a.team : -1 }); } break;
      case 'nade': H.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, z: e.z, k: 'boom', loud: 2.0, id: e.by, team: -1 }); break;
      case 'boom': case 'c2': H.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, z: e.z, k: 'boom', loud: 2.5, id: e.by ?? -1, team: -1 }); break;
      case 'launch': { const a = S.byId[e.id]; if (a) H.push({ x: a.x, y: a.y + 1.4, z: a.z, k: 'shot', loud: 0.9, id: e.id, team: a.team }); break; }
      case 'shieldhit': H.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, z: e.z, k: 'shot', loud: 0.5, id: e.id, team: S.byId[e.id] ? S.byId[e.id].team : -1 }); break;
      case 'glass': break;
      case 'shout': H.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y - 1.6, z: e.z, k: 'shout', loud: 0.8, id: e.id, team: S.byId[e.id] ? S.byId[e.id].team : -1 }); break;
    }
  }
  S.heard = H;
}

// AIの共通の道具: 見る（明るさ・視野・見通し）、聞く、経路に沿って歩く（扉を開ける）、狙う（反応の遅れ・ぶれ・反動の抑え）
import { occluded, CS, LH, levelOfY, groundAt, leafEnd } from '../world.js';

export const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
export const angDiff = (a, b) => { let d = a - b; while (d > Math.PI) d -= TAU; while (d < -Math.PI) d += TAU; return d; };
export const yawTo = (dx, dz) => Math.atan2(dx, dz);
export const dist2 = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.z - b.z);
export const dist3 = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, (a.y - b.y) * 1.5, a.z - b.z);

// 難しさごとの腕前（反応の秒・狙いのぶれの度・回る速さ度/秒・反動を抑える割合）

export function baseInput(a) {
  return { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw: a.yaw, pitch: a.pitch, fire: false, ads: false, low: false, stance: a.stance | 0, lean: 0, sprint: false, act: null };
}
export function pushAct(inp, ac) { (inp.act || (inp.act = [])).push(ac); }

// その場所の明るさ（光の格子から作った表。0..2）
export function brightCell(w, x, y, z) {
  const b = w._bright;
  if (!b) return 0.6;
  const i = Math.floor(x / CS), j = Math.floor(z / CS);
  if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) return 0.6;
  const L = Math.max(0, Math.min(w.NL - 1, Math.floor((y + 0.4) / LH)));
  return b[w.idx(L, i, j)];
}

// a から b が見えるか（そのときの見えやすさ 0..1。0は見えない）
export function visibility(S, w, a, b, opt = {}) {
  if (!b.alive && !opt.dead) return 0;
  const e = eyeOf(S, a);
  const bx = b.x, bz = b.z, by = b.y + (b.down || b.dead ? 0.25 : b.st > 1.5 ? 0.3 : b.st > 0.5 ? 0.95 : 1.35);
  const dx = bx - e[0], dy = by - e[1], dz = bz - e[2];
  const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
  const maxD = opt.maxD || 45;
  if (d > maxD) return 0;
  // 視野
  const fov = (opt.fov || 75) * Math.PI / 180;
  const ang = Math.abs(angDiff(yawTo(dx, dz), a.yaw));
  if (ang > fov && d > 1.8) return 0;
  // 見通し（胸と頭）
  const blocked1 = occluded(w, e[0], e[1], e[2], bx, by, bz, S.doors, true);
  if (blocked1) {
    const hy = b.y + (b.st > 1.5 ? 0.45 : b.st > 0.5 ? 1.15 : 1.65);
    if (occluded(w, e[0], e[1], e[2], bx, hy, bz, S.doors, true)) return 0;
  }
  // 明るさ: 暗いと見えにくい（ライトや暗視があれば別）
  let L = Math.min(1, brightCell(w, bx, b.y + 1, bz) * 2.2);
  if (b.light) L = Math.max(L, 0.95); // 自分のライトで目立つ
  if (a.light && ang < 0.35 && d < 18) L = Math.max(L, 0.9); // ライトで照らしている
  if (a.nvg || (a.armor && a.armor.head === 'nvg' && a.nvgOn)) L = Math.max(L, 0.85);
  if (b.fireK > 0.3) L = 1; // 撃った光
  let v = Math.max(0.12, L);
  // 姿勢・動き・距離・視野の端
  v *= b.st > 1.5 ? 0.45 : b.st > 0.5 ? 0.75 : 1;
  v *= b.spd > 1.0 ? 1.15 : 1;
  v *= d < 6 ? 1 : d < 20 ? 0.85 : 0.6;
  v *= ang < 0.5 ? 1 : 0.7;
  if (a.flash > 0.4) v *= 0.05;
  if (a.gas > 0 && !(a.armor && a.armor.head === 'gasmask')) v *= 0.6;
  return Math.min(1, v);
}

// 見つける度合いを貯める（見えている間）。戻り値: 見つけたか
export function detect(S, a, b, vis, dt) {
  const mem = a.ai.seen || (a.ai.seen = {});
  let m = mem[b.id];
  if (!m) m = mem[b.id] = { det: 0, t: -1e9, x: b.x, y: b.y, z: b.z };
  if (vis > 0) {
    const rate = a.ai.alert ? 6 : 3;
    m.det = Math.min(1.2, m.det + vis * rate * dt);
    if (m.det >= 1) { m.t = S.t; m.x = b.x; m.y = b.y; m.z = b.z; return true; }
  } else {
    m.det = Math.max(0, m.det - dt * 0.25);
  }
  return false;
}
export function lastSeen(S, a, id) { const m = a.ai.seen && a.ai.seen[id]; return m && m.t > -1e8 ? m : null; }
export function seenAgo(S, a, id) { const m = lastSeen(S, a, id); return m ? (S.t - m.t) * S.dt : 1e9; }

// ---- 経路に沿って歩く。戻り値: 'moving' | 'arrived' | 'blocked' | 'door'
// a.ai.nav = { tk: 目的のマス, path: [...], i, t: 作った時刻, stuck }
export function goTo(S, w, a, inp, tx, ty, tz, o = {}) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  const tk = navCell(w, tx, ty, tz);
  if (tk < 0) return 'blocked';
  const here = navCell(w, a.x, a.y, a.z);
  let nv = ai.nav;
  const arriveR = o.r ?? 0.45;
  // 隊員は鍵のかかった扉を蹴って通る（移動・追従・捜索のとき。突入の命令は扉の操作を自分でする）
  const kick = o.kick ?? (a.kind === 'swat' && !o.noDoors);
  if (Math.hypot(tx - a.x, tz - a.z) < arriveR && Math.abs(levelOfY(ty + 0.3) - levelOfY(a.y + 0.3)) === 0) { ai.nav = null; return 'arrived'; }
  if (!nv || nv.tk !== tk || (S.t - nv.t) * S.dt > 6 || nv.bad) {
    const lc = leafCells(w, S);
    const p = findPath(w, S, here, tk, { unlock: !!(o.unlock || kick), wedgeOK: false, breakBar: !!o.breakBar, avoid: o.avoid, leaf: lc });
    if (!p) {
      // 開いた扉の板が通り道をふさいでいるだけなら、その扉を向こうへ押し開ける（板の陰の袋小路から出る）
      const p2 = lc && lc.size ? findPath(w, S, here, tk, { unlock: !!(o.unlock || kick), wedgeOK: false, breakBar: !!o.breakBar, avoid: o.avoid }) : null;

        // 道をふさいでいる板（道の上で最初に当たる板の扉）

        for (const k of p2.slice(0, 16)) { const i = lc.owner ? lc.owner.get(k) : undefined; if (i != null && i !== o.keep) { best = i; break; } }

        if (d && d.L === levelOfY(a.y + 0.3) && Math.hypot(d.cx - a.x, d.cz - a.z) < 2.6) {
          const ds = S.doors[best];
          // 半端に開いた扉は押し開け、開ききった扉は閉める。板に手が届くまで寄る
          const op = ds.ang.every(v => Math.abs(v) < 0.6) ? 'open' : 'close';
          const can = reachOK(S, w, a, 'door', best, op);
          steerToward(a, inp, d.cx, d.cz, can || Math.hypot(d.cx - a.x, d.cz - a.z) < 0.35 ? 0 : 0.5);

          ai.nav = { tk, path: [], i: 0, t: S.t, bad: false, fail: true, soft: true };
          return 'door';
        }
      }
      // 板のある扉はまだ遠い: 板を気にしない道で近くまで行く（近づいて道を作り直したとき、上で板をどける）
      if (p2 && (!o.noDoors || o.keep != null)) nv = ai.nav = { tk, path: smoothPath(w, here, p2), i: 0, t: S.t - Math.round(3 / S.dt), bad: false, stuck: 0, lx: a.x, lz: a.z };
      else { ai.nav = { tk, path: [], i: 0, t: S.t, bad: false, fail: true }; return 'blocked'; }
    } else {
      const sp = smoothPath(w, here, p);
      nv = ai.nav = { tk, path: sp, i: 0, t: S.t, bad: false, stuck: 0, lx: a.x, lz: a.z };
    }
  }
  if (nv.fail) { if ((S.t - nv.t) * S.dt > (nv.soft ? 0.6 : 1.5)) ai.nav = null; return nv.soft ? 'door' : 'blocked'; }
  // 次の点
  while (nv.i < nv.path.length) {
    const c = cellCenter(w, nv.path[nv.i]);
    const last = nv.i === nv.path.length - 1;
    const dd = Math.hypot(c[0] - a.x, c[2] - a.z);
    if (dd < (last ? arriveR * 0.9 : 0.42) && Math.abs(c[1] - a.y) < 1.2) nv.i++;
    else break;
  }
  let px, pz, py;
  if (nv.i >= nv.path.length) { px = tx; pz = tz; py = ty; }
  else { const c = cellCenter(w, nv.path[nv.i]); px = c[0]; py = c[1]; pz = c[2]; }
  // 扉: 次のマスが閉じた扉なら開ける
  const nk = nv.i < nv.path.length ? nv.path[nv.i] : tk;
  const did = w.doorAt[nk];
  if (did >= 0) {
    const ds = S.doors[did];
    if (ds && !ds.broken && !isOpen(ds)) {
      const d = w.doors[did];
      const dd = Math.hypot(d.cx - a.x, d.cz - a.z);
      if (dd < 1.7) {
        // 扉の口（線の上）に立っていると、開く板が体に当たって止まる: 来た側へ一歩下がってから開ける
        const across = (a.x - d.cx) * d.nx + (a.z - d.cz) * d.nz;
        if (Math.abs(across) < 0.42 && !o.noDoors) {
          const nk2 = nv.path[Math.min(nv.path.length - 1, nv.i + 1)] ?? tk, c2 = cellCenter(w, nk2);
          const sgn = (c2[0] - d.cx) * d.nx + (c2[2] - d.cz) * d.nz > 0 ? -1 : 1, mv = sgn * 0.6 - across;
          steerToward(a, inp, a.x + d.nx * mv, a.z + d.nz * mv, 0.6, false);
          return 'door';
        }
        steerToward(a, inp, d.cx, d.cz, 0);
        if (o.noDoors) return 'door';
        // バリケード（対戦）: 壊して通る
        if (ds.bar > 0 && o.breakBar) {
          if (!ai.doorT || (S.t - ai.doorT) * S.dt > 0.7) { ai.doorT = S.t; pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'door', id: did, op: 'bash' }); }
          return 'door';

          pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'door', id: did, op: ds.locked && !ds.lockBroken && kick ? 'kick' : 'open' });
        }
        if (ds.wedge || ds.bar > 0 || (ds.locked && !ds.lockBroken && !o.unlock && !kick)) { nv.bad = true; return 'door'; }
        return 'door';
      }
    }
  }
  // 詰まり（動けない）
  const moved = Math.hypot(a.x - nv.lx, a.z - nv.lz);
  if (moved < 0.02) { nv.stuck = (nv.stuck || 0) + S.dt; } else nv.stuck = Math.max(0, (nv.stuck || 0) - S.dt * 2);
  nv.lx = a.x; nv.lz = a.z;
  if (nv.stuck > 1.2) {
    nv.stuck = 0;
    // 開いた扉の板の陰に入って動けない: 板に手が届けば閉める（突入する扉 o.keep は除く）
    const lf0 = o.noDoors && o.keep == null ? -1 : nearLeaf(w, S, a, 0.9, o.keep);
    if (lf0 >= 0 && reachOK(S, w, a, 'door', lf0, 'close')) { if (!ai.doorT || (S.t - ai.doorT) * S.dt > 1.2) { ai.doorT = S.t; pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'door', id: lf0, op: 'close' }); } nv.bad = true; return 'door'; }
    nv.bad = true; ai.unstick = { until: S.t + Math.round(0.6 / S.dt), dir: ((a.id + S.t) & 1) ? 1 : -1 };
  }
  // 進まない（行ったり来たりして、いまの経路の点に近づけない）: 開いた扉の板にはばまれていれば閉める
  const dNode = Math.hypot(px - a.x, pz - a.z);
  if (nv.ni !== nv.i) { nv.ni = nv.i; nv.bestD = dNode; nv.bestT = S.t; }
  else if (dNode < nv.bestD - 0.15) { nv.bestD = dNode; nv.bestT = S.t; }
  if ((S.t - nv.bestT) * S.dt > 2.5) {
    nv.bestT = S.t; nv.bestD = dNode;
    const lf = o.noDoors ? -1 : nearLeaf(w, S, a, 1.0);
    if (lf >= 0 && reachOK(S, w, a, 'door', lf, 'close')) pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'door', id: lf, op: 'close' });
    else { nv.bad = true; ai.unstick = { until: S.t + Math.round(0.8 / S.dt), dir: ((a.id + S.t) & 1) ? 1 : -1 }; }
  }
  const spd = o.speed ?? 1;
  // 詰まったら少し横へずれてから進み直す（扉の板・家具の角・人に引っかかったとき）
  if (ai.unstick && S.t < ai.unstick.until) {
    const dx = px - a.x, dz = pz - a.z, l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    steerToward(a, inp, a.x - dz / l * ai.unstick.dir * 2 - dx / l * 0.5, a.z + dx / l * ai.unstick.dir * 2 - dz / l * 0.5, spd, false);
    return 'moving';
  }
  steerToward(a, inp, px, pz, spd, o.faceMove !== false && o.look == null);
  return 'moving';
}
// いちばん近い開いた扉の板（lim 以内）
function nearLeaf(w, S, a, lim, skip = -1) {
  let best = -1, bd = lim;
  const L = levelOfY(a.y + 0.3);
  for (let i = 0; i < w.doors.length; i++) {
    const d = w.doors[i], ds = S.doors[i];
    if (i === skip || !ds || ds.broken || d.L !== L || Math.abs(d.cx - a.x) > 3 || Math.abs(d.cz - a.z) > 3) continue;
    d.leaves.forEach((lf, li) => {
      if (Math.abs(ds.ang[li] || 0) < 0.25) return;
      const [ex, ez] = leafEnd(lf, ds.ang[li]), vx = ex - lf.hx, vz = ez - lf.hz, vv = vx * vx + vz * vz || 1;
      const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((a.x - lf.hx) * vx + (a.z - lf.hz) * vz) / vv));
      const dd = Math.hypot(a.x - (lf.hx + vx * t), a.z - (lf.hz + vz * t));
      if (dd < bd) { bd = dd; best = i; }
    });
  }
  return best;
}
// 世界の向きの移動を、体の向き（yaw）に対する mx/mz にする
export function steerToward(a, inp, x, z, spd = 1, face = false) {
  const dx = x - a.x, dz = z - a.z, L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (L < 1e-3 || spd <= 0) { inp.mx = 0; inp.mz = 0; return; }
  const ux = dx / L, uz = dz / L;
  const yaw = face ? yawTo(dx, dz) : inp.yaw;
  if (face) inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yaw, 9 * Math.PI / 180 * 2);
  const sy = Math.sin(inp.yaw), cy = Math.cos(inp.yaw);
  // 前 = (sy, cy)、右 = (-cy, sy)
  const fwd = ux * sy + uz * cy, right = ux * -cy + uz * sy;
  const k = Math.min(1, L / 0.35) * spd;
  inp.mz = fwd * k; inp.mx = right * k;
}
export function turnToward(cur, want, maxStep) {
  const d = angDiff(want, cur);
  if (Math.abs(d) <= maxStep) return want;
  return cur + Math.sign(d) * maxStep;
}

// 狙う: 目標の点へ。反応の遅れのあとで、ぶれ（だんだん小さくなる）を足す。反動を抑える
export function aimAt(S, a, inp, tx, ty, tz, sk, dt, o = {}) {
  const e = eyeOf(S, a);
  const dx = tx - e[0], dy = ty - e[1], dz = tz - e[2];
  const h = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  let wantYaw = yawTo(dx, dz), wantPitch = Math.atan2(dy, h);
  const ai = a.ai;
  // ぶれ: 目標が変わったら大きく、狙い続けると小さく
  if (ai.aimId !== o.id) { ai.aimId = o.id; ai.aimErr = (sk.err * (0.7 + 0.6 * hrand(a.id, S.t, 31))) * Math.PI / 180; ai.aimT = 0; ai.aimDir = hrand(a.id, S.t, 32) * TAU; }
  ai.aimT = (ai.aimT || 0) + dt;
  const settle = Math.exp(-ai.aimT * 1.6);
  let err = (ai.aimErr || 0) * (0.25 + 0.75 * settle) * (1 + (a.supp || 0) * 1.2) * (a.stun > 0 ? 2.5 : 1) * (o.errMul || 1);
  // 距離が遠いと難しい（角度は小さくなるので少しだけ）
  err *= h > 15 ? 0.8 : 1;
  const wob = ai.aimDir + ai.aimT * 0.9;
  wantYaw += Math.cos(wob) * err; wantPitch += Math.sin(wob) * err * 0.6;
  // 反動を抑える（AIの入力の向きに、反動の逆を足す）
  const W = curW(a);
  if (W) { wantPitch -= (a.ws.rp * Math.PI / 180) * sk.comp; wantYaw -= (a.ws.ry * Math.PI / 180) * sk.comp; }
  const step = sk.turn * Math.PI / 180 * dt * (a.stun > 0 ? 0.3 : 1);
  inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, wantYaw, step);
  inp.pitch = a.pitch + Math.max(-step, Math.min(step, wantPitch - a.pitch));
  return Math.abs(angDiff(inp.yaw, wantYaw)) + Math.abs(inp.pitch - wantPitch);
}

// 撃つかどうか（連射の区切り・単発の間隔）
export function trigger(S, a, inp, sk, onTarget) {
  const ai = a.ai, W = curW(a), wi = curWeapon(a);
  if (!W || !wi) return;
  const [inMag] = ammoCount(wi);
  if (inMag <= 0) { if (a.ws.st === 'ready') pushAct(inp, { a: 'reload' }); return; }
  if (!onTarget) { ai.burst = 0; return; }
  const mode = W.modes[wi.mode] || 'semi';
  if (mode === 'auto') {
    if (!ai.burst) { ai.burst = Math.round(sk.burst[0] + (sk.burst[1] - sk.burst[0]) * hrand(a.id, S.t, 41)); ai.burstN = a.stats.sh; ai.burstGap = 0; }
    if (a.stats.sh - ai.burstN >= ai.burst) {
      ai.burstGap = (ai.burstGap || 0) + S.dt;
      if (ai.burstGap > 0.18 + 0.25 * hrand(a.id, S.t, 42)) { ai.burst = 0; }
      return;
    }
    inp.fire = true;
  } else {
    // 単発: 押して離す
    ai.semiT = (ai.semiT || 0) + S.dt;
    const gap = W.cat === 'shotgun' ? 0.45 : W.cat === 'pistol' ? 0.22 : 0.18;
    if (ai.semiT > gap) { inp.fire = true; ai.semiT = 0; }
  }
}

// 聞こえた音（前のステップの出来事から）: S.heard = [{x,y,z,k,loud,id}]
export function hearNearest(S, w, a, range = 25, filter = null) {
  let best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (const h of S.heard || []) {
    if (h.id === a.id) continue;
    if (filter && !filter(h)) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(h.x - a.x, (h.y - a.y) * 2, h.z - a.z);
    const R = range * h.loud;
    if (d > R) continue;
    // 階が違うと聞こえにくい
    const sc = d / R;
    if (sc < bd) { bd = sc; best = h; }
  }
  return best;
}

// 部屋の中のランダムな床のマス（隠れ場所・見回り）
export function randomCellInRoom(S, w, room, k) {
  const r = w.rooms[room];
  if (!r || !r.cells.length) return null;
  const nav = buildNav(w);
  for (let t = 0; t < 12; t++) {
    const c = r.cells[Math.floor(hrand(room, S.t + t * 7, k) * r.cells.length)];
    if (nav.walk[c] === 1) return cellCenter(w, c);
  }
  return null;
}
export function roomAtPos(w, x, y, z) {
  const i = Math.floor(x / CS), j = Math.floor(z / CS);
  if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) return -1;
  const L = Math.max(0, Math.min(w.NL - 1, Math.floor((y + 0.4) / LH)));
  return w.roomAt[w.idx(L, i, j)];
}
// 相手が自分を狙っているか（銃口の向き）
export function aimingAt(a, b, cone = 0.22) {
  if (!a.alive || a.down) return false;
  const dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.z - a.z;
  return Math.abs(angDiff(yawTo(dx, dz), a.yaw)) < cone && Math.hypot(dx, dz) < 30;
}
export function canFight(a) { return a.alive && !a.down && !a.cuffed && !a.comply && a.tased <= 0; }
export function hasGun(a) { return !!(a.inv.w[0] || a.inv.w[1]); }

// いる部屋。扉・開口のマスに立っているときは、まわりの一番近い床の部屋
function roomOfActor(w, a) {
  const k = navCell(w, a.x, a.y + 0.2, a.z);
  if (k < 0) return -1;
  if (w.roomAt[k] >= 0) return w.roomAt[k];
  const WD = w.W * w.D, L = Math.floor(k / WD), r = k - L * WD, j = Math.floor(r / w.W), i = r - j * w.W;
  let best = -1, bd = 1e9;
  for (let dj = -2; dj <= 2; dj++) for (let di = -2; di <= 2; di++) {
    const ii = i + di, jj = j + dj; if (ii < 0 || jj < 0 || ii >= w.W || jj >= w.D) continue;
    const rr = w.roomAt[L * WD + jj * w.W + ii]; if (rr < 0) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot((ii + 0.5) * CS - a.x, (jj + 0.5) * CS - a.z); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = rr; }
  }
  return best;
}

  if (!target && !m.softDone) {

    if (!L.hunt) L.hunt = {};
    let best = null, bd = 1e9;
    for (const b of S.actors) {

  if (tries > 2) { L.skip.push(target.room); (L.blocked || (L.blocked = [])).push(target.next); return; }
