}

const SINGLE = new Set(['mirror', 'wedge', 'disarm', 'pick', 'unwedge', 'deploy', 'restrain']);

function roomPoint(w, R, px, pz) {
  const nav = buildNav(w);
  if (R.mx == null) { let sx = 0, sz = 0, n = 0; for (const k of R.cells) { const r = k % (w.W * w.D); sx += (r % w.W + 0.5) * CS; sz += (Math.floor(r / w.W) + 0.5) * CS; n++; } R.mx = sx / n; R.mz = sz / n; }
  let best = null, bs = 1e9;
  for (const k of R.cells) {
    if (nav.walk[k] !== 1) continue;
    const r = k % (w.W * w.D), x = (r % w.W + 0.5) * CS, z = (Math.floor(r / w.W) + 0.5) * CS;
    const sc = Math.abs(Math.hypot(x - px, z - pz) - 2.5) + 0.35 * Math.hypot(x - R.mx, z - R.mz);
    if (sc < bs) { bs = sc; best = [x, z]; }
  }
  return best;
}

function issue(S, L, leader, o) {
  if (S.debugLead) S.debugLead.push(((S.t * S.dt) | 0) + 's ' + o.cmd + (o.door != null ? ' d' + o.door : '') + (o.method ? ' ' + o.method : '') + (o.x != null ? ` (${o.x.toFixed(1)},${o.z.toFixed(1)})` : ''));
  const n = ++S.cmdSeq;
  S.orders.push({ ...o, team: 'gold', by: leader.id, t: S.t, n });
  L.seq = n; L.t = S.t; L.cmd = o.cmd;
}

// 今いる所から、まだ入っていない屋内の部屋のうち、歩く距離が一番近いものへの最初の一歩（通り口と次の部屋）
// 部屋を点、通り口を辺とした最短経路（距離は入った点から通り口までの直線）
function nextStep(S, w, rg, from, L, sx, sz) {
  const dist = new Map([[from, 0]]), prev = new Map([[from, null]]), at = new Map([[from, [sx, sz]]]);
  const open = [from], done = new Set();
  let found = -1;
  while (open.length) {
    let bi = 0; for (let i = 1; i < open.length; i++) if (dist.get(open[i]) < dist.get(open[bi])) bi = i;
    const r = open.splice(bi, 1)[0];
    if (done.has(r)) continue;
    done.add(r);
    if (r !== from && !w.rooms[r].out && !L.visited.includes(r) && !L.skip.includes(r)) { found = r; break; }
    const [px, pz] = at.get(r);
    for (const p of rg.adj[r] || []) {
      if (p.type !== 'door' && p.type !== 'open' && p.type !== 'stair') continue;
      if (p.door >= 0 && L.badDoors && L.badDoors.includes(p.door)) continue;
      const o = p.a === r ? p.b : p.a;
      if (done.has(o) || (L.blocked && L.blocked.includes(o))) continue;
      const d = dist.get(r) + Math.hypot(p.x - px, p.z - pz) + (p.type === 'stair' ? 6 : 1);
      if (!dist.has(o) || d < dist.get(o)) { dist.set(o, d); prev.set(o, { r, p }); at.set(o, [p.x, p.z]); open.push(o); }
    }
  }
  if (found < 0) return null;
  let cur = found, step = prev.get(cur);
  while (step && step.r !== from) { cur = step.r; step = prev.get(cur); }
  if (!step) return null;
  return { room: found, next: cur, portal: step.p };
}

// 経路: 0.5mのマスの格子で A*。扉・階段・家具をふまえる。滑らかにする（見通しで角を落とす）。
import { CS, LH, C, STEP, isWallish, groundAt, leafEnd, pushOut } from '../world.js';
import { M } from '../data/materials.js';

// 歩けるマスの印: 0 歩けない、1 床、2 扉、3 階段（その階の坂）、4 開口
export function buildNav(w) {
  if (w._nav) return w._nav;
  const N = w.NL * w.W * w.D;
  const walk = new Uint8Array(N);
  for (let L = 0; L < w.NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < w.D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w.W; i++) {
    const k = w.idx(L, i, j), t = w.cell[k];
    if (t === C.FLOOR || t === C.OUT) walk[k] = 1;
    else if (t === C.DOOR) walk[k] = 2;
    else if (t === C.OPEN) walk[k] = 4;
    else if (t === C.STAIR) {
      const s = w.stairAt[k];
      if (s >= 0 && w.stairs[s].L === L) walk[k] = 3; // 坂の部分（上の階の同じマスは吹き抜け）
    }
  }
  // 家具（低い物も人は越えない: AIは回り込む）
  for (const p of w.props) {
    if (!p.solid) continue;
    for (const b of p.boxes) {
      if (b[4] - b[1] < 0.05 || b[4] - p.y < 0.3) continue;
      const i0 = Math.floor((b[0] + 0.12) / CS), i1 = Math.floor((b[3] - 0.12) / CS), j0 = Math.floor((b[2] + 0.12) / CS), j1 = Math.floor((b[5] - 0.12) / CS);
      for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < w.W && j < w.D) walk[w.idx(p.L, i, j)] = 0;
    }
  }
  // 狭すぎる所: 家具と家具・階段の横・壁のあいだで、人の幅（直径0.56m）が入らないマスは歩けない。
  // マスの中心から押し出してみて、マスの中に収まる場所がなければふさがっている
  const po = [0, 0, 0, 0];
  for (let L = 0; L < w.NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < w.D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w.W; i++) {
    const k = w.idx(L, i, j);
    if (walk[k] !== 1) continue;
    const cx = (i + 0.5) * CS, cz = (j + 0.5) * CS, y0 = L * LH + STEP + 0.03, y1 = L * LH + 1.6;
    let x = cx, z = cz, ok = false;
    for (let it = 0; it < 4; it++) {
      pushOut(w, x, z, y0, y1, 0.28, null, -1, po);
      if (!po[2] || po[3] < 2e-3) { ok = true; break; }
      x += po[0]; z += po[1];
    }
    if (!ok || Math.abs(x - cx) > 0.3 || Math.abs(z - cz) > 0.3) walk[k] = 0;
  }
  // 壁ぎわ（壁のマスの隣）はそのまま歩ける（板はマスの中央）
  // 階段のつながり: 坂の上の端 → 上の階の床
  const links = new Map(); // k -> [k2...]
  const addLink = (a, b) => { let x = links.get(a); if (!x) links.set(a, x = []); if (!x.includes(b)) x.push(b); };
  for (const s of w.stairs) {
    if (s.L + 1 >= w.NL) continue;
    const di = s.dir === 'e' ? 1 : s.dir === 'w' ? -1 : 0, dj = s.dir === 's' ? 1 : s.dir === 'n' ? -1 : 0;
    // 上の端の列のマスと、その先の上の階のマス
    for (let jj = 0; jj < s.jw; jj++) for (let ii = 0; ii < s.iw; ii++) {
      const i = s.i0 + ii, j = s.j0 + jj;
      const atTop = (di > 0 && ii === s.iw - 1) || (di < 0 && ii === 0) || (dj > 0 && jj === s.jw - 1) || (dj < 0 && jj === 0);
      if (!atTop) continue;
      const ni = i + di, nj = j + dj;
      if (ni < 0 || nj < 0 || ni >= w.W || nj >= w.D) continue;
      const a = w.idx(s.L, i, j), b = w.idx(s.L + 1, ni, nj);
      if (!walk[b]) continue;
      addLink(a, b); addLink(b, a);
    }
    // 坂の下の端は同じ階の床とふつうにつながる
  }
  const nav = { walk, links, W: w.W, D: w.D, NL: w.NL };
  // 経路の計算用の作業領域
  nav.g = new Float32Array(N); nav.from = new Int32Array(N); nav.stamp = new Uint32Array(N); nav.closed = new Uint32Array(N); nav.cur = 0;
  nav.heap = new Int32Array(N + 1); nav.hf = new Float32Array(N + 1);
  w._nav = nav;
  return nav;
}

// 位置 → マスの番号（その階）
export function navCell(w, x, y, z) {
  const i = Math.floor(x / CS), j = Math.floor(z / CS);
  if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) return -1;
  let L = Math.max(0, Math.min(w.NL - 1, Math.floor((y + 0.4) / LH)));
  let k = w.idx(L, i, j);
  // 階段の上（上の階の吹き抜け）にいるときは下の階の坂
  if (w.cell[k] === C.STAIR && w.stairAt[k] >= 0 && w.stairs[w.stairAt[k]].L === L - 1) k = w.idx(L - 1, i, j);
  return k;
}
export function cellCenter(w, k) {
  const L = Math.floor(k / (w.W * w.D)), r = k - L * w.W * w.D, j = Math.floor(r / w.W), i = r - j * w.W;
  const x = (i + 0.5) * CS, z = (j + 0.5) * CS;
  const y = groundAt(w, x, z, L * LH + LH * 0.95);
  return [x, y < -50 ? L * LH : y, z, L];
}

// 扉の状態で通れるか（鍵・ウェッジ・バリケード）。canOpen: 鍵を開けられる（容疑者は内側から）
function doorPass(w, S, k, opt) {
  const did = w.doorAt[k];
  if (did < 0 || !S) return true;
  const ds = S.doors[did];
  if (!ds || ds.broken) return true;
  if (ds.bar > 0 && !opt.breakBar) return false;
  const open = ds.ang.some(a => Math.abs(a) > 0.6);
  if (open) return true;
  if (ds.wedge && !opt.wedgeOK) return false;
  if (ds.locked && !ds.lockBroken && !opt.unlock) return false;
  return true;
}

function heapPush(nav, k, f) {
  let n = ++nav.hn; const H = nav.heap, F = nav.hf;
  while (n > 1) { const p = n >> 1; if (F[p] <= f) break; H[n] = H[p]; F[n] = F[p]; n = p; }
  H[n] = k; F[n] = f;
}
function heapPop(nav) {
  const H = nav.heap, F = nav.hf;
  const top = H[1]; const lk = H[nav.hn], lf = F[nav.hn]; nav.hn--;
  let n = 1;
  while (true) { let c = n * 2; if (c > nav.hn) break; if (c + 1 <= nav.hn && F[c + 1] < F[c]) c++; if (F[c] >= lf) break; H[n] = H[c]; F[n] = F[c]; n = c; }
  H[n] = lk; F[n] = lf;
  return top;
}

// 開いた扉の板が通るマス（経路で避ける）。ステップごとに作り直す（状態には入れない）
const _lc = { S: null, t: -1, set: null };
export function leafCells(w, S) {
  if (!S || !S.doors) return null;
  if (_lc.S === S && _lc.t === S.t) return _lc.set;
  const set = new Set(), owner = new Map();
  set.owner = owner;
  for (let i = 0; i < w.doors.length; i++) {
    const d = w.doors[i], ds = S.doors[i];
    if (!ds || ds.broken || !d.leaves) continue;
    d.leaves.forEach((lf, li) => {
      const ang = ds.ang[li] || 0;
      if (Math.abs(ang) < 0.25) return;
      const [ex, ez] = leafEnd(lf, ang);
      const lx = ex - lf.hx, lz = ez - lf.hz;
      for (let t = 0.2; t <= 1.001; t += 0.1) {
        const x = lf.hx + lx * t, z = lf.hz + lz * t;
        const ci = Math.floor(x / CS), cj = Math.floor(z / CS);
        if (ci < 0 || cj < 0 || ci >= w.W || cj >= w.D) continue;
        const k = w.idx(d.L, ci, cj);
        if (w.doorAt[k] >= 0) continue;
        set.add(k); if (!owner.has(k)) owner.set(k, i);
      }
    });
  }
  _lc.S = S; _lc.t = S.t; _lc.set = set;
  return set;
}

// A*。戻り値: マスの番号の列（スタートを含まない）か null。opt: { maxNodes, avoid: Set(k), unlock, breakBar, wedgeOK, costFn }
export function findPath(w, S, from, to, opt = {}) {

  if (from < 0 || to < 0) return null;
  if (!nav.walk[to]) { to = nearestWalk(w, to); if (to < 0) return null; }
  if (!nav.walk[from]) { const f2 = nearestWalk(w, from); if (f2 < 0) return null; from = f2; }
  if (from === to) return [];

  nav.hn = 0;
  nav.g[from] = 0; nav.stamp[from] = cur; nav.from[from] = -1;
  heapPush(nav, from, h(from));

  const avoid = opt.avoid || null;

      const ni = i + di, nj = j + dj;

      }
      if (wk === 2 && !doorPass(w, S, k2, opt)) continue;
      if (opt.leaf && opt.leaf.has(k2) && k2 !== to) continue;
      let c = d < 4 ? 1 : 1.414;
      if (wk === 2) c += 1.5;
      if (avoid && avoid.has(k2)) c += 6;
      if (opt.costFn) c += opt.costFn(k2);
      const g2 = gk + c;
      if (nav.stamp[k2] === cur && g2 >= nav.g[k2]) continue;
      nav.stamp[k2] = cur; nav.g[k2] = g2; nav.from[k2] = k;
      heapPush(nav, k2, g2 + h(k2));
    }
    const lk = nav.links.get(k);
    if (lk) for (const k2 of lk) {
      const g2 = gk + 2;
      if (nav.stamp[k2] === cur && g2 >= nav.g[k2]) continue;
      nav.stamp[k2] = cur; nav.g[k2] = g2; nav.from[k2] = k;
      heapPush(nav, k2, g2 + h(k2));
    }
  }
  if (nav.closed[to] !== cur) return null;
  const out = [];
  for (let k = to; k !== from && k >= 0; k = nav.from[k]) out.push(k);
  out.reverse();
  return out;
}

// 坂の下の端の手前のマスか（階段への乗り口）
export function stairFoot(s, i, j) {
  if (s.dir === 'n') return j === s.j0 + s.jw && i >= s.i0 && i < s.i0 + s.iw;
  if (s.dir === 's') return j === s.j0 - 1 && i >= s.i0 && i < s.i0 + s.iw;
  if (s.dir === 'e') return i === s.i0 - 1 && j >= s.j0 && j < s.j0 + s.jw;
  return i === s.i0 + s.iw && j >= s.j0 && j < s.j0 + s.jw;
}

export function nearestWalk(w, k, maxR = 6) {
  const nav = buildNav(w);
  const WD = w.W * w.D, L = Math.floor(k / WD), r = k - L * WD, j = Math.floor(r / w.W), i = r - j * w.W;
  for (let R = 0; R <= maxR; R++) for (let dj = -R; dj <= R; dj++) for (let di = -R; di <= R; di++) {
    if (Math.max(Math.abs(di), Math.abs(dj)) !== R) continue;
    const ii = i + di, jj = j + dj; if (ii < 0 || jj < 0 || ii >= w.W || jj >= w.D) continue;
    const k2 = L * WD + jj * w.W + ii;
    if (nav.walk[k2] === 1 || nav.walk[k2] === 3) return k2;
  }
  return -1;
}

// 近くの歩ける床（扉・階段でない）の中心。room >= 0 ならその部屋のマスだけ。見つからなければ null
export function snapFloor(w, x, y, z, room = -1, maxR = 4) {
  const k = navCell(w, x, y, z);
  if (k < 0) return null;
  const nav = buildNav(w);
  const WD = w.W * w.D, L = Math.floor(k / WD), r = k - L * WD, j = Math.floor(r / w.W), i = r - j * w.W;
  let best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (let dj = -maxR; dj <= maxR; dj++) for (let di = -maxR; di <= maxR; di++) {
    const ii = i + di, jj = j + dj; if (ii < 0 || jj < 0 || ii >= w.W || jj >= w.D) continue;
    const k2 = L * WD + jj * w.W + ii;
    if (nav.walk[k2] !== 1 || (room >= 0 && w.roomAt[k2] !== room)) continue;
    const cx = (ii + 0.5) * CS, cz = (jj + 0.5) * CS, d = Math.hypot(cx - x, cz - z);
    if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = [cx, cz]; }
  }
  return best;
}

// 直線で歩けるか（マスの列を調べる）。扉のマスは真っすぐ通るときだけ
export function walkableLine(w, k0, k1) {
  const nav = buildNav(w);
  const WD = w.W * w.D;
  const L0 = Math.floor(k0 / WD), L1 = Math.floor(k1 / WD);
  if (L0 !== L1) return false;
  const r0 = k0 - L0 * WD, r1 = k1 - L1 * WD;
  let i0 = r0 % w.W, j0 = Math.floor(r0 / w.W); const i1 = r1 % w.W, j1 = Math.floor(r1 / w.W);
  // 太さを持たせる: 中心線と、その左右0.2マス
  const dx = i1 - i0, dz = j1 - j0, len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (len < 1e-6) return true;
  const nx = -dz / len * 0.45, nz = dx / len * 0.45;
  for (const off of [0, 1, -1]) {
    const sx = i0 + 0.5 + nx * off, sz = j0 + 0.5 + nz * off;
    const steps = Math.ceil(len * 2.5);
    for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
      const t = s / steps;
      const ci = Math.floor(sx + dx * t), cj = Math.floor(sz + dz * t);
      if (ci < 0 || cj < 0 || ci >= w.W || cj >= w.D) return false;
      const k = L0 * WD + cj * w.W + ci;
      const wk = nav.walk[k];
      if (!wk) return false;
      if ((wk === 2 || wk === 4) && off !== 0) return false;
      if (wk === 3) return false; // 階段は折れ線のまま
    }
  }
  return true;
}

// 経路を滑らかに: 見通せる所は飛ばす
export function smoothPath(w, start, path) {
  if (!path || path.length < 3) return path;
  const out = [];
  let anchor = start, idx = 0;
  while (idx < path.length) {
    let far = idx;
    for (let k = Math.min(path.length - 1, idx + 12); k > idx; k--) { if (walkableLine(w, anchor, path[k])) { far = k; break; } }
    out.push(path[far]);
    anchor = path[far];
    idx = far + 1;
  }
  return out;
}

// 部屋ごとの代表のマスと、部屋どうしのつながり（扉・開口）
export function roomGraph(w) {
  if (w._rg) return w._rg;
  const adj = w.rooms.map(() => []);
  const portals = [];
  for (let L = 0; L < w.NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < w.D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w.W; i++) {
    const k = w.idx(L, i, j), t = w.cell[k];
    if (!isWallish(t)) continue;
    const pairs = [];
    const rA = (ii, jj) => (ii < 0 || jj < 0 || ii >= w.W || jj >= w.D) ? -1 : w.roomAt[w.idx(L, ii, jj)];
    pairs.push([rA(i - 1, j), rA(i + 1, j), 'x'], [rA(i, j - 1), rA(i, j + 1), 'z']);
    for (const [a, b, ax] of pairs) {
      if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a === b) continue;
      const type = t === C.DOOR ? 'door' : t === C.OPEN ? 'open' : t === C.WINDOW || t === C.GLASSWALL ? 'window' : t === C.LOW || t === C.FENCE ? 'low' : 'wall';
      portals.push({ k, a, b, type, door: w.doorAt[k], x: (i + 0.5) * CS, z: (j + 0.5) * CS, L, ax });
    }
  }
  // 階段: 下の階の部屋と上の階の部屋
  for (const s of w.stairs) {
    if (s.L + 1 >= w.NL) continue;
    const k0 = w.idx(s.L, s.i0, s.j0);
    const a = w.roomAt[k0];
    let b = -1;
    const di = s.dir === 'e' ? 1 : s.dir === 'w' ? -1 : 0, dj = s.dir === 's' ? 1 : s.dir === 'n' ? -1 : 0;
    const ti = s.dir === 'e' ? s.i0 + s.iw : s.dir === 'w' ? s.i0 - 1 : s.i0, tj = s.dir === 's' ? s.j0 + s.jw : s.dir === 'n' ? s.j0 - 1 : s.j0;
    if (ti >= 0 && tj >= 0 && ti < w.W && tj < w.D) b = w.roomAt[w.idx(s.L + 1, ti, tj)];
    if (b < 0) { for (let jj = 0; jj < s.jw && b < 0; jj++) for (let ii = 0; ii < s.iw && b < 0; ii++) { const r = w.roomAt[w.idx(s.L + 1, s.i0 + ii, s.j0 + jj)]; if (r >= 0) b = r; } }
    if (a >= 0 && b >= 0 && a !== b) portals.push({ k: k0, a, b, type: 'stair', door: -1, x: (s.x0 + s.x1) / 2, z: (s.z0 + s.z1) / 2, L: s.L });
  }
  for (const p of portals) { adj[p.a].push(p); adj[p.b].push(p); }
  w._rg = { adj, portals };
  return w._rg;
}

// 容疑者と市民のAI（Ready Or Not のように）: 士気と呼びかけで投降、偽装投降、隠れる・待ち伏せ・逃げる、人質犯、乱射犯
import { baseInput, pushAct, visibility, detect, lastSeen, seenAgo, goTo, steerToward, aimAt, trigger, hearNearest, randomCellInRoom, roomAtPos, aimingAt, canFight, hasGun, angDiff, yawTo, turnToward, SKILL } from './common.js';

// ---- 呼びかけを聞いたか（自分に向いた警官の声）
function shoutsAtMe(S, w, a) {
  let n = 0, by = null;
  for (const s of S.shouts) {
    const b = S.byId[s.by];
    if (!b || b.kind === a.kind || b.team === a.team) continue;
    if (b.kind !== 'swat') continue;
    const dx = a.x - s.x, dz = a.z - s.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (d > 15 || Math.abs(a.y - s.y) > 2) continue;
    const facing = Math.abs(angDiff(yawTo(dx, dz), s.yaw)) < 0.95 || d < 4;
    if (!facing) continue;
    const e = eyeOf(S, a);
    if (!los(w, e[0], e[1], e[2], s.x, s.y + 1.6, s.z, S.doors) && d > 3) continue;
    n++; by = b;
  }
  return n ? { n, by } : null;
}

function surrender(S, w, a, ctx) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  if (ai.hidden && hrand(a.id, S.t, 76) < 0.75) {
    // 偽装投降: 手を上げるが、隠した拳銃を持ったまま
    ai.st = 'fake'; ai.stT = 0; a.comply = 1; a.stateT = 0;
    const hid = a.inv.w[1];
    a.inv.w[1] = null;
    if (a.inv.w[0]) { a.ws.slot = 0; dropWeapon(S, a, []); }
    a.inv.w = [null, hid];
    a.ws.slot = -1;
    return;
  }
  ai.st = 'surr'; ai.stT = 0; a.comply = 1; a.stateT = 0;
  if (a.inv.w[0] || a.inv.w[1]) dropWeapon(S, a, []);
  a.inv.w = [null, null]; a.ws.slot = -1;
  ai.saidT = S.t;
}

function fakeState(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx, sk) {

function fight(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx, sk, tgt, td) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  inp.low = false;
  if (!tgt) {
    // 見失った: 最後に見た所を狙ったまま、少し待つ
    const ago = ai.lastTgt != null ? seenAgo(S, a, ai.lastTgt) : 1e9;
    if (ago > 4) { ai.st = 'alert'; ai.stT = 0; return inp; }
    const m = ai.lastTgt != null ? lastSeen(S, a, ai.lastTgt) : null;
    if (m) aimAt(S, a, inp, m.x, m.y + 1.2, m.z, sk, dt, { id: -1 });
    inp.ads = true;
    if (ago > 2 && ai.wantAmbush) inp.stance = 1;
    return inp;
  }
  ai.lastTgt = tgt.id;
  const W = curW(a);
  const reacted = sec(S, ai.reactT ?? S.t) >= (ai.reactD ?? 0.5);
  const tx = tgt.x, ty = tgt.y + (tgt.st > 1.5 ? 0.3 : tgt.st > 0.5 ? 0.9 : 1.3), tz = tgt.z;
  const off = aimAt(S, a, inp, tx, ty, tz, sk, dt, { id: tgt.id });

  return inp;
}
function alerted(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx, sk) {

  return inp;
}
function idle(S, w, a, inp, dt) {

// 逃げる・隠れる: 警官から遠い部屋へ。着いたら隠れる（しゃがむ）か待ち伏せ
function fleeOrHide(S, w, a, inp, dt, tgt) {

        if (s > bs) { bs = s; best = r; }
      }
      if (best) { const c = randomCellInRoom(S, w, best.id, a.id); if (c) ai.fleeTo = [c[0], c[1], c[2]]; }
    }
    if (!ai.fleeTo) ai.fleeTo = [a.x, a.y, a.z];
  }
  const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, ai.fleeTo[0], ai.fleeTo[1], ai.fleeTo[2], { speed: 1, unlock: true });

  }

}

      return inp;
    }
    ai.cower = true;
    // 縮こまって、ときどき顔を上げる
    return inp;
  }

  return inp;
}

// 命令の受け取り（brain から呼ぶ）
export function takeOrders(S, w) {
  if (!S.orders.length) return;
  for (const o of S.orders) {
    const team = o.team || 'gold';
    const mem = S.actors.filter(a => a.kind === 'swat' && a.ai && a.ai.type === 'swat' && a.alive && !a.down && (team === 'gold' || TEAMOF(a) === team)).sort((p, q) => p.ai.slot - q.ai.slot);
    mem.forEach((a, i) => {

      a.ai.leader = o.by;

    });

  S.orders.length = 0;
}

export function thinkSwat(S, w, a, dt, ctx) {

  if (!a.alive || a.down) return inp;

    if (src) { ai.alarmT = S.t; ai.alarm = src; }

  ai.alert = alarmed;

  // 見張り: 容疑者・市民
  const threats = [], people = [];
  for (const b of ctx.others) {
    if (b.kind !== 'sus' && b.kind !== 'civ') continue;
    if (!b.alive && !b.dead) continue;

    // 警戒中: 撃ってきた方（±35°）に見える相手は、暗くても見つけやすい

    const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
    if (b.kind === 'sus' && canFight(b) && hasGun(b) && isThreat(S, b)) threats.push({ b, d });
    else people.push({ b, d });
  }

  // 交戦: 差し迫った脅威は撃つ（味方が射線にいなければ）
  if (threats.length) {
    const t = threats[0].b;
    if (ai.engId !== t.id) { ai.engId = t.id; ai.engT = S.t; ai.engD = sk.react[0] + (sk.react[1] - sk.react[0]) * hrand(a.id, S.t, 101); }

    const off = aimAt(S, a, inp, t.x, ty, t.z, sk, dt, { id: t.id });
    inp.ads = true;
    const clear = lineClear(S, a, t);
    if (sec(S, ai.engT) >= ai.engD && clear) trigger(S, a, inp, sk, off < 0.08);
    if (!ai.yellT || sec(S, ai.yellT) > 1.6) { ai.yellT = S.t; pushAct(inp, { a: 'shout', line: 'swat_drop' }); }
    // 撃ち合いの最中も命令の動きは止める
    return inp;
  }
  ai.engId = null;
  // 呼びかけ: 従っていない人
  let yelling = null;
  for (const p of people) {
    const b = p.b;
    if (!b.alive || b.cuffed || b.down || b.comply >= 2 || (b.ai && b.ai.bound)) continue;
    if (p.d > 14) continue;
    yelling = b; break;
  }
  if (yelling && (!ai.yellT || sec(S, ai.yellT) > 1.3)) { ai.yellT = S.t; pushAct(inp, { a: 'shout', line: yelling.kind === 'sus' ? 'swat_hands' : 'swat_civ' }); }
  // 命令
  const o = ai.order;
  let busy = false;
  if (o) busy = doOrder(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, ctx, sk, people);
  // 命令がない・終わった: 拘束と報告を自分で、それから追従
  if (!busy) {
    if (autoSecure(S, w, a, inp, dt, people, ctx)) return inp;
    follow(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx);
  }
  // 呼びかけ相手がいれば、そちらへ銃を向ける（撃たない）
  if (yelling && !a.act) { aimAt(S, a, inp, yelling.x, yelling.y + 1.1, yelling.z, sk, dt, { id: yelling.id, errMul: 0.5 }); inp.ads = Math.hypot(yelling.x - a.x, yelling.z - a.z) < 10; inp.low = false; }

  else if (alarmYaw != null && !a.act && !(o && (o.stage === 'open' || o.ph === 'doing'))) { lookKeepMove(inp, turnToward(inp.yaw, alarmYaw, 7 * dt)); inp.ads = true; inp.low = false; }
  return inp;
}

// 体の向きだけを変え、世界での動く向きは保つ（mx/mz は体の向きに対する値なので直す）
function lookKeepMove(inp, yaw) {
  const s0 = Math.sin(inp.yaw), c0 = Math.cos(inp.yaw);
  const wx = s0 * inp.mz - c0 * inp.mx, wz = c0 * inp.mz + s0 * inp.mx;
  const s1 = Math.sin(yaw), c1 = Math.cos(yaw);
  inp.yaw = yaw; inp.mz = wx * s1 + wz * c1; inp.mx = -wx * c1 + wz * s1;
}

// 脅威か: 撃った・構えた（直前）・戦っている
export function isThreat(S, b) {
  if (!b.ai) return true;
  if (b.ai.threatT != null && sec(S, b.ai.threatT) < 1.2) return true;
  if (b.ai.st === 'fight' && b.ws && b.ws.slot >= 0 && !b.low) return true;
  return false;
}
// 射線に味方・市民がいないか
function lineClear(S, a, t) {
  const e = eyeOf(S, a);
  const dx = t.x - e[0], dz = t.z - e[2], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
  for (const b of S.actors) {
    if (b === a || b === t || !b.alive || (b.kind !== 'swat' && b.kind !== 'civ')) continue;
    const px = b.x - e[0], pz = b.z - e[2];
    const along = (px * dx + pz * dz) / L;
    if (along < 0.3 || along > L) continue;
    const perp = Math.abs(px * dz - pz * dx) / L;
    if (perp < 0.45 && Math.abs(b.y - a.y) < 1.5) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function leaderOf(S, a) {
  const id = a.ai.leader;
  let L = id != null ? S.byId[id] : null;
  if (!L || !L.alive || L.down) L = S.actors.find(b => b.pid != null && b.kind === 'swat' && b.alive && !b.down) || S.actors.find(b => b.kind === 'swat' && b.alive && !b.down && b !== a && b.ai && b.ai.slot === 0);
  return L;
}

// 追従: 指揮する人の後ろに、ずらした列で
function follow(S, w, a, inp, dt, ctx) {
  const L = leaderOf(S, a);
  if (!L || L === a) { inp.low = true; return; }
  const rank = (a.ai.slot || 0) + 1;
  const side = rank % 2 ? 0.55 : -0.55;
  const back = 0.9 + rank * 0.85;
  const fx = Math.sin(L.yaw), fz = Math.cos(L.yaw), rx = -fz, rz = fx;
  let tx = L.x - fx * back + rx * side, tz = L.z - fz * back + rz * side;
  // 歩けない所なら近くの床
  const k = navCell(w, tx, L.y, tz);
  const nav = buildNav(w);
  if (k < 0 || !nav.walk[k]) { const k2 = k >= 0 ? nearestWalk(w, k, 3) : -1; if (k2 >= 0) { const c = cellCenter(w, k2); tx = c[0]; tz = c[2]; } else { tx = L.x; tz = L.z; } }
  const d = Math.hypot(tx - a.x, tz - a.z);
  if (d > 0.7) {
    const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, tx, L.y, tz, { speed: d > 3 ? 1 : 0.6, r: 0.6, faceMove: d > 3 });
    inp.low = d > 2.5;
  }
  // 見張りの向き: 列の順に、前・右・左・後ろ
  const look = [0, 0.7, -0.7, Math.PI][a.ai.slot % 4];
  if (d <= 3) { const want = L.yaw + look; inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, want, 3 * dt); inp.pitch = a.pitch * 0.9; }
  inp.stance = L.stance === 1 ? 1 : 0;
}

// 人・物に手の届く立ち位置まで行き、向いて動作する（家具の向こうなら回り込む）。戻り値: 'busy' | 'fail'
function reachAndDo(S, w, a, inp, dt, k, t, op) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  const key = k + ':' + t.id + ':' + op;
  if (!reachOK(S, w, a, k, t.id, op)) {
    const same = ai.apt && ai.apt.key === key;
    if (!same || sec(S, ai.apt.t) > 2.0) ai.apt = { key, t: S.t, t0: same ? ai.apt.t0 : S.t, p: approachPoint(S, w, a, k, t.id, op, buildNav(w)) };
    if (!ai.apt.p || sec(S, ai.apt.t0) > 14) { ai.apt = null; return 'fail'; }
    const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, ai.apt.p[0], t.y, ai.apt.p[1], { speed: 0.6, r: 0.2 });
    if (r === 'blocked') { ai.apt = null; return 'fail'; }
    inp.low = true;
    return 'busy';
  }
  ai.apt = null;
  inp.mx = inp.mz = 0;
  const yw = yawTo(t.x - a.x, t.z - a.z);
  inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yw, 6 * dt);
  inp.pitch = turnToward(a.pitch, k === 'item' ? -0.7 : -0.6, 3 * dt);
  if (Math.abs(angDiff(inp.yaw, yw)) < 0.3) pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k, id: t.id, op });
  return 'busy';
}

// 投降・倒れた人を拘束し、報告する
function autoSecure(S, w, a, inp, dt, people, ctx) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  if (a.act) { inp.mx = inp.mz = 0; return true; }
  // 他の隊員がやっている相手は除く
  const taken = new Set();
  for (const b of S.actors) if (b !== a && b.kind === 'swat' && b.ai && b.ai.secId != null) taken.add(b.ai.secId);
  let best = null, bd = 1e9, op = null;
  const bad = ai.noReach || (ai.noReach = {});
  for (const p of people) {
    const b = p.b;
    if (taken.has(b.id) || p.d > 9 || (bad[b.id] && S.t < bad[b.id])) continue;
    if (b.alive && !b.cuffed && (b.comply >= 1 || b.down || b.tased > 0 || b.stun > 1)) { if (p.d < bd) { bd = p.d; best = b; op = 'restrain'; } }
    else if ((b.cuffed || b.down || b.dead) && !b.reported) { if (p.d + 3 < bd) { bd = p.d + 3; best = b; op = 'report'; } }
  }
  // 倒れた味方の報告
  for (const b of S.actors) if (b.kind === 'swat' && b !== a && b.down && !b.reported && !taken.has(b.id)) { const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z); if (d < 8 && d + 4 < bd) { bd = d + 4; best = b; op = 'report'; } }
  // 見つけた爆弾の解除（爆弾脅迫）: 人の確保より先に
  if (S.m && S.m.bombs && S.m.bombs.length) {
    let bb = null, bbd = 1e9;
    for (const B of S.m.bombs) {
      if (B.done || !B.found || taken.has('b' + B.id) || (bad['b' + B.id] && S.t < bad['b' + B.id]) || Math.abs(B.y - a.y) > 1.5) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(B.x - a.x, B.z - a.z);
      if (d < 14 && d < bbd) { bbd = d; bb = B; }
    }
    if (bb) {
      ai.secId = 'b' + bb.id;
      if (reachAndDo(S, w, a, inp, dt, 'bomb', bb, 'bombdefuse') === 'fail') { bad['b' + bb.id] = S.t + Math.round(20 / S.dt); ai.secId = null; return false; }
      return true;
    }
  }
  if (!best) { ai.secId = null; return false; }
  ai.secId = best.id;
  // 拘束は手の届く所まで、報告は見えていれば少し離れていてよい
  if (reachAndDo(S, w, a, inp, dt, 'person', best, op) === 'fail') { bad[best.id] = S.t + Math.round(30 / S.dt); ai.secId = null; return false; }
  return true;
}

// ---- 命令ごとの動き。戻り値: 命令で忙しいか
function doOrder(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, ctx, sk, people) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  const done = () => { ai.order = null; ai.nav = null; return false; };
  if (sec(S, o.phT) > 90) return done();
  switch (o.cmd) {
    case 'move': {
      if (!o.tgt) {
        // 自分の位置: 指示の点のまわりに少しずつずらす。家具の中・壁の向こう・扉の口なら、同じ部屋の近くの床へ
        const off = o.role === 0 ? [0, 0] : [[0.7, 0], [-0.7, 0], [0, -0.8], [0.7, -0.8]][(o.role - 1) % 4];
        const fx = Math.sin(o.yaw || 0), fz = Math.cos(o.yaw || 0);
        const tx = o.x + (-fz) * off[0] + fx * off[1], tz = o.z + fx * off[0] + fz * off[1];
        const kc = navCell(w, o.x, o.y || 0, o.z), room = kc >= 0 ? w.roomAt[kc] : -1;
        o.tgt = snapFloor(w, tx, o.y || 0, tz, room) || snapFloor(w, o.x, o.y || 0, o.z, room) || [o.x, o.z];
      }
      const [tx, tz] = o.tgt;
      const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, tx, o.y, tz, { speed: 0.8, r: 0.5 });
      inp.low = r === 'moving';
      // 着いた・行けない・近くで詰まった（味方が立っているなど）・進まない（8秒）・時間切れ → その場で待機
      const dd = Math.hypot(tx - a.x, tz - a.z);
      if (o.bestD == null || dd < o.bestD - 0.3) { o.bestD = dd; o.bestT = S.t; }
      else if (sec(S, o.bestT) > 8) { o.cmd = 'hold'; o.hy = o.yaw; o.doneT = S.t; o.failed = true; return true; }
      if (dd < 1.8 && los(w, a.x, a.y + 1, a.z, tx, (o.y || 0) + 1, tz, S.doors)) o.nearT = (o.nearT || 0) + S.dt;
      if (r === 'arrived' || r === 'blocked' || (o.nearT || 0) > 1.2 || sec(S, o.phT) > 25) { o.cmd = 'hold'; o.hy = o.yaw; o.doneT = S.t; }
      return true;
    }
    case 'hold': case 'cover': {
      inp.mx = inp.mz = 0;
      // 扉の口（死の漏斗）に立ち止まらない: 近ければ脇へよける
      const dn = nearDoor(w, a);
      if (dn) { steerToward(a, inp, dn.x, dn.z, 0.6, false); return true; }
      const want = o.cmd === 'cover' && o.x != null ? yawTo(o.x - a.x, o.z - a.z) : (o.hy ?? a.yaw);
      inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, want + (o.role % 2 ? 0.25 : -0.25) * (o.cmd === 'hold' ? 1 : 0.3), 4 * dt);
      inp.ads = o.cmd === 'cover';
      return true;
    }
    case 'stack': return stackAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, o.side || 'split');
    case 'breach': return breach(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, ctx, sk);
    case 'mirror': case 'wedge': case 'disarm': case 'pick': case 'unwedge': {
      if (o.role !== 0) return stackAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, 'split');
      const d = w.doors[o.door]; if (!d) return done();
      if (o.ph === 'done') return done();
      const side = o.side0 ?? (o.side0 = sideOf(d, a.x, a.z));
      const fx = d.cx + d.nx * side * 0.65, fz = d.cz + d.nz * side * 0.65;
      const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, fx, d.L * LH, fz, { speed: 0.7, r: 0.3, noDoors: true });
      if (r === 'arrived' || Math.hypot(fx - a.x, fz - a.z) < 0.5) {
        inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(d.cx - a.x, d.cz - a.z), 6 * dt);
        if (!a.act && o.ph !== 'doing') {
          const ops = doorOps(S, w, a, o.door);
          const want = o.cmd === 'pick' ? (ops.find(x => x.op === 'lockgun') ? 'lockgun' : 'pick') : o.cmd;
          if (!ops.find(x => x.op === want)) { o.ph = 'done'; return true; }
          pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'door', id: o.door, op: want }); o.ph = 'doing'; o.doT = S.t;
        } else if (!a.act && o.ph === 'doing' && sec(S, o.doT) > 0.3) o.ph = 'done';
      }
      return true;
    }
    case 'restrain': {
      const b = S.byId[o.target];
      if (!b || b.cuffed || !b.alive) return done();
      if (o.role !== 0) return false;
      if (a.act) { inp.mx = inp.mz = 0; return true; }
      if (reachAndDo(S, w, a, inp, dt, 'person', b, 'restrain') === 'fail') return done();
      return true;
    }
    case 'deploy': {
      if (o.role !== 0) return false;
      return throwAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o.nade, o.x, o.y, o.z, () => { ai.order = null; });
    }
    case 'search': return search(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, people);
  }
  return done();
}

// 扉の口の近く（1m以内）にいたら、よける先（扉の面に沿って脇、自分のいる側）
function nearDoor(w, a) {
  const L = levelOfY(a.y + 0.2);
  for (const d of w.doors) {
    if (d.L !== L) continue;
    const dx = a.x - d.cx, dz = a.z - d.cz;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 1.4 || Math.abs(dz) > 1.4) continue;
    const along = d.axis === 0 ? dx : dz, across = dx * d.nx + dz * d.nz;
    const half = (d.a1 - d.a0) / 2;
    if (Math.abs(along) < half + 0.25 && Math.abs(across) < 0.9) {
      const sgn = along >= 0 ? 1 : -1, side = across >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
      const tx = d.axis === 0 ? 1 : 0, tz = d.axis === 0 ? 0 : 1;
      return { x: d.cx + tx * sgn * (half + 0.7) + d.nx * side * 0.7, z: d.cz + tz * sgn * (half + 0.7) + d.nz * side * 0.7 };
    }
  }
  return null;
}
// スタック: 扉の手前側の壁ぞいに並ぶ（分割＝左右交互）
function stackPos(S, w, d, side, role, how) {
  const tx = d.axis === 0 ? 1 : 0, tz = d.axis === 0 ? 0 : 1; // 壁にそった向き
  const half = (d.a1 - d.a0) / 2;
  let sgn = how === 'left' ? -1 : how === 'right' ? 1 : (role % 2 ? 1 : -1);
  const rank = how === 'split' ? Math.floor(role / 2) : role;
  const along = half + 0.45 + rank * 0.65;
  const outN = 0.45;
  let x = d.cx + tx * along * sgn + d.nx * side * outN, z = d.cz + tz * along * sgn + d.nz * side * outN;
  return [x, z];
}
function stackAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, how) {
  const d = w.doors[o.door]; if (!d) { a.ai.order = null; return false; }
  const side = o.side0 ?? (o.side0 = sideOf(d, S.byId[o.by] ? S.byId[o.by].x : a.x, S.byId[o.by] ? S.byId[o.by].z : a.z));
  const [x, z] = stackPos(S, w, d, side, o.role, how);
  const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, x, d.L * LH, z, { speed: 0.8, r: 0.3, noDoors: true, keep: o.door });
  inp.low = r === 'moving';
  if (r === 'arrived' || (r !== 'moving' && Math.hypot(x - a.x, z - a.z) < 1.2)) {
    inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(d.cx - a.x, d.cz - a.z), 5 * dt);
    o.inPos = true;
  } else if (r === 'blocked') {
    // 行けない: 少し待ってだめなら、この命令をやめる（指揮する人が別の道を選ぶ）
    o.blockT = (o.blockT || 0) + S.dt;
    if (o.blockT > 6) { o.inPos = true; o.cantReach = true; }
  }
  return true;
}

// 突入: スタック → 開ける（方法）→ 投げ物 → 入る（左右の角へ）→ 安全を確かめる
function breach(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, ctx, sk) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  const d = w.doors[o.door], ds = S.doors[o.door];
  if (!d || !ds) { ai.order = null; return false; }
  const issuer = S.byId[o.by];
  const side = o.side0 ?? (o.side0 = sideOf(d, issuer ? issuer.x : a.x, issuer ? issuer.z : a.z));
  // 全員で共有する進み具合（同じ命令番号）
  // 突入の命令をまだ実行中の隊員だけ（待機に移った人は数えない。数えると段階が最初に戻る）
  const team = S.actors.filter(b => b.kind === 'swat' && b.ai && b.ai.order && b.ai.order.seq === o.seq && b.ai.order.cmd === 'breach' && b.alive && !b.down);
  const lead = team.reduce((m, b) => (b.ai.order.role < m.ai.order.role ? b : m), team[0] || a);
  const T = lead.ai.order;
  if (!T.stage) { T.stage = 'stack'; T.stT = S.t; }
  const stage = T.stage;
  // 遠い隊員（別の階・8mより先）は待たない（あとから追いつく）
  const far = (b) => levelOfY(b.y + 0.3) !== d.L || Math.hypot(b.x - d.cx, b.z - d.cz) > 8;
  if (stage === 'stack') {
    stackAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, 'split');
    if (a === lead) {
      const ready = team.every(b => b.ai.order.inPos || far(b)) || sec(S, T.stT) > 8;
      if (ready) { T.stage = 'open'; T.stT = S.t; T.party = team.filter(b => b.ai.order.inPos).map(b => b.id); pushAct(inp, { a: 'shout', line: 'swat_breaching' }); }
    }
    return true;
  }
  if (stage === 'open') {
    // 開ける人: 必要な道具を持つ隊員
    const need = o.method === 'ram' ? (b) => b.inv.long === 'ram' : o.method === 'breach' ? (b) => b.inv.long === 'breacher' : o.method === 'c2' ? (b) => b.inv.gear.some(g => g.id === 'c2' && g.n > 0) : () => true;
    // 道具を持つ隊員が扉の前へ来られない（5秒）ときは、先頭が蹴る・開ける
    const opener = (!T.noTool && team.find(need)) || lead;
    if (a !== opener) { stackAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, 'split'); return true; }
    if (isOpen(ds) || ds.broken) { T.stage = o.nade && o.nade !== 'none' ? 'nade' : 'enter'; T.stT = S.t; return true; }
    const fx = d.cx + d.nx * side * 0.6, fz = d.cz + d.nz * side * 0.6;
    const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, fx, d.L * LH, fz, { speed: 0.6, r: 0.25, noDoors: true, keep: o.door });
    if (r !== 'arrived' && Math.hypot(fx - a.x, fz - a.z) > 0.45) {
      if (!T.noTool && a !== lead && sec(S, T.stT) > 5) { T.noTool = true; T.stT = S.t; }
      // 扉の前まで行けない（12秒）: 突入をやめる
      if (sec(S, T.stT) > 12) { for (const b of team) b.ai.order = null; }
      return true;
    }
    inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(d.cx - a.x, d.cz - a.z), 6 * dt);
    if (a.act) return true;
    const ops = doorOps(S, w, a, o.door);
    let m = T.noTool && (o.method === 'ram' || o.method === 'breach' || o.method === 'c2') ? 'open' : o.method || 'open';
    if (m === 'open' && ds.locked && !ds.lockBroken) { m = 'kick'; if (!T.saidLocked) { T.saidLocked = true; pushAct(inp, { a: 'shout', line: 'swat_locked' }); } }
    if (!ops.find(x => x.op === m)) m = ops.find(x => x.op === 'kick') ? 'kick' : 'open';
    if (m === 'c2') {
      if (!ds.c2) { pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'door', id: o.door, op: 'c2' }); T.c2T = S.t; return true; }
      // 離れて起爆
      const bx = d.cx + d.nx * side * 3.0, bz = d.cz + d.nz * side * 3.0;
      const r2 = goTo(S, w, a, inp, bx, d.L * LH, bz, { speed: 0.9, r: 0.5, noDoors: true });
      if (r2 !== 'moving' || sec(S, T.c2T) > 6) pushAct(inp, { a: 'det' });
      return true;
    }
    if (!T.opT || sec(S, T.opT) > 0.9) { T.opT = S.t; pushAct(inp, { a: 'op', k: 'door', id: o.door, op: m }); }
    if (sec(S, T.stT) > 20) { T.stage = 'enter'; T.stT = S.t; }
    return true;
  }
  if (stage === 'nade') {
    const thrower = team.find(b => b.inv.gear.some(g => g.id === o.nade && g.n > 0) && b.ai.order.role !== 0) || team.find(b => b.inv.gear.some(g => g.id === o.nade && g.n > 0));
    if (!thrower) { T.stage = 'enter'; T.stT = S.t; return true; }
    if (a !== thrower) { stackAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, 'split'); if (T.thrown && sec(S, T.thrown) > 1.7) { T.stage = 'enter'; T.stT = S.t; } return true; }
    const tx = d.cx - d.nx * side * 3.2, tz = d.cz - d.nz * side * 3.2;
    if (!T.thrown) throwAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o.nade, tx, d.L * LH + 0.5, tz, () => { T.thrown = S.t; });
    else { stackAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, 'split'); if (sec(S, T.thrown) > 1.7) { T.stage = 'enter'; T.stT = S.t; } }
    return true;
  }
  if (stage === 'enter') {
    // 入る順: 役の番号順に 0.45秒ずつ
    const myT = o.role * 0.45;
    if (sec(S, T.stT) < myT) { stackAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, 'split'); return true; }
    const P = entryPoint(S, w, d, side, o.role);
    const r = goTo(S, w, a, inp, P[0], d.L * LH, P[1], { speed: 0.75, r: 0.35 });
    inp.ads = true; inp.low = false;
    // 入りながら部屋の奥を見る
    const lx = d.cx - d.nx * side * 4, lz = d.cz - d.nz * side * 4;
    const inside = sideOf(d, a.x, a.z) !== side;
    if (inside) { inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(P[2] - a.x, P[3] - a.z), 7 * dt); inp.mz = Math.min(inp.mz, 0.8); }
    if (r !== 'moving') { o.inRoom = true; inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(P[2] - a.x, P[3] - a.z), 6 * dt); }
    // スタックにいた隊員（party）が部屋に入ったら制圧へ
    const party = T.party && T.party.length ? T.party : team.map(b => b.id);
    if (a === lead && team.every(b => !party.includes(b.id) || b.ai.order.inRoom || !b.alive)) { if (!T.clearT) T.clearT = S.t; if (sec(S, T.clearT) > 1.5) { T.stage = 'clear'; T.stT = S.t; } }
    if (sec(S, T.stT) > 18) { T.stage = 'clear'; T.stT = S.t; }
    return true;
  }
  if (stage === 'clear') {
    if (a === lead && !T.said) { T.said = true; pushAct(inp, { a: 'shout', line: 'swat_clear' }); }
    // その場で見張る。少したったら全員そろって待機へ（指揮する人が動いたら追従へ）
    const P = entryPoint(S, w, d, side, o.role);
    inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, yawTo(P[2] - a.x, P[3] - a.z), 4 * dt);
    if (a === lead && sec(S, T.stT) > 2.5) {
      for (const b of team) { const bo = b.ai.order; b.ai.order = { cmd: 'hold', hy: b.yaw, role: bo.role, seq: bo.seq, cnt: bo.cnt, ph: 'go', phT: S.t, by: bo.by, team: bo.team, t: S.t, doneT: S.t }; }
    }
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}
// 部屋の中の制圧の位置（入口の左右の角、奥）と見る点
function entryPoint(S, w, d, side, role) {
  const nx = -d.nx * side, nz = -d.nz * side; // 部屋の中への向き
  const tx = d.axis === 0 ? 1 : 0, tz = d.axis === 0 ? 0 : 1;
  const sgn = role % 2 ? 1 : -1, rank = Math.floor(role / 2);
  const depth = 0.9 + rank * 1.0, lat = 1.4 + rank * 0.6;
  let x = d.cx + nx * depth + tx * sgn * lat, z = d.cz + nz * depth + tz * sgn * lat;
  const k = navCell(w, x, d.L * LH, z);
  const nav = buildNav(w);
  if (k < 0 || !nav.walk[k]) { const k2 = k >= 0 ? nearestWalk(w, k, 3) : -1; if (k2 >= 0) { const c = cellCenter(w, k2); x = c[0]; z = c[2]; } else { x = d.cx + nx * 1.0; z = d.cz + nz * 1.0; } }
  // 見る点: 反対側の奥の角
  const lx = d.cx + nx * 4.5 - tx * sgn * 2.5, lz = d.cz + nz * 4.5 - tz * sgn * 2.5;
  return [x, z, lx, lz];
}

// 投げ物を点へ
function throwAt(S, w, a, inp, dt, nade, tx, ty, tz, onThrown) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  const has = a.inv.gear.find(g => g.id === nade && g.n > 0);
  if (!has) { onThrown(); return false; }
  const dx = tx - a.x, dz = tz - a.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  const want = yawTo(dx, dz);
  inp.yaw = turnToward(a.yaw, want, 7 * dt);
  const th = 0.28;
  inp.pitch = turnToward(a.pitch, th - 0.12, 3 * dt);
  if (a.ws.slot !== 2 || a.ws.gear !== nade) { if (!ai.selT || sec(S, ai.selT) > 1) { ai.selT = S.t; pushAct(inp, { a: 'gear', id: nade }); } return true; }
  if ((a.ws.st === 'gear' || a.ws.st === 'ready') && Math.abs(angDiff(a.yaw, want)) < 0.12) {
    const v = Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, d) * 9.81 / Math.sin(2 * th));
    inp.power = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(1, (v - 4) / 9));
    inp.fire = true;
    pushAct(inp, { a: 'shout', line: nade === 'flash' ? 'swat_flash' : nade === 'stinger' ? 'swat_stinger' : 'swat_gas' });
    onThrown();
  }
  return true;
}

// 捜索して確保: 近くの部屋で、投降・倒れた人を拘束して報告し、落ちた武器を回収
function search(S, w, a, inp, dt, o, people) {
  const ai = a.ai;
  if (a.act) { inp.mx = inp.mz = 0; return true; }
  if (sec(S, o.phT) > 30) { ai.order = null; ai.secId = null; return false; }
  const bad = ai.noReach || (ai.noReach = {});
  const room0 = o.room ?? (o.room = roomAtPos(w, a.x, a.y, a.z));
  const taken = new Set();
  for (const b of S.actors) if (b !== a && b.kind === 'swat' && b.ai && b.ai.secId != null) taken.add(b.ai.secId);
  // 人
  let best = null, bd = 1e9, op = null, kind = 'person';
  for (const b of S.actors) {
    if ((b.kind !== 'sus' && b.kind !== 'civ') || taken.has(b.id) || (bad[b.id] && S.t < bad[b.id])) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
    if (d > 16 || Math.abs(b.y - a.y) > 2) continue;
    if (b.alive && !b.cuffed && (b.comply >= 1 || b.down)) { if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = b; op = 'restrain'; } }
    else if ((b.cuffed || b.dead || b.down) && !b.reported) { if (d + 2 < bd) { bd = d + 2; best = b; op = 'report'; } }
  }
  // 証拠
  for (const it of S.items) {
    if (it.gone || (it.kind !== 'weapon' && it.kind !== 'evidence') || (bad[-it.id] && S.t < bad[-it.id])) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(it.x - a.x, it.z - a.z);
    if (d > 14 || taken.has(-it.id) || Math.abs(it.y - a.y) > 2) continue;
    if (d + 1 < bd) { bd = d + 1; best = it; op = 'collect'; kind = 'item'; }
  }
  // 見つけた爆弾（いちばん先に）
  if (S.m && S.m.bombs) for (const B of S.m.bombs) {
    if (B.done || !B.found || taken.has('b' + B.id) || (bad['b' + B.id] && S.t < bad['b' + B.id]) || Math.abs(B.y - a.y) > 2) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(B.x - a.x, B.z - a.z) - 6;
    if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = B; op = 'bombdefuse'; kind = 'bomb'; }
  }
  if (!best) { if (sec(S, o.phT) > 3) ai.order = null; return false; }
  const sid = kind === 'item' ? -best.id : kind === 'bomb' ? 'b' + best.id : best.id;
  if (ai.secId !== sid) { ai.secId = sid; ai.secT = S.t; }
  // 手の届く所まで行って動作。届かない相手・物（回り込めない・14秒）はしばらく後回し
  if (reachAndDo(S, w, a, inp, dt, kind, best, op) === 'fail' || sec(S, ai.secT) > 20) { bad[sid] = S.t + Math.round(30 / S.dt); ai.secId = null; ai.apt = null; }
  return true;
}

// 世界の点 → 体の向きの座標（+Z 前、+X 左、Y は足元から）
function toLocal(a, p, out) {
  if (!p) return null;
  const dx = p[0] - a.x, dz = p[2] - a.z, c = Math.cos(a.yaw), s = Math.sin(a.yaw);
  const o = out || [0, 0, 0];
  o[0] = dx * c - dz * s; o[1] = p[1] - a.y; o[2] = dx * s + dz * c;
  return o;
}

// 人の当たりのカプセル（そのステップで1回だけ計算）
export function capsOf(S, a) {

}

export function spawnBullet(S, a, W, wi, am, dx, dy, dz, m, extraPellet) {

// すべての弾を1ステップ進める
export function stepBullets(S, w, dt, ev) {
  const B = S.bullets;
  for (let i = B.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

  }

function stepBullet(S, w, b, dt, ev) {
  b.t += dt;
  if (b.t > 2.0 || b.dist > 400) return false;
  const vx = b.vx, vy = b.vy - G * dt * 0.5, vz = b.vz;
  const sp = Math.hypot(vx, vy, vz);
  const segL = sp * dt;
  const dx = vx / sp, dy = vy / sp, dz = vz / sp;
  // 世界との当たり
  const hits = raycast(w, b.x, b.y, b.z, dx, dy, dz, segL, S.doors, _rc).slice();
  // 人との当たり
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    if (a.id === b.skip && b.dist < 2) continue;
    if (!a.alive && !a.dead) continue;
    if (a.isDrone) {
      const t = raySphere(b.x, b.y, b.z, dx, dy, dz, segL, a.x, a.y + 0.08, a.z, 0.16);
      if (t >= 0) hits.push({ t0: t, t1: t + 0.1, kind: 'actor', a, part: 'drone' });
      continue;
    }
    // おおまかな判定（体を包む球）
    const cx = a.x, cy = a.y + 0.9, cz = a.z;
    const ox = cx - b.x, oy = cy - b.y, oz = cz - b.z;
    const tc = ox * dx + oy * dy + oz * dz;
    if (tc < -1.3 || tc > segL + 1.3) continue;
    const d2 = ox * ox + oy * oy + oz * oz - tc * tc;
    if (d2 > 1.6 * 1.6) {
      continue;
    }
    // 近くを抜けた（制圧）
    if (a.alive && a.team !== b.team && d2 < 2.2 && a.id !== b.owner) { a._whiz = Math.max(a._whiz || 0, 1 - Math.sqrt(d2) / 1.5); a.whizBy = b.owner; a.whizT = S.t; }
    const caps = capsOf(S, a);
    let best = -1, bp = null;
    for (const c of caps) {
      const t = rayCapsule(b.x, b.y, b.z, dx, dy, dz, segL, c.a, c.b, c.r);
      if (t >= 0 && (best < 0 || t < best)) { best = t; bp = c; }
    }
    if (best >= 0) hits.push({ t0: best, t1: best + 0.25, kind: 'actor', a, part: bp.part, cap: bp });
    // 防弾盾（前から当たったときだけ）
    if (a._shieldF && a.alive) { const t = rayShield(b.x, b.y, b.z, dx, dy, dz, segL, a._shieldF); if (t >= 0) hits.push({ t0: t, t1: t + 0.03, kind: 'shield', a }); }
  }
  hits.sort((p, q) => p.t0 - q.t0);
  for (const h of hits) {
    if (h.t0 > segL) break;
    const hx = b.x + dx * h.t0, hy = b.y + dy * h.t0, hz = b.z + dz * h.t0;
    if (h.kind === 'shield') {
      const a = h.a, sf = a._shieldF;
      const am = AMMO[b.cal] && AMMO[b.cal][b.am];
      if (!b.less && am && am.apen > SHIELD.prot) {
        // 抜ける（7.62×51mmの徹甲弾）
        ev.push({ e: 'imp', x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, nx: sf.f[0], ny: sf.f[1], nz: sf.f[2], m: M.METAL, k: 'shield', pen: true, o: b.owner, w: b.wid });
        b.pen -= 450; b.k = Math.max(0.05, b.pen / b.pen0);
        if (b.pen <= 0) return false;
        continue;
      }
      ev.push({ e: 'imp', x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, nx: sf.f[0], ny: sf.f[1], nz: sf.f[2], m: M.METAL, k: 'shield', pen: false, o: b.owner, w: b.wid });
      ev.push({ e: 'shieldhit', id: a.id, by: b.owner, x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, less: b.less ? 1 : 0 });
      a.flinch = Math.max(a.flinch || 0, b.less ? 0.08 : 0.2);
      return false;
    }
    if (h.kind === 'actor') {
      const a = h.a;
      if (a.alive || a.dead) {
        const dist = b.dist + h.t0;
        applyBulletHit(S, w, a, b, h.part, hx, hy, hz, dx, dy, dz, dist, ev);
        if (b.less) return false;
        b.pen -= BODY_PEN;
        b.k = Math.max(0, b.pen / b.pen0);
        if (b.pen <= 0) { return false; }
        b.skip = a.id;
      }
      continue;
    }
    const mat = MATS[h.mat];
    if (!mat) continue;
    if (h.kind === 'edge') return false;
    // 割れる物
    if (h.mat === M.GLASS) { breakGlass(S, w, h, ev); b.pen -= 30; b.k = Math.max(0.05, b.pen / b.pen0); continue; }
    if (h.mat === M.GLASSBROKEN) continue;
    if (h.kind === 'bar') { damageBarricade(S, w, h.id, b.pellet ? 3 : 1, ev); }
    if (h.kind === 'block' && mat.hp > 0 && b.pellet && b.dist < 6) { damageBlock(S, w, h.k, h.q, 8, ev); }
    const thick = Math.min(1.5, Math.max(0.01, h.t1 - h.t0));
    const cost = h.kind === 'slab' || h.kind === 'stair' ? 1e9 : mat.pen * thick;
    const stop = b.less || cost >= b.pen;
    ev.push({ e: 'imp', x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, nx: h.nx || 0, ny: h.ny || 0, nz: h.nz || 0, m: h.mat, k: h.kind, pen: !stop, o: b.owner, w: b.wid });
    if (stop) {
      // 跳ね返りは小さい音だけ
      return false;
    }
    b.pen -= cost;
    b.k = Math.max(0.05, b.pen / b.pen0);
    // 出口
    ev.push({ e: 'imp', x: b.x + dx * h.t1, y: b.y + dy * h.t1, z: b.z + dz * h.t1, nx: dx, ny: dy, nz: dz, m: h.mat, k: h.kind, exit: 1, o: b.owner });
  }
  b.x += dx * segL; b.y += dy * segL; b.z += dz * segL;
  b.vy -= G * dt; b.dist += segL;
  return true;
}

// 盾の板（中心 p、前 f、上 u、左 l）と線の交わり。前から当たったときだけ
function rayShield(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, maxT, sf) {
  const n = sf.f, den = dx * n[0] + dy * n[1] + dz * n[2];
  if (den > -1e-4) return -1;
  const t = ((sf.p[0] - ox) * n[0] + (sf.p[1] - oy) * n[1] + (sf.p[2] - oz) * n[2]) / den;
  if (t < 0 || t > maxT) return -1;
  const px = ox + dx * t - sf.p[0], py = oy + dy * t - sf.p[1], pz = oz + dz * t - sf.p[2];
  if (Math.abs(px * sf.l[0] + py * sf.l[1] + pz * sf.l[2]) > SHIELD.hw) return -1;
  if (Math.abs(px * sf.u[0] + py * sf.u[1] + pz * sf.u[2]) > SHIELD.hh) return -1;
  return t;
}
function raySphere(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, maxT, cx, cy, cz, r) {
  const lx = ox - cx, ly = oy - cy, lz = oz - cz;
  const bq = lx * dx + ly * dy + lz * dz, cq = lx * lx + ly * ly + lz * lz - r * r;
  const h = bq * bq - cq; if (h < 0) return -1;
  const t = -bq - Math.sqrt(h); return t >= 0 && t <= maxT ? t : -1;
}

export function breakGlass(S, w, h, ev) {
  const k = h.k, q = h.q;
  if (k == null) return;
  // 同じ窓のガラスはまとめて割れる
  const b = k * 4;
  let any = false;
  for (let qq = 0; qq < 4; qq++) if (w.blocks[b + qq] === M.GLASS) { w.blocks[b + qq] = M.GLASSBROKEN; any = true; }
  if (any) { S.bdiff[k] = 1; ev.push({ e: 'glass', k, x: h.x, q }); }
}

// 壁のブロックを傷める（散弾・爆発）。壊れたら穴になる
export function damageBlock(S, w, k, q, dmg, ev) {
  const bi = k * 4 + q;
  const m = w.blocks[bi];
  if (!m || !MATS[m] || !MATS[m].hp) return false;
  if (S.reinf && S.reinf[k]) return false;
  const hp = w.bhp[bi] - dmg;
  if (hp > 0) { w.bhp[bi] = hp; return false; }
  w.blocks[bi] = 0; w.bhp[bi] = 0;
  S.bdiff[k] = 1;
  ev.push({ e: 'block', k, q, m });
  return true;
}

export function damageBarricade(S, w, did, dmg, ev) {
  const ds = S.doors[did];
  if (!ds || ds.bar <= 0) return;
  ds.bar -= dmg;
  if (ds.bar <= 0) { ds.bar = 0; ev.push({ e: 'barbreak', d: did }); }
  else ev.push({ e: 'barhit', d: did });
}

// ---- ダメージ ----
// 部位が防具に覆われているか: 胸は前と後ろ（撃たれた向き）、重いベストは腹と脇も
function plateSide(a, dx, dz) {
  // 弾の向きと体の前の内積: 正なら後ろから
  const fx = Math.sin(a.yaw), fz = Math.cos(a.yaw);
  return dx * fx + dz * fz > 0 ? 'back' : 'front';
}

export function applyBulletHit(S, w, a, b, part, hx, hy, hz, dx, dy, dz, dist, ev) {
  const shooter = S.byId[b.owner];
  const W = WEAPONS[b.wid];
  if (part === 'drone') { killDrone(S, a, b.owner, ev); return; }
  if (a.dead) { ev.push({ e: 'blood', x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, dx, dy, dz, n: 1, id: a.id }); return; }
  if (S.pvp) return applyPvP(S, w, a, b, shooter, W, part, hx, hy, hz, dx, dy, dz, dist, ev);
  return applyPvE(S, w, a, b, shooter, W, part, hx, hy, hz, dx, dy, dz, dist, ev);
}

function applyPvE(S, w, a, b, shooter, W, part, hx, hy, hz, dx, dy, dz, dist, ev) {
  const am = AMMO[b.cal][b.am];
  // 交戦規定の判定は、撃たれる前の状態で（この弾で倒れたことを「倒れている人を撃った」にしない）
  const pre = { down: a.down || !a.alive, dead: !a.alive, cuffed: a.cuffed, comply: a.comply, armed: !!(a.inv.w[0] || a.inv.w[1]) };
  const rnd = (k) => hrand(a.id, S.t, k + (b.owner << 4));
  // 非致死
  if (am.less) {
    const L = am.less;
    if (L.tase) {
      const range = W.range || 7.6;
      if (dist <= range) { a.tased = L.tase; a.stun = Math.max(a.stun, L.tase); ev.push({ e: 'tase', id: a.id, by: b.owner }); harm(S, a, shooter, 'less', 0, part, ev, pre); }
      return;
    }
    let st = L.stun;
    if (part === 'head') st *= 1.6;
    a.stun = Math.max(a.stun, st);
    if (a.ai) a.ai.morale = Math.max(0, (a.ai.morale ?? 0.5) - L.morale);
    if (L.gas) S.clouds.push({ x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, r: 0.9, t: 3.5, type: 'pepper', max: 1.2 });
    let d = am.dmg * (part === 'head' ? (dist < 3 ? 6 : 2.5) : 1);
    if (d > 0) hurt(S, w, a, d, part, shooter, b, dx, dz, ev, 'less');
    ev.push({ e: 'hit', id: a.id, by: b.owner, part, d, less: 1, x: hx, y: hy, z: hz });
    harm(S, a, shooter, 'less', d, part, ev, pre);
    return;
  }
  let d = am.dmg * b.k;
  let blocked = false, pen = true;
  const ar = a.armor;
  // 部位の倍率
  if (part === 'head') {
    // 顔か頭の上・後ろか
    const fx = Math.sin(a.yaw), fz = Math.cos(a.yaw);
    const face = (-dx * fx - dz * fz) > 0.45 && dy > -0.6;
    if (face && ar.face > 0) { ar.face--; if (rnd(1) < 0.33 || am.apen < 3) { blocked = true; d *= 0.08; ev.push({ e: 'rico', id: a.id, x: hx, y: hy, z: hz }); } }
    else if (!face && ar.helm > 0) { ar.helm--; blocked = true; d *= 0.06; if (rnd(2) < (HELMET[ar.helmet] || HELMET.none).rico) d = 0; ev.push({ e: 'rico', id: a.id, x: hx, y: hy, z: hz }); }
    if (!blocked) d *= am.head;
  } else if (part === 'neck') d *= 1.4;
  else if (part === 'arm' || part === 'leg') d *= am.limb;
  else {
    // 胴: 防具
    const cov = { none: [], light: ['chest'], heavy: ['chest', 'belly', 'pelvis'] }[ar.vest] || [];
    if (cov.includes(part)) {
      const P = PLATE[ar.plate];
      const side = plateSide(a, dx, dz);
      if (am.apen > P.prot) { d *= 0.85; }
      else {
        pen = false;
        const key = side === 'back' ? 'pb' : 'pf';
        if (P.hits > 0 && ar[key] > 0) { ar[key]--; d *= 0; blocked = true; ev.push({ e: 'plate', id: a.id, left: ar[key], side, x: hx, y: hy, z: hz }); }
        else d *= 1 - (P.hits > 0 ? P.after : P.red);
        if (P.spall && rnd(3) < 0.25) { d += 4; }
      }
    }
  }
  // 容疑者 → 隊員（人）の1発の上限（RoN: ふつう70/むずかしい80 → ×0.625）
  if (shooter && shooter.kind === 'sus' && a.kind === 'swat' && a.pid != null) d = Math.min(d, S.rules.cap || 44);
  // 怯み（容疑者と市民だけ）
  if (a.kind !== 'swat' && a.ai) { a.ai.stagger = Math.max(a.ai.stagger || 0, blocked ? 0.7 : 0.45); if (a.ai.morale != null) a.ai.morale -= blocked ? 0.15 : 0.08; }
  // 負傷と出血（隊員と、撃たれて生き残った人）
  if (d > 0 && !blocked) {
    if (part === 'arm') a.inj.arm = 1;
    if (part === 'leg') a.inj.leg = Math.min(4, a.inj.leg + 1);
    if (pen && (part === 'arm' || part === 'leg' || part === 'belly' || part === 'chest' || part === 'pelvis') && rnd(4) < 0.28) a.bleed = Math.max(a.bleed, 1.9);
  }
  if (d > 0) ev.push({ e: 'blood', x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, dx, dy, dz, n: Math.min(4, 1 + d / 30), id: a.id });
  // エイムパンチ（受けたダメージで決まる）
  a.flinch = Math.max(a.flinch, Math.min(1, 1 - Math.exp(-d / 30)));
  ev.push({ e: 'hit', id: a.id, by: b.owner, part, d, blocked, x: hx, y: hy, z: hz });
  if (d > 0) hurt(S, w, a, d, part, shooter, b, dx, dz, ev, 'bullet');
  harm(S, a, shooter, 'gun', d, part, ev, pre);
}

// 体力を減らし、倒れる・死ぬを決める
export function hurt(S, w, a, d, part, shooter, b, dx, dz, ev, kind) {
  if (!a.alive) return;
  a.hp -= d;
  if (shooter) { a.dmgBy[shooter.id] = (a.dmgBy[shooter.id] || 0) + d; shooter.stats.dmg += d; if (shooter.id !== a.id) shooter.stats.hi++; }
  a.lastHit = { by: shooter ? shooter.id : -1, t: S.t, part, kind };
  if (a.hp > 0) return;
  // 倒れる向き: 弾の向き
  a.fallYaw = Math.atan2(dx || 0, dz || 1) - a.yaw + (hrand(a.id, S.t, 9) - 0.5) * 0.8;
  const vital = part === 'head' || part === 'neck';
  if (a.kind === 'swat' && a.pid == null && !S.pvp) {
    // AI隊員: 行動不能（作戦の残りは動けない）
    a.hp = 0; downActor(S, a, shooter, ev, true);
    return;
  }
  if ((a.kind === 'sus' || a.kind === 'civ') && !vital && a.hp > -45 && kind !== 'blast' && hrand(a.id, S.t, 11) < 0.55) {
    // 容疑者・市民: 行動不能（まだ生きている。放っておくと出血で死ぬことがある）
    a.hp = 1; downActor(S, a, shooter, ev, false);
    return;
  }
  killActor(S, a, shooter, ev, kind, part);
}

export function downActor(S, a, by, ev, permanent) {
  if (a.down) return;
  a.down = true; a.downT = 0; a.stateT = 0; a.comply = 0; a.adsOn = false; a.ads = 0;
  a.bleedOut = permanent ? 0 : 45 + hrand(a.id, S.t, 3) * 90;
  dropWeapon(S, a, ev);
  ev.push({ e: 'down', id: a.id, by: by ? by.id : -1 });
}

export function killActor(S, a, by, ev, kind = 'bullet', part = '') {
  if (a.dead) return;
  a.alive = false; a.dead = true; a.down = false; a.stateT = a.down ? a.stateT : 0; a.comply = 0; a.hp = Math.min(0, a.hp);
  a.vx = a.vz = 0; if (a.act && a.act.k === 'restrain') { const b = S.byId[a.act.id]; if (b) { b.cuffBy = null; b.cuffYaw = null; b.cuffK = 0; } } a.act = null; a.ads = 0; a.dbno = 0;
  dropWeapon(S, a, ev);
  const killer = by && by.id !== a.id ? by : (a.lastHit && S.byId[a.lastHit.by]);
  const assists = [];
  for (const [id, dmg] of Object.entries(a.dmgBy)) { if (killer && +id === killer.id) continue; if (dmg >= 30 && S.byId[id]) assists.push(+id); }
  ev.push({ e: 'kill', id: a.id, by: killer ? killer.id : -1, kind, part, as: assists, hs: part === 'head' });
}

export function dropWeapon(S, a, ev) {
  if (a.kind === 'swat' && !S.pvp) return; // 隊員の銃は落とさない
  const wi = a.ws && a.ws.slot >= 0 ? a.inv.w[a.ws.slot] : null;
  const list = a.kind === 'sus' ? a.inv.w.filter(Boolean) : (wi ? [wi] : []);
  for (const x of list) {
    if (x.dropped) continue;
    x.dropped = true;
    S.items.push({ id: S.nextItem++, kind: 'weapon', wid: x.id, x: a.x + (hrand(a.id, S.t, 5) - 0.5) * 0.6, y: a.y + 0.03, z: a.z + (hrand(a.id, S.t, 6) - 0.5) * 0.6, yaw: hrand(a.id, S.t, 7) * 6.28, ev: a.kind === 'sus', from: a.id, w: x });
  }
  if (a.kind === 'sus' || a.kind === 'civ') { a.inv.w = [null, null]; a.ws.slot = -1; }
  ev.push({ e: 'drop', id: a.id });
}

function killDrone(S, a, by, ev) {
  if (!a.alive) return;
  a.alive = false; a.dead = true;
  ev.push({ e: 'dronedead', id: a.id, by });
}

// PvP（R6寄り）: 頭は即死（散弾の粒は1.5倍）、胴100%、手足75%、距離で減衰。ダウン（DBNO）はモードが決める
function applyPvP(S, w, a, b, shooter, W, part, hx, hy, hz, dx, dy, dz, dist, ev) {
  if (!W.pvp) return;
  if (shooter && shooter.team === a.team && shooter.id !== a.id && !S.rules.ff) return;
  if (a.spawnProt > 0) return;
  const P = W.pvp;
  let d = P.dmg * b.k;
  const [f0, f1, fm] = P.fall || [20, 35, 0.7];
  if (dist > f0) d *= dist >= f1 ? fm : 1 - (1 - fm) * (dist - f0) / (f1 - f0);
  let head = false;
  if (part === 'head') { if (b.pellet) d *= 1.5; else { d = 999; head = true; } }
  else if (part === 'arm' || part === 'leg') d *= 0.75;
  else if (part === 'neck') d *= 1.2;
  ev.push({ e: 'blood', x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, dx, dy, dz, n: Math.min(4, 1 + d / 25), id: a.id });
  a.flinch = Math.max(a.flinch, Math.min(1, 1 - Math.exp(-d / 30)));
  ev.push({ e: 'hit', id: a.id, by: b.owner, part, d: Math.min(d, a.hp + (a.down ? 20 : 0)), x: hx, y: hy, z: hz, hs: head });
  pvpDamage(S, a, d, shooter, part, dx, dz, ev, head ? 'head' : 'bullet');
}

export function pvpDamage(S, a, d, shooter, part, dx, dz, ev, kind) {
  if (!a.alive) return;
  if (shooter) { a.dmgBy[shooter.id] = (a.dmgBy[shooter.id] || 0) + d; if (shooter.id !== a.id) { shooter.stats.dmg += d; shooter.stats.hi++; } }
  a.lastHit = { by: shooter ? shooter.id : -1, t: S.t, part, kind };
  if (a.down && a.dbno) {
    a.dbno -= d;
    if (a.dbno <= 0) killActor(S, a, shooter, ev, kind, part);
    return;
  }
  a.hp -= d;
  if (a.hp > 0) return;
  a.fallYaw = Math.atan2(dx || 0, dz || 1) - a.yaw;
  // ダウンできるか（モードの規則）
  const canDown = !!(S.rules.dbno && kind !== 'head' && kind !== 'blast' && a.dbnoCount < 1 && hooks.canDown && hooks.canDown(S, a));
  if (canDown) {
    a.hp = 0; a.down = true; a.dbno = 20; a.dbnoCount++; a.downT = 0; a.stateT = 0; a.ads = 0; a.adsOn = false; a.sprint = false;
    a.bleedOut = 0;
    ev.push({ e: 'down', id: a.id, by: shooter ? shooter.id : -1, dbno: 1 });
    return;
  }
  killActor(S, a, shooter, ev, kind, part);
}

// 交戦規定の記録（モードが採点に使う）
function harm(S, a, shooter, how, d, part, ev, pre = null) {
  // 死んだ体に当たった弾（同じ瞬間の散弾・連射の残り）は数えない
  if (!shooter || S.pvp || (pre && pre.dead)) return;
  if (shooter.kind === 'swat' && (a.kind === 'sus' || a.kind === 'civ' || a.kind === 'swat')) {
    const st = pre || { down: a.down || !a.alive, cuffed: a.cuffed, comply: a.comply, armed: !!(a.inv.w[0] || a.inv.w[1]) };
    S.harms.push({ t: S.t, by: shooter.id, tgt: a.id, how, d, part, kind: a.kind, threat: a.ai ? (S.t - (a.ai.threatT ?? -1e9)) * S.dt < 2.0 : false, warned: a.ai ? a.ai.warned || 0 : 0, armed: st.armed, comply: st.comply, cuffed: st.cuffed, down: st.down });
  }
}

// 家具・小物の種類。大きさ w(左右) d(奥行) h(高さ) はメートル、向き0のとき w がX方向。
// boxes: 当たり（弾・視線・移動）の箱 [x0,y0,z0, x1,y1,z1, 材質]（中心が原点、床が y=0）
// solid: 移動を止める（低いものは足元を越えられる）。vault: 乗り越えられる。hide: 容疑者や市民が隠れる場所。

const B = (w, h, d, mat, y0 = 0, ox = 0, oz = 0) => [ox - w / 2, y0, oz - d / 2, ox + w / 2, y0 + h, oz + d / 2, mat];

// 銃のデータ（実銃の諸元＋ゲームの扱い）。資料室はここから作る。
// rpm: 発射速度（毎分）、vel: 銃口の弾の速さ m/s、kg: 重さ、mag: 装弾数、spare: 予備の弾倉の数
// ads/draw: 構える・持ち替えの時間（秒）、move: 移動の速さの倍率
// rc: 反動（度）{ v: 縦, h: 横のばらつき, bias: 横の癖（+で右）, first: 初弾の跳ねの倍率, ctrl: 戻る速さ（度/秒）, kick: 見た目の跳ね }
// sp: 散らばり（度）{ hip, ads, move: 全速で足される分 }
// rl: リロード（秒）{ tac: 弾倉を残す, fast: 捨てる, empty: 空のときに足す, shell: 散弾1発, start: 込め始め }
// pvp: { dmg, fall: [減衰が始まる距離, 終わる距離, 最低の倍率], pellets }
// 見た目: model（形の種類）

// 銃の種類ごとに付けられるもの
export function attachOptions(wid) {
  const W = WEAPONS[wid];
  if (!W) return {};
  const c = W.cat;
  if (c === 'rifle') return { sight: W.model === 'g36' ? ['reddot', 'holo', 'iron'] : ['iron', 'reddot', 'holo', 'lpvo'], muzzle: ['none', 'supp', 'comp'], grip: ['none', 'vert', 'angled'] };
  if (c === 'smg') return { sight: ['iron', 'reddot', 'holo'], muzzle: W.integral ? ['none'] : ['none', 'supp', 'comp'], grip: W.model === 'mp7' || W.model === 'ump' || W.model === 'mpx' ? ['none', 'vert', 'angled'] : ['none'] };
  if (c === 'shotgun') return { sight: W.model === 'sawedoff' ? ['iron'] : ['iron', 'reddot'], muzzle: ['none'], grip: ['none'] };
  if (c === 'pistol') return { sight: W.revolver || W.model === 'makarov' ? ['iron'] : ['iron', 'rmr'], muzzle: W.revolver ? ['none'] : ['none', 'supp'], grip: ['none'] };
  return { sight: ['iron'], muzzle: ['none'], grip: ['none'] };
}
export const CAT_NAME = { rifle: '小銃', smg: '短機関銃', shotgun: '散弾銃', pistol: '拳銃', less: '非致死' };

// 扉: 開ける（向こうへ押す）・少し開ける・閉める・蹴る・ピッキング・ウェッジ・C2・破城槌・ブリーチングショットガン・ミラー・罠・バリケード
import { leafEnd, CS, LH } from './world.js';
import { hrand } from './rng.js';

export const OPEN_ANG = 1.62;   // 約93°
export const PEEK_ANG = 0.3;    // 約17°

export function makeDoorStates(w, def, rng) {
  return w.doors.map((d, i) => {
    const o = d.opt || {};
    return { ang: d.leaves.map(() => 0), tgt: d.leaves.map(() => 0), spd: d.leaves.map(() => 2.2), locked: !!o.locked, lockBroken: false, wedge: 0, trap: o.trap ? { armed: true, team: 1 } : null, broken: false, bar: 0, c2: null, kicks: 0, lastOp: -1, open: false };
  });
}

// 扉のどちら側にいるか（+1 = 法線の側）
export function sideOf(d, x, z) {
  const s = (x - d.cx) * d.nx + (z - d.cz) * d.nz;
  return s >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
}
// 扉の前（片側）の立つ位置
export function doorFront(d, side, dist = 0.8) {
  return [d.cx + d.nx * side * dist, d.cz + d.nz * side * dist];
}
export function isOpen(ds) { return ds.broken || ds.ang.some(a => Math.abs(a) > 0.6); }
export function isClosed(ds) { return !ds.broken && ds.ang.every(a => Math.abs(a) < 0.05); }

// 人の位置から、向こう側へ開く角度
function awayAngle(d, li, side, amt) {
  const lf = d.leaves[li];
  // +ang で +法線の側へ開く（lf.s で向きが決まる）。人が side にいるなら -side へ
  return -side * lf.s * amt;
}

// 操作。戻り値: { ok, why }
export function doorOp(S, w, a, did, op, ev, opt = {}) {
  const d = w.doors[did], ds = S.doors[did];
  if (!d || !ds) return { ok: false, why: 'none' };
  const side = sideOf(d, a.x, a.z);
  ds.lastOp = S.t;
  if (op === 'open' || op === 'peek') {
    if (ds.broken) return { ok: true };
    if (ds.bar > 0) { ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: 'barred', id: a.id }); return { ok: false, why: 'barred' }; }
    if (ds.locked && !ds.lockBroken && isClosed(ds)) { ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: 'locked', id: a.id }); return { ok: false, why: 'locked' }; }
    if (ds.wedge && isClosed(ds)) { ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: 'wedged', id: a.id }); return { ok: false, why: 'wedged' }; }
    const amt = op === 'peek' ? PEEK_ANG : OPEN_ANG;
    for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) { ds.tgt[li] = awayAngle(d, li, side, amt); ds.spd[li] = op === 'peek' ? 0.8 : 2.0; }
    if (op === 'open' && ds.trap && ds.trap.armed && trapTrips(S, ds, a)) triggerTrap(S, w, did, a, ev);
    ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: op, id: a.id, loud: op === 'peek' ? 0.1 : 0.3 });
    return { ok: true };
  }
  if (op === 'close') {
    if (ds.broken) return { ok: false, why: 'broken' };
    for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) { ds.tgt[li] = 0; ds.spd[li] = 2.2; }
    ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: 'close', id: a.id, loud: 0.35 });
    return { ok: true };
  }
  if (op === 'kick') {
    if (ds.broken) return { ok: false };
    if (ds.bar > 0) { ds.bar = Math.max(0, ds.bar - 20); ev.push({ e: ds.bar > 0 ? 'barhit' : 'barbreak', d: did, id: a.id }); return { ok: true }; }
    ds.kicks++;
    let opens = true;
    if (ds.wedge) opens = false;
    else if (ds.locked && !ds.lockBroken) opens = ds.kicks >= 3 || hrand(did, S.t, a.id) < 0.4;
    ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: opens ? 'kickopen' : 'kickfail', id: a.id, loud: 1.0 });
    if (opens) {
      ds.lockBroken = true;
      for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) { ds.tgt[li] = awayAngle(d, li, side, OPEN_ANG + 0.05); ds.spd[li] = 7.5; }
      if (ds.trap && ds.trap.armed && trapTrips(S, ds, a)) triggerTrap(S, w, did, a, ev);
      awe(S, w, d, -side, 0.12, 0, ev);
    }
    return { ok: opens, why: opens ? '' : (ds.wedge ? 'wedged' : 'held') };
  }
  if (op === 'ram') {
    if (ds.broken) return { ok: false };
    ds.lockBroken = true; ds.locked = false; ds.wedge = 0;
    if (ds.bar > 0) { ds.bar = 0; ev.push({ e: 'barbreak', d: did, id: a.id }); }
    for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) { ds.tgt[li] = awayAngle(d, li, side, OPEN_ANG + 0.1); ds.spd[li] = 10; }
    ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: 'ram', id: a.id, loud: 1.0 });
    if (ds.trap && ds.trap.armed) triggerTrap(S, w, did, a, ev);
    // すぐ後ろの人を怯ませる
    awe(S, w, d, -side, 0.3, 1.6, ev);
    return { ok: true };
  }
  if (op === 'breach') {
    if (ds.broken) return { ok: false };
    ds.lockBroken = true; ds.locked = false; ds.wedge = 0;
    if (ds.trap) { ds.trap = null; ev.push({ e: 'trapoff', d: did }); }
    for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) { ds.tgt[li] = awayAngle(d, li, side, 0.9); ds.spd[li] = 6; }
    ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: 'breach', id: a.id, loud: 1.0 });
    awe(S, w, d, -side, 0.18, 0.4, ev);
    return { ok: true };
  }
  if (op === 'unlock') { ds.locked = false; ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: 'unlock', id: a.id, loud: 0.15 }); return { ok: true }; }
  if (op === 'wedge') { if (!isClosed(ds)) return { ok: false, why: 'open' }; ds.wedge = side; ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: 'wedge', id: a.id, loud: 0.15 }); return { ok: true }; }
  if (op === 'unwedge') { ds.wedge = 0; ev.push({ e: 'door', d: did, k: 'unwedge', id: a.id, loud: 0.1 }); return { ok: true }; }
  if (op === 'disarm') { if (ds.trap) { ds.trap = null; ev.push({ e: 'trapoff', d: did, id: a.id }); } return { ok: true }; }
  if (op === 'c2') { ds.c2 = { owner: a.id, side, t: S.t }; ev.push({ e: 'c2set', d: did, id: a.id }); return { ok: true }; }
  if (op === 'bar') { if (!isClosed(ds) && !ds.broken) { for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) { ds.tgt[li] = 0; ds.ang[li] = 0; } } ds.bar = 60; ev.push({ e: 'barset', d: did, id: a.id }); return { ok: true }; }
  if (op === 'unbar') { ds.bar = 0; ev.push({ e: 'barbreak', d: did, id: a.id, pry: 1 }); return { ok: true }; }
  if (op === 'trap') { ds.trap = { armed: true, team: a.team, by: a.id, side: sideOf(d, a.x, a.z) }; ev.push({ e: 'trapset', d: did, id: a.id }); return { ok: true }; }
  return { ok: false, why: 'op' };
}

// 罠が作動する人: 対戦は相手の陣営だけ。作戦は警官だけ（容疑者と市民は罠の場所を知っていて避ける）
function trapTrips(S, ds, a) { if (!ds.trap.team) return true; if (S.pvp) return ds.trap.team !== a.team; return a.kind === 'swat'; }

export function triggerTrap(S, w, did, a, ev) {
  const d = w.doors[did], ds = S.doors[did];
  ds.trap = null;
  const L = d.L;
  ev.push({ e: 'trap', d: did, id: a ? a.id : -1 });
  S.blasts.push({ x: d.cx, y: L * LH + 1.0, z: d.cz, r: 4.0, dmg: 140, kind: 'frag', by: ds.trapBy ?? -1, door: did, t: 0.25 });
}

// 扉の向こうの人を怯ませる（槌・C2・蹴り）
function awe(S, w, d, side, morale, stun, ev) {
  for (const b of S.actors) {
    if (!b.alive || b.down || Math.abs(b.y - d.L * LH) > 1.5) continue;
    const s = (b.x - d.cx) * d.nx + (b.z - d.cz) * d.nz;
    if (s * side <= 0) continue;
    const dist = Math.hypot(b.x - d.cx, b.z - d.cz);
    if (dist > 2.2) continue;
    if (stun) b.stun = Math.max(b.stun, stun * (1 - dist / 2.6));
    if (b.ai && b.ai.morale != null) b.ai.morale -= morale;
  }
}

// 扉の動き（人にぶつかったら止まる）
export function stepDoors(S, w, dt, ev) {
  for (let i = 0; i < w.doors.length; i++) {
    const d = w.doors[i], ds = S.doors[i];
    if (ds.broken) continue;
    for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) {
      const cur = ds.ang[li], tgt = ds.tgt[li];
      if (cur === tgt) continue;
      const step = ds.spd[li] * dt;
      let nxt = Math.abs(tgt - cur) <= step ? tgt : cur + Math.sign(tgt - cur) * step;
      // 人に当たるか
      const lf = d.leaves[li];
      const [ex, ez] = leafEnd(lf, nxt);
      let blocked = null;
      for (const a of S.actors) {
        if (a.dead || a.isDrone || Math.abs(a.y - d.L * LH) > 1.2) continue;
        if (Math.hypot(a.x - lf.hx, a.z - lf.hz) > lf.len + 0.35) continue;
        if (segDist(a.x, a.z, lf.hx, lf.hz, ex, ez) < 0.27) { blocked = a; break; }
      }
      if (blocked) {
        // 板に当たって止めている AI はよける（味方が開け閉めしている扉）
        if (blocked.ai && blocked.pid == null && !blocked.act && blocked.alive && !blocked.down) blocked.ai.yieldTo = { until: S.t + Math.round(1.0 / S.dt), ax: lf.hx, az: lf.hz, tx: ex, tz: ez };
        if (ds.spd[li] > 5) { // 蹴った扉は人をはね飛ばす
          blocked.stun = Math.max(blocked.stun, 0.8);
          if (blocked.ai && blocked.ai.morale != null) blocked.ai.morale -= 0.15;
          ds.tgt[li] = nxt = cur;
        } else { ds.tgt[li] = cur; nxt = cur; }
      }
      ds.ang[li] = nxt;
    }
    ds.open = isOpen(ds);
  }
}
function segDist(px, pz, ax, az, bx, bz) {
  const vx = bx - ax, vz = bz - az, L2 = vx * vx + vz * vz || 1e-9;
  let t = ((px - ax) * vx + (pz - az) * vz) / L2; t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t;
  return Math.hypot(px - ax - vx * t, pz - az - vz * t);
}

// C2 を起爆: 扉は壊れ、扉の前85°・2.56mは致死、100°・12mは怯み
export function detonateC2(S, w, did, ev) {
  const d = w.doors[did], ds = S.doors[did];
  if (!ds || !ds.c2) return false;
  const c2 = ds.c2; ds.c2 = null;
  ds.broken = true; ds.wedge = 0; ds.locked = false; ds.lockBroken = true; ds.bar = 0;
  if (ds.trap) { ds.trap = null; }
  ev.push({ e: 'c2', d: did, x: d.cx, y: d.L * LH + 1.0, z: d.cz, by: c2.owner });
  const side = -c2.side;
  for (const b of S.actors) {
    if (!b.alive || Math.abs(b.y - d.L * LH) > 1.6) continue;
    const rx = b.x - d.cx, rz = b.z - d.cz, dist = Math.hypot(rx, rz);
    const s = (rx * d.nx + rz * d.nz) * side;
    if (s <= 0.05 && dist > 0.8) {
      // 手前側（置いた側）: 近いと耳と少しの怯み
      if (dist < 4) { b.deaf = Math.max(b.deaf, 2); b.stun = Math.max(b.stun, 0.3); }
      continue;
    }
    const cosA = s / Math.max(0.01, dist);
    if (dist <= 2.56 && cosA >= Math.cos(85 / 2 * Math.PI / 180)) {
      S.blasts.push({ x: d.cx, y: d.L * LH + 1.0, z: d.cz, r: 2.9, dmg: 160, kind: 'c2', by: c2.owner, only: b.id, t: 0 });
    } else if (dist <= 12 && cosA >= Math.cos(100 / 2 * Math.PI / 180)) {
      const k = 1 - dist / 12;
      b.stun = Math.max(b.stun, 1.2 + 3.0 * k);
      b.deaf = Math.max(b.deaf, 3 + 4 * k);
      if (b.ai && b.ai.morale != null) b.ai.morale -= 0.25 + 0.35 * k;
    }
  }
  // 扉のまわりの石膏の壁も少し壊れる
  return true;
}

// エンジン: 状態（関数を含まないデータ）と1ステップの進め方。命令（入力）→ 出来事（イベント）。
// 固定ステップ 1/60 秒（シミュレーションでは 1/30 も可）。乱数はシード付き。dump/load で丸ごと保存・復元。
import { compileMap, CS, LH } from './world.js';
import { rngNew, rnd, setSalt } from './rng.js';
import { COMPAT } from './data/version.js';
import { moveActor, separateActors, tryVault } from './move.js';

const worldCache = new Map();
// マップの組み立ては重いので1回だけ。試合ごとに壊れる物（ブロック）だけ写す
export function baseWorld(mapId) {
  let w = worldCache.get(mapId);
  if (!w) {
    const def = MAPS[mapId];
    if (!def) throw new Error('マップがない: ' + mapId);
    w = compileMap(def);
    if (w.errors.length) throw new Error(`マップ ${mapId} の誤り: ` + w.errors.slice(0, 5).join(' / '));
    lightForAI(w, def);
    worldCache.set(mapId, w);
  }
  return w;
}
// 光の格子を焼き、AI 用にマスごとの明るさ（胸の高さ）を作る。描画も同じ光の格子を使う
function lightForAI(w, def) {
  const lat = bakeLight(w, def, { sunSeparate: true });
  w._lat = lat;
  const br = new Float32Array(w.N);
  const { W1, D1, data, sunVis, sky } = lat;
  const sunL = 0.2126 * sky.sun[0] + 0.7152 * sky.sun[1] + 0.0722 * sky.sun[2];
  for (let L = 0; L < w.NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < w.D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w.W; i++) {
    let s = 0;
    for (const [di, dj] of [[0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 1]]) {
      const p = ((L * 3 + 1) * D1 + j + dj) * W1 + i + di;
      let l = 0;
      for (let a = 0; a < 6; a++) l += 0.2126 * data[p * 18 + a * 3] + 0.7152 * data[p * 18 + a * 3 + 1] + 0.0722 * data[p * 18 + a * 3 + 2];
      s += l / 6 + sunVis[p] * sunL * 0.35;
    }
    br[w.idx(L, i, j)] = s / 4;
  }
  w._bright = br;
}
export function instWorld(mapId) {
  const b = baseWorld(mapId);
  const w = Object.create(b);
  w.blocks = b.blocks0.slice();
  w.bhp = b.bhp.slice();
  return w;
}

// 試合を作る。o: { map, mode, mission, rules, seed, roster: [{pid?, name, team, kind, lo, bot?}] }
export function createGame(o) {
  const w = instWorld(o.map);
  const S = {
    v: COMPAT, t: 0, dt: o.dt || 1 / 60, seed: o.seed ?? 1, rng: rngNew(o.seed ?? 1), map: o.map, mode: o.mode, mission: o.mission || null,
    rules: Object.assign({ cap: 44, diff: 'normal', ff: true, dbno: false, recoil: 1 }, o.rules || {}),
    pvp: o.mode !== 'pve' && o.mode !== 'train', nextId: 1, nextItem: 1,
    actors: [], byId: {}, doors: makeDoorStates(w), bdiff: {}, reinf: {}, bullets: [], nades: [], clouds: [], blasts: [], items: [], harms: [],

  const api = { S, w };

}
export function reindex(S) { S.byId = {}; for (const a of S.actors) S.byId[a.id] = a; }

// 1ステップ。inputs: { [actorId]: {mx,mz,yaw,pitch,fire,ads,low,stance,lean,sprint,act:[...]} }
export function step(G, inputs = {}) {
  const { S, w } = G;
  const dt = S.dt;
  const ev = [];
  if (S.paused) return ev;
  setSalt(S.seed);
  const mod = MODES[S.mode];
  hooks.canDown = mod.canDown || null;
  // AI の判断（入力を作る）
  const aiIn = thinkAll(S, w, dt, ev);
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    if (a.isDrone) continue;
    let inp = a.pid != null ? (inputs[a.id] || idle(a)) : (aiIn[a.id] || idle(a));
    // 拘束されている最中: 動かず、警官に背中を向ける
    if (a.cuffBy != null) { const c = S.byId[a.cuffBy]; if (!c || !c.act || c.act.k !== 'restrain' || c.act.id !== a.id) { a.cuffBy = null; a.cuffYaw = null; } else inp = heldInput(a, inp, dt); }
    // AI が手元の動作をしている: その場で、手元（目標）を見続ける
    else if (a.pid == null && a.act && !a.act.quick && a.act.kind !== 'self' && a.act.k !== 'report') inp = actingInput(a, inp, dt);
    a._inp = inp;
    if (inp.act) for (const ac of inp.act) {
      if (ac.a === 'vault') tryVault(S, w, a);
      else doAction(S, w, a, ac, ev);
    }
  }
  // 状態（怯み・閃光・ガス・出血など）
  stepStatus(S, w, dt, ev);
  // 動き・銃
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    if (a.isDrone) { if (mod.stepDrone) mod.stepDrone(S, w, a, a.pid != null ? inputs[a.id] : null, dt, ev); continue; }
    const inp = a._inp;
    moveActor(S, w, a, inp, dt, ev);
    stepWeapon(S, w, a, inp, dt, ev);
  }
  separateActors(S, w);
  stepActs(S, w, dt, ev);
  stepDoors(S, w, dt, ev);
  stepBullets(S, w, dt, ev);
  stepNades(S, w, dt, ev);
  stepBlasts(S, w, dt, ev);
  stepClouds(S, w, dt, ev);
  // 弾がそばを抜けた（制圧）
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    if (a._whiz) { a.supp = Math.min(1, Math.max(a.supp, a._whiz)); ev.push({ e: 'whiz', id: a.id, k: a._whiz }); a._whiz = 0; }
  }
  if (mod.step) mod.step(S, w, dt, ev);
  if (mod.onEvents) mod.onEvents(S, w, ev);
  collectNoise(S, ev);
  S.t++;
  for (const e of ev) e.s = ++S.evSeq;
  return ev;
}

function heldInput(a, inp, dt) {
  let yaw = a.yaw;
  if (a.cuffYaw != null) { let d = a.cuffYaw - a.yaw; d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(d), Math.cos(d)); const st = 4.5 * dt; yaw = a.yaw + (Math.abs(d) <= st ? d : Math.sign(d) * st); }
  return { ...inp, mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw, fire: false, ads: false, low: false, sprint: false, lean: 0, act: null };
}
function actingInput(a, inp, dt) {
  const x = a.act, lk = x.look || x.tgt;
  let yaw = a.yaw;
  if (lk) { const tx = lk[0] - a.x, tz = lk[2] - a.z; if (Math.hypot(tx, tz) > 0.25) { let d = Math.atan2(tx, tz) - a.yaw; d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(d), Math.cos(d)); const st = 6 * dt; yaw = a.yaw + (Math.abs(d) <= st ? d : Math.sign(d) * st); } }
  return { ...inp, mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw, fire: false, ads: false, sprint: false };
}
export function idle(a) { return { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw: a.yaw, pitch: a.pitch, fire: false, ads: false, low: false, stance: a.stance, lean: 0, sprint: false, act: null }; }

// 保存と復元（壊れた壁は差分だけ）
export function dump(G) {
  const { S, w } = G;
  const blocks = [];
  for (const k of Object.keys(S.bdiff)) { const b = +k * 4; blocks.push([+k, w.blocks[b], w.blocks[b + 1], w.blocks[b + 2], w.blocks[b + 3], w.bhp[b], w.bhp[b + 1], w.bhp[b + 2], w.bhp[b + 3]]); }
  const o = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S, (k, v) => (k === 'byId' || k === '_caps' || k === '_eye' || k === '_capT' || k === '_inp' || k === '_whiz' || k === '_shieldF' || k === '_wr' ? undefined : v)));
  o.blocksDiff = blocks;
  return o;
}
export function load(o) {
  if (!o || o.v !== COMPAT) throw new Error('互換番号が違うセーブ');
  const w = instWorld(o.map);
  const S = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));
  for (const [k, b0, b1, b2, b3, h0, h1, h2, h3] of (S.blocksDiff || [])) { const b = k * 4; w.blocks[b] = b0; w.blocks[b + 1] = b1; w.blocks[b + 2] = b2; w.blocks[b + 3] = b3; w.bhp[b] = h0; w.bhp[b + 1] = h1; w.bhp[b + 2] = h2; w.bhp[b + 3] = h3; }
  delete S.blocksDiff;
  reindex(S);
  return { S, w };
}

function reachLine(S, w, x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, skipDoor = -1, skipProp = -1) {
  const dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0, dz = z1 - z0, L = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
  if (L < 0.05) return true;
  const hits = raycast(w, x0, y0, z0, dx / L, dy / L, dz / L, L, S.doors, _rr);
  for (const h of hits) {
    if (h.t0 >= L - 0.04) break;
    if (h.kind === 'prop') { const pr = w.props[h.id]; if (!pr || !pr.solid || h.id === skipProp) continue; return false; }
    if ((h.kind === 'door' || h.kind === 'bar') && h.id === skipDoor) continue;
    if (h.kind === 'block' && h.mat === M.GLASSBROKEN) continue;
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}
// 上から見た線分と四角（x0,z0〜x1,z1）が交わるか
function segRect(ax, az, bx, bz, x0, z0, x1, z1) {
  if (x1 <= x0 || z1 <= z0) return false;
  let t0 = 0, t1 = 1;
  const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
  const clip = (p, q) => { if (Math.abs(p) < 1e-9) return q >= 0; const r = q / p; if (p < 0) { if (r > t1) return false; if (r > t0) t0 = r; } else { if (r < t0) return false; if (r < t1) t1 = r; } return true; };
  return clip(-dx, ax - x0) && clip(dx, x1 - ax) && clip(-dz, az - z0) && clip(dz, z1 - az) && t0 <= t1;
}
function distSeg(px, pz, ax, az, bx, bz) {
  const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az, l2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1e-9;
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((px - ax) * dx + (pz - az) * dz) / l2));
  return Math.hypot(px - ax - dx * t, pz - az - dz * t);
}

// 直前の bodyClear で間に立っていた人（AI なら脇へよけてもらう）
export let BLOCKER = null;
export function bodyClear(S, w, a, tx, tz, L, o = {}) {
  const x0 = a.x, z0 = a.z;
  BLOCKER = null;
  if (Math.hypot(tx - x0, tz - z0) < 0.06) return true;
  const base = L * LH;

  const j0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Math.min(z0, tz) - 1.0) / CS)), j1 = Math.min(w.D - 1, Math.floor((Math.max(z0, tz) + 1.0) / CS));
  _bcSeen.clear();
  for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
    const near = w.propNear.get(w.idx(L, i, j));
    if (!near) continue;
    for (const pid of near) {
      if (_bcSeen.has(pid)) continue;
      _bcSeen.add(pid);
      const p = w.props[pid];
      if (!p || p.alive === false || !p.solid || pid === o.skipProp || p.L !== L) continue;
      for (const b of p.boxes) {
        if (b[4] - base < 0.28 || b[1] - base > 1.45) continue;
        if (segRect(x0, z0, tx, tz, b[0] + 0.025, b[2] + 0.025, b[3] - 0.025, b[5] - 0.025)) return false;
      }
    }
  }
  for (const b of S.actors) {
    if (b === a || b.id === o.skipId || b.isDrone || !b.alive || b.down) continue;
    if (Math.abs(b.y - a.y) > 1.2) continue;
    if (distSeg(b.x, b.z, x0, z0, tx, tz) < 0.22) { BLOCKER = b; return false; }
  }
  return true;
}

export function doorPoint(w, d, side, op) {
