  const mid = op === 'bar' || op === 'unbar' || op === 'bash';
  const hy = d.L * LH + (low ? 0.1 : op === 'kick' || op === 'bash' ? 0.55 : op === 'c2' ? 1.05 : op === 'bar' || op === 'unbar' ? 1.0 : 0.98);
  const bx = low || mid ? d.cx : op === 'kick' ? (d.cx + hx) / 2 : hx, bz = low || mid ? d.cz : op === 'kick' ? (d.cz + hz) / 2 : hz;
  return [bx + d.nx * side * 0.14, hy, bz + d.nz * side * 0.14];
}
// ノブを回したあと扉を押す・引く手の当て所: 自分に近い葉の面（自分の側）、自由端から 0.22m。
// 押し開けるときは胸の高さ（手のひらで押す）、閉めるときは腰の高さ（端を持って引く・押す）
export function pushPoint(S, w, a, did, op) {
  const d = w.doors[did], ds = S.doors[did];
  if (!d || !ds || ds.broken) return null;
  let best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) {
    const lf = d.leaves[li], [ex, ez] = leafEnd(lf, ds.ang[li]);
    const f = Math.max(0.3, (lf.len - 0.22) / lf.len);
    const px = lf.hx + (ex - lf.hx) * f, pz = lf.hz + (ez - lf.hz) * f;
    const dd = Math.hypot(px - a.x, pz - a.z);
    if (dd < bd) { bd = dd; best = [px, pz]; }
  }
  if (!best) return null;
  const dx = a.x - best[0], dz = a.z - best[1], l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
  return [best[0] + dx / l * 0.05, d.L * LH + (op === 'close' ? 1.05 : 1.38), best[1] + dz / l * 0.05];
}
// 扉の開口（線分）からの距離
function doorDist(d, x, z) {
  const along = d.axis === 0 ? x : z, across = (d.axis === 0 ? z : x) - d.c;
  const ex = Math.max(0, d.a0 - along, along - d.a1);
  return Math.hypot(across, ex);
}
// 動作 op が、いまの位置から目標に届くか。slack: 動作の最中は少しゆるめる（寄りながら行うため）
// 届かない理由（直前の reachOK）: 'dist' 離れている、'block' 間に物・人・壁がある
export let REACH_WHY = 'dist';
export function reachOK(S, w, a, k, id, op, slack = 0) {
  const lim = (REACH_D[op] ?? 1.0) + slack;
  REACH_WHY = 'dist';
  if (lim >= 90) return true;
  const L = levelOfY(a.y + 0.2);
  if (k === 'person') {
    const b = S.byId[id]; if (!b) return false;
    if (Math.abs(b.y - a.y) > 0.7) return false;
    const low = b.down || b.dead;
    if (op === 'report') {
      if (Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z) > lim) return false;
      const e = eyeOf(S, a); return reachLine(S, w, e[0], e[1], e[2], b.x, b.y + (low ? 0.3 : b.cuffed || b.comply === 2 ? 0.8 : 1.1), b.z);
    }
    const tp = personPoint(S, b);
    if (Math.hypot(tp[0] - a.x, tp[2] - a.z) > lim) return false;
    REACH_WHY = 'block';
    if (!bodyClear(S, w, a, tp[0], tp[2], L, { skipId: b.id })) return false;
    return reachLine(S, w, a.x, a.y + 1.0, a.z, tp[0], tp[1], tp[2]) && reachLine(S, w, a.x, a.y + 0.5, a.z, tp[0], b.y + (low ? 0.2 : 0.45), tp[2]);
  }
  if (k === 'item') {
    const it = S.items.find(x => x.id === id); if (!it || it.gone) return false;
    if (Math.hypot(it.x - a.x, it.z - a.z) > lim || it.y - a.y > 1.45 || a.y - it.y > 0.35) return false;
    const sp = supportProp(w, it);
    REACH_WHY = 'block';
    if (!bodyClear(S, w, a, it.x, it.z, L, { skipProp: sp })) return false;
    return reachLine(S, w, a.x, a.y + 1.1, a.z, it.x, it.y + 0.08, it.z, -1, sp);
  }
  if (k === 'door') {
    const d = w.doors[id], ds = S.doors[id]; if (!d || Math.abs(a.y - d.L * LH) > 0.8) return false;
    // 開いている扉（閉める・押し開ける）は、板のいちばん近い所に手が届けばよい
    if (ds && !ds.broken && (op === 'close' || op === 'open') && d.leaves.some((lf, li) => Math.abs(ds.ang[li] || 0) > 0.2)) {
      let best = 1e9, bx = 0, bz = 0;
      d.leaves.forEach((lf, li) => {
        const [ex, ez] = leafEnd(lf, ds.ang[li] || 0), vx = ex - lf.hx, vz = ez - lf.hz, vv = vx * vx + vz * vz || 1;
        const t = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1, ((a.x - lf.hx) * vx + (a.z - lf.hz) * vz) / vv));
        const qx = lf.hx + vx * t, qz = lf.hz + vz * t, dd = Math.hypot(a.x - qx, a.z - qz);
        if (dd < best) { best = dd; bx = qx; bz = qz; }
      });
      if (best > lim) return false;
      REACH_WHY = 'block';
      if (!bodyClear(S, w, a, bx, bz, d.L)) return false;
      return reachLine(S, w, a.x, a.y + 1.0, a.z, bx, d.L * LH + 1.0, bz, id);
    }
    const side = sideOf(d, a.x, a.z) || 1;
    // 開口の中（扉の線の上）に立っていたら、横からは操作できない
    const across = (a.x - d.cx) * d.nx + (a.z - d.cz) * d.nz;
    if (Math.abs(across) < 0.1) return false;
    const P = doorPoint(w, d, side, op);
    if (Math.hypot(P[0] - a.x, P[2] - a.z) > lim && doorDist(d, a.x, a.z) > lim) return false;
    if (Math.hypot(P[0] - a.x, P[2] - a.z) > lim + 0.35) return false;
    REACH_WHY = 'block';
    if (!bodyClear(S, w, a, P[0], P[2], d.L)) return false;
    return reachLine(S, w, a.x, a.y + 1.0, a.z, P[0], Math.max(P[1], d.L * LH + 0.5), P[2], id);
  }
  if (k === 'bomb') {
    const b = S.m.bombs && S.m.bombs.find(q => q.id === id); if (!b) return false;
    if (Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z) > lim || Math.abs(b.y - a.y) > 1.2) return false;
    REACH_WHY = 'block';
    if (!bodyClear(S, w, a, b.x, b.z, L, { skipProp: supportProp(w, b) })) return false;
    return reachLine(S, w, a.x, a.y + 0.9, a.z, b.x, b.y + 0.15, b.z, -1, supportProp(w, b));
  }
  if (k === 'site') {
    if (op !== 'defuse') return true;
    const q = S.m.defuser; if (!q) return false;
    if (Math.hypot(q.x - a.x, q.z - a.z) > lim || Math.abs(q.y - a.y) > 1.2) return false;
    REACH_WHY = 'block';
    if (!bodyClear(S, w, a, q.x, q.z, L)) return false;
    return reachLine(S, w, a.x, a.y + 0.9, a.z, q.x, q.y + 0.15, q.z);
  }
  if (k === 'wall') {
    const i = id % w.W, j = Math.floor(id / w.W) % w.D;
    const cx = (i + 0.5) * CS, cz = (j + 0.5) * CS;
    // 壁の面（マスの中央の板の手前）までの距離
    const dd = Math.max(Math.abs(cx - a.x), Math.abs(cz - a.z)) - 0.15;
    if (dd > lim) return false;
    REACH_WHY = 'block';
    const fx = Math.abs(cx - a.x) > Math.abs(cz - a.z) ? cx - Math.sign(cx - a.x) * 0.2 : a.x, fz = Math.abs(cx - a.x) > Math.abs(cz - a.z) ? a.z : cz - Math.sign(cz - a.z) * 0.2;
    return bodyClear(S, w, a, fx, fz, L);
  }
  return true;
}
// AI: 目標（人・物）に手が届く立ち位置。近い順に、歩ける床のマスから届くかを試す（家具の向こうなら回り込む）
export function approachPoint(S, w, a, k, id, op, nav) {
  const t = k === 'person' ? S.byId[id] : k === 'item' ? S.items.find(x => x.id === id) : k === 'bomb' ? (S.m && S.m.bombs || []).find(x => x.id === id) : null;
  if (!t) return null;
  const tp = k === 'person' ? personPoint(S, t) : [t.x, t.y, t.z];
  const L = levelOfY(t.y + 0.3), lim = REACH_D[op] ?? 1.0, R = Math.ceil(lim / CS) + 1;
  const ci = Math.floor(tp[0] / CS), cj = Math.floor(tp[2] / CS);
  const sx = a.x, sz = a.z, sy = a.y;
  const cand = [];
  for (let j = cj - R; j <= cj + R; j++) for (let i = ci - R; i <= ci + R; i++) {
    if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) continue;
    const kk = w.idx(L, i, j);
    if (nav && nav.walk[kk] !== 1) continue;
    const x = (i + 0.5) * CS, z = (j + 0.5) * CS, dt = Math.hypot(x - tp[0], z - tp[2]);
    if (dt < 0.45 || dt > lim - 0.08) continue;
    cand.push([Math.hypot(x - sx, z - sz) + dt * 0.5, x, z]);
  }
  cand.sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]);
  let found = null;
  for (const [, x, z] of cand.slice(0, 24)) {
    a.x = x; a.z = z; a.y = L * LH;
    const okR = reachOK(S, w, a, k, id, op);
    a.x = sx; a.z = sz; a.y = sy;
    if (okR) { found = [x, z]; break; }
  }
  a.x = sx; a.z = sz; a.y = sy;
  return found;
}
// 届かない操作に印をつけ、既定の操作は届くものから
function markReach(S, w, a, ctx) {
  for (const o of ctx.ops) { o.far = !reachOK(S, w, a, ctx.k, ctx.id, o.op); o.why = o.far ? REACH_WHY : null; }
  ctx.def = ctx.ops.find(o => !o.far) || ctx.ops[0];
  ctx.far = ctx.ops.every(o => o.far);
  return ctx;
}
// 動作の手の行き先（世界の点）: 体の動きに使う
function actTarget(S, w, a, k, id, op) {
  if (k === 'person') {
    const b = S.byId[id]; if (!b) return null;
    if (op === 'report') return null;
    if (b.down || b.dead) return personPoint(S, b);
    // 手首（背中側の腰）。拘束では毎ステップ、相手の手首を追う
    return wristsOf(S, b);
  }
  if (k === 'item') { const it = S.items.find(x => x.id === id); return it ? [it.x, it.y + 0.05, it.z] : null; }
  if (k === 'door') {
    const d = w.doors[id]; if (!d) return null;
    return doorPoint(w, d, sideOf(d, a.x, a.z) || 1, op);
  }
  if (k === 'bomb') { const b = S.m.bombs && S.m.bombs.find(q => q.id === id); return b ? [b.x, b.y + 0.15, b.z] : null; }
  if (k === 'site') {
    if (op === 'defuse' && S.m.defuser) return [S.m.defuser.x, S.m.defuser.y + 0.1, S.m.defuser.z];
    return [a.x + Math.sin(a.yaw) * 0.5, a.y + 0.05, a.z + Math.cos(a.yaw) * 0.5];
  }
  if (k === 'wall') { const i = id % w.W, j = Math.floor(id / w.W) % w.D; const cx = (i + 0.5) * CS, cz = (j + 0.5) * CS; const ax = Math.abs(cx - a.x) > Math.abs(cz - a.z); return [ax ? cx - Math.sign(cx - a.x) * 0.16 : a.x, a.y + 1.15, ax ? a.z : cz - Math.sign(cz - a.z) * 0.16]; }
  return null;
}
// 動作の立ち位置: 目標の手前（目標から自分への向き、扉は自分の側の正面）。歩ける所で、今の所から体ごと移れるときだけ
function standPoint(S, w, a, k, id, op, tgt) {
  const sd = STAND_D[op];
  if (sd == null || !tgt) return null;
  const L = levelOfY(a.y + 0.2);
  let bx, bz, nx, nz;
  if (k === 'door') {
    const d = w.doors[id]; if (!d) return null;
    const side = sideOf(d, a.x, a.z) || 1;
    nx = d.nx * side; nz = d.nz * side; bx = tgt[0] - nx * 0.14; bz = tgt[2] - nz * 0.14;
  } else if (k === 'wall') {
    bx = tgt[0]; bz = tgt[2]; const dx = a.x - bx, dz = a.z - bz, dd = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; nx = dx / dd; nz = dz / dd;
    if (Math.abs(nx) > Math.abs(nz)) { nx = Math.sign(nx); nz = 0; } else { nz = Math.sign(nz); nx = 0; }
  } else {
    const c = k === 'person' ? personPoint(S, S.byId[id]) : tgt;
    bx = c[0]; bz = c[2];
    const dx = a.x - bx, dz = a.z - bz, dd = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (dd < 0.05) return null;
    nx = dx / dd; nz = dz / dd;
  }
  const sx = bx + nx * sd, sz = bz + nz * sd;
  const mv = Math.hypot(sx - a.x, sz - a.z);
  if (mv < 0.04) return null;
  if (mv > (op === 'kick' || op === 'bash' ? 0.4 : 0.85)) return null;
  // 立てる床か（壁・家具に重ならない）
  const i = Math.floor(sx / CS), j = Math.floor(sz / CS);
  if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) return null;
  const t = w.cell[w.idx(L, i, j)];
  if (t !== C.FLOOR && t !== C.OUT && t !== C.OPEN && t !== C.DOOR) return null;
  const po = pushOut(w, sx, sz, a.y + 0.4, a.y + 1.5, 0.25, S.doors, -1, _po);
  if (po[2] && Math.hypot(po[0], po[1]) > 0.06) return null;
  if (!bodyClear(S, w, a, sx, sz, L, { skipId: k === 'person' ? id : -1 })) return null;
  return [sx, sz];
}
const _po = [0, 0, 0];

// 見ている物を調べる
export function contextOf(S, w, a) {
  if (!a.alive || a.down || a.cuffed) return null;
  const eye = eyeOf(S, a);
  const cp = Math.cos(a.pitch), dx = Math.sin(a.yaw) * cp, dy = Math.sin(a.pitch), dz = Math.cos(a.yaw) * cp;
  const hits = raycast(w, eye[0], eye[1], eye[2], dx, dy, dz, 3.2, S.doors, _rc);
  let wallHit = null, doorHit = null;
  for (const h of hits) {
    if (h.kind === 'door' || h.kind === 'bar') { doorHit = h; break; }
    if (h.kind === 'block' || h.kind === 'slab' || h.kind === 'prop' || h.kind === 'stair' || h.kind === 'edge') { if (MATS[h.mat] && MATS[h.mat].see) continue; wallHit = h; break; }
  }
  const wallT = wallHit ? wallHit.t0 : 99;
  // 人（照準の線の近く、2.5m以内）
  let person = null, pd = 1e9;
  for (const b of S.actors) {
    if (b.id === a.id || b.isDrone) continue;
    if (!b.alive && !b.dead) continue;
    const by = b.down || b.dead ? b.y + 0.25 : b.comply === 2 || b.cuffed ? b.y + 0.9 : b.y + 1.2;
    const ox = b.x - eye[0], oy = by - eye[1], oz = b.z - eye[2];
    const t = ox * dx + oy * dy + oz * dz;
    if (t < 0.2 || t > 2.6 || t > wallT + 0.3) continue;
    const perp = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, ox * ox + oy * oy + oz * oz - t * t));
    const lim = b.down || b.dead ? 0.7 : 0.55;
    if (perp > lim) continue;
    const score = perp + t * 0.15;
    if (score < pd) { pd = score; person = b; }
  }
  if (person) {
    const ops = personOps(S, a, person);
    if (ops.length) return markReach(S, w, a, { k: 'person', id: person.id, ops, def: ops[0], dist: pd });
  }
  // 落ちている物
  let item = null, idist = 1e9;
  for (const it of S.items) {
    if (it.gone) continue;
    const ox = it.x - eye[0], oy = it.y + 0.05 - eye[1], oz = it.z - eye[2];
    const t = ox * dx + oy * dy + oz * dz;
    if (t < 0.1 || t > 2.6 || t > wallT + 0.3) continue;
    const perp = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, ox * ox + oy * oy + oz * oz - t * t));
    if (perp > 0.6) continue;
    if (perp < idist) { idist = perp; item = it; }
  }
  if (item) {
    const ops = itemOps(S, a, item);
    if (ops.length) return markReach(S, w, a, { k: 'item', id: item.id, ops, def: ops[0] });
  }
  // 扉（当たった、または近くの扉）
  let did = doorHit ? doorHit.id : -1;
  if (did < 0) {
    let best = 2.0;
    for (const d of w.doors) {
      if (d.L !== levelOfY(a.y + 0.2)) continue;
      const ox = d.cx - a.x, oz = d.cz - a.z, dist = Math.hypot(ox, oz);
      if (dist > 2.2) continue;
      const fwd = (ox * dx + oz * dz) / Math.max(0.01, dist * Math.hypot(dx, dz));
      if (fwd < 0.55) continue;
      if (dist * (1.6 - fwd) < best && dist < wallT + 0.6) { best = dist * (1.6 - fwd); did = d.id; }
    }
  }
  if (did >= 0) {
    const ops = doorOps(S, w, a, did);
    if (ops.length) return markReach(S, w, a, { k: 'door', id: did, ops, def: ops[0] });
  }
  // 対戦: 爆弾の場所・壁・窓
  if (S.pvp && S.m && S.m.sites) {
    const so = siteOps(S, w, a, eye, dx, dz);
    if (so) return markReach(S, w, a, so);
  }
  if (S.pvp && wallHit && wallHit.kind === 'block' && wallHit.t0 < 1.6) {
    const ops = wallOps(S, w, a, wallHit);
    if (ops.length) return markReach(S, w, a, { k: 'wall', id: wallHit.k, ops, def: ops[0], q: wallHit.q });
  }
  // 作戦: 爆弾（爆弾脅迫）
  if (!S.pvp && S.m && S.m.bombs) {
    for (const b of S.m.bombs) {
      if (b.done) continue;
      const dist = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
      if (dist < 2.2 && Math.abs(b.y - a.y) < 1.5) return markReach(S, w, a, { k: 'bomb', id: b.id, ops: [{ op: 'bombdefuse', t: ACT_T.bombdefuse }], def: null });
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function gearN(a, id) { const g = a.inv.gear.find(x => x.id === id); return g ? g.n : 0; }
function useGear(a, id) { const g = a.inv.gear.find(x => x.id === id); if (g && g.n > 0) { g.n--; return true; } return false; }

export function personOps(S, a, b) {
  const ops = [];
  if (S.pvp) {
    if (b.alive && b.down && b.team === a.team) ops.push({ op: 'revive', t: ACT_T.revive });
    return ops;
  }
  if (b.alive && !b.cuffed && (b.comply >= 1 || b.down || b.tased > 0 || b.stun > 1.0 || b.flash > 1.0) && b.kind !== 'swat') ops.push({ op: 'restrain', t: ACT_T.restrain });
  if ((b.cuffed || b.down || b.dead) && !b.reported) ops.push({ op: 'report', t: ACT_T.report });
  if (b.kind === 'swat' && b.down && !b.reported) ops.push({ op: 'report', t: ACT_T.report });
  return ops;
}
function itemOps(S, a, it) {
  if (S.pvp) {
    if (it.kind === 'defuser' && a.team === S.m.att) return [{ op: 'pickup', t: 0.3 }];
    return [];
  }
  if (it.kind === 'weapon' || it.kind === 'evidence') return [{ op: 'collect', t: ACT_T.collect }];
  return [];
}
export function doorOps(S, w, a, did) {
  const ds = S.doors[did], d = w.doors[did];
  const ops = [];
  if (ds.broken) return ops;
  const closed = isClosed(ds);
  const side = sideOf(d, a.x, a.z);
  if (S.pvp && ds.bar > 0) {
    if (a.team === S.m.def) ops.push({ op: 'unbar', t: ACT_T.unbar });
    else { ops.push({ op: 'bash', t: ACT_T.bash }); if (gearN(a, 'c2')) ops.push({ op: 'c2', t: ACT_T.c2, gear: 'c2' }); }
    return ops;
  }
  if (ds.c2) ops.push({ op: 'det', t: 0 });
  if (!closed) { ops.push({ op: 'close', t: 0 }); if (Math.abs(ds.ang[0]) < 0.6) ops.push({ op: 'open', t: 0 }); }
  else {
    ops.push({ op: 'open', t: 0 }); ops.push({ op: 'peek', t: 0 });
    ops.push({ op: 'mirror', t: a.pid != null ? ACT_T.mirrorP : ACT_T.mirror });
    if (a.inv.long === 'wand') ops.push({ op: 'wand', t: ACT_T.wand });
    if (ds.wedge) ops.push({ op: 'unwedge', t: ACT_T.unwedge });
    else if (gearN(a, 'wedge')) ops.push({ op: 'wedge', t: ACT_T.wedge, gear: 'wedge' });
    ops.push({ op: 'kick', t: ACT_T.kick });
    if (ds.locked && !ds.lockBroken) { ops.push({ op: gearN(a, 'lockgun') ? 'lockgun' : 'pick', t: gearN(a, 'lockgun') ? ACT_T.lockgun : ACT_T.pick }); }
    if (a.inv.long === 'ram') ops.push({ op: 'ram', t: ACT_T.ram });
    if (a.inv.long === 'breacher') ops.push({ op: 'breach', t: ACT_T.breach });
    if (gearN(a, 'c2') && !ds.c2) ops.push({ op: 'c2', t: ACT_T.c2, gear: 'c2' });
    if (ds.trap && ds.trapSeen) ops.push({ op: 'disarm', t: ACT_T.disarm });
    if (S.pvp && a.team === S.m.def && S.m.phase === 'prep') { ops.unshift({ op: 'bar', t: ACT_T.bar }); if (gearN(a, 'claymore') && !ds.trap) ops.push({ op: 'trap', t: ACT_T.trap, gear: 'claymore' }); }
  }
  // 既定の操作: 閉じていれば「開ける」
  return ops;
}
function siteOps(S, w, a, eye, dx, dz) {
  const m = S.m;
  if (m.defuser && m.defuser.planted && a.team === m.def) {
    const p = m.defuser;
    if (Math.hypot(p.x - a.x, p.z - a.z) < 2.2 && Math.abs(p.y - a.y) < 1.5) return { k: 'site', id: -1, ops: [{ op: 'defuse', t: ACT_T.defuse }], def: { op: 'defuse', t: ACT_T.defuse } };
  }
  if (a.carry === 'defuser' && m.phase === 'action' && !(m.defuser && m.defuser.planted)) {
    for (const s of m.sites) {
      if (s.L !== levelOfY(a.y + 0.2)) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(s.x - a.x, s.z - a.z) < s.r) return { k: 'site', id: s.id, ops: [{ op: 'plant', t: ACT_T.plant }], def: { op: 'plant', t: ACT_T.plant } };
    }
  }
  return null;
}
function wallOps(S, w, a, h) {
  const ops = [];
  const k = h.k;
  const t = w.cell[k];
  const mat = w.blocks[k * NB + (h.q || 0)];
  if (t !== C.WALL || !(mat === M.DRYWALL || mat === M.WOOD)) return ops;
  if (S.m.def === a.team && S.m.phase === 'prep' && !S.reinf[k] && (S.m.reinfLeft ?? 0) > 0) ops.push({ op: 'reinforce', t: ACT_T.reinforce });
  if (S.m.att === a.team && gearN(a, 'frame')) ops.push({ op: 'frame', t: ACT_T.frame, gear: 'frame' });
  return ops;
}

// 動作を始める（人もAIも同じ）。ac: { a:'use' } | { a:'op', k, id, op } | { a:'shout' } | ...
export function doAction(S, w, a, ac, ev) {
  if (!a.alive) return;
  const kind = ac.a;
  if (kind === 'shout') { shout(S, a, ev, ac.line); return; }
  if (kind === 'cmd') { S.orders.push({ ...ac, by: a.id, t: S.t, n: ++S.cmdSeq }); ev.push({ e: 'cmd', id: a.id, cmd: ac.cmd, team: ac.team || 'gold' }); return; }
  if (kind === 'det') { detonateMine(S, w, a, ev); return; }
  if (kind === 'reload') return; // 銃の側で処理
  if (kind === 'unlockDoor') { if (a.kind === 'sus' || a.kind === 'civ') doorOp(S, w, a, ac.id, 'unlock', ev); return; }
  if (a.down || a.cuffed || a.comply) return;
  if (kind === 'cancel') { if (a.act) { ev.push({ e: 'actcancel', id: a.id, k: a.act.k }); endCuff(S, a.act); a.act = null; } return; }
  if (kind === 'gear') { selectGear(S, a, ac.id, ev); return; }
  if (kind === 'm320') { m320Next(a, ev); return; }
  if (kind === 'long') { selectLong(S, a, ev); return; }
  if (kind === 'peekend') { if (a.peek) endPeek(S, w, a, ev, 'user'); return; }
  if (kind === 'dropcarry') { if (a.carry === 'defuser') { a.carry = null; S.items.push({ id: S.nextItem++, kind: 'defuser', x: a.x, y: a.y + 0.02, z: a.z }); ev.push({ e: 'defdrop', id: a.id }); } return; }
  if (a.act) return;
  let ctx = null, op = null;
  if (kind === 'use') { ctx = contextOf(S, w, a); if (!ctx) return; op = ctx.def; }
  else if (kind === 'op') {
    ctx = contextOf(S, w, a);
    if (!ctx || ctx.k !== ac.k || ctx.id !== ac.id) {
      // AIは見ていなくても近ければよい
      if (a.pid == null && ac.k === 'door') ctx = { k: 'door', id: ac.id, ops: doorOps(S, w, a, ac.id) };
      else if (a.pid == null && ac.k === 'person') { const b = S.byId[ac.id]; ctx = b ? { k: 'person', id: ac.id, ops: personOps(S, a, b) } : null; }
      else if (a.pid == null && ac.k === 'item') { const it = S.items.find(x => x.id === ac.id); ctx = it ? { k: 'item', id: ac.id, ops: itemOps(S, a, it) } : null; }
      else if (a.pid == null && ac.k === 'site') { const eye = eyeOf(S, a); ctx = siteOps(S, w, a, eye, 0, 0); }
      else if (a.pid == null && ac.k === 'wall') { const kk = ac.id; ctx = { k: 'wall', id: kk, q: ac.q || 1, ops: wallOps(S, w, a, { k: kk, q: ac.q || 1 }) }; }
      else if (a.pid == null && ac.k === 'bomb') { const b = S.m && S.m.bombs && S.m.bombs.find(q => q.id === ac.id && !q.done); ctx = b ? { k: 'bomb', id: b.id, ops: [{ op: 'bombdefuse', t: ACT_T.bombdefuse }], def: null } : null; }
      if (!ctx) return;
      markReach(S, w, a, ctx);
    }
    op = ctx.ops.find(o => o.op === ac.op);
    if (!op) return;
  } else return;
  startOp(S, w, a, ctx, op, ev);
}

// 扉のノブに手を伸ばす時間（開ける・閉める・少し開ける）
const KNOB_T = 0.24;
function startOp(S, w, a, ctx, op, ev) {
  const id = ctx.id;
  if (op.op === 'det') { detonateMine(S, w, a, ev); return; }
  // 手が届かない（離れている・間に物がある）
  if (op.far ?? !reachOK(S, w, a, ctx.k, id, op.op)) {
    // 間に立っているのが AI の味方なら、脇へよけてもらう（RoN の隊員と同じ）。理由はこの動作で調べ直す
    if (op.far != null) reachOK(S, w, a, ctx.k, id, op.op);
    if (REACH_WHY === 'block' && BLOCKER && BLOCKER.ai && BLOCKER.pid == null && !BLOCKER.act && (BLOCKER.team === a.team || (BLOCKER.kind === 'swat' && a.kind === 'swat'))) {
      const tg = actTarget(S, w, a, ctx.k, id, op.op);
      if (tg) BLOCKER.ai.yieldTo = { until: S.t + Math.round(1.1 / S.dt), ax: a.x, az: a.z, tx: tg[0], tz: tg[2] };
    }
    ev.push({ e: 'deny', id: a.id, why: (op.why || REACH_WHY) === 'block' ? 'blocked' : 'far', op: op.op, k: ctx.k });
    return;
  }
  if (op.op === 'pickup') { const it = S.items.find(x => x.id === id); if (it && !it.gone) { it.gone = true; a.carry = 'defuser'; a.gest = { k: 'grab', t: 0, dur: 0.7, tgt: [it.x, it.y + 0.05, it.z] }; ev.push({ e: 'defpick', id: a.id }); } return; }
  const tgt = actTarget(S, w, a, ctx.k, id, op.op);
  // 扉を開ける・閉める: 左手をノブへ伸ばしてから（銃は右手のまま、歩きながらでもよい）
  if (ctx.k === 'door' && (op.t || 0) === 0) {
    a.act = { k: op.op, t: 0, dur: KNOB_T, kind: 'door', id, still: false, noAds: false, x: a.x, z: a.z, gear: null, pose: 'knob', tgt, quick: true };
    return;
  }
  const dur = (op.t || 0.5) * (a.inj.arm && op.op !== 'report' ? 1.2 : 1);
  const still = op.op !== 'report' && op.op !== 'bash';
  a.act = { k: op.op, t: 0, dur, kind: ctx.k, id, still, noAds: true, x: a.x, z: a.z, gear: op.gear || null, pose: ACT_POSE[op.op] || null, tgt, chk: 0 };
  // 立ち位置へ寄る（はじめの少しの間）
  if (still) { const sp = standPoint(S, w, a, ctx.k, id, op.op, tgt); if (sp) { a.act.stand = sp; a.act.alignT = ALIGN_T[op.op] ?? ALIGN_T.def; } }
  // 拘束: 手を上げて立っている人は、ひざをつかせ、背中を向けさせる（その間は動かない）
  if (op.op === 'restrain') {
    const b = S.byId[id];
    if (b && b.alive) {
      if (!b.down && b.comply === 1) { b.comply = 2; b.stateT = 0; }
      b.cuffBy = a.id;
      b.cuffYaw = !b.down && !b.dead ? Math.atan2(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z) : null;
      b.cuffK = 0;
    }
  }
  ev.push({ e: 'act', id: a.id, k: op.op, dur, tgt: id, kind: ctx.k });
}
function endCuff(S, x) { if (x.k !== 'restrain') return; const b = S.byId[x.id]; if (b) { b.cuffK = 0; if (b.cuffBy != null) { b.cuffBy = null; b.cuffYaw = null; } } }

// 時間のかかる動作の進み
export function stepActs(S, w, dt, ev) {
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    // 投げ物を持っているとき: 引き金で投げる。特殊装備を持っているとき: 引き金で使う
    if (a.ws && a.ws.slot === 2 && a.alive && !a.down) gearInHand(S, w, a, dt, ev);
    if (a.ws && a.ws.slot === 3 && a.alive && !a.down) longInHand(S, w, a, dt, ev);
    if (a.peek) stepPeek(S, w, a, dt, ev);
    if (a.gest) {
      a.gest.t += dt;
      // 押している間（前の 6 割）は、手は動いていく扉の面について行く
      if (a.gest.did != null && a.gest.t < a.gest.dur * 0.6) { const pp = pushPoint(S, w, a, a.gest.did, a.gest.op); if (pp) a.gest.tgt = pp; }
      if (a.gest.t >= a.gest.dur) a.gest = null;
    }
    const x = a.act;
    if (!x) continue;
    const cancel = (why) => { a.act = null; endCuff(S, x); ev.push({ e: 'actcancel', id: a.id, k: x.k, why }); };
    if (!a.alive || a.down || a.stun > 0.3 || a.flash > 0.5) { cancel('state'); continue; }
    // ノブに手を伸ばす（短い）: 届かなくなったらやめる。終わりに扉を動かし、手で押す・引く
    if (x.quick) {
      x.t += dt;
      if (x.t < x.dur) continue;
      a.act = null;
      if (!reachOK(S, w, a, 'door', x.id, x.k, 0.2)) { ev.push({ e: 'deny', id: a.id, why: 'far', op: x.k, k: 'door' }); continue; }
      const r = doorOp(S, w, a, x.id, x.k, ev);
      if (!r.ok && r.why) ev.push({ e: 'deny', id: a.id, why: r.why, d: x.id });
      else a.gest = { k: 'push', t: 0, dur: x.k === 'peek' ? 0.3 : 0.4, tgt: pushPoint(S, w, a, x.id, x.k) || actTarget(S, w, a, 'door', x.id, x.k), did: x.id, op: x.k };
      continue;
    }
    // 立ち位置へ寄る（体ごと少し動き、目標を向く）
    if (x.stand && x.t < x.alignT) {
      const dx = x.stand[0] - a.x, dz = x.stand[1] - a.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (d > 0.01) { const st = Math.min(d, 2.0 * dt); a.x += dx / d * st; a.z += dz / d * st; }
      x.x = a.x; x.z = a.z;
    }
    // 動いたら中断（AIは止まって行う）
    if (x.still && Math.hypot(a.x - x.x, a.z - x.z) > 0.5) { cancel('moved'); continue; }
    // 拘束: 手は相手の手首を追う。目は相手の腰の後ろ（手首を回してくる所）
    if (x.k === 'restrain') {
      const b = S.byId[x.id];
      if (b) {
        x.tgt = actTarget(S, w, a, 'person', b.id, 'restrain');
        if (b.down || b.dead) x.look = x.tgt;
        else { const dx = a.x - b.x, dz = a.z - b.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; x.look = [b.x + dx / d * 0.14, b.y + (b.comply === 2 || b.cuffed ? 0.72 : 0.95), b.z + dz / d * 0.14]; }
      }
    }
    // 目標から目をそらした（手元が見えない）。拘束は手元を見ていること
    if (x.tgt && x.kind !== 'self') {
      const tx = x.tgt[0] - a.x, tz = x.tgt[2] - a.z;
      const lim = x.k === 'restrain' ? 1.25 : 1.75;
      if (Math.hypot(tx, tz) > 0.3 && x.t > (x.alignT || 0)) { let da = Math.atan2(tx, tz) - a.yaw; da = Math.atan2(Math.sin(da), Math.cos(da)); if (Math.abs(da) > lim) { cancel('look'); continue; } }
    }
    // ときどき（0.1秒ごと）、まだ手が届くか（離れた・間に物や人が入った）
    if ((x.chk = (x.chk || 0) + 1) % 6 === 0 && x.kind !== 'self' && x.k !== 'report' && !reachOK(S, w, a, x.kind, x.id, x.k, 0.25)) { cancel('reach:' + REACH_WHY); continue; }
    // 相手が離れた・状態が変わった
    if (x.kind === 'person') {
      const b = S.byId[x.id];
      if (!b) { cancel('gone'); continue; }
      if (x.k === 'restrain' && (b.cuffed || !b.alive || (!b.comply && !b.down && b.tased <= 0 && b.stun <= 0 && b.flash <= 0.2))) { cancel('tgt'); continue; }
      if (x.k === 'restrain') { b.cuffK = Math.min(1, x.t / x.dur); b.cuffBy = a.id; }
    }
    x.t += dt;
    if (x.t < x.dur) continue;
    a.act = null;
    endCuff(S, x);
    finishOp(S, w, a, x, ev);
  }
}

function finishOp(S, w, a, x, ev) {
  const k = x.k;
  if (x.kind === 'door') {
    const did = x.id;
    if (k === 'pick' || k === 'lockgun') { doorOp(S, w, a, did, 'unlock', ev); return; }
    // 人が操作するミラー・オプティワンド: 扉の下からのぞく視点に切り替える
    if ((k === 'mirror' && a.pid != null) || k === 'wand') { startPeek(S, w, a, k, ev, did); return; }
    if (k === 'mirror') {
      // 扉の向こうの人と罠を見る
      const d = w.doors[did], side = -sideOf(d, a.x, a.z);
      const seen = [];
      for (const b of S.actors) {
        if (!b.alive || b.isDrone || Math.abs(b.y - d.L * LH) > 1.6) continue;
        const s = (b.x - d.cx) * d.nx + (b.z - d.cz) * d.nz;
        if (s * side <= 0) continue;
        const room = w.roomAt[w.idx(d.L, Math.floor(b.x / CS), Math.floor(b.z / CS))];
        const dist = Math.hypot(b.x - d.cx, b.z - d.cz);
        if (dist > 9) continue;
        seen.push({ id: b.id, kind: b.kind, armed: !!(b.inv.w[0] || b.inv.w[1]), comply: b.comply, dist: +dist.toFixed(1), room });
        if (b.ai) b.ai.mirroredT = S.t;
        b.spot = Math.max(b.spot || 0, 6);
      }
      const ds = S.doors[did];
      if (ds.trap) ds.trapSeen = true;
      ev.push({ e: 'mirror', id: a.id, d: did, seen, trap: !!ds.trap, locked: !!(ds.locked && !ds.lockBroken) });
      return;
    }
    if (k === 'wedge' && x.gear && !useGear(a, 'wedge')) return;
    if (k === 'c2' && !useGear(a, 'c2')) return;
    if (k === 'trap' && !useGear(a, 'claymore')) return;
    const r = doorOp(S, w, a, did, k === 'bash' ? 'kick' : k, ev);
    if (!r.ok && r.why) ev.push({ e: 'deny', id: a.id, why: r.why, d: did });
    return;
  }
  if (x.kind === 'person') {
    const b = S.byId[x.id];
    if (!b) return;
    if (k === 'restrain') {
      b.cuffed = true; b.comply = 2; b.stateT = 0; b.act = null; b.vx = b.vz = 0;
      if (b.inv.w[0] || b.inv.w[1]) dropWeapon(S, b, ev);
      a.stats.arrest += b.kind === 'sus' ? 1 : 0; a.stats.rescue += b.kind === 'civ' ? 1 : 0;
      ev.push({ e: 'cuffed', id: b.id, by: a.id, kind: b.kind, down: b.down });
      return;
    }
    if (k === 'report') { b.reported = true; ev.push({ e: 'report', id: b.id, by: a.id, kind: b.kind, st: b.dead ? 'dead' : b.down ? 'down' : 'cuffed' }); return; }
    if (k === 'revive') { if (b.down && b.alive) { b.down = false; b.dbno = 0; b.hp = 20; b.stateT = 0; b.revivedT = S.t; ev.push({ e: 'revive', id: b.id, by: a.id }); } return; }
  }
  if (x.kind === 'item') {
    const it = S.items.find(q => q.id === x.id);
    if (!it || it.gone) return;
    if (k === 'collect') { it.gone = true; ev.push({ e: 'evidence', id: it.id, by: a.id, kind: it.kind, wid: it.wid || null, ev: it.ev, obj: it.obj || null }); }
    return;
  }
  if (x.kind === 'bomb' && k === 'bombdefuse') { const b = S.m.bombs.find(q => q.id === x.id); if (b && !b.done) { b.done = true; ev.push({ e: 'bombdone', id: b.id, by: a.id }); } return; }
  if (x.kind === 'site') {
    if (k === 'plant' && a.carry === 'defuser') { a.carry = null; S.m.defuser = { planted: true, x: a.x, y: a.y, z: a.z, t: 0, site: x.id, by: a.id }; ev.push({ e: 'plant', id: a.id, site: x.id }); }
    if (k === 'defuse' && S.m.defuser) { S.m.defuser.disabled = true; ev.push({ e: 'disable', id: a.id }); }
    return;
  }
  if (x.kind === 'wall') {
    const kk = x.id;
    if (k === 'reinforce') { if ((S.m.reinfLeft ?? 0) > 0) { S.reinf[kk] = 1; S.m.reinfLeft--; ev.push({ e: 'reinf', k: kk, id: a.id }); } }
    if (k === 'frame' && useGear(a, 'frame')) { S.mines = S.mines || []; S.mines.push({ k: 'frame', owner: a.id, x: (kk % w.W + 0.5) * CS, y: a.y + 1.0, z: (Math.floor(kk / w.W) % w.D + 0.5) * CS, cell: kk }); ev.push({ e: 'frameset', id: a.id }); }
    return;
  }
  if (k === 'bandage') {
    if (S.pvp) { a.hp = Math.min(a.maxHp, a.hp + 40); } else { a.hp = Math.max(a.hp, Math.min(a.maxHp, a.maxHp * 0.5)); a.inj.arm = 0; }
    a.bleed = 0;
    ev.push({ e: 'bandaged', id: a.id });
  }
}

// 呼びかけ（警告）。聞こえた人は AI が投降するか決める
export function shout(S, a, ev, line) {
  if ((S.t - (a._shoutT ?? -999)) * S.dt < 0.75) return false;
  a._shoutT = S.t;
  S.shouts.push({ by: a.id, t: S.t, x: a.x, y: a.y, z: a.z, yaw: a.yaw });
  ev.push({ e: 'shout', id: a.id, line: line ?? -1, x: a.x, y: a.y + 1.6, z: a.z });
  return true;
}

function selectGear(S, a, id, ev) {
  const G = GEAR[id];
  if (!G) return;
  const g = a.inv.gear.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!g || g.n <= 0) { ev.push({ e: 'deny', id: a.id, why: 'nogear' }); return; }
  if (G.kind === 'heal') { if (a.act) return; if (g.n > 0) { g.n--; a.act = { k: 'bandage', t: 0, dur: ACT_T.bandage, kind: 'self', id: a.id, still: false, noAds: true, x: a.x, z: a.z, pose: 'bandage', tgt: null }; ev.push({ e: 'act', id: a.id, k: 'bandage', dur: ACT_T.bandage }); } return; }
  if (G.kind === 'nade' || G.kind === 'spray') {
    // 手に持つ（slot 2）。引き金で投げる・吹きつける
    a.ws.gear = id;
    if (a.ws.slot !== 2) switchTo(S, a, 2, ev);
    ev.push({ e: 'gearsel', id: a.id, g: id });
    return;
  }
  // 扉や壁に使う物（C2・ウェッジなど）は、扉を見て「調べる」から使う
  ev.push({ e: 'gearhint', id: a.id, g: id });
}

function gearInHand(S, w, a, dt, ev) {
  const ws = a.ws, inp = a._inp || {};
  if (ws.st !== 'ready' && ws.st !== 'gear') { ws.gearTrig = !!inp.fire; return; }
  ws.st = 'gear';
  const id = ws.gear;
  const g = a.inv.gear.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!g || g.n <= 0) { switchTo(S, a, ws.prev >= 0 ? ws.prev : 0, ev); ws.st = 'holster'; return; }
  const press = !!inp.fire && !ws.gearTrig;
  ws.gearTrig = !!inp.fire;
  if (!press) return;
  if (GEAR[id].kind === 'nade') {
    g.n--;
    throwNade(S, a, id, inp.power ?? 0.75, ev);
    if (g.n <= 0 || !inp.keepGear) { ws.next = ws.prev >= 0 ? ws.prev : 0; ws.st = 'holster'; ws.t = 0.35; }
  } else if (GEAR[id].kind === 'spray') {
    spray(S, w, a, ev);
    g.n = Math.max(0, g.n - 0); // 本数ではなく回数で管理（6回）
    ws.sprays = (ws.sprays || 0) + 1;
    if (ws.sprays >= (GEAR.spray.uses || 6)) { g.n = 0; ws.next = ws.prev >= 0 ? ws.prev : 0; ws.st = 'holster'; ws.t = 0.3; }
  }
}

function spray(S, w, a, ev) {
  ev.push({ e: 'spray', id: a.id });
  const fx = Math.sin(a.yaw), fz = Math.cos(a.yaw);
  for (const b of S.actors) {
    if (b.id === a.id || !b.alive || b.isDrone) continue;
    const dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.z - a.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (d > 3.2 || Math.abs(b.y - a.y) > 1) continue;
    if ((dx * fx + dz * fz) / Math.max(0.01, d) < 0.85) continue;
    if (b.armor && b.armor.head === 'gasmask') continue;
    b.stun = Math.max(b.stun, 3.5); b.gas = Math.max(b.gas, 5);
    if (b.ai && b.ai.morale != null) b.ai.morale -= 0.6;
    S.harms.push({ t: S.t, by: a.id, tgt: b.id, how: 'less', d: 0, part: 'head', kind: b.kind, threat: b.ai ? (S.t - (b.ai.threatT ?? -1e9)) * S.dt < 2 : false, warned: b.ai ? b.ai.warned || 0 : 0, armed: !!(b.inv.w[0] || b.inv.w[1]), comply: b.comply, cuffed: b.cuffed, down: b.down });
    ev.push({ e: 'sprayed', id: b.id, by: a.id });
  }
}

// ---- 特殊装備
// 装備の切り替えから選ぶ: 盾は副武器と一緒に構える。ほかは手に持つ（slot 3）。もう一度選ぶと銃に戻す
function selectLong(S, a, ev) {
  const L = a.inv.long, ws = a.ws;
  if (!L || L === 'none' || !LONG[L]) { ev.push({ e: 'deny', id: a.id, why: 'nolong' }); return; }
  if (L === 'shield') {
    if (ws.slot === 1 && ws.st !== 'holster') { if (a.inv.w[0]) switchTo(S, a, 0, ev); }
    else if (a.inv.w[1]) switchTo(S, a, 1, ev);
    ev.push({ e: 'longsel', id: a.id, k: L, on: ws.next === 1 || (ws.slot === 1 && ws.st !== 'holster') });
    return;
  }
  if (!HAND_LONG[L]) return;
  if (ws.slot === 3 && ws.st !== 'holster') { switchTo(S, a, ws.prev >= 0 && a.inv.w[ws.prev] ? ws.prev : (a.inv.w[0] ? 0 : 1), ev); return; }
  if (switchTo(S, a, 3, ev)) ev.push({ e: 'longsel', id: a.id, k: L, on: true });
}

// 手に持った特殊装備: 引き金で使う
function longInHand(S, w, a, dt, ev) {
  const ws = a.ws, inp = a._inp || {}, L = a.inv.long;
  if (!HAND_LONG[L]) { switchTo(S, a, a.inv.w[0] ? 0 : 1, ev); return; }
  if (ws.st !== 'ready' && ws.st !== 'long') { ws.longTrig = !!inp.fire; return; }
  ws.st = 'long';
  if (ws.lt > 0) {
    ws.lt -= dt;
    if (ws.lt <= 0) { ws.lt = 0; ev.push({ e: 'reloaded', id: a.id }); }
  }
  const press = !!inp.fire && !ws.longTrig;
  ws.longTrig = !!inp.fire;
  if (!press || ws.lt > 0 || a.act || a.peek || a.sprint || a.vault) return;
  if (L === 'm320') {
    const m = a.inv.m320;
    if (!m) return;
    if (!(m[m.sel] > 0)) m320Next(a, null);
    if (!(m[m.sel] > 0)) { ev.push({ e: 'dry', id: a.id }); ev.push({ e: 'deny', id: a.id, why: 'noammo' }); return; }
    m[m.sel]--;
    launchNade(S, a, m.sel, ev);
    a.fireK = 1;
    // 1発ずつ込める（中折れ）。弾が残っていれば自動で込める
    const left = m.flash + m.stinger + m.cs;
    if (!(m[m.sel] > 0)) m320Next(a, null);
    if (left > 0) { ws.lt = LONG.m320.reload || 2.6; ws.rd = ws.lt; ev.push({ e: 'reload', id: a.id, k: 'break', dur: ws.lt, long: 1 }); }
    return;
  }
  if (L === 'wand') {
    // 扉を見ていれば扉の下から、そうでなければ手を伸ばして角の先を
    const c = contextOf(S, w, a);
    if (c && c.k === 'door') { const op = c.ops.find(o => o.op === 'wand'); if (op) { startOp(S, w, a, c, op, ev); return; } }
    startPeek(S, w, a, 'wand', ev, -1);
    return;
  }
  if (L === 'ram' || L === 'breacher') {
    const c = contextOf(S, w, a);
    const want = L === 'ram' ? 'ram' : 'breach';
    if (c && c.k === 'door') { const op = c.ops.find(o => o.op === want); if (op) { startOp(S, w, a, c, op, ev); return; } }
    ev.push({ e: 'deny', id: a.id, why: 'needdoor' });
  }
}

// ---- のぞく（ミラー・オプティワンド）: 扉の下や角の先にカメラを置く。見回すのは画面の側（体は動かない）
export const PEEK = { mirror: { fov: 64, max: 1.25, time: 15 }, wand: { fov: 78, max: 1.6, time: 25 } };
function startPeek(S, w, a, k, ev, did) {
  let x, y, z, yaw0;
  if (did >= 0) {
    const d = w.doors[did], side = -sideOf(d, a.x, a.z);
    // 扉の下から少し差し込む（振り返ると扉の枠と罠が見える）
    const off = (d.th || 0.12) / 2 + 0.16;
    x = d.cx + d.nx * side * off; z = d.cz + d.nz * side * off; y = d.L * LH + 0.06;
    yaw0 = Math.atan2(d.nx * side, d.nz * side);
  } else {
    // 目の高さから少し下、前へ最大 0.6m（壁の手前で止める）
    const e = eyeOf(S, a), fx = Math.sin(a.yaw), fz = Math.cos(a.yaw);
    const y0 = e[1] - 0.12;
    const hits = raycast(w, e[0], y0, e[2], fx, 0, fz, 0.75, S.doors, _rc);
    let L = 0.6;
    for (const h of hits) { if (h.mat === M.GLASSBROKEN) continue; L = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(L, h.t0 - 0.12)); break; }
    x = e[0] + fx * L; y = y0; z = e[2] + fz * L; yaw0 = a.yaw;
  }
  const P = PEEK[k];
  a.peek = { k, x, y, z, yaw0, door: did, t: 0, max: P.max, fov: P.fov, ax: a.x, az: a.z, spotT: 0, seen: [] };
  peekSpot(S, w, a);
  ev.push({ e: 'peek', id: a.id, k, x, y, z, yaw0, door: did, max: P.max, fov: P.fov, trap: did >= 0 && !!S.doors[did].trap, locked: did >= 0 && !!(S.doors[did].locked && !S.doors[did].lockBroken) });
}
// カメラから見える人（見回せる範囲・10m以内）。見えた人は気づかれやすくなる
function peekSpot(S, w, a) {
  const P = a.peek;
  const seen = [];
  for (const b of S.actors) {
    if (b === a || !b.alive || b.isDrone) continue;
    const dx = b.x - P.x, dz = b.z - P.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (d > 10 || Math.abs(b.y - (P.y - 0.06)) > 2.2) continue;
    let da = Math.atan2(dx, dz) - P.yaw0; da = Math.atan2(Math.sin(da), Math.cos(da));
    if (Math.abs(da) > P.max + 0.6) continue;
    if (!los(w, P.x, P.y, P.z, b.x, b.y + 0.9, b.z, S.doors) && !los(w, P.x, P.y, P.z, b.x, b.y + 0.25, b.z, S.doors)) continue;
    seen.push(b.id);
    if (b.ai) b.ai.mirroredT = S.t;
    b.spot = Math.max(b.spot || 0, 6);
  }
  P.seen = seen;
  if (P.door >= 0) { const ds = S.doors[P.door]; if (ds.trap) ds.trapSeen = true; }
}
function stepPeek(S, w, a, dt, ev) {
  const P = a.peek;
  P.t += dt;
  const moved = Math.hypot(a.x - P.ax, a.z - P.az) > 0.35;
  const hurtNow = !a.alive || a.down || a.stun > 0.3 || a.flash > 0.5 || a.flinch > 0.6;
  const dropped = P.k === 'wand' && P.door < 0 && a.ws.slot !== 3;
  if (moved || hurtNow || dropped || a.act || P.t > PEEK[P.k].time) { endPeek(S, w, a, ev, moved ? 'move' : hurtNow ? 'hurt' : 'time'); return; }
  P.spotT -= dt;
  if (P.spotT <= 0) { P.spotT = 0.4; peekSpot(S, w, a); }
}
function endPeek(S, w, a, ev, why) {
  const P = a.peek;
  if (!P) return;
  a.peek = null;
  ev.push({ e: 'peekend', id: a.id, k: P.k, why, n: P.seen.length });
}

// 仕掛けたC2・壁の爆破薬を起爆
function detonateMine(S, w, a, ev) {
  let any = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < w.doors.length; i++) { const ds = S.doors[i]; if (ds.c2 && ds.c2.owner === a.id) { detonateC2(S, w, i, ev); any = true; } }
  if (S.mines) for (let i = S.mines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const m = S.mines[i]; if (m.owner !== a.id) continue; S.mines.splice(i, 1); S.blasts.push({ x: m.x, y: m.y, z: m.z, r: 3.0, dmg: 120, kind: 'frame', by: a.id, t: 0 }); any = true; }
  if (!any) ev.push({ e: 'deny', id: a.id, why: 'nodet' });
}

function clear(w, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz) { return !occluded(w, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, null, false); }
function rayFree(w, ax, ay, az, dx, dy, dz, L) {
  // 地図の外に出るか L まで進んで何もなければ空が見える
  const ex = ax + dx * L, ey = ay + dy * L, ez = az + dz * L;
  return !occluded(w, ax, ay, az, ex, ey, ez, null, false);
}
// 空を見る方向（上半球、決まった並び）
const SKYD = [];
for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
  const el = [0.28, 0.75, 1.3][r], n = [8, 6, 1][r];
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const az = (k / n) * Math.PI * 2 + r * 0.4; SKYD.push([Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el), Math.sin(el), Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el)]); }
}

export function bakeLight(w, def, opt = {}) {

  const W1 = w.W + 1, D1 = w.D + 1, NLy = w.NL * 3;

  const sky = SKIES[def.time || 'day'] || SKIES.day;
  const lights = (def.lights || []).map(([x, z, L, kind, mul]) => {
    const K = LIGHT_KIND[kind] || LIGHT_KIND.lamp;
    return { x: x * CS, y: (L || 0) * LH + (K.h || CEIL - 0.06), z: z * CS, L: L || 0, col: K.col, I: K.I * (mul || 1) * (def.lampMul || 1), R: K.R, down: K.down };

  const nearOpen = new Uint8Array(w.NL * w.W * w.D);

      if (isWallish(b) && (w.arms[w.idx(L, ci, j - 1)] & 4)) return false;
      return a !== C.VOID || b !== C.VOID;

function touchesOut(w, L, i, j) {
  for (const [di, dj] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) { const ni = i + di, nj = j + dj; if (ni < 0 || nj < 0 || ni >= w.W || nj >= w.D) continue; if (w.cell[w.idx(L, ni, nj)] === C.OUT) return true; }
  return false;
}

// 位置と法線での明るさ（RGB）。snap: 法線の向きに格子へ寄せる（壁・床の面用）
export function lightAt(lat, x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, out = [0, 0, 0], snap = false) {
  const { W1, D1, data } = lat;
  let L = Math.max(0, Math.min(lat.NLy / 3 - 1, Math.floor((y + 0.05) / LH)));
  let yl = y - L * LH;
  if (yl > LH - 0.05) { L = Math.min(lat.NLy / 3 - 1, L + 1); yl = y - L * LH; }
  let fx = x / CS, fz = z / CS;
  // 高さの段
  let fh = yl <= HS[0] ? 0 : yl >= HS[2] ? 2 : yl < HS[1] ? (yl - HS[0]) / (HS[1] - HS[0]) : 1 + (yl - HS[1]) / (HS[2] - HS[1]);
  if (snap) {
    const ax = Math.abs(nx), ay = Math.abs(ny), az = Math.abs(nz);
    if (ax >= ay && ax >= az) fx = Math.round(fx + nx * 0.15);
    else if (az >= ay) fz = Math.round(fz + nz * 0.15);
    else fh = ny > 0 ? Math.floor(fh) : Math.ceil(fh);
  }
  fx = Math.max(0, Math.min(W1 - 1.0001, fx)); fz = Math.max(0, Math.min(D1 - 1.0001, fz)); fh = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, fh));
  const i0 = Math.floor(fx), j0 = Math.floor(fz), h0 = Math.min(1, Math.floor(fh));
  const tx = fx - i0, tz = fz - j0, th = fh - h0;
  // 法線の重み（ambient cube）
  const wx = nx * nx, wy = ny * ny, wz = nz * nz;
  const ax = nx >= 0 ? 0 : 1, ay = ny >= 0 ? 2 : 3, az = nz >= 0 ? 4 : 5;
  out[0] = out[1] = out[2] = 0;
  for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
    const di = c & 1, dj = (c >> 1) & 1, dh = (c >> 2) & 1;
    const wgt = (di ? tx : 1 - tx) * (dj ? tz : 1 - tz) * (dh ? th : 1 - th);
    if (wgt < 1e-5) continue;
    const ii = Math.min(W1 - 1, i0 + di), jj = Math.min(D1 - 1, j0 + dj), hh = h0 + dh;
    const o = (((L * 3 + hh) * D1 + jj) * W1 + ii) * 18;
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) out[k] += wgt * (wx * data[o + ax * 3 + k] + wy * data[o + ay * 3 + k] + wz * data[o + az * 3 + k]);
  }
  return out;
}
// 6方向の明るさ（人や動く物の照らし方）。out: 18個
export function cubeAt(lat, x, y, z, out = new Float32Array(18)) {
  const tmp = [0, 0, 0];
  for (let a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
    const d = DIRS[a];
    lightAt(lat, x, y, z, d[0], d[1], d[2], tmp);
    out[a * 3] = tmp[0]; out[a * 3 + 1] = tmp[1]; out[a * 3 + 2] = tmp[2];
  }
  return out;
}
// AI 用: その場所の明るさ（0..1くらい）
export function brightAt(lat, x, y, z) {
  const t = [0, 0, 0];
  let s = 0;
  for (const d of DIRS) { lightAt(lat, x, y, z, d[0], d[1], d[2], t); s += 0.2126 * t[0] + 0.7152 * t[1] + 0.0722 * t[2]; }
  return s / 6;
}

// ---- 部屋の型。u は部屋の西（反転なら東）から、v は廊下の側からのマス。p, q は同じ向きの連続した座標
function frame(cv, x0, side, flip, n) {
  const Xi = (u) => flip ? x0 + n - 1 - u : x0 + u;
  const Zi = (v) => side === 'n' ? 27 - v : 33 + v;
  const Xc = (p) => flip ? x0 + n - p : x0 + p;
  const Zc = (q) => side === 'n' ? 28 - q : 33 + q;
  const R = (lr) => lr === 0 ? (side === 'n' ? 2 : 0) : lr === 2 ? (side === 'n' ? 0 : 2) : lr === 1 ? (flip ? 3 : 1) : (flip ? 1 : 3);
  const r1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 100) / 100;
  return {
    Xi, Zi, Xc, Zc,
    H: (u0, u1, v, ch) => cv.h(Xi(u0), Xi(u1), Zi(v), ch),
    V: (u, v0, v1, ch) => cv.v(Xi(u), Zi(v0), Zi(v1), ch),
    F: (u0, v0, u1, v1, ch) => cv.rect(Math.min(Xi(u0), Xi(u1)), Math.min(Zi(v0), Zi(v1)), Math.max(Xi(u0), Xi(u1)), Math.max(Zi(v0), Zi(v1)), ch),
    DH: (u, v, ch = 'D') => cv.door(Math.min(Xi(u), Xi(u + 1)), Zi(v), 'h', 2, ch),
    DV: (u, v) => cv.door(Xi(u), Math.min(Zi(v), Zi(v + 1)), 'v'),
    WH: (u, v, len) => cv.win(Math.min(Xi(u), Xi(u + len - 1)), Zi(v), 'h', len),
    P: (L) => (type, p, q, lr, o) => props.push([type, r1(Xc(p)), r1(Zc(q)), L, R(lr), ...(o ? [o] : [])]),
    at: (p, q, L) => L ? [r1(Xc(p)), r1(Zc(q)), L] : [r1(Xc(p)), r1(Zc(q))],
    lt: (p, q, L, kind, mul) => lights.push([r1(Xc(p)), r1(Zc(q)), L, kind, ...(mul ? [mul] : [])]),
  };
}

@@@@ FILE src/engine/maps/draw.js text 1764
// マップを描く道具: 文字マスの紙に、四角・線・扉・窓を描いて、行の文字列にする（決まった手順なのでデータと同じ）
export function canvas(W, D, fill = ' ') {
  const g = Array.from({ length: D }, () => Array(W).fill(fill));
  const c = {
    W, D, g,
    set(x, z, ch) { if (x >= 0 && z >= 0 && x < W && z < D) g[z][x] = ch; return c; },
    get(x, z) { return x >= 0 && z >= 0 && x < W && z < D ? g[z][x] : ' '; },
    rect(x0, z0, x1, z1, ch) { for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) c.set(x, z, ch); return c; },
    frame(x0, z0, x1, z1, ch) { for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) { c.set(x, z0, ch); c.set(x, z1, ch); } for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) { c.set(x0, z, ch); c.set(x1, z, ch); } return c; },
    // 床つきの部屋（外周は壁）
    room(x0, z0, x1, z1, wall, floor) { c.rect(x0 + 1, z0 + 1, x1 - 1, z1 - 1, floor); c.frame(x0, z0, x1, z1, wall); return c; },
    h(x0, x1, z, ch) { for (let x = Math.min(x0, x1); x <= Math.max(x0, x1); x++) c.set(x, z, ch); return c; },
    v(x, z0, z1, ch) { for (let z = Math.min(z0, z1); z <= Math.max(z0, z1); z++) c.set(x, z, ch); return c; },
    // 扉: 横の壁（h）なら x から n マス、縦の壁（v）なら z から n マス
    door(x, z, dir, n = 2, ch = 'D') { for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) dir === 'h' ? c.set(x + k, z, ch) : c.set(x, z + k, ch); return c; },
    win(x, z, dir, n = 2, ch = 'G') { for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) dir === 'h' ? c.set(x + k, z, ch) : c.set(x, z + k, ch); return c; },
    // 階段の範囲を 'S' で（外の階段は 's'）
    stairs(x, z, iw, jw, ch = 'S') { c.rect(x, z, x + iw - 1, z + jw - 1, ch); return c; },
    rows() { return g.map(r => r.join('')); },
  };
  return c;
}

function unit(cv, L, no, x0, flip, kind) {
  const Xi = (u) => flip ? x0 + 8 - u : x0 + u;
  const Xc = (p) => flip ? x0 + 9 - p : x0 + p;
  const R = (r) => flip ? (r === 1 ? 3 : r === 3 ? 1 : r) : r;
  const P = (type, p, z, r, o) => props.push([type, r2(Xc(p)), z, L, R(r), ...(o ? [o] : [])]);
  const lo = (u, n) => Math.min(Xi(u), Xi(u + n - 1));

  const e = cv.get(Xi(0), 20) === 'C' ? 0.18 : 0;

// 作戦（PvE）: バリケード・人質救出・爆弾脅迫・強制捜査（レイド）・アクティブシューター
// 採点（100点）: 主目的50（容疑者25・市民25）、副目的30（報告10・証拠10・作戦別10）、隊員の安全10、規則10。違反で減点。評価 S〜F
import { spawnSwat, spawnSuspect, spawnCivilian, cellPos } from './spawn.js';
import { OFFICERS, LOADOUTS, SUSPECTS } from '../data/npc.js';
import { MAPS } from '../maps/index.js';
import { MISSIONS, DIFFS } from '../data/missions.js';
import { rnd, rndShuffle, rndInt, rndPick } from '../rng.js';
import { CS, LH, los } from '../world.js';
import { killActor, eyeOf } from '../combat.js';

const sec = (S, t0) => (S.t - t0) * S.dt;

export default {
  init(S, w, o) {
    const def = MAPS[S.map];
    const M = MISSIONS[o.mission] || MISSIONS.barricade;
    const D = DIFFS[o.diff || 'normal'] || DIFFS.normal;
    S.rules.cap = D.cap; S.rules.diff = o.diff || 'normal';
    const r = S.rng;
    const sp = def.spawn;
    // 隊員: プレイヤー（最大4人）＋AI で合計 team 人
    // allAI: 全員AI（自動テスト・観戦）。AIの指揮（ai/lead.js）が命令を出す
    const roster = o.allAI ? [] : o.roster && o.roster.length ? o.roster : [{ pid: 0, name: 'リード', lo: LOADOUTS.player }];
    if (o.allAI) S.rules.aiLead = true;
    const entry = (sp.swat || [])[o.entry ?? 0] || sp.swat[0];
    const total = Math.max(roster.length, Math.min(4, o.team ?? 4));
    let k = 0;
    const place = (n) => { const col = n % 2, row = Math.floor(n / 2); const fx = Math.sin(entry.yaw || 0), fz = Math.cos(entry.yaw || 0); return { x: entry.x - fx * row * 2.4 + (-fz) * (col ? 1.2 : -1.2) * 0.9, z: entry.z - fz * row * 2.4 + fx * (col ? 1.2 : -1.2) * 0.9 }; };
    for (const pl of roster) { const p = place(k); spawnSwat(S, w, { pid: pl.pid, name: pl.name, x: p.x, z: p.z, L: entry.L || 0, yaw: entry.yaw || 0, lo: pl.lo || LOADOUTS.player, cell: true, team: 0 }); k++; }
    const keys = ['red1', 'red2', 'blue1', 'blue2'];
    const aiN = total - roster.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < aiN; i++) {
      const of = OFFICERS[i], p = place(k);
      const lo = (o.aiLoadouts && o.aiLoadouts[i]) || LOADOUTS[keys[i]];
      spawnSwat(S, w, { name: of.name, x: p.x, z: p.z, L: entry.L || 0, yaw: entry.yaw || 0, lo, cell: true, squad: i < 2 ? 'red' : 'blue', slot: i, team: 0 });
      k++;
    }
    // 容疑者と市民（作戦とマップから）
    const MM = (def.missions && def.missions[o.mission]) || {};
    const nSus = Math.round(lerp(M.sus[0], M.sus[1], rnd(r)) * D.susMul * (MM.susMul || 1));
    const nCiv = Math.round(lerp(M.civ[0], M.civ[1], rnd(r)) * (MM.civMul || 1));
    const susSpots = rndShuffle(r, (sp.sus || []).slice());
    const civSpots = rndShuffle(r, (sp.civ || []).slice());
    const profs = MM.prof || M.prof;
    S.m = { kind: 'pve', mission: o.mission, phase: 'play', startT: S.t, sus: [], civ: [], evidence: [], bombs: [], hostages: [], log: [], reportsDone: 0, softDone: false, execDelay: D.exec, fail: null, diff: o.diff || 'normal', entry: o.entry ?? 0, title: M.name };
    // 人質救出: 人質と見張り
    if (o.mission === 'hostage') {
      const hs = rndShuffle(r, (sp.hostage || sp.civ || []).slice());
      const nH = Math.min(hs.length, Math.round(lerp(M.hostages[0], M.hostages[1], rnd(r))));
      for (let i = 0; i < nH; i++) {
        const [x, z, L = 0] = hs[i];
        const h = spawnCivilian(S, w, x, z, L, 'hostage', { tag: 'hostage' });
        S.m.hostages.push(h.id);
        // 見張り（近く）
        const g = spawnSuspect(S, w, x + (rnd(r) - 0.5) * 4, z + (rnd(r) - 0.5) * 4, L, 'taker', { hostage: h.id });
        g.ai.wantAmbush = true;
        S.m.sus.push(g.id);
      }
    }
    // 爆弾脅迫: 爆弾と見張り
    if (o.mission === 'bomb') {
      const bs = rndShuffle(r, (sp.bomb || []).slice());
      const nB = Math.min(bs.length, Math.round(lerp(M.bombs[0], M.bombs[1], rnd(r))));
      for (let i = 0; i < nB; i++) {
        const [x, z, L = 0] = bs[i];
        const p = cellPos(w, x, z, L);
        S.m.bombs.push({ id: i + 1, x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z, L, done: false });
        if (i < nSus) { const g = spawnSuspect(S, w, x + (rnd(r) - 0.5) * 3, z + (rnd(r) - 0.5) * 3, L, 'bomber'); g.ai.wantAmbush = true; S.m.sus.push(g.id); }
      }
      S.m.bombT = MM.time || M.time; // 秒（広いマップは長め）
    }
    // ほかの容疑者
    while (S.m.sus.length < nSus && susSpots.length) {
      const [x, z, L = 0] = susSpots.pop();
      const prof = rndPick(r, profs);
      const a = spawnSuspect(S, w, x, z, L, prof);
      if (o.mission === 'active') { a.ai.active = true; a.ai.alert = true; }
      S.m.sus.push(a.id);
    }
    // 市民
    const civProfs = M.civProf || ['adult', 'adult', 'staff', 'elder', 'angry'];
    for (let i = 0; i < nCiv && civSpots.length; i++) {
      const [x, z, L = 0] = civSpots.pop();
      const c = spawnCivilian(S, w, x, z, L, rndPick(r, civProfs));
      S.m.civ.push(c.id);
    }
    // 証拠（落とした武器のほかに、置かれた物）
    const evSpots = rndShuffle(r, (sp.evidence || []).slice());
    const nEv = Math.min(evSpots.length, Math.round(lerp(M.evidence[0], M.evidence[1], rnd(r))));
    const EVK = M.evKinds || ['drugs', 'phone', 'docs', 'cash'];
    for (let i = 0; i < nEv; i++) {
      const [x, z, L = 0] = evSpots[i];
      const p = cellPos(w, x, z, L);
      S.items.push({ id: S.nextItem++, kind: 'evidence', ek: rndPick(r, EVK), x: p.x + (rnd(r) - 0.5) * 0.3, y: p.y + (MM.evY || 0.76), z: p.z + (rnd(r) - 0.5) * 0.3, yaw: rnd(r) * 6.28, ev: true, obj: true });
      S.m.evidence.push(S.nextItem - 1);
    }
    // 扉の鍵と罠（マップの指定＋難しさ）
    for (let i = 0; i < w.doors.length; i++) {
      const d = w.doors[i], ds = S.doors[i];
      if (d.opt.locked == null && !d.opt.outer && rnd(r) < (M.lockChance ?? 0.25)) ds.locked = true;
      // 罠は入口から遠い側（中の側）に仕掛けてある
      if (d.opt.trap || (!d.opt.outer && rnd(r) < (M.trapChance ?? 0) * D.trapMul)) { const toEntry = (entry.x * CS - d.cx) * d.nx + (entry.z * CS - d.cz) * d.nz; ds.trap = { armed: true, team: 1, side: toEntry > 0 ? -1 : 1 }; }
    }
    S.rules.ff = true;
  },

  step(S, w, dt, ev) {
    const m = S.m;
    if (m.phase !== 'play') return;
    // 爆弾の時間
    if (m.mission === 'bomb' && m.bombs.some(b => !b.done)) {
      m.bombT -= dt;
      if (m.bombT <= 0) {
        m.bombT = 0;
        for (const b of m.bombs) if (!b.done) S.blasts.push({ x: b.x, y: b.y + 0.4, z: b.z, r: 14, dmg: 600, kind: 'bomb', by: -1, t: 0 });
        endMission(S, 'fail', 'bomb', ev);
        return;
      }
    }
    // 爆弾を見つける（警官の目から 10m 以内で見通せる）。見つけた爆弾は AI の隊員も解除しに行く
    if (m.mission === 'bomb' && S.t % 15 === 7) {
      for (const b of m.bombs) {
        if (b.done || b.found) continue;
        for (const a of S.actors) {
          if (a.kind !== 'swat' || !a.alive || a.down || Math.abs(a.y - b.y) > 2) continue;
          if (Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.z - b.z) > 10) continue;
          const e = eyeOf(S, a);
          if (los(w, e[0], e[1], e[2], b.x, b.y + 0.25, b.z, S.doors)) { b.found = true; ev.push({ e: 'bombfound', id: b.id, by: a.id }); break; }
        }
      }
    }
    // 乱射犯がいる間、時間とともに市民が危ない（乱射犯のAIが撃つ）
    // 全滅
    const team = S.actors.filter(a => a.kind === 'swat');
    if (team.length && team.every(a => !a.alive || a.down)) { endMission(S, 'fail', 'wiped', ev); return; }
    // 人質が全員死んだ
    if (m.mission === 'hostage' && m.hostages.length && m.hostages.every(id => { const h = S.byId[id]; return !h || !h.alive; })) { endMission(S, 'fail', 'hostages', ev); return; }
    // 主目的がそろった（ソフト完了）
    if (!m.softDone && S.t % 15 === 0) {
      const susOK = m.sus.every(id => { const a = S.byId[id]; return !a || !a.alive || a.cuffed || a.down; });
      const civOK = m.civ.concat(m.hostages).every(id => { const a = S.byId[id]; return !a || !a.alive || a.cuffed; });
      const bombOK = m.bombs.every(b => b.done);
      if (susOK && civOK && bombOK) { m.softDone = true; m.softT = S.t; ev.push({ e: 'soft', t: S.t }); }
    }
  },

  onEvents(S, w, evs) {
    const m = S.m;
    for (const e of evs) {
      if (e.e === 'report') m.reportsDone++;
      if (e.e === 'bombdone') { if (m.bombs.every(b => b.done)) evs.push({ e: 'allbombs' }); }
      if (e.e === 'kill' || e.e === 'down' || e.e === 'cuffed' || e.e === 'evidence' || e.e === 'bombdone' || e.e === 'report') m.log.push({ t: S.t, e: e.e, id: e.id, by: e.by, kind: e.kind });
      if (e.e === 'abort' && m.phase === 'play') endMission(S, m.softDone ? 'done' : 'abort', e.why || 'player', evs);
    }
  },
  // ダウン（PvEはなし）
  canDown() { return false; },
};

function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }

export function endMission(S, res, why, ev) {
  const m = S.m;
  if (m.phase !== 'play') return;
  m.phase = 'end'; m.result = res; m.why = why; m.endT = S.t;
  m.score = scoreMission(S);
  if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'end', res, why });
}

// ---- 交戦規定の判定（記録された害から）
export function judgeHarm(S, h) {
  if (h.kind === 'swat') return { ok: false, v: 'ff' };
  const lethal = h.how === 'gun' || h.how === 'blast';
  if (h.kind === 'civ') return { ok: false, v: lethal ? (h.d >= 999 ? 'civkill' : 'civhurt') : 'civforce' };
  // 容疑者
  if (h.cuffed || h.down || h.comply) return { ok: false, v: lethal ? 'kill_unjust' : 'force' };
  if (lethal) {
    if (h.threat) return { ok: true };
    if (h.armed && h.warned >= 2) return { ok: true };
    return { ok: false, v: 'kill_unjust' };
  }
  // 非致死: 従わない（警告済み）か武器を持つ
  if (h.armed || h.warned >= 1) return { ok: true };
  return { ok: false, v: 'force' };
}

// ---- 採点
export function scoreMission(S) {
  const m = S.m;
  const out = { parts: [], total: 0, grade: 'F', viol: [], stats: {} };
  const add = (key, name, got, max, note = '') => { out.parts.push({ key, name, got: Math.round(got * 10) / 10, max, note }); out.total += got; };
  // 容疑者
  const sus = m.sus.map(id => S.byId[id]).filter(Boolean);
  let sv = 0;
  const unjustKilled = new Set();
  for (const h of S.harms) { const j = judgeHarm(S, h); if (!j.ok && (j.v === 'kill_unjust') && S.byId[h.tgt] && !S.byId[h.tgt].alive) unjustKilled.add(h.tgt); }
  for (const a of sus) {
    if (a.alive && a.cuffed && !a.down) sv += 1;
    else if (a.alive && a.cuffed && a.down) sv += 0.7;
    else if (!a.alive) sv += unjustKilled.has(a.id) ? 0 : 0.4;
  }
  add('sus', '容疑者の制圧', sus.length ? 25 * sv / sus.length : 25, 25, `${sus.filter(a => a.alive && a.cuffed).length}人逮捕・${sus.filter(a => !a.alive).length}人死亡`);
  // 市民（人質を含む）
  const civ = m.civ.concat(m.hostages).map(id => S.byId[id]).filter(Boolean);
  let cv = 0;
  for (const a of civ) if (a.alive && a.cuffed) cv += 1; else if (a.alive && a.down) cv += 0.5;
  add('civ', '市民の救出', civ.length ? 25 * cv / civ.length : 25, 25, `${civ.filter(a => a.alive && a.cuffed).length}/${civ.length}人`);
  // 報告: 拘束・死亡・行動不能の人
  const toReport = S.actors.filter(a => (a.kind === 'sus' || a.kind === 'civ' || a.kind === 'swat') && (a.cuffed || !a.alive || a.down) && !(a.kind === 'swat' && a.alive && !a.down));
  const rep = toReport.filter(a => a.reported).length;
  add('report', 'TOCへの報告', toReport.length ? 10 * rep / toReport.length : 10, 10, `${rep}/${toReport.length}`);
  // 証拠: 置かれた物と、容疑者の武器
  const evItems = S.items.filter(it => it.ev);
  const got = evItems.filter(it => it.gone).length;
  add('evidence', '証拠の回収', evItems.length ? 10 * got / evItems.length : 10, 10, `${got}/${evItems.length}`);
  // 作戦ごと
  let spc = 10, note = '';
  if (m.mission === 'bomb') { const d = m.bombs.filter(b => b.done).length; spc = m.bombs.length ? 10 * d / m.bombs.length : 10; note = `爆弾 ${d}/${m.bombs.length} 解除`; }
  else if (m.mission === 'hostage') { const hs = m.hostages.map(id => S.byId[id]).filter(Boolean); const ok = hs.filter(h => h.alive).length; spc = hs.length ? 10 * ok / hs.length : 10; note = `人質 ${ok}/${hs.length} 生存`; }
  else if (m.mission === 'active') { const t = sec(S, m.startT); spc = t < 180 ? 10 : t < 420 ? 10 - (t - 180) / 48 : 5; note = `${Math.floor(t / 60)}分${Math.floor(t % 60)}秒`; const dead = civ.filter(a => !a.alive).length; spc = Math.max(0, spc - dead * 2); }
  else if (m.mission === 'raid') { spc = evItems.length ? 10 * got / evItems.length : 10; note = '証拠の確保'; }
  else { const hurt = civ.filter(a => a.hp < a.maxHp).length; spc = Math.max(0, 10 - hurt * 3); note = hurt ? `負傷した市民 ${hurt}人` : '市民に負傷者なし'; }
  add('mission', '作戦の目標', spc, 10, note);
  // 隊員の安全

    rescued: civ.filter(a => a.alive && a.cuffed).length, civTotal: civ.length, civDead: civ.filter(a => !a.alive).length,
  };

      }
      if (d && d.disabled) return roundWin(S, w, ev, m.def, 'disable');
      if (any[m.def] === 0 || alive[m.def] === 0) { if (alive[m.def] === 0 && any[m.def] > 0) { for (const a of S.actors) if (a.team === m.def && a.alive) a.dbno = 0.01; } return roundWin(S, w, ev, m.att, 'elim'); }
      if (alive[m.att] === 0 && !(d && d.planted)) return roundWin(S, w, ev, m.def, 'elim');
      if (m.phase === 'action' && el >= m.roundTime && !(d && d.planted)) return roundWin(S, w, ev, m.def, 'time');
    },
    onEvents(S, w, evs) {
      const m = S.m;
      for (const e of evs) {
        if (e.e === 'kill') {
          const v = S.byId[e.id], k = S.byId[e.by];
          if (v && !v.isDrone) { v.stats.d++; if (k && k.team !== v.team) { k.stats.k++; if (kind === 'tdm') m.score[k.team]++; } else if (kind === 'tdm' && k && k.team === v.team && k !== v) m.score[1 - k.team]++; for (const as of (e.as || [])) { const x = S.byId[as]; if (x && x.team !== v.team) x.stats.a++; } }
          if (kind === 'tdm' && v && !v.isDrone) m.respawn.push({ id: v.id, at: S.t + Math.round(4 / S.dt) });
          // 解除装置を落とす
          if (v && v.carry === 'defuser') { v.carry = null; S.items.push({ id: S.nextItem++, kind: 'defuser', x: v.x, y: v.y + 0.02, z: v.z }); evs.push({ e: 'defdrop', id: v.id }); }

        }
        if (e.e === 'plant') { m.defuser.t = 0; }
      }
    },
    canDown(S, a) {
      if (!S.rules.dbno) return false;
      if (a.dbnoCount >= 1) return false;

      const mates = S.actors.filter(b => !b.isDrone && b.team === a.team && b !== a && b.alive && !b.down);
      if (!mates.length && !(S.m.defuser && S.m.defuser.planted && a.team === S.m.att)) return false;

    },
    stepDrone(S, w, a, inp, dt, ev) { stepDrone(S, w, a, inp, dt, ev); },
  };

// ---- ラウンド
function startRound(S, w, first) {
  const m = S.m, def = MAPS[S.map];
  // 世界を元に戻す
  if (!first) {
    for (let q = 0; q < w.blocks.length; q++) { w.blocks[q] = w.blocks0[q]; }
    for (let q = 0; q < w.bhp.length; q++) w.bhp[q] = 0;
    S.bdiff = {};
    S.doors = makeDoorStates(w);
    S.items.length = 0; S.nades.length = 0; S.clouds.length = 0; S.blasts.length = 0; S.bullets.length = 0; S.mines = [];
    S.reinf = {};
    S.actors = S.actors.filter(a => !a.isDrone);
  }
  // 対戦では扉に鍵はかけない（R6 と同じ。ふさぐのはバリケード・補強で）
  for (const ds of S.doors) { ds.locked = false; ds.lockBroken = false; }
  m.phase = 'pre'; m.phaseT = S.t; m.defuser = { planted: false, disabled: false, t: 0 }; m.intel = {}; m.target = null;
  m.reinfLeft = Math.min(10, 2 * S.actors.filter(a => a.team === m.def).length);
  // 陣営の見た目: 攻撃側（またはチーム0）が SWAT
  const sideOf = (t) => m.kind === 'bomb' ? (t === m.att ? 'swat' : 'sus') : ((t === 0) !== !!m.swapped ? 'swat' : 'sus');
  const spawnA = (def.spawn.pvp && def.spawn.pvp.a) || def.spawn.swat.map(s => [s.x, s.z, s.L || 0]);
  const spawnB = (def.spawn.pvp && def.spawn.pvp.b) || (def.spawn.sus || []);
  const used = new Set();
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    const side = sideOf(a.team);
    a.pvpSide = side; a._lookV = (a._lookV || 0) + 1;
    const list = (side === 'swat') ? spawnA : spawnB;
    let pt = null;
    for (let tries = 0; tries < list.length; tries++) { const c = list[(a.slotIdx + tries * 3 + (m.round * 5)) % list.length]; const key = c.join(','); if (!used.has(key)) { used.add(key); pt = c; break; } }
    if (!pt) pt = list[a.slotIdx % list.length];
    resetFighter(S, w, a, pt, side);
  }
  // 解除装置: 攻撃側のひとり
  if (m.kind === 'bomb') {
    const att = S.actors.filter(a => a.team === m.att);
    const carrier = att.find(a => a.pid != null) || att[0];
    if (carrier) carrier.carry = 'defuser';
  }
}
function resetFighter(S, w, a, pt, side) {
  const [x, z, L = 0] = pt;
  const p = cellPos(w, x, z, L);
  a.x = p.x + (hrand(a.id, S.t, 1) - 0.5) * 0.4; a.z = p.z + (hrand(a.id, S.t, 2) - 0.5) * 0.4; a.y = p.y;
  a.spawnAt = [a.x, a.z];
  a.vx = a.vz = a.vy = 0; a.alive = true; a.dead = false; a.down = false; a.dbno = 0; a.dbnoCount = 0; a.cuffed = false; a.comply = 0;
  a.stun = a.flash = a.gas = a.tased = a.deaf = a.supp = a.bleed = 0; a.flinch = 0; a.act = null; a.carry = null; a.st = 0; a.stance = 0; a.vault = null;
  a.inj = { arm: 0, leg: 0, head: 0 };
  const A = PVP_ARMOR[a.pvpArmor] || PVP_ARMOR.medium;
  a.hp = a.maxHp = A.hp;
  const lo = Object.assign({}, PVP_LOADOUTS[side], a.pvpLo && a.pvpLo[side] ? a.pvpLo[side] : {});
  a.inv = makeInventory({ primary: lo.primary, secondary: lo.secondary, gear: lo.gear, long: 'none' });
  a.armor = makeArmor({ vest: 'heavy', plate: 'kevlar', helmet: A.hp >= 110 ? 'helmet' : 'none' });

  a.yaw = Math.atan2(c[0] - a.x, c[1] - a.z); a.pitch = 0;
  a.spawnProt = 2; a.stateT = 0; a.dmgBy = {};
  if (a.ai) { const keep = { type: a.ai.type, slot: a.ai.slot }; a.ai = { ...keep, st: 'idle' }; }
}
function roundWin(S, w, ev, team, why) {
  const m = S.m;
  if (m.phase === 'post') return;
  m.phase = 'post'; m.phaseT = S.t; m.lastWin = team; m.lastWhy = why;
  if (team >= 0) m.wins[team]++;
  ev.push({ e: 'round', win: team, why, wins: m.wins.slice(), round: m.round });
  // MVP: このラウンドのキル
  if (m.wins[0] >= m.winsNeeded || m.wins[1] >= m.winsNeeded) { m.over = true; m.winner = m.wins[0] >= m.winsNeeded ? 0 : 1; ev.push({ e: 'matchend', win: m.winner }); }
}
function nextRound(S, w, ev) {
  const m = S.m;
  m.round++;
  const W = m.winsNeeded;
  if (m.kind === 'bomb') {
    // 攻守交代: (勝利数−1) ラウンドのあと、延長（両方 W−1）では毎ラウンド
    const ot = m.wins[0] === W - 1 && m.wins[1] === W - 1;
    if (m.round === W || (ot && m.round > W)) { const t = m.att; m.att = m.def; m.def = t; ev.push({ e: 'swap' }); }
  } else {
    if (m.round === W) { m.swapped = !m.swapped; ev.push({ e: 'swap' }); }
  }
  startRound(S, w, false);
  ev.push({ e: 'roundstart', round: m.round });
}
// ---- TDM（リスポーンあり）
function stepTdm(S, w, dt, ev, el) {
  const m = S.m;
  if (m.phase !== 'action') return;
  // 復活
  for (let i = m.respawn.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const r = m.respawn[i];
    if (S.t < r.at) continue;
    m.respawn.splice(i, 1);
    const a = S.byId[r.id];
    if (!a) continue;
    const pt = pickSpawn(S, w, a);
    resetFighter(S, w, a, pt, a.pvpSide);
    ev.push({ e: 'respawn', id: a.id });
  }
  if (m.score[0] >= m.limit || m.score[1] >= m.limit || el >= m.timeLimit) {
    m.over = true; m.winner = m.score[0] > m.score[1] ? 0 : m.score[1] > m.score[0] ? 1 : -1;
    ev.push({ e: 'matchend', win: m.winner });
  }
}
// 敵から遠く、見られていない、味方に近い所
function pickSpawn(S, w, a) {
  // w: 世界
  const def = MAPS[S.map];
  const pts = [].concat(def.spawn.pvp ? def.spawn.pvp.a : [], def.spawn.pvp ? def.spawn.pvp.b : [], def.spawn.tdm || []);
  let best = pts[0], bs = -1e9;
  pts.forEach((p, i) => {
    const x = p[0] * CS, z = p[1] * CS, y = (p[2] || 0) * LH + 1.6;
    let minE = 1e9, mate = 1e9, seen = 0;
    for (const b of S.actors) {
      if (b.isDrone || !b.alive || b === a) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(b.x - x, b.z - z);
      if (b.team !== a.team) { minE = Math.min(minE, d); if (d < 30 && los(w, x, y, z, b.x, b.y + 1.5, b.z, S.doors)) seen++; }
      else mate = Math.min(mate, d);
    }
    const s = Math.min(minE, 40) - seen * 30 - Math.max(0, mate - 15) * 0.3 + hrand(a.id, S.t, i) * 6;
    if (s > bs) { bs = s; best = p; }
  });
  return best;
}

// ---- ドローン（準備中の偵察）
export function deployDrone(S, w, a, ev) {
  const m = S.m;
  if (!m || m.kind !== 'bomb' || a.team !== m.att || a.dronesLeft === 0) return null;
  if (a.dronesLeft == null) a.dronesLeft = 2;
  a.dronesLeft--;
  const d = createActor(S, { kind: 'drone', team: a.team, pid: a.pid, x: a.x + Math.sin(a.yaw) * 0.6, y: a.y, z: a.z + Math.cos(a.yaw) * 0.6, yaw: a.yaw, hp: 1 });
  d.isDrone = true; d.owner = a.id; d.h = 0.2; d.jumpT = 0;
  S.byId[d.id] = d;
  a.drone = d.id;
  ev.push({ e: 'drone', id: d.id, owner: a.id });
  return d;
}
function killDroneQuiet(S, d) { d.alive = false; d.dead = true; }
function stepDrone(S, w, d, inp, dt, ev) {
  if (!d.alive) return;
  inp = inp || {};
  d.yaw = inp.yaw ?? d.yaw; d.pitch = Math.max(-0.6, Math.min(0.6, inp.pitch ?? d.pitch));
  const sp = 2.6;
  const sy = Math.sin(d.yaw), cy = Math.cos(d.yaw);
  const vx = (sy * (inp.mz || 0) - cy * (inp.mx || 0)) * sp, vz = (cy * (inp.mz || 0) + sy * (inp.mx || 0)) * sp;
  d.x += vx * dt; d.z += vz * dt;
  const out = [0, 0, 0];
  // 小さな当たり（床すれすれ）
  import_pushOut(w, d, out, S);
  const g = groundAt(w, d.x, d.z, d.y + 0.3);
  d.jumpT = Math.max(0, (d.jumpT || 0) - dt);
  if (inp.jump && d.jumpT <= 0 && d.y - g < 0.05) { d.vy = 3.2; d.jumpT = 3; }
  d.vy = (d.vy || 0) - 9.8 * dt; d.y += d.vy * dt; if (d.y < g) { d.y = g; d.vy = 0; }
  d.spd = Math.hypot(vx, vz);
  // 見つめた敵を印に
  if (inp.fire) {
    for (const b of S.actors) {
      if (b.isDrone || b.team === d.team || !b.alive) continue;
      const dx = b.x - d.x, dz = b.z - d.z, dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (dist > 25) continue;
      const ang = Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dx, dz) - d.yaw), Math.cos(Math.atan2(dx, dz) - d.yaw)));
      if (ang > 0.2) continue;
      if (!los(w, d.x, d.y + 0.12, d.z, b.x, b.y + 1.2, b.z, S.doors)) continue;
      if (!b.spot || b.spot < 4) ev.push({ e: 'spotted', id: b.id, by: d.owner });
      b.spot = 6; b.spotTeam = d.team;
    }
  }
}
function import_pushOut(w, d, out, S) {
  pushOut(w, d.x, d.z, d.y + 0.02, d.y + 0.18, 0.14, S.doors, -1, out);
  if (out[2]) { d.x += out[0]; d.z += out[1]; }
}

// 人を置く道具（モードが使う）
import { createActor } from '../actor.js';
import { rnd, rndPick } from '../rng.js';
import { SUSPECTS, CIVILIANS, LOADOUTS } from '../data/npc.js';
import { CS, LH, groundAt, nearestFloor } from '../world.js';

export function cellPos(w, x, z, L = 0) {
  const p = nearestFloor(w, L, x * CS, z * CS, 4) || [x * CS, z * CS];
  return { x: p[0], z: p[1], y: groundAt(w, p[0], p[1], L * LH + 0.4) };
}
function pickWeighted(r, list) {
  let sum = 0; for (const [, wt] of list) sum += wt;
  let x = rnd(r) * sum;
  for (const [v, wt] of list) { x -= wt; if (x <= 0) return v; }
  return list[0][0];
}
// 人と重ならない所（出現の位置が家具や車で詰められて、隣の人と重なるとき）
function apartFrom(S, w, p, L, gap = 0.8) {
  const near = (x, z) => S.actors.some(b => !b.isDrone && Math.abs(b.y - p.y) < 1.5 && Math.hypot(b.x - x, b.z - z) < gap);
  if (!near(p.x, p.z)) return p;
  for (let r = 1; r <= 8; r++) for (let dj = -r; dj <= r; dj++) for (let di = -r; di <= r; di++) {
    if (Math.max(Math.abs(di), Math.abs(dj)) !== r) continue;
    const x = p.x + di * CS, z = p.z + dj * CS;
    const q = nearestFloor(w, L, x, z, 0.3);
    if (!q || Math.hypot(q[0] - x, q[1] - z) > 0.05 || near(q[0], q[1])) continue;
    return { x: q[0], z: q[1], y: groundAt(w, q[0], q[1], L * LH + 0.4) };
  }
  return p;
}
export function spawnSwat(S, w, o) {

}
