// 移動: RoN の速さ（歩き2.4・ゆっくり0.96・しゃがみ1.2）、しゃがみ・伏せ・リーン・乗り越え・階段・PvPのダッシュ
import { groundAt, pushOut, raycast, STEP, CS, LH, levelOfY, cellType, C, leafEnd } from './world.js';
import { OPEN_ANG, isOpen } from './doors.js';
import { KNEEL_ACT } from './data/acts.js';
import { curW, bodyHeight } from './actor.js';
import { PLATE, LONG } from './data/equipment.js';
import { FLOORS } from './data/materials.js';

export const SPEED = { walk: 2.4, crouch: 1.2, prone: 0.45, low: 1.2, ads: 0.7, sprint: 4.6, back: 0.8, side: 0.9 };
export const RADIUS = 0.28;
const _po = [0, 0, 0];
const _rc = { out: [], seenProp: new Set(), seenDoor: new Set() };

// PvPの防具の重さ（R6の3段階）
export const PVP_ARMOR = { light: { hp: 100, speed: 1.08 }, medium: { hp: 110, speed: 1.0 }, heavy: { hp: 125, speed: 0.9 } };

export function maxSpeed(S, a, inp) {
  const st = Math.round(a.st);
  let v = st === 0 ? SPEED.walk : st === 1 ? SPEED.crouch : SPEED.prone;
  const W = curW(a);
  if (W) v *= W.move;
  if (a.inv.long && LONG[a.inv.long] && LONG[a.inv.long].move) v *= LONG[a.inv.long].move;
  if (a.lowOn && a.ads < 0.2 && st < 2) v *= 1 + (SPEED.low - 1) * a.low;
  if (a.ads > 0.3) v *= 1 - (1 - SPEED.ads) * a.ads;
  if (a.sprint) v = SPEED.sprint * (W ? Math.min(1, W.move + 0.03) : 1);
  if (S.pvp) v *= (PVP_ARMOR[a.pvpArmor || 'medium'] || PVP_ARMOR.medium).speed;
  else { const P = PLATE[a.armor.plate]; if (P && a.armor.vest !== 'none') v *= P.speed; }
  v *= 1 - 0.025 * Math.min(4, a.inj.leg);
  if (a.bleed > 0) v *= 0.8;
  if (a.stun > 0 || a.flash > 0.5) v *= 0.45;
  if (a.gas > 0 && !(a.armor.head === 'gasmask')) v *= 0.7;
  if (a.comply === 1) v = Math.min(v, 0.9);
  if (a.comply === 2 || a.cuffed || a.down || a.dead || a.tased > 0) v = a.down && S.pvp && a.dbno ? 0.35 : 0;
  if (a.act && a.act.still) v = 0;
  return v;
}

function accelOf(S, a) {
  let ac = 7.0;
  if (!S.pvp && a.armor.vest !== 'none') { const P = PLATE[a.armor.plate]; const n = a.armor.vest === 'heavy' ? 2 : 1; ac *= 1 - (P ? P.accel : 0) * n * 0.6; }
  return ac;
}

// 1人を1ステップ動かす。inp: {mx,mz,yaw,pitch,stance,lean,sprint}
export function moveActor(S, w, a, inp, dt, ev) {
  if (!a.alive && !a.dead) return;
  // 向き（死んでいたら動かない）
  if (!a.dead && !a.tased && !(a.down && !S.pvp)) {
    a.yaw = inp.yaw; a.pitch = Math.max(-1.45, Math.min(1.45, inp.pitch));
  }
  if (a.dead) { settle(S, w, a, dt); a.stateT += dt; return; }
  // 姿勢
  let want = inp.stance | 0;
  // ひざをついて行う動作（拘束・ピッキング・解除・拾うなど）の間はしゃがむ
  if (a.act && KNEEL_ACT.has(a.act.k) && want < 1) want = 1;
  if (a.peek && want < 1) want = 1;
  if (a.down || a.cuffed || a.comply === 2) want = 0;
  if (a.sprint && want) a.sprint = false;
  const rate = (a.st < 1 && want <= 1) || (a.st <= 1 && want === 0) ? 4.0 : 1.25;
  if (want !== Math.round(a.st) || Math.abs(a.st - want) > 1e-3) {
    // 立ち上がる前に頭がつかえないか
    const target = want;
    if (target < a.st) {
      const hNew = target < 1 ? 1.8 - 0.6 * target : 1.2 - 0.7 * (target - 1);
      pushOut(w, a.x, a.z, a.y + STEP, a.y + hNew, RADIUS - 0.02, S.doors, -1, _po);
      if (_po[2] && (Math.abs(_po[0]) + Math.abs(_po[1])) > 0.12) want = Math.round(a.st);
    }
    const d = want - a.st, stp = rate * dt;
    a.st = Math.abs(d) <= stp ? want : a.st + Math.sign(d) * stp;
  }
  a.stance = want;
  // リーン（壁にめり込まない）
  let lw = inp.lean || 0;
  if (a.sprint || a.st > 1.3 || a.vault || a.down || a.comply || a.cuffed) lw = 0;
  if (lw) {
    const rx = -Math.cos(a.yaw) * lw, rz = Math.sin(a.yaw) * lw;
    const hy = a.y + bodyHeight(a) - 0.25;
    const hits = raycast(w, a.x, hy, a.z, rx, 0, rz, 0.65, S.doors, _rc);
    let lim = 1;
    for (const h of hits) { if (h.kind === 'prop' && h.t0 > 0.6) continue; lim = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (h.t0 - 0.22) / 0.36)); break; }
    lw *= lim;
  }
  const ld = lw - a.lean, ls = 4.2 * dt;
  a.lean = Math.abs(ld) <= ls ? lw : a.lean + Math.sign(ld) * ls;
  // 乗り越え中
  if (a.vault) { stepVault(S, w, a, dt); a.stateT += dt; return; }
  // 速さ
  let mx = inp.mx || 0, mz = inp.mz || 0;
  let mag = Math.hypot(mx, mz); if (mag > 1) { mx /= mag; mz /= mag; mag = 1; }
  // ダッシュ（PvPだけ。立って前へ）
  a.sprint = !!(S.pvp && inp.sprint && a.st < 0.2 && mz > 0.55 && !a.adsOn && !a.down && !a.act);
  const vmax = maxSpeed(S, a, inp);
  // 後ろ・横は遅い
  let dirMul = 1;
  if (mag > 0.01) { const fz = mz / mag, fx = mx / mag; dirMul = fz >= 0 ? 1 - (1 - SPEED.side) * Math.abs(fx) : SPEED.back + (SPEED.side - SPEED.back) * Math.abs(fx); }
  const tgt = vmax * mag * dirMul;
  // ローカル → 世界（前 = (sin yaw, cos yaw)、右 = (-cos yaw, sin yaw)）
  const sy = Math.sin(a.yaw), cy = Math.cos(a.yaw);
  let dvx = 0, dvz = 0;
  if (mag > 0.01) { const ux = (sy * mz - cy * mx) / mag, uz = (cy * mz + sy * mx) / mag; dvx = ux * tgt; dvz = uz * tgt; }
  const cur = Math.hypot(a.vx, a.vz);
  const ac = (tgt >= cur ? accelOf(S, a) : 10) * dt;
  let ex = dvx - a.vx, ez = dvz - a.vz; const el = Math.hypot(ex, ez);
  if (el > ac) { ex *= ac / el; ez *= ac / el; }
  a.vx += ex; a.vz += ez;
  // 動かす（速いときは2回に分ける）
  const h = bodyHeight(a);
  const n = Math.hypot(a.vx, a.vz) * dt > 0.12 ? 2 : 1;
  const ox = a.x, oz = a.z;
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    a.x += a.vx * dt / n; a.z += a.vz * dt / n;
    for (let it = 0; it < 2; it++) {
      pushOut(w, a.x, a.z, a.y + STEP, a.y + h, RADIUS, S.doors, -1, _po);
      if (!_po[2]) break;
      a.x += _po[0]; a.z += _po[1];
    }
  }
  // 開いている扉の板に体で当たって進もうとしたら、板は押されて回る（RoN と同じく、半開きの扉は体で押し開けられる）
  if (mag > 0.01) pushLeaves(S, w, a, dvx, dvz, dt);
  // 実際に動いた分で速さを直す（壁に沿って滑る）
  // 押し出された分で速くはならない（重なりを直した分が勢いにならないように）
  const mvx = (a.x - ox) / dt, mvz = (a.z - oz) / dt, sp0 = Math.hypot(a.vx, a.vz);
  let nvx = a.vx * 0.3 + mvx * 0.7, nvz = a.vz * 0.3 + mvz * 0.7;
  const sp1 = Math.hypot(nvx, nvz);
  if (sp1 > sp0 && sp1 > 1e-6) { nvx *= sp0 / sp1; nvz *= sp0 / sp1; }
  a.vx = nvx; a.vz = nvz;
  // 足元
  const g = groundAt(w, a.x, a.z, a.y);
  if (g < -50) { a.y -= 9.8 * dt; if (a.y < -20) { a.y = 0; } }
  else if (a.y - g > 0.04) { a.vy -= 9.8 * dt; a.y += a.vy * dt; if (a.y <= g) { if (a.vy < -6.5 && ev) ev.push({ e: 'fall', id: a.id, v: -a.vy }); a.y = g; a.vy = 0; } }
  else { a.y = g; a.vy = 0; }
  a.ground = a.y - g < 0.05;
  // 歩きの位相と足音
  const dist = Math.hypot(a.x - ox, a.z - oz);
  const stepLen = a.sprint ? 0.95 : a.st > 1.5 ? 0.35 : a.st > 0.5 ? 0.55 : 0.72;
  const before = Math.floor(a.phase / Math.PI);
  a.phase += dist * Math.PI / stepLen;
  if (a.phase > 1e4) a.phase -= 2 * Math.PI * 1000;
  const after = Math.floor(a.phase / Math.PI);
  // ローカルの速さ（アニメ用）
  a.mvx = -(mvx * cy - mvz * sy); a.mvz = mvx * sy + mvz * cy;
  a.spd = Math.hypot(mvx, mvz);
  if (after !== before && ev && a.spd > 0.25) {
    const L = levelOfY(a.y + 0.1);
    const i = Math.floor(a.x / CS), j = Math.floor(a.z / CS);
    const fm = (L < w.NL && i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < w.W && j < w.D) ? w.floorMat[w.idx(L, i, j)] : 0;
    const F = FLOORS[fm] || FLOORS[1];
    // 音の大きさ: 速さ・姿勢・床・防具（重いと大きい）
    let loud = (a.sprint ? 1.6 : a.spd > 1.8 ? 1.0 : a.spd > 0.9 ? 0.6 : 0.3) * F.loud * (a.st > 0.5 ? 0.6 : 1);
    if (!S.pvp && a.armor.vest === 'heavy') loud *= 1.15;
    ev.push({ e: 'step', id: a.id, x: a.x, y: a.y, z: a.z, f: F.step, loud, foot: after & 1 });
  }
  a.stateT += dt;
}

// 死体が床に落ち着く（階段など）
function settle(S, w, a, dt) {
  const g = groundAt(w, a.x, a.z, a.y + 0.2);
  if (g > -50) { if (a.y > g + 0.02) { a.vy -= 9.8 * dt; a.y = Math.max(g, a.y + a.vy * dt); } else { a.y = g; a.vy = 0; } }
}

// 乗り越え: 前に低い物（0.45〜1.25m）があり、向こうに降りられるとき
export function tryVault(S, w, a) {
  if (a.vault || a.st > 1.2 || a.down || a.comply || a.cuffed || !a.ground) return false;
  const fx = Math.sin(a.yaw), fz = Math.cos(a.yaw);
  // 前に物があるか（腰の高さ）
  const hitAt = (hh, dist) => { const hs = raycast(w, a.x, a.y + hh, a.z, fx, 0, fz, dist, S.doors, _rc); for (const x of hs) { if (x.kind === 'slab' || x.kind === 'stair') continue; return x; } return null; };
  const low = hitAt(0.5, 1.0);
  if (!low) return false;
  // てっぺんを探す
  let top = -1;
  for (let hh = 0.55; hh <= 1.35; hh += 0.1) { if (!hitAt(hh, low.t0 + 0.6)) { top = hh; break; } }
  if (top < 0 || top > 1.3) return false;
  // 越えた先（物の奥行きぶん進む）
  let far = -1;
  for (let d = low.t0 + 0.4; d <= low.t0 + 1.8; d += 0.1) {
    const x = a.x + fx * d, z = a.z + fz * d;
    const g = groundAt(w, x, z, a.y + 0.3);
    if (g < a.y - 1.2 || g > a.y + 0.4) continue;
    pushOut(w, x, z, g + STEP, g + 1.1, RADIUS, S.doors, -1, _po);
    if (!_po[2]) { far = d; break; }
  }
  if (far < 0) return false;
  // 上に頭がつかえないか（窓の上の壁）: 越える高さ + 0.9m まで空いている
  const clear = hitAt(Math.min(2.0, top + 0.75), low.t0 + 0.4);
  if (clear && top + 0.75 < 1.9) { /* 低い開口: しゃがんで越える */ }
  a.vault = { t: 0, dur: 0.55 + top * 0.25, x0: a.x, z0: a.z, y0: a.y, x1: a.x + fx * (far + 0.05), z1: a.z + fz * (far + 0.05), top: a.y + top, y1: groundAt(w, a.x + fx * far, a.z + fz * far, a.y + 0.3) };
  a.vx = a.vz = 0;
  return true;
}
function stepVault(S, w, a, dt) {
  const v = a.vault;
  v.t += dt;
  const u = Math.min(1, v.t / v.dur);
  const e = u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
  a.x = v.x0 + (v.x1 - v.x0) * e; a.z = v.z0 + (v.z1 - v.z0) * e;
  // 弧: 物の上を越える
  const arc = Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, u * 1.15));
  a.y = v.y0 + (v.y1 - v.y0) * e + Math.max(0, (v.top - Math.max(v.y0, v.y1)) + 0.15) * arc;
  a.st = Math.max(a.st, 0.55 * arc);
  if (u >= 1) { a.y = v.y1; a.vault = null; a.st = Math.min(a.st, a.stance); }
}

// 人どうしの押し合い
export function separateActors(S, w) {
  const A = S.actors;
  for (let i = 0; i < A.length; i++) {
    const a = A[i]; if (a.dead || a.vault || a.isDrone) continue;
    for (let j = i + 1; j < A.length; j++) {
      const b = A[j]; if (b.dead || b.vault || b.isDrone) continue;
      if (Math.abs(a.y - b.y) > 1.4) continue;
      const dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.z - a.z, d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz, R = RADIUS * 2 - 0.04;
      if (d2 >= R * R || d2 < 1e-8) continue;
      const d = Math.sqrt(d2), o = (R - d);
      const ha = a.down || a.cuffed || a.comply === 2 ? 0.1 : 1, hb = b.down || b.cuffed || b.comply === 2 ? 0.1 : 1;
      const sa = ha / (ha + hb), sb = hb / (ha + hb);
      a.x -= dx / d * o * sa; a.z -= dz / d * o * sa; b.x += dx / d * o * sb; b.z += dz / d * o * sb;
      for (const c of [a, b]) {
        pushOut(w, c.x, c.z, c.y + STEP, c.y + bodyHeight(c), RADIUS, S.doors, -1, _po);
        if (_po[2]) { c.x += _po[0]; c.z += _po[1]; }
      }
    }
  }
}

// 体で扉の板を押す: 閉じた扉（掛け金がかかっている）は押せない。板は押す速さに合わせて、蝶番を中心に体から離れる向きへ回る
function pushLeaves(S, w, a, vx, vz, dt) {
  const L = levelOfY(a.y + 0.3);
  const k = w.idx(L, Math.floor(a.x / CS), Math.floor(a.z / CS));
  const dn = w.doorNear.get(k);
  if (!dn) return;
  for (const did of dn) {
    const d = w.doors[did], ds = S.doors[did];
    if (!ds || ds.broken || ds.bar > 0 || d.L !== L) continue;
    for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) {
      const ang = ds.ang[li];
      if (Math.abs(ang) < 0.05 || ds.tgt[li] !== ang) continue; // 閉じている・動いている最中
      const lf = d.leaves[li], [ex, ez] = leafEnd(lf, ang);
      const lx = ex - lf.hx, lz = ez - lf.hz, len = Math.hypot(lx, lz) || 1, ux = lx / len, uz = lz / len;
      const t = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1, ((a.x - lf.hx) * ux + (a.z - lf.hz) * uz) / len));
      const cx = lf.hx + ux * len * t, cz = lf.hz + uz * len * t;
      if (Math.hypot(a.x - cx, a.z - cz) > RADIUS + 0.08) continue;
      const nx = -uz, nz = ux, side = Math.sign((a.x - lf.hx) * nx + (a.z - lf.hz) * nz) || 1;
      const push = -(vx * nx + vz * nz) * side;
      if (push < 0.1) continue;
      // どちらへ回すと当たっている所が体から離れるか
      const [ex2, ez2] = leafEnd(lf, ang + 0.01);
      const mx = (lf.hx + (ex2 - lf.hx) * t) - cx, mz = (lf.hz + (ez2 - lf.hz) * t) - cz;
      const dir = (mx * nx + mz * nz) * side < 0 ? 1 : -1;
      const om = Math.min(1.6, push / Math.max(0.3, len * t));
      const nxt = Math.max(-OPEN_ANG - 0.05, Math.min(OPEN_ANG + 0.05, ang + dir * om * dt));
      ds.ang[li] = ds.tgt[li] = nxt;
      ds.open = isOpen(ds);
    }
  }
}

// 投げ物と爆発: 閃光・スティンガー・CSガス・罠（破片）・C2・壁用の爆破薬。ガスの雲。
import { raycast, los, CS, LH, levelOfY, NB } from './world.js';
import { hrand } from './rng.js';
import { eyeOf, hurt, killActor, pvpDamage, damageBlock, breakGlass, downActor } from './combat.js';
import { M, MATS } from './data/materials.js';

const _rc = { out: [], seenProp: new Set(), seenDoor: new Set() };

export function throwNade(S, a, type, power, ev) {
  const eye = eyeOf(S, a);
  const cp = Math.cos(a.pitch + 0.12), v = 4 + 9 * Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1, power));
  const dx = Math.sin(a.yaw) * cp, dy = Math.sin(a.pitch + 0.12), dz = Math.cos(a.yaw) * cp;
  const n = { id: S.nextItem++, type, x: eye[0] + dx * 0.3, y: eye[1] - 0.1, z: eye[2] + dz * 0.3, vx: dx * v + a.vx * 0.5, vy: dy * v + 1.2, vz: dz * v + a.vz * 0.5, t: 0, fuse: type === 'cs' ? 1.6 : 1.5, by: a.id, team: a.team, rest: false };
  S.nades.push(n);
  a.throwT = 1;
  ev.push({ e: 'throw', id: a.id, type, n: n.id });
  return n;
}
// M320 の弾: まっすぐ速く飛び、当たったら作動
export function launchNade(S, a, type, ev) {
  const eye = eyeOf(S, a);
  const cp = Math.cos(a.pitch), v = 55;
  const dx = Math.sin(a.yaw) * cp, dy = Math.sin(a.pitch), dz = Math.cos(a.yaw) * cp;
  S.nades.push({ id: S.nextItem++, type, x: eye[0] + dx * 0.5, y: eye[1] - 0.05, z: eye[2] + dz * 0.5, vx: dx * v, vy: dy * v + 1.5, vz: dz * v, t: 0, fuse: 9, impact: true, by: a.id, team: a.team });
  ev.push({ e: 'launch', id: a.id, type });
}

export function stepNades(S, w, dt, ev) {
  for (let i = S.nades.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const n = S.nades[i];
    n.t += dt;
    if (!n.rest) {
      n.vy -= 9.81 * dt;
      const sp = Math.hypot(n.vx, n.vy, n.vz);
      if (sp > 0.05) {
        const L = sp * dt, dx = n.vx / sp, dy = n.vy / sp, dz = n.vz / sp;
        const hits = raycast(w, n.x, n.y, n.z, dx, dy, dz, L + 0.06, S.doors, _rc);
        let h = null;
        for (const x of hits) { const m = MATS[x.mat]; if (x.mat === M.GLASSBROKEN) continue; if (x.mat === M.GLASS) { breakGlass(S, w, x, ev); continue; } h = x; break; }
        if (h) {
          const t = Math.max(0, h.t0 - 0.06);
          n.x += dx * t; n.y += dy * t; n.z += dz * t;
          if (n.impact) { n.t = n.fuse; }
          else {
            // 跳ね返り
            const nx = h.nx || 0, ny = h.ny || 0, nz = h.nz || 0;
            const vd = n.vx * nx + n.vy * ny + n.vz * nz;
            n.vx -= 1.6 * vd * nx; n.vy -= 1.6 * vd * ny; n.vz -= 1.6 * vd * nz;
            n.vx *= 0.45; n.vy *= 0.45; n.vz *= 0.45;
            if (ny > 0.6 && Math.abs(n.vy) < 1.2) { n.vy = 0; n.vx *= 0.6; n.vz *= 0.6; if (Math.hypot(n.vx, n.vz) < 0.3) n.rest = true; }
            ev.push({ e: 'bounce', n: n.id, x: n.x, y: n.y, z: n.z, v: sp });
          }
        } else { n.x += n.vx * dt; n.y += n.vy * dt; n.z += n.vz * dt; }
      }
    }
    if (n.t >= n.fuse) { detonate(S, w, n, ev); S.nades.splice(i, 1); }
  }
}

function detonate(S, w, n, ev) {
  const by = S.byId[n.by];
  ev.push({ e: 'nade', type: n.type, x: n.x, y: n.y, z: n.z, by: n.by });
  if (n.type === 'flash') {
    for (const a of S.actors) {
      if (!a.alive || a.isDrone) continue;
      const eye = eyeOf(S, a);
      const dx = n.x - eye[0], dy = n.y - eye[1], dz = n.z - eye[2], d = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
      if (d > 12) continue;
      const see = los(w, eye[0], eye[1], eye[2], n.x, n.y + 0.05, n.z, S.doors);
      // 見ている向き
      const cp = Math.cos(a.pitch), fx = Math.sin(a.yaw) * cp, fy = Math.sin(a.pitch), fz = Math.cos(a.yaw) * cp;
      const facing = (dx * fx + dy * fy + dz * fz) / Math.max(0.01, d);
      let k = (1 - d / 12) * (see ? (facing > 0.3 ? 1 : facing > -0.3 ? 0.65 : 0.35) : (d < 3 ? 0.25 : 0));
      if (a.armor && a.armor.head === 'goggles') k *= 0.4;
      if (k <= 0.02) { if (d < 8) a.deaf = Math.max(a.deaf, 1.5); continue; }
      a.flash = Math.max(a.flash, 0.8 + 4.5 * k);
      a.deaf = Math.max(a.deaf, 2 + 4 * k);
      if (a.ai) { a.stun = Math.max(a.stun, 1.5 + 4 * k); if (a.ai.morale != null) a.ai.morale -= 0.4 * k + 0.1; }
      ev.push({ e: 'flashed', id: a.id, k });
    }
  } else if (n.type === 'stinger') {
    for (const a of S.actors) {
      if (!a.alive || a.isDrone) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(a.x - n.x, a.y + 1 - n.y, a.z - n.z);
      if (d > 5.5) continue;
      if (!los(w, n.x, n.y + 0.1, n.z, a.x, a.y + 1.0, a.z, S.doors)) continue;
      const k = 1 - d / 5.5;
      a.stun = Math.max(a.stun, (a.ai ? 1.5 : 0.6) + 2.5 * k);
      a.deaf = Math.max(a.deaf, 1.5);
      if (a.ai && a.ai.morale != null) a.ai.morale -= 0.25 + 0.25 * k;
      const dmg = 3 + 7 * k;
      if (S.pvp) pvpDamage(S, a, dmg, by, 'chest', a.x - n.x, a.z - n.z, ev, 'stinger');
      else hurt(S, w, a, dmg, 'chest', by, null, a.x - n.x, a.z - n.z, ev, 'less');
      ev.push({ e: 'stung', id: a.id, k });
      if (by && !S.pvp) S.harms.push({ t: S.t, by: by.id, tgt: a.id, how: 'less', d: dmg, part: 'chest', kind: a.kind, threat: a.ai ? (S.t - (a.ai.threatT ?? -1e9)) * S.dt < 2 : false, warned: a.ai ? a.ai.warned || 0 : 0, armed: !!(a.inv.w[0] || a.inv.w[1]), comply: a.comply, cuffed: a.cuffed, down: a.down });
    }
  } else if (n.type === 'cs') {
    S.clouds.push({ x: n.x, y: n.y, z: n.z, r: 0.5, max: 4.6, t: 20, type: 'cs', L: levelOfY(n.y) });
  } else if (n.type === 'frag') {
    S.blasts.push({ x: n.x, y: n.y + 0.2, z: n.z, r: 5, dmg: 150, kind: 'frag', by: n.by, t: 0 });
  }
}

// ガスの雲: 広がって薄れる。中の人（マスクなし）に効く
export function stepClouds(S, w, dt, ev) {
  for (let i = S.clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const c = S.clouds[i];
    c.t -= dt;
    c.r = Math.min(c.max, c.r + dt * 1.6);
    if (c.t <= 0) { S.clouds.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    if (S.t % 6 !== 0) continue;
    for (const a of S.actors) {
      if (!a.alive || a.isDrone) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(a.x - c.x, (a.y + 1.4) - c.y, a.z - c.z);
      if (d > c.r) continue;
      if (a.armor && a.armor.head === 'gasmask') continue;
      // 壁の向こうには届かない
      if (!los(w, c.x, c.y + 0.2, c.z, a.x, a.y + 1.4, a.z, S.doors)) continue;
      const k = c.type === 'pepper' ? 0.6 : 1;
      a.gas = Math.max(a.gas, 4 * k);
      if (a.ai) { if (a.ai.morale != null) a.ai.morale -= 0.05 * k; a.ai.gasCough = 1; }
    }
  }
}

export function stepBlasts(S, w, dt, ev) {

    const b = S.blasts[i];
    b.t -= dt;
    if (b.t > 0) continue;

    const by = S.byId[b.by];
    if (b.kind !== 'c2') ev.push({ e: 'boom', x: b.x, y: b.y, z: b.z, kind: b.kind, r: b.r });

      const k = Math.pow(1 - d / b.r, 1.3);

(S.t - (a.ai.threatT ?? -1e9)) * S.dt < 2 : false, warned: a.ai ? a.ai.warned || 0 : 0, armed: !!(a.inv.w[0] || a.inv.w[1]), comply: a.comply, cuffed: a.cuffed, down: a.down });
      }
      if (a.ai && a.ai.morale != null) a.ai.morale -= 0.4 * k;
    }
    // 壁（石膏・木）を壊す

        }

// 人の骨の位置（手続きアニメ）。当たり判定（エンジン）と描画（レンダラー）で同じものを使う。
// 体の向き: ローカルで +Z が前、+Y が上、+X が左。世界へは yaw で回す（前 = (sin yaw, 0, cos yaw)）。
// 関節の位置を直接決め（足と腕は2本の骨のIK）、骨の向きは「始点→終点」と前向きのヒントから作る。
export const BONES = ['pelvis', 'spine', 'chest', 'neck', 'head', 'uarmL', 'farmL', 'handL', 'uarmR', 'farmR', 'handR', 'thighL', 'shinL', 'footL', 'thighR', 'shinR', 'footR'];
export const NBONE = BONES.length;
export const BI = Object.fromEntries(BONES.map((b, i) => [b, i]));

// 当たりのカプセル: [骨, 始点の比率(骨の長さに対して), 終点の比率, 半径, 部位]
export const HITCAPS = [

  ['neck', 0.0, 1.0, 0.06, 'neck'],

  ['uarmR', 0.05, 0.95, 0.055, 'arm'], ['farmR', 0.0, 0.95, 0.045, 'arm'],
  ['thighL', 0.0, 1.0, 0.075, 'leg'], ['shinL', 0.0, 1.0, 0.055, 'leg'],

];

// ---- 小さなベクトルの道具（配列 [x,y,z]）----
const v3 = (x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) => [x, y, z];
const add = (a, b) => [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]];
const sub = (a, b) => [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]];
const mul = (a, s) => [a[0] * s, a[1] * s, a[2] * s];
const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
const cross = (a, b) => [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]];
const len = (a) => Math.hypot(a[0], a[1], a[2]);
const norm = (a) => { const l = len(a) || 1; return [a[0] / l, a[1] / l, a[2] / l]; };
const madd = (a, b, s) => [a[0] + b[0] * s, a[1] + b[1] * s, a[2] + b[2] * s];
const lerp3 = (a, b, t) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t];
const clamp = (v, a, b) => v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v;
const sm = (t) => { t = clamp(t, 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
// 軸まわりの回転（ロドリゲス）
function rotAxis(v, ax, ang) {
  const c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang), d = dot(ax, v), cr = cross(ax, v);
  return [v[0] * c + cr[0] * s + ax[0] * d * (1 - c), v[1] * c + cr[1] * s + ax[1] * d * (1 - c), v[2] * c + cr[2] * s + ax[2] * d * (1 - c)];
}
// 2本の骨のIK: 根元 a から目標 t へ、長さ l1, l2。曲がる向きのヒント pole。戻り値: 中間の関節
function ik2(a, t, l1, l2, pole) {
  let d = sub(t, a); let L = len(d);
  const maxL = (l1 + l2) * 0.999;
  if (L > maxL) { d = mul(d, maxL / L); L = maxL; }
  if (L < 1e-4) L = 1e-4;
  const dn = mul(d, 1 / L);
  // 余弦定理
  const x = (l1 * l1 - l2 * l2 + L * L) / (2 * L);
  const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, l1 * l1 - x * x));
  let p = sub(pole, mul(dn, dot(pole, dn)));
  if (len(p) < 1e-5) p = Math.abs(dn[1]) < 0.9 ? [0, 1, 0] : [1, 0, 0];
  p = norm(p);
  return add(a, add(mul(dn, x), mul(p, h)));
}

// 骨の枠: 位置(3) + 列 X(3) Y(3) Z(3) = 12
function frame(out, i, start, end, hint) {
  let y = sub(end, start); const L = len(y) || 1e-4; y = mul(y, 1 / L);
  let z = sub(hint, mul(y, dot(hint, y)));
  if (len(z) < 1e-5) z = Math.abs(y[1]) < 0.9 ? [0, 1, 0] : [0, 0, 1];
  z = norm(z);
  const x = cross(y, z);
  const o = i * 12;
  out[o] = start[0]; out[o + 1] = start[1]; out[o + 2] = start[2];
  out[o + 3] = x[0]; out[o + 4] = x[1]; out[o + 5] = x[2];
  out[o + 6] = y[0]; out[o + 7] = y[1]; out[o + 8] = y[2];
  out[o + 9] = z[0]; out[o + 10] = z[1]; out[o + 11] = z[2];
  return L;
}

export const DIM = { hip: 0.92, ps: 0.23, sn: 0.33, nh: 0.17, shW: 0.18, shD: -0.035, hipW: 0.09, thigh: 0.44, shin: 0.42, ankle: 0.075, foot: 0.17, uarm: 0.29, farm: 0.26, hand: 0.17, neck: 0.08 };

export const HOLD = {

  smg: { r: [0, -0.04, 0], l: [0.0, -0.035, 0.2], stock: -0.17 },
  shotgun: { r: [0, -0.04, 0], l: [0.0, -0.05, 0.3], stock: -0.22 },

  less: { r: [0, -0.04, 0], l: [0.0, -0.035, 0.24], stock: -0.2 },

/**
 * 姿勢を計算する。
 * p: { x,y,z, yaw, pitch, h(身長), stance(0立ち..1しゃがみ..2伏せ、連続), lean(-1..1), moveX, moveZ（ローカルの速さ m/s）, phase（歩きの位相）,
 *      hold: 'rifle'|'pistol'|...|'none', ads(0..1), low(0..1 ローレディ), reload(0..1 or -1), fire(0..1 撃った直後の跳ね),
 *      state: 'normal'|'hands'|'kneel'|'cuffed'|'down'|'dead'|'stun'|'cower'|'shield'|'carry', stateT（その状態の経過）, fallYaw, seed, throwT }
 * out: Float32Array(NBONE*12)。戻り値: { eye:[x,y,z], gun: {p, x,y,z}, muzzle }
 */
export function computePose(p, out) {
  const s = (p.h || 1.8) / 1.8;
  const D = DIM;
  const st = clamp(p.stance || 0, 0, 2);
  const crouch = clamp(st, 0, 1), prone = clamp(st - 1, 0, 1);
  const state = p.state || 'normal';
  const T = p.stateT || 0;
  const pitch = clamp(p.pitch || 0, -1.4, 1.4);
  const lean = clamp(p.lean || 0, -1, 1);
  // 動作（拘束・作業・拾う・取りつけ・包帯・無線・蹴る）。両手を使う動作では銃を胸の前に吊る
  const act = state === 'normal' || state === 'shield' ? (p.act || null) : null;
  const actT = clamp(p.actT || 0, 0, 1);
  const aP = p.actP || null;
  const free = act === 'cuff' || act === 'kneel' || act === 'grab' || act === 'place' || act === 'bandage' || act === 'peek';
  const hold0 = state === 'normal' || state === 'shield' ? (p.hold || 'none') : 'none';
  const hold = free ? 'none' : hold0;
  const H = HOLD[hold] || null;
  // 動作の始めに手を伸ばし、終わりに戻す（拘束: 寄ってひざをつき、0.2で相手の手を取り、0.9で離す）
  const reachK = act === 'cuff' ? sm((actT - 0.04) / 0.16) * (1 - sm((actT - 0.9) / 0.1)) : act === 'knob' ? sm(actT / 0.8) : act ? sm(actT / 0.16) * (1 - sm((actT - 0.93) / 0.07)) : 0;
  // ひざをつく（片ひざ）: 作業・のぞく・拘束（相手が低い）
  const kneelW = (act === 'kneel' || act === 'peek' || (act === 'cuff' && aP && aP[1] < 0.85 * s)) ? sm(actT / 0.12) : 0;
  // 蹴り: 0〜0.4 ひざを上げる、0.4〜0.6 伸ばす、0.6〜1 戻す
  const kickUp = act === 'kick' ? sm(actT / 0.35) * (1 - sm((actT - 0.62) / 0.3)) : 0;
  const kickExt = act === 'kick' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp((actT - 0.3) / 0.38, 0, 1)) : 0;
  // ---- 下半身
  const spd = Math.hypot(p.moveX || 0, p.moveZ || 0);
  const ph = p.phase || 0;
  const walkAmt = clamp(spd / 1.2, 0, 1) * (1 - prone);
  const runAmt = clamp((spd - 2.6) / 1.8, 0, 1);
  const bob = -Math.abs(Math.cos(ph)) * 0.025 * walkAmt * s - runAmt * 0.04 * s;
  let pelvisY = D.hip * s * (1 - crouch) + 0.6 * s * crouch + bob;
  let torsoBend = 0.05 + crouch * 0.28 + runAmt * 0.25; // 前かがみ（ラジアン）
  if (hold !== 'none') torsoBend += 0.04;
  const kneel = state === 'kneel' || state === 'cuffed';
  const down = state === 'down' || state === 'dead';
  if (kneel) { const k = sm(T / 0.8); pelvisY = lerpN(pelvisY, 0.62 * s, k); torsoBend = lerpN(torsoBend, -0.05, k); }
  if (state === 'cower' || state === 'stun') { const k = sm(T / 0.5); pelvisY = lerpN(pelvisY, 0.55 * s, k); torsoBend = lerpN(torsoBend, 0.75, k); }
  if (kneelW > 0 && crouch > 0.5) {
    // 片ひざ: 腰を下げ、手元（低いほど深く）へ体を傾ける
    pelvisY = lerpN(pelvisY, 0.5 * s, kneelW);
    const low = aP ? clamp((0.9 * s - aP[1]) / (0.8 * s), 0, 1) : 0.3;
    // 拘束は背すじを立てたまま（相手の背中に顔が近づきすぎない）
    // 作業: 手元が低いほど深く前へ（錠の高さならほぼ立てたまま）
    if (act === 'cuff') torsoBend = lerpN(torsoBend, 0.24, kneelW); else torsoBend = lerpN(torsoBend, 0.12 + 0.42 * low, kneelW);
  }
  if (act === 'grab') torsoBend += 0.45 * Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp((actT - 0.05) / 0.8, 0, 1));
  if (act === 'place') torsoBend += 0.08 * reachK;
  if (act === 'kick') torsoBend -= 0.16 * kickExt;
  // ローカルでの関節
  const fwd = v3(0, 0, 1), up = v3(0, 1, 0), left = v3(1, 0, 0);
  let P = v3(0, pelvisY, 0);
  // 伏せ: 体を前に倒す（腰を支点に）
  let tUp = rotAxis(up, left, torsoBend);
  // 体の傾き（リーン）: 前の軸まわり
  // lean > 0 は右へ（ローカルの +x は左なので、前の軸まわりに＋に回すと右へ倒れる）
  const leanAng = lean * 0.36;
  tUp = rotAxis(tUp, fwd, leanAng);
  P = madd(P, left, -lean * 0.07 * s);
  // 伏せの混ぜ: 胴が水平に近づく
  if (prone > 0) {
    const proneUp = norm(v3(0, 0.05, 1));
    tUp = norm(lerp3(tUp, proneUp, sm(prone)));
    P = lerp3(P, v3(0, 0.16 * s, -0.55 * s), sm(prone));
  }
  // 胸は狙いの上下に少しついていく
  const aimP = pitch * (hold !== 'none' ? 1 : 0.4);
  const spineUp = rotAxis(tUp, left, -aimP * 0.25 * (1 - prone));
  const S = madd(P, spineUp, D.ps * s);
  const chestUp = rotAxis(spineUp, left, -aimP * 0.3 * (1 - prone));
  let N = madd(S, chestUp, D.sn * s);
  // 頭: 狙いの向きを見る
  let headFwd = norm(v3(0, Math.sin(pitch), Math.cos(pitch)));
  if (prone > 0) headFwd = norm(lerp3(headFwd, norm(v3(0, Math.sin(pitch) + 0.2, 1)), prone));
  let headUp = norm(sub(up, mul(headFwd, dot(up, headFwd))));
  headUp = rotAxis(headUp, headFwd, leanAng * 0.6);
  if (state === 'cuffed' || state === 'kneel') headFwd = norm(v3(0, -0.15, 1));
  if (state === 'cower' || state === 'stun') { headFwd = norm(v3(0, -0.6, 0.8)); headUp = norm(v3(0, 0.8, 0.6)); }
  const neckTop = madd(N, norm(lerp3(chestUp, headUp, 0.5)), D.neck * s);
  const Hc = madd(neckTop, headUp, (D.nh - D.neck) * s);
  const eye = madd(madd(Hc, headFwd, 0.085 * s), headUp, 0.025 * s);
  // 肩・腰
  const chestLeft = norm(cross(chestUp, cross(left, chestUp)));
  const chestFwd = norm(cross(chestLeft, chestUp));
  const shL = madd(madd(N, chestLeft, D.shW * s), chestUp, D.shD * s);
  const shR = madd(madd(N, chestLeft, -D.shW * s), chestUp, D.shD * s);
  const pelLeft = norm(cross(tUp, cross(left, tUp)));
  const hipL = madd(madd(P, pelLeft, D.hipW * s), tUp, -0.03 * s);
  const hipR = madd(madd(P, pelLeft, -D.hipW * s), tUp, -0.03 * s);
  // ---- 足（IK）
  const legL = D.thigh * s, legS = D.shin * s;
  let ankL, ankR, kneeHintL = v3(0.1, 0, 1), kneeHintR = v3(-0.1, 0, 1);
  const mvx = p.moveX || 0, mvz = p.moveZ || 0;
  const mdir = spd > 0.05 ? norm(v3(mvx, 0, mvz)) : v3(0, 0, 1);
  const stride = clamp(0.32 + spd * 0.2, 0.32, 0.85) * s * walkAmt;
  const footY = D.ankle * s;
  const gait = (o) => {
    const c = Math.cos(ph + o), sn = Math.sin(ph + o);
    const lift = Math.max(0, sn) * (0.09 + runAmt * 0.12) * s * walkAmt;
    return add(mul(mdir, c * stride * 0.5), v3(0, lift, 0));
  };
  if (prone > 0.01) {
    ankL = madd(madd(P, tUp, -0.95 * s), pelLeft, 0.16 * s); ankL[1] = 0.1 * s;
    ankR = madd(madd(P, tUp, -0.95 * s), pelLeft, -0.16 * s); ankR[1] = 0.1 * s;
    const crawl = Math.sin(ph) * 0.12 * s * clamp(spd / 0.4, 0, 1);
    ankL = madd(ankL, tUp, crawl); ankR = madd(ankR, tUp, -crawl);
    kneeHintL = v3(0, -1, 0); kneeHintR = v3(0, -1, 0);
    const standL = add(v3(D.hipW * s, footY, 0.03 * s), gait(0)), standR = add(v3(-D.hipW * s, footY, -0.03 * s), gait(Math.PI));
    const k = sm(prone);
    ankL = lerp3(standL, ankL, k); ankR = lerp3(standR, ankR, k);
  } else if (kneel) {
    const k = sm(T / 0.8);
    const stL = v3(D.hipW * s, footY, 0.02), stR = v3(-D.hipW * s, footY, -0.02);
    // ひざをついて、すねが床に
    const kL = v3(D.hipW * s, footY, -0.48 * s), kR = v3(-D.hipW * s, footY, -0.48 * s);
    ankL = lerp3(stL, kL, k); ankR = lerp3(stR, kR, k);
    kneeHintL = v3(0, -0.4, 1); kneeHintR = v3(0, -0.4, 1);
  } else if (crouch > 0.01) {
    // しゃがみ: 左足を前、右ひざを下げる
    const cL = add(v3(D.hipW * s * 1.1, footY, 0.34 * s), mul(gait(0), 0.6));
    const cR = add(v3(-D.hipW * s * 1.2, footY, -0.36 * s), mul(gait(Math.PI), 0.6));
    const stL = add(v3(D.hipW * s, footY, 0.03 * s), gait(0)), stR = add(v3(-D.hipW * s, footY, -0.03 * s), gait(Math.PI));
    const k = sm(crouch);
    ankL = lerp3(stL, cL, k); ankR = lerp3(stR, cR, k);
    if (spd < 0.1) ankR[1] = lerpN(ankR[1], footY + 0.12 * s, k);
    // 片ひざ: 右ひざを床に、すねを後ろへ
    if (kneelW > 0) { ankR = lerp3(ankR, v3(-D.hipW * s * 1.15, footY * 0.8, -0.44 * s), kneelW); ankL = lerp3(ankL, v3(D.hipW * s * 1.15, footY, 0.4 * s), kneelW); kneeHintR = norm(lerp3(kneeHintR, v3(0, -0.9, 0.4), kneelW)); }
  } else {
    ankL = add(v3(D.hipW * s, footY, 0.03 * s), gait(0));
    ankR = add(v3(-D.hipW * s, footY, -0.03 * s), gait(Math.PI));
    if (spd < 0.1 && hold !== 'none') { ankL[2] += 0.1 * s; ankR[2] -= 0.08 * s; ankR[0] -= 0.03 * s; }
  }
  if (state === 'cower' || state === 'stun') { const k = sm(T / 0.5); ankL = lerp3(ankL, v3(D.hipW * s * 1.4, footY, 0.12 * s), k); ankR = lerp3(ankR, v3(-D.hipW * s * 1.4, footY, 0.0), k); }
  // 蹴り: 右ひざを上げてから、かかとで扉（腰より下）を前へ押し出す
  if (kickUp > 0) {
    const chamber = v3(-D.hipW * s, 0.42 * s, 0.12 * s), ext = v3(-D.hipW * s * 0.8, 0.5 * s, 0.78 * s);
    ankR = lerp3(ankR, lerp3(chamber, ext, kickExt), kickUp);
    kneeHintR = norm(lerp3(kneeHintR, v3(0, 0.6, 1), kickUp));
    ankL = madd(ankL, v3(0, 0, 1), -0.08 * s * kickUp);
  }
  const kneeL = ik2(hipL, ankL, legL, legS, kneeHintL);
  const kneeR = ik2(hipR, ankR, legL, legS, kneeHintR);
  // つま先
  let toeDirL = prone > 0.5 ? norm(v3(0, -1, -0.2)) : kneel ? norm(v3(0, 0.1, -1)) : v3(0, 0, 1);
  let toeDirR = prone > 0.5 ? norm(v3(0, -1, -0.2)) : kneel ? norm(v3(0, 0.1, -1)) : v3(-0.05, 0, 1);
  const toeL = madd(ankL, toeDirL, D.foot * s), toeR = madd(ankR, toeDirR, D.foot * s);
  // ---- 腕
  const ua = D.uarm * s, fa = D.farm * s;
  let wristL, wristR, handDirL = v3(0, -1, 0), handDirR = v3(0, -1, 0), elbowHintL = v3(0.6, -1, -0.2), elbowHintR = v3(-0.6, -1, -0.2);
  let gun = null, shield = null;
  // 狙いの向き（ローカル）
  const aimDir = norm(v3(0, Math.sin(pitch), Math.cos(pitch)));
  if (H) {
    // 銃の位置: 右肩の前。ADSで目の高さへ。ローレディで下げる
    const ads = clamp(p.ads || 0, 0, 1), low = clamp(p.low || 0, 0, 1);
    const isPistol = hold === 'pistol';
    let gp = madd(madd(madd(shR, chestFwd, (isPistol ? 0.36 : 0.12) * s), chestUp, -0.03 * s), chestLeft, (isPistol ? 0.16 : 0.03) * s);
    // ADS: 銃の線を目の前へ
    const adsP = madd(madd(eye, aimDir, (isPistol ? 0.42 : 0.2) * s), headUp, -0.055 * s);
    gp = lerp3(gp, madd(adsP, chestLeft, isPistol ? 0 : -0.0), ads);
    let gf = aimDir;
    // ローレディ: 銃口を下げる
    if (low > 0) { gf = norm(lerp3(gf, norm(v3(0.15, -0.75, 0.6)), low)); gp = madd(gp, chestUp, -0.12 * s * low); }
    // 走り（ダッシュ）: 銃を斜めに
    if (runAmt > 0) { gf = norm(lerp3(gf, norm(v3(0.5, -0.35, 0.7)), runAmt * 0.8)); gp = madd(gp, chestUp, -0.1 * s * runAmt); }
    // リロード: 銃を傾けて下げる
    const rl = p.reload == null ? -1 : p.reload;
    let gUp = norm(sub(up, mul(gf, dot(up, gf))));
    if (rl >= 0) { const k = Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp(rl, 0, 1)); gp = madd(madd(gp, chestUp, -0.06 * s * k), chestFwd, -0.03 * k); gUp = rotAxis(gUp, gf, 0.5 * k); }
    // 撃った直後の跳ね
    const fk = clamp(p.fire || 0, 0, 1);
    gp = madd(gp, gf, -0.025 * fk * s);
    gf = norm(madd(gf, gUp, 0.08 * fk));
    if (state === 'shield') {
      // 盾: 左手で胸の前に。拳銃は盾の右の縁。ADSでは盾を少し下げて、拳銃を盾の上の角から
      const hipS = madd(madd(shR, chestFwd, 0.42 * s), chestLeft, -0.12 * s);
      gp = lerp3(hipS, madd(adsP, chestLeft, -0.05 * s), ads);
      shield = { p: madd(madd(madd(shL, chestFwd, 0.47 * s), chestLeft, -0.14 * s), chestUp, (-0.27 - 0.12 * ads) * s), f: chestFwd, u: chestUp, l: chestLeft };
    }
    const gl = norm(cross(gUp, gf)); // 銃の左
    gun = { p: gp, f: gf, u: gUp, l: gl };
    const toW = (o) => add(add(add(gp, mul(gl, o[0] * s)), mul(gUp, o[1] * s)), mul(gf, o[2] * s));
    wristR = toW(H.r); handDirR = norm(add(gf, mul(gUp, -0.6)));
    if (rl >= 0 && rl < 0.75 && hold !== 'pistol') {
      // 左手は弾倉へ（下に下りて戻る）
      const k = Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp(rl / 0.75, 0, 1));
      wristL = lerp3(toW([0.02, -0.12, 0.1]), madd(madd(N, chestUp, -0.42 * s), chestLeft, 0.12 * s), k);
      handDirL = v3(0, -1, 0.3);
    } else if (state === 'shield') {
      wristL = madd(madd(madd(shL, chestFwd, 0.41 * s), chestUp, (-0.2 - 0.12 * clamp(p.ads || 0, 0, 1)) * s), chestLeft, -0.06 * s); handDirL = norm(v3(-0.3, 0.9, 0.2));
    } else { wristL = toW(H.l); handDirL = norm(add(gf, mul(gl, -0.4))); }
    elbowHintL = norm(v3(0.8, -1, -0.2)); elbowHintR = norm(v3(-1.0, -0.8, -0.4));
    // 無線（TOCへ報告）: 左手を肩の無線へ
    if (act === 'radio') {
      const rp = madd(madd(madd(shL, chestUp, -0.04 * s), chestFwd, 0.07 * s), chestLeft, -0.05 * s);
      wristL = lerp3(wristL, rp, reachK); handDirL = norm(lerp3(handDirL, v3(-0.4, 0.8, 0.2), reachK)); elbowHintL = norm(lerp3(elbowHintL, v3(1, -0.2, 0.2), reachK));
    }
    // 扉: 左手をノブへ伸ばす（銃は右手のまま）
    if (act === 'knob' && aP) {
      let tgt = v3(aP[0], aP[1], aP[2]);
      const off = sub(tgt, shL), dl = len(off), maxR = (ua + fa) * 0.97;
      if (dl > maxR) tgt = madd(shL, off, maxR / dl);
      wristL = lerp3(wristL, tgt, reachK); handDirL = norm(lerp3(handDirL, norm(off), reachK)); elbowHintL = norm(lerp3(elbowHintL, v3(1, -0.6, 0), reachK));
    }
    // 扉を開ける・閉める: 左手をノブへ伸ばして戻す（銃は右手）
    if ((p.gest === 'push' || p.gest === 'grab') && p.gestP) {
      const g = Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp(p.gestT || 0, 0, 1));
      let tgt = v3(p.gestP[0], p.gestP[1], p.gestP[2]);
      const off = sub(tgt, shL), dl = len(off), maxR = (ua + fa) * 0.95;
      if (dl > maxR) tgt = madd(shL, off, maxR / dl);
      wristL = lerp3(wristL, tgt, g); handDirL = norm(lerp3(handDirL, norm(off), g));
    }
  } else if (free) {
    // ---- 両手で行う動作
    let T0 = aP ? v3(aP[0], aP[1], aP[2]) : madd(madd(P, chestFwd, 0.45 * s), chestUp, 0.25 * s);
    // 届く所まで（肩から腕の長さ）
    const midSh = lerp3(shL, shR, 0.5), off0 = sub(T0, midSh), d0 = len(off0), maxR = (ua + fa) * 0.92;
    if (d0 > maxR) T0 = madd(midSh, off0, maxR / d0);
    const dirT = norm(v3(T0[0], 0, Math.abs(T0[2]) < 0.05 ? 0.3 : T0[2]));
    const sideT = v3(dirT[2], 0, -dirT[0]); // 目標に向かって左
    const restL = madd(madd(shL, chestUp, -0.46 * s), chestFwd, 0.12 * s), restR = madd(madd(shR, chestUp, -0.46 * s), chestFwd, 0.12 * s);
    const wig = (f, o) => Math.sin(actT * f + o) * 0.016 * s;
    let tL = T0, tR = T0;
    handDirL = handDirR = norm(add(dirT, v3(0, -0.35, 0)));
    if (act === 'cuff') {
      // 相手の手首を両手で取る（左手で押さえ、右手で結束バンドを回す）→ 締める（両手を引く）→ 離す
      const tie = clamp((actT - 0.62) / 0.2, 0, 1), loop = Math.sin(Math.PI * tie);
      const pull = Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp((actT - 0.82) / 0.1, 0, 1)) * 0.08 * s;
      const ang = tie * Math.PI * 2;
      tL = madd(madd(T0, sideT, 0.06 * s + pull), v3(0, 1, 0), 0.015 * s + wig(9, 0));
      tR = madd(madd(madd(T0, sideT, -0.05 * s - pull + Math.cos(ang) * 0.05 * s * loop), v3(0, 1, 0), Math.sin(ang) * 0.06 * s * loop - 0.01 * s), dirT, -0.04 * s * loop);
      handDirL = norm(add(dirT, add(mul(sideT, -0.5), v3(0, -0.4, 0)))); handDirR = norm(add(dirT, mul(sideT, 0.6)));
    } else if (act === 'kneel' || act === 'peek') {
      // 手元で細かく動かす（ピッキング・解除・手当て…）
      tL = madd(madd(T0, sideT, 0.07 * s), dirT, wig(23, 0)); tR = madd(madd(T0, sideT, -0.05 * s), v3(0, 1, 0), wig(31, 2));
    } else if (act === 'grab') {
      // 右手で拾って胸へ。左手はひざ
      const up1 = sm((actT - 0.5) / 0.4);
      tR = lerp3(T0, madd(madd(N, chestUp, -0.24 * s), chestFwd, 0.28 * s), up1);
      tL = madd(madd(madd(P, chestFwd, 0.3 * s), pelLeft, 0.14 * s), chestUp, 0.08 * s);
      handDirR = norm(lerp3(v3(0, -1, 0.3), v3(0, 0.3, 1), up1));
    } else if (act === 'place') {
      // 両手で取りつけ、最後に押さえる
      const push = actT > 0.72 ? Math.sin(Math.PI * clamp((actT - 0.72) / 0.22, 0, 1)) * 0.05 * s : 0;
      tL = madd(madd(T0, sideT, 0.13 * s), dirT, push - 0.04 * s); tR = madd(madd(T0, sideT, -0.13 * s), dirT, push - 0.04 * s);
      handDirL = handDirR = dirT;
    } else if (act === 'bandage') {
      // 左の前腕を胸の前に出し、右手で巻く

    }

      L[o + 3] = X[0]; L[o + 4] = X[1]; L[o + 5] = X[2]; L[o + 6] = Y[0]; L[o + 7] = Y[1]; L[o + 8] = Y[2]; L[o + 9] = Z[0]; L[o + 10] = Z[1]; L[o + 11] = Z[2];
    }
    extra = { ang, axis };
  }
  // ---- 世界へ（yaw と位置）
  const cy = Math.cos(p.yaw || 0), sy = Math.sin(p.yaw || 0);
  const tw = (v) => [v[0] * cy + v[2] * sy + p.x, v[1] + p.y, -v[0] * sy + v[2] * cy + p.z];
  const tr = (v) => [v[0] * cy + v[2] * sy, v[1], -v[0] * sy + v[2] * cy];

    L[o] = P0[0]; L[o + 1] = P0[1]; L[o + 2] = P0[2];
    L[o + 3] = X[0]; L[o + 4] = X[1]; L[o + 5] = X[2]; L[o + 6] = Y[0]; L[o + 7] = Y[1]; L[o + 8] = Y[2]; L[o + 9] = Z[0]; L[o + 10] = Z[1]; L[o + 11] = Z[2];
  }
  // 骨の長さ（描画とカプセル用）
  const lens = POSE_LEN;
  lens[0] = 0.2 * s; lens[1] = D.ps * s; lens[2] = D.sn * s; lens[3] = D.neck * s; lens[4] = 0.2 * s;

  let gunW = null;
  if (gun && !down) gunW = { p: tw(gun.p), f: tr(gun.f), u: tr(gun.u), l: tr(gun.l) };
  const shieldW = shield && !down ? { p: tw(shield.p), f: tr(shield.f), u: tr(shield.u), l: tr(shield.l) } : null;
  return { eye: eyeW, gun: gunW, shield: shieldW, s, extra };
}
export const POSE_LEN = new Float32Array(NBONE);
function lerpN(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }

// 当たりのカプセルを世界の座標で（骨の枠から）。out: [{a:[..], b:[..], r, part}]
export function hitCapsules(bones, lens, s = 1, out = []) {
  out.length = 0;
  for (const [bn, t0, t1, r, part] of HITCAPS) {
    const b = BI[bn], o = b * 12, L = lens[b];
    const px = bones[o], py = bones[o + 1], pz = bones[o + 2], yx = bones[o + 6], yy = bones[o + 7], yz = bones[o + 8];
    out.push({ a: [px + yx * L * t0, py + yy * L * t0, pz + yz * L * t0], b: [px + yx * L * t1, py + yy * L * t1, pz + yz * L * t1], r: r * s, part, bone: b });
  }
  return out;
}

// 線分とカプセルの交差。光線 o + d t (|d|=1), t∈[0, maxT]。戻り値 t か -1
export function rayCapsule(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, maxT, a, b, r) {
  // 線分 ab 上の点と光線の最短距離
  const bax = b[0] - a[0], bay = b[1] - a[1], baz = b[2] - a[2];
  const oax = ox - a[0], oay = oy - a[1], oaz = oz - a[2];
  const baba = bax * bax + bay * bay + baz * baz, bard = bax * dx + bay * dy + baz * dz, baoa = bax * oax + bay * oay + baz * oaz;
  const rdoa = dx * oax + dy * oay + dz * oaz, oaoa = oax * oax + oay * oay + oaz * oaz;
  const A = baba - bard * bard, B = baba * rdoa - baoa * bard, Cc = baba * oaoa - baoa * baoa - r * r * baba;
  const h = B * B - A * Cc;
  if (h >= 0 && A > 1e-9) {
    const t = (-B - Math.sqrt(h)) / A;
    const y = baoa + t * bard;
    if (y > 0 && y < baba && t >= 0 && t <= maxT) return t;
  }
  // 端の球
  const sph = (cx, cy, cz) => {
    const ocx = ox - cx, ocy = oy - cy, ocz = oz - cz;
    const bq = ocx * dx + ocy * dy + ocz * dz, cq = ocx * ocx + ocy * ocy + ocz * ocz - r * r;
    const hq = bq * bq - cq; if (hq < 0) return -1;
    const t = -bq - Math.sqrt(hq); return t >= 0 && t <= maxT ? t : (cq < 0 ? 0 : -1);
  };
  const t0 = sph(a[0], a[1], a[2]), t1 = sph(b[0], b[1], b[2]);
  if (t0 >= 0 && t1 >= 0) return Math.min(t0, t1);
  return t0 >= 0 ? t0 : t1;
}

// シード付き乱数（mulberry32）。状態は {s: uint32} のデータだけ。
export function rngNew(seed) {
  return { s: (hashSeed(seed) >>> 0) };
}

export function hashSeed(v) {
  const str = String(v);
  let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    h ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) >>> 0;
  }
  // 混ぜる
  h ^= h >>> 16; h = Math.imul(h, 0x7feb352d) >>> 0;
  h ^= h >>> 15; h = Math.imul(h, 0x846ca68b) >>> 0;
  h ^= h >>> 16;
  return h >>> 0;
}

export function rnd(r) {
  let t = (r.s = (r.s + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0);
  t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
  t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
  return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

export function rndInt(r, n) { return Math.floor(rnd(r) * n); }
export function rndRange(r, a, b) { return a + (b - a) * rnd(r); }
export function rndPick(r, arr) { return arr[Math.floor(rnd(r) * arr.length)]; }
export function rndChance(r, p) { return rnd(r) < p; }
export function rndShuffle(r, arr) {
  for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(rnd(r) * (i + 1));
    const t = arr[i]; arr[i] = arr[j]; arr[j] = t;
  }
  return arr;
}
// 正規分布っぽい値（-1..1付近、三角分布）
export function rndTri(r) { return rnd(r) - rnd(r); }
// 決まった乱数（引数から毎回同じ値）: ホストとゲストで同じ反動・散らばりになる。
// 試合のシードを「塩」として混ぜる（step の初めに setSalt(S.seed)）。シードが違えば判断の揺れも変わる
let SALT = 0;
export function setSalt(s) { SALT = (s | 0) >>> 0; }
export function hrand(a, b, c = 0) {
  let h = (Math.imul(a | 0, 0x9E3779B1) ^ Math.imul(b | 0, 0x85EBCA77) ^ Math.imul(c | 0, 0xC2B2AE3D) ^ Math.imul(SALT, 0x27D4EB2F)) >>> 0;
  h ^= h >>> 16; h = Math.imul(h, 0x7feb352d) >>> 0; h ^= h >>> 15; h = Math.imul(h, 0x846ca68b) >>> 0; h ^= h >>> 16;
  return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

// 体の状態の時間の進み: 怯み・閃光・ガス・テーザー・耳鳴り・制圧・エイムパンチ・出血・行動不能・ダウン
import { killActor } from './combat.js';

export function stepStatus(S, w, dt, ev) {
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    if (a.isDrone) continue;
    if (a.stun > 0) a.stun = Math.max(0, a.stun - dt);
    if (a.flash > 0) a.flash = Math.max(0, a.flash - dt);
    if (a.gas > 0) a.gas = Math.max(0, a.gas - dt);
    if (a.tased > 0) { a.tased = Math.max(0, a.tased - dt); }
    if (a.deaf > 0) a.deaf = Math.max(0, a.deaf - dt);
    if (a.spawnProt > 0) a.spawnProt = Math.max(0, a.spawnProt - dt);
    if (a.spot > 0) a.spot = Math.max(0, a.spot - dt);
    a.supp *= Math.pow(0.25, dt);
    a.flinch *= Math.pow(0.004, dt);
    if (!a.alive) continue;
    // 出血（隊員・PvE）。止血するまで毎秒1.9HP
    if (a.bleed > 0 && !a.down) {
      a.hp -= a.bleed * dt;
      if (a.hp <= 0) { a.hp = 0; const by = a.lastHit ? S.byId[a.lastHit.by] : null; killActor(S, a, by, ev, 'bleed'); continue; }
    }
    if (a.down) {
      a.downT += dt;
      if (S.pvp && a.dbno > 0) {
        // ダウン: 20HP が約20秒で尽きる（傷を押さえると半分の速さ = 動かないとき）
        a.dbno -= dt * (a.spd < 0.05 ? 0.6 : 1.0);
        if (a.dbno <= 0) { const by = a.lastHit ? S.byId[a.lastHit.by] : null; killActor(S, a, by, ev, 'bleed'); }
      } else if (!S.pvp && a.bleedOut > 0 && !a.cuffed && !a.reported) {
        a.bleedOut -= dt;
        if (a.bleedOut <= 0) { const by = a.lastHit ? S.byId[a.lastHit.by] : null; killActor(S, a, by, ev, 'bleed'); }
      }
    }
  }
}

// 銃の動き: 撃つ・弾倉（1本ずつ残弾）・通常/速いリロード・1発ずつ込める・ポンプ・持ち替え・反動（BattleBit式）・散らばり
import { WEAPONS, AMMO, ATTACH } from './data/weapons.js';
import { LONG, HAND_LONG } from './data/equipment.js';
import { curWeapon, curW } from './actor.js';
import { spawnBullet } from './combat.js';
import { hrand } from './rng.js';

const DEG = Math.PI / 180;
export function attMods(wi) {
  const m = { rcv: 1, rch: 1, rcfirst: 1, ads: 0, noise: 1, vel: 1, flash: 1, zoom: 1, scope: false };
  if (!wi) return m;
  const s = ATTACH.sight[wi.att.sight], mu = ATTACH.muzzle[wi.att.muzzle], g = ATTACH.grip[wi.att.grip];
  for (const x of [s, mu, g]) {
    if (!x) continue;
    if (x.rcv) m.rcv *= x.rcv; if (x.rch) m.rch *= x.rch; if (x.rcfirst) m.rcfirst *= x.rcfirst;
    if (x.ads) m.ads += x.ads; if (x.noise) m.noise *= x.noise; if (x.vel) m.vel *= x.vel; if (x.flash != null) m.flash *= x.flash;
    if (x.zoom) m.zoom = Math.max(m.zoom, x.zoom); if (x.scope) m.scope = true;
  }
  if (wi.att.muzzle === 'supp' && WEAPONS[wi.id].integral) m.noise = 0.25;
  return m;
}

// 今の散らばり（度）
export function spreadDeg(S, a, W, wi) {
  const sp = W.sp;
  let s = sp.hip + (sp.ads - sp.hip) * a.ads;
  s += sp.move * Math.min(1.5, a.spd / 2.4) * (1 - 0.6 * a.ads);
  s += a.ws.bloom;
  if (a.st > 1.5) s *= 0.6; else if (a.st > 0.5) s *= 0.8;
  if (a.inj.arm) s *= 1.4;
  if (a.flash > 0.2 || (a.gas > 0 && a.armor.head !== 'gasmask')) s *= 1.6;
  if (a.supp > 0) s *= 1 + 0.4 * a.supp;
  if (!a.ground || a.vault) s += 4;
  return s;
}

// 1ステップ。inp: { fire, ads, low } と act の配列（reload/switch/mode/light）
export function stepWeapon(S, w, a, inp, dt, ev) {
  const ws = a.ws;
  if (a.dead || a.cuffed || (a.down && !S.pvp)) { ws.trigWas = !!inp.fire; return; }
  if (ws.cd > 0) ws.cd -= dt;
  // 反動の戻り（撃ち続けている間は弱く）
  const W = curW(a), wi = curWeapon(a);
  const since = (S.t - ws.lastShot) * S.dt;
  if (W) {
    const ctrl = W.rc.ctrl * (since > 0.12 ? 1 : 0.25);
    const dec = ctrl * dt;
    if (ws.rp > 0) ws.rp = Math.max(0, ws.rp - dec); else ws.rp = Math.min(0, ws.rp + dec);
    ws.ry *= since > 0.12 ? Math.pow(0.02, dt) : Math.pow(0.6, dt);
    if (Math.abs(ws.ry) < 1e-3) ws.ry = 0;
    ws.bloom = Math.max(0, ws.bloom - dt * 3.0);
    if (since > 0.25) ws.shots = 0;
  }
  a.fireK = Math.max(0, a.fireK - dt * 9);
  a.throwT = Math.max(0, a.throwT - dt * 1.8);
  // ADS とローレディ
  const busy = ws.st === 'draw' || ws.st === 'holster' || a.sprint || a.vault || (a.act && a.act.noAds);
  a.adsOn = !!inp.ads && !busy && ws.slot >= 0 && (ws.slot < 2 || (ws.slot === 3 && a.inv.long === 'm320')) && !a.down && !a.peek;
  a.lowOn = !!inp.low && !a.adsOn;
  const adsT = W ? W.ads + attMods(wi).ads : 0.25;
  a.ads = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, a.ads + (a.adsOn ? dt / adsT : -dt / (adsT * 0.8))));
  a.low = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, a.low + (a.lowOn ? dt * 5 : -dt * 6)));
  // 状態の時間
  if (ws.t > 0) ws.t -= dt;
  if (ws.t <= 0) finishState(S, a, ev);
  // 操作
  for (const ac of (inp.act || [])) {
    if (ac.a === 'reload') startReload(S, a, !!ac.fast, ev);
    else if (ac.a === 'switch') switchTo(S, a, ac.slot, ev);
    else if (ac.a === 'mode' && ws.slot === 3) m320Next(a, ev);
    else if (ac.a === 'mode' && W && wi && W.modes.length > 1 && ws.st === 'ready') { wi.mode = (wi.mode + 1) % W.modes.length; ev.push({ e: 'fmode', id: a.id, m: W.modes[wi.mode] }); }
    else if (ac.a === 'light' && wi && wi.att.light) { wi.lightOn = !wi.lightOn; a.light = wi.lightOn; ev.push({ e: 'lightsw', id: a.id, on: wi.lightOn }); }
  }
  if (wi) a.light = !!wi.lightOn; else a.light = false;
  // 撃つ
  const trig = !!inp.fire;
  if (W && wi && trig) tryFire(S, w, a, W, wi, inp, ev);
  if (!trig) ws.burstN = 0;
  ws.trigWas = trig;
}

function finishState(S, a, ev) {
  const ws = a.ws, wi = curWeapon(a), W = curW(a);
  const st = ws.st;
  if (st === 'draw') { ws.st = 'ready'; ws.t = 0; }
  else if (st === 'holster') { ws.slot = ws.next; ws.next = -1; ws.st = 'draw'; const W2 = curW(a); ws.t = W2 ? W2.draw : ws.slot === 3 ? (LONG[a.inv.long] && LONG[a.inv.long].draw) || 0.6 : 0.3; if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'draw', id: a.id, slot: ws.slot }); }
  else if (st === 'reload' && wi && W) {
    // 弾倉を替える
    if (ws.rk === 'rev') { const need = W.mag - wi.mag; const take = Math.min(need, wi.res); wi.mag += take; wi.res -= take; }
    else if (ws.rk === 'break') { const need = W.mag - wi.mag; const take = Math.min(need, wi.res); wi.mag += take; wi.res -= take; }
    else if (wi.mags) {
      // いちばん多い弾倉を入れる。通常は抜いた弾倉を残す、速いときは捨てる
      let bi = -1; for (let i = 0; i < wi.mags.length; i++) if (bi < 0 || wi.mags[i] > wi.mags[bi]) bi = i;
      if (bi >= 0) {
        const nm = wi.mags[bi]; wi.mags.splice(bi, 1);
        if (ws.rk === 'tac' && wi.mag > 0) wi.mags.push(wi.mag);
        wi.mag = nm;
        if (!wi.ch && W.chamber) { if (wi.mag > 0) { wi.mag--; wi.ch = 1; } }
      }
    }
    ws.st = 'ready'; ws.t = 0; ws.rk = null;
    if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'reloaded', id: a.id });
  } else if (st === 'shell' && wi && W) {
    // 1発込めた
    if (wi.res > 0 && wi.mag < W.mag) { wi.mag++; wi.res--; if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'shell', id: a.id }); }
    if (!wi.ch && wi.mag > 0 && W.chamber) { wi.mag--; wi.ch = 1; ws.st = 'pump'; ws.t = (W.pump || 0.35); return; }
    if (wi.mag < W.mag && wi.res > 0 && !ws.stopShell) { ws.t = W.rl.shell; }
    else { ws.st = 'ready'; ws.t = 0; ws.stopShell = false; }
  } else if (st === 'pump' && wi && W) {
    if (!wi.ch && wi.mag > 0) { wi.mag--; wi.ch = 1; }
    ws.st = 'ready'; ws.t = 0;
    if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'pumped', id: a.id });
  } else if (st === 'gear') { /* 投げ物を持っている */ }
}

export function startReload(S, a, fast, ev) {
  const ws = a.ws, wi = curWeapon(a), W = curW(a);
  if (!wi || !W || (ws.st !== 'ready' && ws.st !== 'pump')) return false;
  if (a.sprint || a.vault) return false;
  if (W.tube) {
    if (wi.mag >= W.mag || wi.res <= 0) return false;
    ws.st = 'shell'; ws.t = W.rl.start + W.rl.shell; ws.stopShell = false;
    if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'reload', id: a.id, k: 'shell' });
    return true;
  }
  if (W.revolver || W.breakAction) {
    if (wi.mag >= W.mag || wi.res <= 0) return false;
    ws.st = 'reload'; ws.rk = W.revolver ? 'rev' : 'break'; ws.t = W.rl.tac; ws.rd = ws.t;
    if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'reload', id: a.id, k: ws.rk, dur: ws.t });
    return true;
  }
  if (!wi.mags || !wi.mags.length) return false;
  if (wi.mag >= W.mag && (wi.ch || !W.chamber)) return false;
  const empty = !wi.ch && W.chamber;
  ws.rk = fast ? 'fast' : 'tac';
  ws.t = (fast ? W.rl.fast : W.rl.tac) + (empty ? W.rl.empty : 0);
  if (a.inj.arm) ws.t *= 1.15;
  ws.rd = ws.t; ws.st = 'reload';
  if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'reload', id: a.id, k: ws.rk, dur: ws.t, empty });
  return true;
}

export function switchTo(S, a, slot, ev) {
  const ws = a.ws;
  if (slot === ws.slot && ws.st !== 'holster') return false;
  if (slot >= 0 && slot < 2 && !a.inv.w[slot]) return false;
  if (slot === 3 && !HAND_LONG[a.inv.long]) return false;
  // 持ち替える前の物（特殊装備・投げ物から戻るとき）
  if (ws.slot >= 0 && ws.slot < 2) ws.prev = ws.slot;
  ws.next = slot; ws.st = 'holster'; ws.t = 0.22; ws.rk = null;
  if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'holster', id: a.id });
  return true;
}

// M320 の弾を替える（残っている次の種類へ）
export function m320Next(a, ev) {
  const m = a.inv.m320; if (!m) return;
  const order = ['flash', 'stinger', 'cs'];
  let i = order.indexOf(m.sel);
  for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) { i = (i + 1) % 3; if (m[order[i]] > 0) break; }
  m.sel = order[i];
  if (ev) ev.push({ e: 'm320sel', id: a.id, sel: m.sel, n: m[m.sel] });
}

function tryFire(S, w, a, W, wi, inp, ev) {
  const ws = a.ws;
  if (a.sprint || a.vault || a.low > 0.5 || (a.act && !a.act.canFire) || a.comply || a.down && !S.pvp) return;
  if (ws.st === 'shell') { if (wi.ch || wi.mag > 0) { ws.stopShell = true; ws.st = 'ready'; ws.t = 0; } else return; }
  if (ws.st !== 'ready') return;
  if (ws.cd > 0) return;
  const mode = W.modes[wi.mode] || 'semi';
  if (mode === 'semi' && ws.trigWas) return;
  if (W.range && a.ai == null) { /* テーザーの射程は弾で判定 */ }
  // 弾があるか
  const hasRound = W.chamber ? wi.ch > 0 : wi.mag > 0;
  if (!hasRound) {
    if (!ws.trigWas) ev.push({ e: 'dry', id: a.id });
    ws.cd = 0.25;
    return;
  }
  // 撃つ
  if (W.chamber) {
    wi.ch = 0;
    if (W.pump) { ws.st = 'pump'; ws.t = W.pump; }
    else if (wi.mag > 0) { wi.mag--; wi.ch = 1; }
  } else wi.mag--;
  ws.cd = 60 / W.rpm;
  const m = attMods(wi);
  const am = AMMO[W.cal][wi.am];
  // 散らばりと反動
  const sh = ws.shots;
  const sprd = spreadDeg(S, a, W, wi) * DEG;
  const baseYaw = a.yaw + ws.ry * DEG, basePitch = a.pitch + ws.rp * DEG;
  const pellets = am.pellets || 1;
  const seed = a.stats.sh + 1;
  for (let p = 0; p < pellets; p++) {
    // 円の中で一様に
    const r1 = hrand(a.id, seed, p * 2 + 1), r2 = hrand(a.id, seed, p * 2 + 2);
    let ang = Math.sqrt(r1) * (pellets > 1 ? Math.max(sprd * 0.4, (am.spread || 3) * DEG * (1 - 0.25 * a.ads)) : sprd), th = r2 * Math.PI * 2;
    if (pellets > 1 && p === 0) ang *= 0.3;
    const yaw = baseYaw + Math.cos(th) * ang, pit = basePitch + Math.sin(th) * ang;
    const cp = Math.cos(pit);
    const dx = Math.sin(yaw) * cp, dy = Math.sin(pit), dz = Math.cos(yaw) * cp;
    spawnBullet(S, a, W, wi, am, dx, dy, dz, m, p > 0);
  }
  // 反動
  let kv = W.rc.v * (sh === 0 ? W.rc.first * m.rcfirst : 1) * m.rcv;
  let kh = (hrand(a.id, seed, 77) * 2 - 1) * W.rc.h * m.rch + W.rc.bias * W.rc.h * 0.6;
  let mul = 1 - 0.2 * a.ads;
  if (a.st > 1.5) mul *= 0.7; else if (a.st > 0.5) mul *= 0.85;
  if (a.inj.arm) mul *= 1.6;
  if (S.rules && S.rules.recoil) mul *= S.rules.recoil;
  ws.rp += kv * mul; ws.ry += kh * mul;
  ws.bloom = Math.min(W.sp.hip * 0.8, ws.bloom + W.sp.hip * 0.1 * (1 - 0.7 * a.ads));
  ws.shots++; ws.lastShot = S.t; a.stats.sh++;
  a.fireK = 1;
  // 音と光（AIは聞く）
  const supp = wi.att.muzzle === 'supp';
  ev.push({ e: 'shot', id: a.id, wid: wi.id, x: a.x, y: a.y, z: a.z, supp, loud: (W.less ? 0.4 : 1) * m.noise, fl: m.flash, n: ws.shots });
}

// マップを組み立てて、当たり・視線・弾の通り道を調べる（DOMなし。ホストとゲストで同じ結果になる）
// 座標: メートル。マス (i, j) の中心は x = (i+0.5)*CS, z = (j+0.5)*CS。階 L の床は y = L*LH。
// 壁はマスの中央の板。高さ方向に4つのブロック（0.7mずつ、上の端は天井 2.8m）。
import { M, MATS, F } from './data/materials.js';
import { PROPS } from './data/props.js';

export const CS = 0.5, LH = 3.0, CEIL = 2.8, BH = 0.7, NB = 4, SLAB = 0.2, STEP = 0.36;

// マスの種類
export const C = { VOID: 0, FLOOR: 1, OUT: 2, WALL: 3, DOOR: 4, WINDOW: 5, GLASSWALL: 6, OPEN: 7, LOW: 8, FENCE: 9, STAIR: 10 };
const WALLISH = new Set([C.WALL, C.DOOR, C.WINDOW, C.GLASSWALL, C.OPEN, C.LOW, C.FENCE]);
export const isWallish = (t) => WALLISH.has(t);

// 文字 → [種類, 材質(壁) or 床の材質]
const FLOOR_CH = { '.': -1, ':': F.TILE, '_': F.WOOD, '~': F.CARPET, '-': F.CONCRETE, 'm': F.METAL };
const OUT_CH = { ',': F.ASPHALT, ';': F.GRASS, '`': F.DIRT, '"': F.CONCRETE };
const WALL_CH = { '#': M.BRICK, 'C': M.CONCRETE, '=': M.DRYWALL, 'W': M.WOOD };

export function compileMap(def) {
  const levels = def.levels;
  const NL = levels.length;
  const D = Math.max(...levels.map(l => l.rows.length));
  const W = Math.max(...levels.map(l => Math.max(...l.rows.map(r => r.length))));
  const N = NL * W * D;
  const w = {
    id: def.id, def, NL, W, D, N,
    cell: new Uint8Array(N), floorMat: new Uint8Array(N), wallMat: new Uint8Array(N),
    indoor: new Uint8Array(N), slab: new Uint8Array(N), // slab[L] = 階Lの床の板があるか（L=0は地面）
    arms: new Uint8Array(N), thick: new Float32Array(N),
    boxes: new Float32Array(N * 8), nbox: new Uint8Array(N),
    blocks0: new Uint8Array(N * NB), blocks: null, bhp: null,
    stairs: [], stairAt: new Int16Array(N).fill(-1),
    doors: [], doorAt: new Int16Array(N).fill(-1), doorNear: new Map(),
    windows: [],
    props: [], propNear: new Map(),
    rooms: [], roomAt: new Int16Array(N).fill(-1),
    errors: [],
  };
  const idx = (L, i, j) => (L * D + j) * W + i;
  w.idx = idx;
  const ch = (L, i, j) => { if (L < 0 || L >= NL || i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= W || j >= D) return ' '; const r = levels[L].rows[j]; return (r && r[i]) || ' '; };
  const defFloor = def.floor || F.TILE;
  // 1) マスの種類
  for (let L = 0; L < NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) {
    const c = ch(L, i, j), k = idx(L, i, j);
    if (c in FLOOR_CH) { w.cell[k] = C.FLOOR; w.floorMat[k] = FLOOR_CH[c] < 0 ? defFloor : FLOOR_CH[c]; w.indoor[k] = 1; }
    else if (c in OUT_CH) { w.cell[k] = C.OUT; w.floorMat[k] = OUT_CH[c]; }
    else if (c in WALL_CH) { w.cell[k] = C.WALL; w.wallMat[k] = WALL_CH[c]; }
    else if (c === 'D') { w.cell[k] = C.DOOR; w.wallMat[k] = M.DOORWOOD; }
    else if (c === 'M') { w.cell[k] = C.DOOR; w.wallMat[k] = M.DOORMETAL; }
    else if (c === 'O') { w.cell[k] = C.OPEN; }
    else if (c === 'G') { w.cell[k] = C.WINDOW; }
    else if (c === 'g') { w.cell[k] = C.GLASSWALL; }
    else if (c === 'L') { w.cell[k] = C.LOW; w.wallMat[k] = M.CONCRETE; }
    else if (c === 'F') { w.cell[k] = C.FENCE; w.wallMat[k] = M.FENCE; }
    else if (c === 'S') { w.cell[k] = C.STAIR; w.indoor[k] = 1; w.floorMat[k] = F.WOOD; }
    else if (c === 's') { w.cell[k] = C.STAIR; w.indoor[k] = 0; w.floorMat[k] = F.CONCRETE; } // 外の階段（屋根なし）
    else if (c !== ' ') w.errors.push(`知らない文字 '${c}' (${L},${i},${j})`);
  }
  const T = (L, i, j) => (L < 0 || L >= NL || i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= W || j >= D) ? C.VOID : w.cell[idx(L, i, j)];
  // 壁の材質のない壁マス（扉・窓・開口）は、壁の線の隣から材質と厚さをもらう
  const nbWallMat = (L, i, j) => {
    for (const [di, dj] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1], [2, 0], [-2, 0], [0, 2], [0, -2], [3, 0], [-3, 0], [0, 3], [0, -3]]) {
      const t = T(L, i + di, j + dj);
      if (t === C.WALL) return w.wallMat[idx(L, i + di, j + dj)];
    }
    return M.DRYWALL;
  };
  // 屋内に面しているか
  // 屋内の床か（外の階段は屋外）
  const inCell = (L, i, j) => { const t = T(L, i, j); return t === C.FLOOR || (t === C.STAIR && w.indoor[idx(L, i, j)] === 1); };
  const nearIndoor = (L, i, j) => { for (const [di, dj] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) { if (inCell(L, i + di, j + dj)) return true; } return false; };
  // 2) 床の材質（壁マス・扉マスの床は隣の床から）
  for (let L = 0; L < NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) {

    if (isWallish(t)) {

      for (const [di, dj] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) { const t2 = T(L, i + di, j + dj); if (t2 === C.FLOOR || t2 === C.OUT || t2 === C.STAIR) { const k2 = idx(L, i + di, j + dj); if (!fm || t2 === C.FLOOR) fm = w.floorMat[k2]; if (inCell(L, i + di, j + dj)) ind = 1; } }
      w.floorMat[k] = fm || F.CONCRETE;
      w.indoor[k] = ind ? 2 : 0; // 2 = 屋内に面した壁（天井の板がある）
      if (!w.wallMat[k]) w.wallMat[k] = nbWallMat(L, i, j);
    }
  }
  // 3) 階段
  for (const sd of (def.stairs || [])) {
    const s = { id: w.stairs.length, i0: sd.i, j0: sd.j, w: sd.w, len: sd.len, dir: sd.dir, L: sd.L || 0 };
    // 上がる向き: 'n' = -z, 's' = +z, 'e' = +x, 'w' = -x
    const alongX = s.dir === 'e' || s.dir === 'w';
    s.iw = alongX ? s.len : s.w; s.jw = alongX ? s.w : s.len;
    s.x0 = s.i0 * CS; s.z0 = s.j0 * CS; s.x1 = (s.i0 + s.iw) * CS; s.z1 = (s.j0 + s.jw) * CS;
    for (let jj = 0; jj < s.jw; jj++) for (let ii = 0; ii < s.iw; ii++) {
      const i = s.i0 + ii, j = s.j0 + jj;
      if (T(s.L, i, j) !== C.STAIR) w.errors.push(`階段の範囲が 'S' ではない (${s.L},${i},${j})`);
      w.stairAt[idx(s.L, i, j)] = s.id;
      if (s.L + 1 < NL) { if (T(s.L + 1, i, j) !== C.STAIR) w.errors.push(`階段の上の階が 'S' ではない (${s.L + 1},${i},${j})`); w.stairAt[idx(s.L + 1, i, j)] = s.id; }
    }
    w.stairs.push(s);
  }
  // 4) 床の板: 階L（L>=1）は、その階の床・壁、または下の階が屋内なら板がある。階段の吹き抜けは除く
  for (let L = 0; L < NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) {
    const k = idx(L, i, j);
    if (L === 0) { w.slab[k] = w.cell[k] !== C.VOID ? 1 : 0; continue; }
    const t = w.cell[k];
    const st = w.stairAt[k] >= 0 && w.stairs[w.stairAt[k]].L === L - 1;
    if (st) { w.slab[k] = 0; continue; }
    const below = idx(L - 1, i, j);
    const belowIndoor = w.cell[below] === C.FLOOR || w.indoor[below] === 2 || w.cell[below] === C.STAIR;
    w.slab[k] = (t !== C.VOID && t !== C.STAIR) || belowIndoor ? 1 : 0;
  }
  // 最上階より上の屋根: 最上階の屋内マス（roof()で判定）
  // 5) 壁の腕と厚さと箱
  for (let L = 0; L < NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) {

    // 扉は壁の線に沿う向きだけつなぐ
    if (t === C.DOOR || t === C.OPEN) {

      const zLine = isWallish(T(L, i, j - 1)) || isWallish(T(L, i, j + 1));
      if (xLine && !(zLine && !xLine)) arms &= 3; else if (zLine) arms &= 12;
    }
    w.arms[k] = arms;
