    const k = idx(L, i, j), t = w.cell[k], b = k * NB;
    const wm = w.wallMat[k];
    if (t === C.WALL) for (let q = 0; q < NB; q++) w.blocks0[b + q] = wm;
    else if (t === C.DOOR || t === C.OPEN) { w.blocks0[b + 3] = nbWallMat(L, i, j); }
    else if (t === C.WINDOW) { const m = nbWallMat(L, i, j); w.blocks0[b] = m; w.blocks0[b + 1] = M.GLASS; w.blocks0[b + 2] = M.GLASS; w.blocks0[b + 3] = m; }
    else if (t === C.GLASSWALL) { w.blocks0[b] = M.GLASS; w.blocks0[b + 1] = M.GLASS; w.blocks0[b + 2] = M.GLASS; w.blocks0[b + 3] = nbWallMat(L, i, j); }
    else if (t === C.LOW) { w.blocks0[b] = M.CONCRETE; }
    else if (t === C.FENCE) { w.blocks0[b] = M.FENCE; w.blocks0[b + 1] = M.FENCE; w.blocks0[b + 2] = M.FENCE; }
    // 外に面した（屋内に面していない）壁は上のブロックを省く（塀など）。ただし屋内に面した壁は天井まで
    if (t === C.WALL && !nearIndoor(L, i, j) && !(def.tallOutside)) {
      // 屋外の塀: 2.1m（3ブロック）
      if (!isIndoorWallLine(w, L, i, j, T, idx)) w.blocks0[b + 3] = 0;
    }
  }
  w.blocks = w.blocks0.slice();
  w.bhp = new Uint16Array(N * NB);
  for (let q = 0; q < N * NB; q++) w.bhp[q] = MATS[w.blocks[q]] ? MATS[w.blocks[q]].hp : 0;
  // 7) 扉（2マス＝片開き、4マス＝両開き）
  const seen = new Uint8Array(N);
  const dOpts = def.doors || {};
  for (let L = 0; L < NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) {
    const k = idx(L, i, j);
    if (w.cell[k] !== C.DOOR || seen[k]) continue;
    // 並びの向き
    let axis = -1, n = 0;
    if (T(L, i + 1, j) === C.DOOR) { axis = 0; while (T(L, i + n, j) === C.DOOR) { seen[idx(L, i + n, j)] = 1; n++; } }
    else if (T(L, i, j + 1) === C.DOOR) { axis = 1; while (T(L, i, j + n) === C.DOOR) { seen[idx(L, i, j + n)] = 1; n++; } }
    else { w.errors.push(`扉が1マスしかない (${L},${i},${j})`); seen[k] = 1; continue; }
    if (n !== 2 && n !== 4) w.errors.push(`扉の幅は2か4マス (${L},${i},${j}, ${n})`);
    const o = dOpts[`${i},${j},${L}`] || {};
    const d = { id: w.doors.length, L, axis, i0: i, j0: j, n, mat: w.wallMat[k], double: n >= 4, opt: o, cells: [] };
    for (let q = 0; q < n; q++) { const kk = axis === 0 ? idx(L, i + q, j) : idx(L, i, j + q); d.cells.push(kk); w.doorAt[kk] = d.id; }
    // 開口の両端（壁の中心線上）
    const a0 = axis === 0 ? i * CS : j * CS, a1 = a0 + n * CS, c = axis === 0 ? (j + 0.5) * CS : (i + 0.5) * CS;
    d.a0 = a0; d.a1 = a1; d.c = c;
    d.th = w.thick[k];
    // 扉の板: 蝶番の位置と、蝶番から先端への向き（閉じた状態）
    const hingeB = o.hinge === 'b';
    const leaf = (from, dir) => { const lf = { hx: axis === 0 ? from : c, hz: axis === 0 ? c : from, dx: axis === 0 ? dir : 0, dz: axis === 0 ? 0 : dir, len: (n >= 4 ? (n * CS) / 2 : n * CS) - 0.04 }; const nx = axis === 0 ? 0 : 1, nz = axis === 0 ? 1 : 0; lf.s = Math.sign(lf.dx * nz - lf.dz * nx) || 1; return lf; };
    if (d.double) d.leaves = [leaf(a0 + 0.02, 1), leaf(a1 - 0.02, -1)];
    else d.leaves = [hingeB ? leaf(a1 - 0.02, -1) : leaf(a0 + 0.02, 1)];
    // 扉の法線（開く向きの基準）: axis 0 → ±z、axis 1 → ±x
    d.nx = axis === 0 ? 0 : 1; d.nz = axis === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    d.cx = axis === 0 ? (a0 + a1) / 2 : c; d.cz = axis === 0 ? c : (a0 + a1) / 2;
    w.doors.push(d);
    // 板が通る範囲のマスに登録
    for (const lf of d.leaves) {
      const R = lf.len + 0.1;
      for (let jj = Math.floor((lf.hz - R) / CS); jj <= Math.floor((lf.hz + R) / CS); jj++) for (let ii = Math.floor((lf.hx - R) / CS); ii <= Math.floor((lf.hx + R) / CS); ii++) {
        if (ii < 0 || jj < 0 || ii >= W || jj >= D) continue;
        const kk = idx(L, ii, jj);
        let arr = w.doorNear.get(kk); if (!arr) w.doorNear.set(kk, arr = []);
        if (!arr.includes(d.id)) arr.push(d.id);
      }
    }
  }
  // 8) 窓（ガラスのブロックを持つマス）
  for (let L = 0; L < NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) {
    const k = idx(L, i, j);
    if (w.cell[k] === C.WINDOW || w.cell[k] === C.GLASSWALL) w.windows.push(k);
  }
  // 9) 家具
  for (const p of (def.props || [])) addProp(w, p);
  // 10) 部屋（床のつながり。扉・開口・窓で区切る）
  buildRooms(w, def);
  w.layers = NL;
  return w;
}

function isIndoorWallLine(w, L, i, j, T, idx) {
  // 壁の線をたどって、どこかで屋内に面していれば建物の壁（天井まで）
  for (const [di, dj] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) {
    for (let s = 1; s <= 6; s++) {
      const t = T(L, i + di * s, j + dj * s);
      if (!isWallish(t)) break;
      for (const [ei, ej] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) { const ii = i + di * s + ei, jj = j + dj * s + ej, t2 = T(L, ii, jj); if (t2 === C.FLOOR || (t2 === C.STAIR && w.indoor[idx(L, ii, jj)] === 1)) return true; }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

// 家具を置く: [種類, x(マス), z(マス), 階, 向き(0..3), {w,d,h, color, ...}]
export function addProp(w, p) {
  const [type, xc, zc, L = 0, rot = 0, o = {}] = p;
  const P = PROPS[type];
  if (!P) { w.errors.push('知らない家具 ' + type); return null; }
  const sx = o.w ? o.w / P.w : 1, sz = o.d ? o.d / P.d : 1, sy = o.h ? o.h / P.h : 1;
  const x = xc * CS, z = zc * CS, y = L * LH + (o.y || 0);
  const r = ((rot % 4) + 4) % 4;
  const boxes = P.boxes.map(b => {
    let [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, m] = b;
    x0 *= sx; x1 *= sx; z0 *= sz; z1 *= sz; y0 *= sy; y1 *= sy;
    // 90°ずつ回す
    let X0 = x0, X1 = x1, Z0 = z0, Z1 = z1;
    if (r === 1) { X0 = -z1; X1 = -z0; Z0 = x0; Z1 = x1; }
    else if (r === 2) { X0 = -x1; X1 = -x0; Z0 = -z1; Z1 = -z0; }
    else if (r === 3) { X0 = z0; X1 = z1; Z0 = -x1; Z1 = -x0; }
    return [x + X0, y + y0, z + Z0, x + X1, y + y1, z + Z1, m];
  });
  const fw = (P.foot ? P.foot[0] : P.w) * sx, fd = (P.foot ? P.foot[1] : P.d) * sz;
  const fx = (r % 2) ? fd : fw, fz = (r % 2) ? fw : fd;
  const prop = { id: w.props.length, type, x, y, z, L, rot: r, sx, sy, sz, w: fx, d: fz, h: P.h * sy, boxes, solid: !!P.solid, vault: !!P.vault, hide: P.hide || null, opt: o, alive: true };
  w.props.push(prop);
  const R = 0.05;
  for (let j = Math.floor((z - fz / 2 - R) / CS); j <= Math.floor((z + fz / 2 + R) / CS); j++) for (let i = Math.floor((x - fx / 2 - R) / CS); i <= Math.floor((x + fx / 2 + R) / CS); i++) {
    if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) continue;
    const k = w.idx(L, i, j);
    let arr = w.propNear.get(k); if (!arr) w.propNear.set(k, arr = []);
    arr.push(prop.id);
  }
  return prop;
}

function buildRooms(w, def) {
  const { W, D, NL } = w;
  const named = def.rooms || [];
  for (let L = 0; L < NL; L++) for (let j = 0; j < D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) {
    const k = w.idx(L, i, j);
    const t = w.cell[k];
    if (w.roomAt[k] >= 0 || !(t === C.FLOOR || t === C.OUT || t === C.STAIR)) continue;
    const isOut = (kk, tt) => tt === C.OUT || (tt === C.STAIR && !w.indoor[kk]);
    const id = w.rooms.length, out = isOut(k, t);
    const room = { id, L, out, cells: [], name: null, en: null, x0: 1e9, z0: 1e9, x1: -1e9, z1: -1e9 };
    const stack = [[i, j]];
    w.roomAt[k] = id;
    while (stack.length) {
      const [ci, cj] = stack.pop();
      const kk = w.idx(L, ci, cj);
      room.cells.push(kk);
      room.x0 = Math.min(room.x0, ci); room.x1 = Math.max(room.x1, ci); room.z0 = Math.min(room.z0, cj); room.z1 = Math.max(room.z1, cj);
      for (const [di, dj] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) {
        const ni = ci + di, nj = cj + dj;
        if (ni < 0 || nj < 0 || ni >= W || nj >= D) continue;
        const k2 = w.idx(L, ni, nj), t2 = w.cell[k2];
        if (w.roomAt[k2] >= 0) continue;
        if (isOut(k2, t2) !== out) continue;
        if (!(t2 === C.FLOOR || t2 === C.OUT || t2 === C.STAIR)) continue;
        w.roomAt[k2] = id; stack.push([ni, nj]);
      }
    }
    room.cx = ((room.x0 + room.x1 + 1) / 2) * CS; room.cz = ((room.z0 + room.z1 + 1) / 2) * CS;
    w.rooms.push(room);
  }
  for (const [name, en, i, j, L = 0] of named) {
    const k = w.idx(L, i, j), r = w.roomAt[k];
    if (r < 0) { w.errors.push(`部屋の名前の位置が床ではない: ${name} (${L},${i},${j})`); continue; }
    w.rooms[r].name = name; w.rooms[r].en = en;
  }
  let n = 1;
  for (const r of w.rooms) if (!r.name) { r.name = r.out ? '屋外' : `部屋${n}`; r.en = r.out ? 'OUTSIDE' : `ROOM ${n}`; if (!r.out) n++; }
}

// ---- 調べる道具 ----
export function cellOf(w, x, z) { return [Math.floor(x / CS), Math.floor(z / CS)]; }
export function levelOfY(y) { return Math.max(0, Math.floor((y + 0.4) / LH)); }
export function inMap(w, i, j) { return i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < w.W && j < w.D; }
export function cellType(w, L, i, j) { if (L < 0 || L >= w.NL || !inMap(w, i, j)) return C.VOID; return w.cell[w.idx(L, i, j)]; }

// 階段の坂の高さ（その階段の上にいるとき）
export function stairHeight(w, s, x, z) {
  let t;
  if (s.dir === 'n') t = (s.z1 - z) / (s.z1 - s.z0);
  else if (s.dir === 's') t = (z - s.z0) / (s.z1 - s.z0);
  else if (s.dir === 'e') t = (x - s.x0) / (s.x1 - s.x0);
  else t = (s.x1 - x) / (s.x1 - s.x0);
  t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
  return s.L * LH + t * LH;
}

// 足元の高さ: y（足の高さ）から STEP 以内で上にある、いちばん高い床
export function groundAt(w, x, z, y) {
  const i = Math.floor(x / CS), j = Math.floor(z / CS);
  if (!inMap(w, i, j)) return -100;
  let best = -100;
  for (let L = 0; L < w.NL; L++) {
    const k = w.idx(L, i, j);
    const s = w.stairAt[k];
    if (s >= 0 && w.stairs[s].L === L) {
      const h = stairHeight(w, w.stairs[s], x, z);
      if (h <= y + STEP + 0.02) { if (h > best) best = h; }
      else if (L * LH <= y + STEP && L * LH > best) best = L * LH; // 坂の下に入りこんだ（押し出されるまで床に立つ）
      continue;
    }
    if (s >= 0 && w.stairs[s].L === L - 1) continue; // 吹き抜け
    if (w.slab[k] || (L === 0 && w.cell[k] !== C.VOID)) {
      const h = L * LH;
      if (h <= y + STEP && h > best) best = h;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

// 円（半径r、高さ y0..y1）が壁・家具・扉にめり込んでいたら押し出す。戻り値: 押し出した量 [dx, dz, 当たったか]
export function pushOut(w, x, z, y0, y1, r, doorsState, ignoreProp = -1, out = [0, 0, 0]) {
  let px = x, pz = z, hit = 0, pm = 0, pass = 0;
  const i0 = Math.floor((x - r - 0.3) / CS), i1 = Math.floor((x + r + 0.3) / CS);
  const j0 = Math.floor((z - r - 0.3) / CS), j1 = Math.floor((z + r + 0.3) / CS);
  const L0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(y0 / LH)), L1 = Math.min(w.NL - 1, Math.floor(y1 / LH));
  for (pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
    for (let L = L0; L <= L1; L++) {
      const base = L * LH;
      for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
        if (!inMap(w, i, j)) {
          // 地図の外は壁
          const cx = Math.max(i * CS, Math.min((i + 1) * CS, px)), cz = Math.max(j * CS, Math.min((j + 1) * CS, pz));
          const dx = px - cx, dz = pz - cz, d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
          if (d2 < r * r) { const d = Math.sqrt(d2) || 1e-4; px += dx / d * (r - d) || 0; pz += dz / d * (r - d) || 0; hit = 1; if (pass) pm = Math.max(pm, r - d); }
          continue;
        }
        const k = w.idx(L, i, j);
        const t = w.cell[k];
        if (t === C.VOID && L === levelOfY(y0 + 0.1)) {
          // 何もないマス（建物の外の空白）も通れない
          const cx = Math.max(i * CS, Math.min((i + 1) * CS, px)), cz = Math.max(j * CS, Math.min((j + 1) * CS, pz));
          const dx = px - cx, dz = pz - cz, d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
          if (d2 < r * r) { const d = Math.sqrt(d2) || 1e-4; px += (dx / d) * (r - d); pz += (dz / d) * (r - d); hit = 1; if (pass) pm = Math.max(pm, r - d); }
        }
        if (isWallish(t)) {
          const nb = w.nbox[k], bb = k * NB;
          for (let q = 0; q < NB; q++) {
            const m = w.blocks[bb + q];
            if (!m || m === M.GLASSBROKEN) continue;
            const by0 = base + q * BH, by1 = by0 + BH;
            if (by1 <= y0 || by0 >= y1) continue;
            // 板の継ぎ目で引っかからないように: 隣のマスへ同じ面で続く板は延ばして考え、
            // 1マスの箱（T字の腕など）のうち一番深くめり込んだものだけで押す
            let best = null, bm = 0;
            for (let n = 0; n < nb; n++) {
              const o = k * 8 + n * 4;
              let x0 = w.boxes[o], z0 = w.boxes[o + 1], x1 = w.boxes[o + 2], z1 = w.boxes[o + 3];
              if (x0 <= i * CS + 1e-6 && solidAt(w, L, i - 1, j, q)) x0 -= r;
              if (x1 >= (i + 1) * CS - 1e-6 && solidAt(w, L, i + 1, j, q)) x1 += r;
              if (z0 <= j * CS + 1e-6 && solidAt(w, L, i, j - 1, q)) z0 -= r;
              if (z1 >= (j + 1) * CS - 1e-6 && solidAt(w, L, i, j + 1, q)) z1 += r;
              const r2 = circleBox(px, pz, r, x0, z0, x1, z1);
              if (r2) { const mm = Math.abs(r2[0]) + Math.abs(r2[1]); if (mm > bm) { bm = mm; best = r2; } }
            }
            if (best) { px += best[0]; pz += best[1]; hit = 1; if (pass) pm = Math.max(pm, bm); }
            break; // 1マスにつき1回押せば十分（同じ箱）
          }
        }
        // 階段: 坂の面が足（y0 = 足+段差）より高い所は壁と同じ。横から乗れず、上の端の下にも入れない
        const sa = w.stairAt[k];
        if (sa >= 0 && w.stairs[sa].L === L) {
          const cx = Math.max(i * CS, Math.min((i + 1) * CS, px)), cz = Math.max(j * CS, Math.min((j + 1) * CS, pz));
          if (stairHeight(w, w.stairs[sa], cx, cz) > y0 + 0.02) {
            const r2 = circleBox(px, pz, r, i * CS, j * CS, (i + 1) * CS, (j + 1) * CS);
            if (r2) { px += r2[0]; pz += r2[1]; hit = 1; if (pass) pm = Math.max(pm, Math.abs(r2[0]) + Math.abs(r2[1])); }
          }
        }
        const pr = w.propNear.get(k);
        if (pr) for (const pid of pr) {
          if (pid === ignoreProp) continue;
          const p = w.props[pid];
          if (!p.solid || !p.alive) continue;
          for (const b of p.boxes) {
            if (b[4] <= y0 || b[1] >= y1) continue;
            const r2 = circleBox(px, pz, r, b[0], b[2], b[3], b[5]);
            if (r2) { px += r2[0]; pz += r2[1]; hit = 1; if (pass) pm = Math.max(pm, Math.abs(r2[0]) + Math.abs(r2[1])); }
          }
        }
        const dn = doorsState && w.doorNear.get(k);
        if (dn) for (const did of dn) {
          const ds = doorsState[did];
          if (!ds || ds.broken) continue;
          const d = w.doors[did];
          if (d.L !== L) continue;
          if (base + 2.1 <= y0 || base >= y1) continue;
          for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) {
            const lf = d.leaves[li], ang = ds.ang[li];
            const [ex, ez] = leafEnd(lf, ang);
            const r2 = circleSeg(px, pz, r + 0.025, lf.hx, lf.hz, ex, ez);
            if (r2) { px += r2[0]; pz += r2[1]; hit = 1; if (pass) pm = Math.max(pm, Math.abs(r2[0]) + Math.abs(r2[1])); }
          }
          // バリケード
          if (ds.bar > 0) {
            const bx = barricadeBox(d);
            const r2 = circleBox(px, pz, r, bx[0], bx[1], bx[2], bx[3]);
            if (r2) { px += r2[0]; pz += r2[1]; hit = 1; if (pass) pm = Math.max(pm, Math.abs(r2[0]) + Math.abs(r2[1])); }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  out[0] = px - x; out[1] = pz - z; out[2] = hit; out[3] = pm; // out[3]: 2回目の押し出しの最大（0に近ければ収まっている）
  return out;
}

// そのマスのその高さに、ぶつかる壁のブロックがあるか
function solidAt(w, L, i, j, q) {
  if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) return false;
  const k = w.idx(L, i, j);
  if (!isWallish(w.cell[k])) return false;
  const m = w.blocks[k * NB + q];
  return !!m && m !== M.GLASSBROKEN;
}

export function leafEnd(lf, ang) {
  const c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang);
  // 閉じた向き (dx,dz) を ang だけ回す（Y軸まわり）
  const dx = lf.dx * c - lf.dz * s, dz = lf.dx * s + lf.dz * c;
  return [lf.hx + dx * lf.len, lf.hz + dz * lf.len];
}
export function barricadeBox(d) {
  const h = 0.05;
  return d.axis === 0 ? [d.a0, d.c - d.th / 2 - h, d.a1, d.c - d.th / 2 + 0.01] : [d.c - d.th / 2 - h, d.a0, d.c - d.th / 2 + 0.01, d.a1];
}

function circleBox(px, pz, r, x0, z0, x1, z1) {
  const cx = px < x0 ? x0 : px > x1 ? x1 : px, cz = pz < z0 ? z0 : pz > z1 ? z1 : pz;
  let dx = px - cx, dz = pz - cz;
  const d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
  if (d2 >= r * r) return null;
  if (d2 > 1e-10) { const d = Math.sqrt(d2); return [dx / d * (r - d), dz / d * (r - d)]; }
  // 中心が箱の中: いちばん近い辺へ
  const l = px - x0, rr = x1 - px, t = pz - z0, b = z1 - pz;
  const m = Math.min(l, rr, t, b);
  if (m === l) return [-(l + r), 0]; if (m === rr) return [rr + r, 0]; if (m === t) return [0, -(t + r)]; return [0, b + r];
}
function circleSeg(px, pz, r, ax, az, bx, bz) {
  const vx = bx - ax, vz = bz - az, L2 = vx * vx + vz * vz || 1e-9;
  let t = ((px - ax) * vx + (pz - az) * vz) / L2; t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t;
  const cx = ax + vx * t, cz = az + vz * t, dx = px - cx, dz = pz - cz, d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
  if (d2 >= r * r) return null;
  const d = Math.sqrt(d2) || 1e-4;
  return [dx / d * (r - d), dz / d * (r - d)];
}

// ---- 光線（弾・視線）----
// 当たった物を近い順に返す: {t0, t1, kind:'block'|'slab'|'prop'|'door'|'stair'|'bar', mat, k, q, id, nx, ny, nz}
// opt.stopOpaque: 視線用（最初の見えない物で止める）、opt.max: 距離
const _seenP = new Set(), _seenD = new Set();
export function raycast(w, ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, max, doorsState, opt = {}) {
  const hits = opt.out || [];
  hits.length = 0;
  let i = Math.floor(ox / CS), j = Math.floor(oz / CS);
  const stepI = dx > 0 ? 1 : -1, stepJ = dz > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  const tdI = dx !== 0 ? Math.abs(CS / dx) : Infinity, tdJ = dz !== 0 ? Math.abs(CS / dz) : Infinity;
  let tmI = dx !== 0 ? ((dx > 0 ? (i + 1) * CS - ox : ox - i * CS) / Math.abs(dx)) : Infinity;
  let tmJ = dz !== 0 ? ((dz > 0 ? (j + 1) * CS - oz : oz - j * CS) / Math.abs(dz)) : Infinity;
  let t = 0;
  const seenProp = opt.seenProp || _seenP; seenProp.clear();
  const seenDoor = opt.seenDoor || _seenD; seenDoor.clear();
  let guard = 0;
  let stopAt = max;
  while (t < stopAt && guard++ < 4000) {
    const tNext = Math.min(tmI, tmJ, max);
    if (!inMap(w, i, j)) { hits.push({ t0: t, t1: t, kind: 'edge', mat: M.CONCRETE }); break; }
    // このマスの中の区間 [t, tNext]
    const ya = oy + dy * t, yb = oy + dy * tNext;
    const ylo = Math.min(ya, yb), yhi = Math.max(ya, yb);
    for (let L = 0; L < w.NL; L++) {
      const base = L * LH;
      if (yhi < base - SLAB - 0.01 || ylo > base + LH) continue;
      const k = w.idx(L, i, j), tt = w.cell[k];
      // 床の板
      if (w.slab[k] || (L === 0 && tt !== C.VOID)) {
        const r = rayBox(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, i * CS, base - (L === 0 ? 1 : SLAB), j * CS, (i + 1) * CS, base, (j + 1) * CS);
        if (r && r[0] < stopAt && r[1] > 0) { hits.push({ t0: Math.max(0, r[0]), t1: r[1], kind: 'slab', mat: L === 0 ? M.CONCRETE : M.CONCRETE, k, nx: r[2], ny: r[3], nz: r[4], L }); }
      }
      // 最上階の屋根
      if (L === w.NL - 1 && (w.cell[k] === C.FLOOR || w.indoor[k] === 2 || (w.cell[k] === C.STAIR && w.indoor[k]))) {
        const r = rayBox(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, i * CS, base + CEIL, j * CS, (i + 1) * CS, base + LH, (j + 1) * CS);
        if (r && r[1] > 0) hits.push({ t0: Math.max(0, r[0]), t1: r[1], kind: 'slab', mat: M.CONCRETE, k, nx: r[2], ny: r[3], nz: r[4], L: L + 1 });
      }
      if (isWallish(tt)) {
        const nb = w.nbox[k], bb = k * NB;
        for (let q = 0; q < NB; q++) {
          const m = w.blocks[bb + q];
          if (!m || m === M.GLASSBROKEN) continue;
          const by0 = base + q * BH, by1 = by0 + BH;
          if (yhi < by0 || ylo > by1) continue;
          for (let n = 0; n < nb; n++) {
            const o = k * 8 + n * 4;
            const r = rayBox(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, w.boxes[o], by0, w.boxes[o + 1], w.boxes[o + 2], by1, w.boxes[o + 3]);
            if (r && r[1] > 0 && r[0] < stopAt) hits.push({ t0: Math.max(0, r[0]), t1: r[1], kind: 'block', mat: m, k, q, nx: r[2], ny: r[3], nz: r[4], L });
          }
        }
      }
      // 階段（坂の下は詰まっている）
      const s = w.stairAt[k];
      if (s >= 0 && w.stairs[s].L === L) {
        const st = w.stairs[s];
        const r = rayStair(w, st, ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, t, tNext, i, j);
        if (r) hits.push({ t0: r[0], t1: r[0] + 0.3, kind: 'stair', mat: M.WOOD, k, nx: r[1], ny: r[2], nz: r[3], L });
      }
      // 家具
      const pr = w.propNear.get(k);
      if (pr) for (const pid of pr) {
        if (seenProp.has(pid)) continue;
        seenProp.add(pid);
        const p = w.props[pid];
        if (!p.alive) continue;
        for (const b of p.boxes) {
          const r = rayBox(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4], b[5]);
          if (r && r[1] > 0 && r[0] < stopAt) hits.push({ t0: Math.max(0, r[0]), t1: r[1], kind: 'prop', mat: b[6], id: pid, nx: r[2], ny: r[3], nz: r[4], L });
        }
      }
      // 扉
      const dn = doorsState && w.doorNear.get(k);
      if (dn) for (const did of dn) {
        if (seenDoor.has(did)) continue;
        seenDoor.add(did);
        const ds = doorsState[did], d = w.doors[did];
        if (!ds || d.L !== L) continue;
        if (!ds.broken) for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) {
          const lf = d.leaves[li], [ex, ez] = leafEnd(lf, ds.ang[li]);
          const r = raySlabSeg(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, lf.hx, lf.hz, ex, ez, 0.045, base, base + 2.06);
          if (r && r[1] > 0 && r[0] < stopAt) hits.push({ t0: Math.max(0, r[0]), t1: r[1], kind: 'door', mat: d.mat, id: did, leaf: li, nx: r[2], ny: 0, nz: r[3], L });
        }
        if (ds.bar > 0) {
          const bx = barricadeBox(d);
          const r = rayBox(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, bx[0], base, bx[1], bx[2], base + 2.1, bx[3]);
          if (r && r[1] > 0 && r[0] < stopAt) hits.push({ t0: Math.max(0, r[0]), t1: r[1], kind: 'bar', mat: M.BARRICADE, id: did, nx: r[2], ny: r[3], nz: r[4], L });
        }
      }
    }
    if (opt.stopOpaque && hits.length) {
      // このマスで見えない物に当たったら、そこで止める（それより先は調べない）
      let mn = Infinity;
      for (const h of hits) if (!MATS[h.mat] || !MATS[h.mat].see) { if (h.t0 < mn) mn = h.t0; }
      if (mn < stopAt) stopAt = mn;
    }
    if (tNext >= max) break;
    t = tNext;
    if (tmI < tmJ) { tmI += tdI; i += stepI; } else { tmJ += tdJ; j += stepJ; }
  }
  hits.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0);
  return hits;
}

// 視線が通るか（見えない物にさえぎられないか）
const _losOpt = { stopOpaque: true, out: [], seenProp: new Set(), seenDoor: new Set() };
export function los(w, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, doorsState) {
  const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay, dz = bz - az, L = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
  if (L < 1e-4) return true;
  const hits = raycast(w, ax, ay, az, dx / L, dy / L, dz / L, L - 0.05, doorsState, _losOpt);
  for (const h of hits) { if (h.t0 >= L - 0.05) break; const m = MATS[h.mat]; if (!m || !m.see) return false; }
  return true;
}
// 間にある壁の数（音のこもり方）
export function wallsBetween(w, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, doorsState, cap = 4) {
  const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay, dz = bz - az, L = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
  if (L < 1e-4) return 0;
  const hits = raycast(w, ax, ay, az, dx / L, dy / L, dz / L, L, doorsState, { out: [], seenProp: new Set(), seenDoor: new Set() });
  let n = 0, last = -1;
  for (const h of hits) { if (h.kind === 'prop') continue; if (h.t0 - last > 0.2) { n++; last = h.t1; } if (n >= cap) break; }
  return n;
}

// 光線と箱。戻り値 [tEnter, tExit, nx, ny, nz]（入る面の法線）
export function rayBox(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1) {
  let tmin = -Infinity, tmax = Infinity, nx = 0, ny = 0, nz = 0;
  if (Math.abs(dx) < 1e-12) { if (ox < x0 || ox > x1) return null; } else {
    let a = (x0 - ox) / dx, b = (x1 - ox) / dx, s = -1; if (a > b) { const q = a; a = b; b = q; s = 1; }
    if (a > tmin) { tmin = a; nx = dx > 0 ? -1 : 1; ny = 0; nz = 0; } if (b < tmax) tmax = b; if (tmin > tmax) return null;
  }
  if (Math.abs(dy) < 1e-12) { if (oy < y0 || oy > y1) return null; } else {
    let a = (y0 - oy) / dy, b = (y1 - oy) / dy; if (a > b) { const q = a; a = b; b = q; }
    if (a > tmin) { tmin = a; nx = 0; ny = dy > 0 ? -1 : 1; nz = 0; } if (b < tmax) tmax = b; if (tmin > tmax) return null;
  }
  if (Math.abs(dz) < 1e-12) { if (oz < z0 || oz > z1) return null; } else {
    let a = (z0 - oz) / dz, b = (z1 - oz) / dz; if (a > b) { const q = a; a = b; b = q; }
    if (a > tmin) { tmin = a; nx = 0; ny = 0; nz = dz > 0 ? -1 : 1; } if (b < tmax) tmax = b; if (tmin > tmax) return null;
  }
  if (tmax < 0) return null;
  return [tmin, tmax, nx, ny, nz];
}
// 光線と、縦に立った厚みのある線分（扉の板）
function raySlabSeg(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, ax, az, bx, bz, th, y0, y1) {
  // 板の座標系: u = 線分方向, v = 法線
  const ux = bx - ax, uz = bz - az, len = Math.hypot(ux, uz) || 1e-6;
  const uxn = ux / len, uzn = uz / len, vx = -uzn, vz = uxn;
  const lox = (ox - ax) * uxn + (oz - az) * uzn, loz = (ox - ax) * vx + (oz - az) * vz;
  const ldx = dx * uxn + dz * uzn, ldz = dx * vx + dz * vz;
  const r = rayBox(lox, oy, loz, ldx, dy, ldz, 0, y0, -th / 2, len, y1, th / 2);
  if (!r) return null;
  // 法線を世界へ（vの向き）
  const sgn = ldz > 0 ? -1 : 1;
  return [r[0], r[1], vx * sgn, vz * sgn];
}
// 階段の坂: マスの中の区間で、坂の面より下に入るか
function rayStair(w, st, ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, ta, tb, i, j) {
  const N = 6;
  let prev = null;
  for (let s = 0; s <= N; s++) {
    const t = ta + (tb - ta) * s / N;
    const x = ox + dx * t, y = oy + dy * t, z = oz + dz * t;
    const h = stairHeight(w, st, x, z);
    const below = y < h;
    if (prev !== null && below && !prev.below) {
      const n = st.dir === 'n' ? [0, 0.8, 0.6] : st.dir === 's' ? [0, 0.8, -0.6] : st.dir === 'e' ? [-0.6, 0.8, 0] : [0.6, 0.8, 0];
      return [t, n[0], n[1], n[2]];
    }
    if (s === 0 && below && y > st.L * LH + 0.01) return null; // 坂の下から（段の裏）は無視
    prev = { below };
  }
  return null;
}

// その階でいちばん近い床のマス（湧き位置の補正など）
export function nearestFloor(w, L, x, z, maxR = 6) {
  const ci = Math.floor(x / CS), cj = Math.floor(z / CS);
  // 同じ部屋（床のつながり）を先に探す: 家具をよけるときに壁の向こうへ移さない
  const k0 = L >= 0 && L < w.NL && inMap(w, ci, cj) ? w.idx(L, ci, cj) : -1;
  const room = k0 >= 0 ? w.roomAt[k0] : -1;
  for (let pass = room >= 0 ? 0 : 1; pass < 2; pass++) {
    for (let r = 0; r <= maxR / CS; r++) {
      for (let j = cj - r; j <= cj + r; j++) for (let i = ci - r; i <= ci + r; i++) {
        if (Math.max(Math.abs(i - ci), Math.abs(j - cj)) !== r) continue;
        const t = cellType(w, L, i, j);
        if (t === C.FLOOR || t === C.OUT) {
          const k = w.idx(L, i, j);
          if (pass === 0 && w.roomAt[k] !== room) continue;
          const pr = w.propNear.get(k);
          if (pr && pr.some(pid => { const p = w.props[pid]; return p.solid && Math.abs(p.x - (i + 0.5) * CS) < p.w / 2 + 0.2 && Math.abs(p.z - (j + 0.5) * CS) < p.d / 2 + 0.2; })) continue;
          return [(i + 0.5) * CS, (j + 0.5) * CS];
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// 速い見通しの判定（物を作らない）: a から b までに見えない物があれば true
// props: 家具も調べるか、doorsState: 扉を調べるか（null なら開いているものとして扱う）
export function occluded(w, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, doorsState = null, props = true) {
  const dx0 = bx - ax, dy0 = by - ay, dz0 = bz - az;
  const L = Math.hypot(dx0, dy0, dz0);
  if (L < 1e-4) return false;
  const dx = dx0 / L, dy = dy0 / L, dz = dz0 / L;
  let i = Math.floor(ax / CS), j = Math.floor(az / CS);
  const stepI = dx > 0 ? 1 : -1, stepJ = dz > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  const tdI = dx !== 0 ? Math.abs(CS / dx) : Infinity, tdJ = dz !== 0 ? Math.abs(CS / dz) : Infinity;
  let tmI = dx !== 0 ? ((dx > 0 ? (i + 1) * CS - ax : ax - i * CS) / Math.abs(dx)) : Infinity;
  let tmJ = dz !== 0 ? ((dz > 0 ? (j + 1) * CS - az : az - j * CS) / Math.abs(dz)) : Infinity;
  let t = 0, guard = 0;
  const maxT = L - 0.02;
  while (t < maxT && guard++ < 3000) {
    if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) return false;
    const tN = Math.min(tmI, tmJ, maxT);
    const ya = ay + dy * t, yb = ay + dy * tN, ylo = ya < yb ? ya : yb, yhi = ya < yb ? yb : ya;
    for (let Lv = 0; Lv < w.NL; Lv++) {
      const base = Lv * LH;
      if (yhi < base - SLAB - 0.01 || ylo > base + LH) continue;
      const k = (Lv * w.D + j) * w.W + i, tt = w.cell[k];
      if (Lv > 0 && w.slab[k] && ylo < base && yhi > base - SLAB) {
        if (segBox(ax, ay, az, dx, dy, dz, t, tN, i * CS, base - SLAB, j * CS, (i + 1) * CS, base, (j + 1) * CS)) return true;
      }
      if (Lv === 0 && ylo < 0 && tt !== C.VOID) return true;
      if (Lv === w.NL - 1 && yhi > base + CEIL && (tt === C.FLOOR || w.indoor[k] === 2 || (tt === C.STAIR && w.indoor[k]))) {
        if (segBox(ax, ay, az, dx, dy, dz, t, tN, i * CS, base + CEIL, j * CS, (i + 1) * CS, base + LH, (j + 1) * CS)) return true;
      }
      if (WALLISH.has(tt)) {
        const nb = w.nbox[k], bb = k * NB;
        for (let q = 0; q < NB; q++) {
          const m = w.blocks[bb + q];
          if (!m || MATS[m].see) continue;
          const by0 = base + q * BH, by1 = by0 + BH;
          if (yhi < by0 || ylo > by1) continue;
          for (let n = 0; n < nb; n++) {
            const o = k * 8 + n * 4;
            if (segBox(ax, ay, az, dx, dy, dz, t, tN, w.boxes[o], by0, w.boxes[o + 1], w.boxes[o + 2], by1, w.boxes[o + 3])) return true;
          }
        }
      }
      if (props) {
        const pr = w.propNear.get(k);
        if (pr) for (const pid of pr) {
          const p = w.props[pid];
          for (const b of p.boxes) { if (MATS[b[6]] && MATS[b[6]].see) continue; if (segBox(ax, ay, az, dx, dy, dz, 0, maxT, b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4], b[5])) return true; }
        }
      }
      if (doorsState) {
        const dn = w.doorNear.get(k);
        if (dn) for (const did of dn) {
          const ds = doorsState[did], d = w.doors[did];
          if (!ds || ds.broken || d.L !== Lv) continue;
          if (ds.bar > 0) return true;
          for (let li = 0; li < d.leaves.length; li++) {
            const lf = d.leaves[li], [ex, ez] = leafEnd(lf, ds.ang[li]);
            if (segSeg2(ax, az, ax + dx * maxT, az + dz * maxT, lf.hx, lf.hz, ex, ez)) {
              // 高さ
              const tt2 = segSegT(ax, az, dx, dz, lf.hx, lf.hz, ex, ez);
              const yy = ay + dy * tt2;
              if (yy > base && yy < base + 2.06 && tt2 > 0 && tt2 < maxT) return true;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (tN >= maxT) break;
    t = tN;
    if (tmI < tmJ) { tmI += tdI; i += stepI; } else { tmJ += tdJ; j += stepJ; }
  }
  return false;
}
function segBox(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, t0, t1, x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1) {
  let tmin = t0, tmax = t1;
  if (Math.abs(dx) < 1e-12) { if (ox < x0 || ox > x1) return false; } else { let a = (x0 - ox) / dx, b = (x1 - ox) / dx; if (a > b) { const q = a; a = b; b = q; } if (a > tmin) tmin = a; if (b < tmax) tmax = b; if (tmin > tmax) return false; }
  if (Math.abs(dy) < 1e-12) { if (oy < y0 || oy > y1) return false; } else { let a = (y0 - oy) / dy, b = (y1 - oy) / dy; if (a > b) { const q = a; a = b; b = q; } if (a > tmin) tmin = a; if (b < tmax) tmax = b; if (tmin > tmax) return false; }
  if (Math.abs(dz) < 1e-12) { if (oz < z0 || oz > z1) return false; } else { let a = (z0 - oz) / dz, b = (z1 - oz) / dz; if (a > b) { const q = a; a = b; b = q; } if (a > tmin) tmin = a; if (b < tmax) tmax = b; if (tmin > tmax) return false; }
  return true;
}
function segSeg2(ax, az, bx, bz, cx, cz, dx, dz) {
  const d1 = (dx - cx) * (az - cz) - (dz - cz) * (ax - cx), d2 = (dx - cx) * (bz - cz) - (dz - cz) * (bx - cx);
  const d3 = (bx - ax) * (cz - az) - (bz - az) * (cx - ax), d4 = (bx - ax) * (dz - az) - (bz - az) * (dx - ax);
  return ((d1 > 0) !== (d2 > 0)) && ((d3 > 0) !== (d4 > 0));
}
function segSegT(ax, az, dx, dz, cx, cz, ex, ez) {
  const rx = ex - cx, rz = ez - cz, den = dx * rz - dz * rx;
  if (Math.abs(den) < 1e-9) return -1;
  return ((cx - ax) * rz - (cz - az) * rx) / den;
}

// 部屋のコード（5文字）と招待リンク
// 見まちがえやすい字（0/O、1/I/L、2/Z、5/S、8/B など）は使わない
export const CODE_CHARS = 'ACDEFGHJKMNPQRTUVWXY34679';
export const CODE_LEN = 5;

export function makeCode(rnd = Math.random) {
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < CODE_LEN; i++) s += CODE_CHARS[Math.floor(rnd() * CODE_CHARS.length) % CODE_CHARS.length];
  return s;
}

// 小文字・空白・区切りは許す。使わない字が入っていたら null（別の部屋に入らないように）
export function normCode(v) {
  if (typeof v !== 'string') return null;
  const s = v.toUpperCase().replace(/[\s\-_]/g, '');
  if (s.length !== CODE_LEN) return null;
  for (const ch of s) if (!CODE_CHARS.includes(ch)) return null;
  return s;
}

// 招待リンク: ページのURL + #join=ABCDE（#join-ABCDE も受け付ける）
export function joinLink(code, href = (typeof location !== 'undefined' ? location.href : '')) {
  const base = String(href).split('#')[0];
  return base + '#join=' + code;
}
export function codeFromHash(hash = (typeof location !== 'undefined' ? location.hash : '')) {
  const m = /#join[-=]([A-Za-z0-9]{5})\b/.exec(hash || '');
  return m ? normCode(m[1]) : null;
}

// この端末（このタブ）の目印。読み込み直しても同じ（戻ってこられるように）
export function makeCid(rnd = Math.random) {
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) s += 'abcdefghijkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789'[Math.floor(rnd() * 32) % 32];
  return s;
}

// 通信路: ホストとゲストの間で「最新の状態」を運ぶ。届かないことがあっても、次の状態で上書きされる。
//  - NetLink : 公開のMQTTサーバーで中継し、つながればWebRTCで直接やりとりする（アプリ版。Claude版でも使えれば使う）
//  - RoomLink: Claudeの「部屋」（Claude版。招待されてログインしている人どうし）
//  - MultiLink: 両方を同時に使う（どちらで来た人とも遊べる）
import { Mqtt } from './mqtt.js';

export const BROKERS = [
  { name: 'EMQX', url: 'wss://broker.emqx.io:8084/mqtt' },
  { name: 'HiveMQ', url: 'wss://broker.hivemq.com:8884/mqtt' },
  { name: 'Mosquitto', url: 'wss://test.mosquitto.org:8081/mqtt' },
];
export const ICE = [{ urls: ['stun:stun.l.google.com:19302', 'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302'] }, { urls: 'stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478' }];
const PREFIX = 'hardentry/v1/';
const now = () => (typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now());
const rid = () => Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);

function iceDone(pc, ms) {
  return new Promise((res) => {
    if (pc.iceGatheringState === 'complete') { res(); return; }
    const t = setTimeout(res, ms);
    pc.addEventListener('icegatheringstatechange', () => { if (pc.iceGatheringState === 'complete') { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
  });
}
function anyOk(ps) {
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let left = ps.length, err = null;
    if (!left) { rej(new Error('なし')); return; }
    for (const p of ps) p.then(res, (e) => { err = e; if (--left === 0) rej(err); });
  });
}

export class NetLink {
  constructor({ code, role, cid, brokers = BROKERS, ice = ICE, p2p = true }) {
    this.kind = 'net'; this.code = code; this.role = role; this.cid = cid;
    this.brokers = brokers; this.ice = ice;
    this.p2pOn = !!p2p && typeof RTCPeerConnection !== 'undefined';
    this.T = PREFIX + code + '/';
    this.conns = [];
    this.peers = new Map(); // 相手 cid → { cid, b, at, pc, dc, open, tries, nextTry, xid }
    this.onMsg = () => {}; this.onGone = () => {}; this.onStatus = () => {};
    this.hostCid = null; this.main = null; this.closed = false;
    this.lastRelay = 0; this.relayEvery = 95;
    this.retry = {};
  }
  async open() {
    await anyOk(this.brokers.map((b, i) => this._connect(i)));
    this.timer = setInterval(() => this._tick(), 1000);
    return this;
  }
  _connect(i) {
    const b = this.brokers[i];
    const c = { i, b, ok: false, lastPub: 0, lastHb: 0 };
    c.mq = new Mqtt(b.url, { id: 'he-' + this.cid + '-' + rid(), onMsg: (t, m) => this._mqMsg(i, t, m), onClose: () => this._mqClose(i, c) });
    this.conns[i] = c;
    return c.mq.open(10000).then(() => {
      if (this.closed) { c.mq.close(); return c; }
      c.ok = true; this.retry[i] = 0;
      if (this.role === 'host') c.mq.sub(this.T + 'g/+', this.T + 's/' + this.cid);
      else c.mq.sub(this.T + 'h', this.T + 's/' + this.cid);
      this.onStatus(this.info());
      return c;
    }, (e) => { c.failed = true; throw e; });
  }
  _mqClose(i, c) {
    c.ok = false;
    if (this.closed || this.conns[i] !== c) return;
    if (this.role === 'guest' && this.main === i) {
      this.main = null;
      // 使っていたサーバーが落ちた: 閉じていたほかのサーバーにもつなぎ直して、ホストの声を探す
      this.brokers.forEach((b, j) => { if (j !== i && !this.conns[j]) this._connect(j).catch(() => {}); });
    }
    this.onStatus(this.info());
    // つなぎ直す（少しずつ間をあける）
    const n = (this.retry[i] = (this.retry[i] || 0) + 1);
    setTimeout(() => { if (!this.closed && this.conns[i] === c) this._connect(i).catch(() => {}); }, Math.min(15000, 800 * 2 ** Math.min(4, n)));
  }
  _peer(cid) { let P = this.peers.get(cid); if (!P) { P = { cid, b: null, at: 0, tries: 0, nextTry: 0 }; this.peers.set(cid, P); } return P; }
  _mqMsg(i, topic, text) {
    if (this.closed || text.length > 60000) return;
    let m; try { m = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { return; }
    if (!m || typeof m !== 'object') return;
    const rest = topic.slice(this.T.length);
    if (rest.startsWith('s/')) { this._signal(i, m); return; }
    if (this.role === 'host' && rest.startsWith('g/')) {
      const from = rest.slice(2);
      if (!/^[a-z0-9]{6,16}$/.test(from)) return;
      const P = this._peer(from); P.b = i; P.at = now();
      this.onMsg(from, m);
    } else if (this.role === 'guest' && rest === 'h') {
      if (typeof m.cid !== 'string') return;
      if (this.hostCid !== m.cid) { this.hostCid = m.cid; }
      if (this.main == null) {
        this.main = i;
        // 使わないほうのサーバーは少ししてから閉じる
        setTimeout(() => { for (const c of this.conns) if (c && c.i !== this.main && c.mq && !this.closed) { this.conns[c.i] = null; c.mq.close(); } }, 4000);
      }
      const P = this._peer(m.cid); P.b = i; P.at = now();
      this.onMsg(m.cid, m);
      this._maybeP2P();
    }
  }
  _relayConn() {
    if (this.main != null && this.conns[this.main] && this.conns[this.main].ok) return [this.conns[this.main]];
    return this.conns.filter(c => c && c.ok);
  }
  // 送る（ホスト: ゲスト全員へ。ゲスト: ホストへ）。force: 間引かない
  send(obj, force) {
    if (this.closed) return;
    const text = JSON.stringify(obj);
    const t = now();
    if (this.role === 'host') {
      const need = new Set();
      for (const P of this.peers.values()) {
        const live = this._live(P, t);
        if (P.dc && P.dc.readyState === 'open') { try { if (P.dc.bufferedAmount < 65536) P.dc.send(text); } catch (e) { /* なし */ } }
        if (!live && P.b != null && t - P.at < 30000) need.add(P.b);
      }
      const lobby = obj.ph !== 'game';
      for (const c of this.conns) {
        if (!c || !c.ok) continue;
        // 中継は 10回/秒まで。直接つながった人しかいないサーバーへは 1回/秒（戻ってくる人のため）
        const want = lobby || need.has(c.i) ? (force || t - c.lastPub >= this.relayEvery) : (force || t - c.lastHb >= 1000);
        if (!want || c.mq.backlog() > 262144) continue;
        c.mq.pub(this.T + 'h', text); c.lastPub = t; c.lastHb = t;
      }
    } else {
      const P = this.hostCid && this.peers.get(this.hostCid);
      const direct = P && this._live(P, t);
      if (direct) { try { P.dc.send(text); } catch (e) { /* なし */ } }
      // 直接つながっていても、1回/秒は中継でも送る（直接が切れたときにすぐ戻れる）
      if (!direct || force || t - this.lastRelay >= 1000) {
        if (force || t - this.lastRelay >= this.relayEvery) {
          for (const c of this._relayConn()) if (c.mq.backlog() < 262144) c.mq.pub(this.T + 'g/' + this.cid, text);
          this.lastRelay = t;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  // 直接の道が生きている（開いていて、相手からも最近届いている）
  _live(P, t = now()) { return !!(P && P.dc && P.dc.readyState === 'open' && t - (P.dcAt || 0) < 3000); }
  // ---- WebRTC（直接）
  _maybeP2P() {
    if (!this.p2pOn || this.role !== 'guest' || !this.hostCid) return;
    const P = this._peer(this.hostCid);
    if (P.pc || P.tries >= 3 || now() < P.nextTry) return;
    this._offer(P).catch((e) => { console.warn('p2p', e); this._dropP2P(P); });
  }
  async _offer(P) {
    P.tries++; P.xid = rid();
    const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: this.ice });
    P.pc = pc;
    this._wirePc(P, pc);
    this._wireDc(P, pc.createDataChannel('m', { ordered: false, maxRetransmits: 0 }));
    await pc.setLocalDescription(await pc.createOffer());
    await iceDone(pc, 3000);
    if (P.pc !== pc || this.closed) return;
    this._sig(P.cid, { k: 'offer', x: P.xid, sdp: pc.localDescription.sdp });
    clearTimeout(P.to);
    P.to = setTimeout(() => { if (P.pc === pc && !P.open) this._dropP2P(P); }, 15000);
  }
  async _answer(i, m) {
    const P = this._peer(m.f); P.b = i;
    if (P.pc) this._closePc(P);
    const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: this.ice });
    P.pc = pc; P.xid = m.x;
    this._wirePc(P, pc);
    pc.ondatachannel = (e) => this._wireDc(P, e.channel);
    await pc.setRemoteDescription({ type: 'offer', sdp: m.sdp });
    await pc.setLocalDescription(await pc.createAnswer());
    await iceDone(pc, 3000);
    if (P.pc !== pc || this.closed) return;
    this._sig(m.f, { k: 'answer', x: m.x, sdp: pc.localDescription.sdp }, i);
  }
  _signal(i, m) {
    if (typeof m.f !== 'string' || typeof m.sdp !== 'string' || m.sdp.length > 30000 || m.f === this.cid) return;
    if (this.role === 'host' && m.k === 'offer') { if (this.p2pOn) this._answer(i, m).catch((e) => console.warn('p2p', e)); }
    else if (this.role === 'guest' && m.k === 'answer') {
      const P = this.peers.get(m.f);
      if (P && P.pc && P.xid === m.x && P.pc.signalingState === 'have-local-offer') P.pc.setRemoteDescription({ type: 'answer', sdp: m.sdp }).catch(() => this._dropP2P(P));
    }
  }
  _sig(to, obj, via) {
    obj.f = this.cid;
    const text = JSON.stringify(obj);
    const c = (via != null && this.conns[via] && this.conns[via].ok) ? this.conns[via] : this._relayConn()[0];
    if (c) c.mq.pub(this.T + 's/' + to, text);
  }
  _wirePc(P, pc) {
    pc.onconnectionstatechange = () => {
      const st = pc.connectionState;
      if (st === 'failed' || st === 'closed') this._dropP2P(P);
      else if (st === 'disconnected') { clearTimeout(P.dto); P.dto = setTimeout(() => { if (pc.connectionState === 'disconnected') this._dropP2P(P); }, 5000); }
    };
  }
  _wireDc(P, dc) {
    P.dc = dc;
    dc.onopen = () => { P.open = true; P.dcAt = now(); clearTimeout(P.to); this.onStatus(this.info()); };
    dc.onclose = () => { if (P.dc === dc) this._dropP2P(P); };
    dc.onmessage = (e) => {
      if (typeof e.data !== 'string' || e.data.length > 60000) return;
      let m; try { m = JSON.parse(e.data); } catch (err) { return; }
      if (!m || typeof m !== 'object') return;
      P.at = now(); P.dcAt = P.at;
      this.onMsg(P.cid, m);
    };
  }
  _closePc(P) {
    try { P.dc && P.dc.close(); } catch (e) { /* なし */ }
    try { P.pc && P.pc.close(); } catch (e) { /* なし */ }
    P.dc = null; P.pc = null; P.open = false;
  }
  _dropP2P(P) {
    const was = P.open;
    this._closePc(P);
    P.nextTry = now() + 15000;
    if (was) this.onStatus(this.info());
  }
  _tick() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    // 直接のやりとりを、間をあけて試し直す
    if (this.role === 'guest') this._maybeP2P();
    // 長く何も来ない相手を忘れる
    const t = now();
    for (const [cid, P] of this.peers) if (t - P.at > 60000 && !P.open) { this._closePc(P); this.peers.delete(cid); this.onGone(cid); }
  }
  knows(cid) { const P = this.peers.get(cid); return !!(P && now() - P.at < 10000); }
  info() {
    const conns = this.conns.filter(c => c && c.ok).map(c => c.b.name);
    let p2p = 0, relay = 0;
    for (const P of this.peers.values()) { if (this._live(P)) p2p++; else if (P.b != null) relay++; }
    return { kind: 'net', servers: conns, p2p, relay };
  }
  close() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.closed = true;
    clearInterval(this.timer);
    for (const P of this.peers.values()) { clearTimeout(P.to); clearTimeout(P.dto); this._closePc(P); }
    for (const c of this.conns) if (c && c.mq) c.mq.close();
  }
}

// Claudeの「部屋」: 各自の presence に最新の状態を置く（4KBまで）
export class RoomLink {
  constructor({ code, role, cid, claude }) {
    this.kind = 'room'; this.code = code; this.role = role; this.cid = cid;
    this.cl = claude || globalThis.claude;
    this.onMsg = () => {}; this.onGone = () => {}; this.onStatus = () => {};
    this.closed = false; this.peerCid = new Map(); this.conn = false;
    this.enc = new TextEncoder();
  }
  async open() {
    const cl = this.cl;
    if (!cl || typeof cl.use !== 'function') throw new Error('noroom');
    const room = await cl.use('room');
    if (!room) throw new Error('noroom');
    this.rm = await room.join('he-' + this.code.toLowerCase());
    this.unsub = this.rm.onPeers((ch) => {
      for (const p of [...ch.joined, ...ch.updated]) {
        if (p.sameTab || p.kind !== 'viewer') continue;
        const m = p.presence && p.presence.m;
        if (!m || typeof m !== 'object' || typeof m.cid !== 'string') continue;
        this.peerCid.set(p.peer, m.cid);
        this.onMsg(m.cid, m);
      }
      for (const p of ch.left) { const cid = this.peerCid.get(p.peer); if (cid) { this.peerCid.delete(p.peer); this.onGone(cid); } }
    }, (e) => { this.conn = false; this.onStatus(this.info()); console.warn('room', e && e.code); });
    this.unconn = this.rm.onConnection((c) => { this.conn = !!c; this.onStatus(this.info()); });
    return this;
  }
  send(obj) {
    if (this.closed || !this.rm) return;
    let o = obj;
    let text = JSON.stringify(o);
    // 4KBを超えそうなら、出来事と名簿を減らす（次の状態で届く）
    if (this.enc.encode(text).length > 3900 && o.g) {
      o = { ...o, g: { ...o.g, E: (o.g.E || []).slice(-4) } };
      text = JSON.stringify(o);
      if (this.enc.encode(text).length > 3900) { o = { ...o }; delete o.ro; text = JSON.stringify(o); }
    }
    if (this.enc.encode(text).length > 4000) return;
    this.rm.presence({ m: o }).catch((e) => { if (e && e.code !== 'upstream_error') console.warn('presence', e && e.code); });
  }
  info() { return { kind: 'room', ok: this.conn }; }
  knows(cid) { for (const v of this.peerCid.values()) if (v === cid) return true; return false; }
  close() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.closed = true;
    try { this.unsub && this.unsub(); this.unconn && this.unconn(); } catch (e) { /* なし */ }
    try { this.rm && this.rm.presence({ m: null }).catch(() => {}); } catch (e) { /* なし */ }
    try { this.rm && this.rm.leave().catch(() => {}); } catch (e) { /* なし */ }
  }
}

// いくつかの通信路をまとめて1つに見せる（同じものが2回届いても、番号で古いものは捨てられる）
export class MultiLink {
  constructor(links) {
    this.links = links; this.kind = links.map(l => l.kind).join('+');
    this.onMsg = () => {}; this.onGone = () => {}; this.onStatus = () => {};
    for (const l of links) {
      l.onMsg = (f, m) => this.onMsg(f, m);
      l.onGone = (f) => { if (!this.links.some(x => x !== l && x.knows && x.knows(f))) this.onGone(f); };
      l.onStatus = () => this.onStatus(this.info());
    }
  }
  send(obj, force) { for (const l of this.links) l.send(obj, force); }
  info() { return { kind: this.kind, parts: this.links.map(l => l.info()) }; }
  close() { for (const l of this.links) l.close(); }
}

// 通信路を開く。room: Claudeの部屋を使ってみる。net: 公開サーバー。どちらか開けば使う
export async function openLink({ code, role, cid, room = true, net = true, brokers, ice, p2p = true, claude }) {
  const tries = [];
  const cl = claude || globalThis.claude;
  if (room && cl && typeof cl.use === 'function') tries.push(new RoomLink({ code, role, cid, claude: cl }));
  if (net) tries.push(new NetLink({ code, role, cid, brokers, ice, p2p }));
  const res = await Promise.all(tries.map(l => l.open().then(() => l, (e) => { console.warn('link', l.kind, e && e.message); return null; })));
  const ok = res.filter(Boolean);
  if (!ok.length) throw new Error('つながりません');
  return ok.length === 1 ? ok[0] : new MultiLink(ok);
}

// 小さな MQTT 3.1.1 クライアント（WebSocketの上。QoS 0 だけ）。外部のライブラリは使わない
// 使い方: const c = new Mqtt(url, { id, onMsg(topic, text), onClose(reason) }); await c.open(); c.sub('a/+'); c.pub('a/b', 'text');
const enc = new TextEncoder(), dec = new TextDecoder();

function varLen(n) {
  const out = [];
  do { let b = n % 128; n = Math.floor(n / 128); if (n > 0) b |= 128; out.push(b); } while (n > 0);
  return out;
}
function str(s) { const b = enc.encode(s); return [b.length >> 8, b.length & 255, ...b]; }
function packet(type, body) {
  const head = [type, ...varLen(body.length)];
  const out = new Uint8Array(head.length + body.length);
  out.set(head, 0); out.set(body, head.length);
  return out;
}

export function mqttConnect(id, keepAlive = 30) {
  return packet(0x10, Uint8Array.from([...str('MQTT'), 4, 0x02, keepAlive >> 8, keepAlive & 255, ...str(id)]));
}
export function mqttPublish(topic, payload) {
  const t = str(topic), p = typeof payload === 'string' ? enc.encode(payload) : payload;
  const body = new Uint8Array(t.length + p.length);
  body.set(t, 0); body.set(p, t.length);
  return packet(0x30, body);
}
export function mqttSubscribe(pid, filters) {
  const body = [pid >> 8, pid & 255];
  for (const f of filters) body.push(...str(f), 0);
  return packet(0x82, Uint8Array.from(body));
}
export const PINGREQ = Uint8Array.from([0xc0, 0]);
export const DISCONNECT = Uint8Array.from([0xe0, 0]);

// 受け取ったバイト列から、まとまった MQTT のパケットを取り出す（途中で切れていたら残す）
export class MqttReader {
  constructor() { this.buf = new Uint8Array(0); }
  push(chunk) {
    const b = new Uint8Array(this.buf.length + chunk.length);
    b.set(this.buf, 0); b.set(chunk, this.buf.length);
    this.buf = b;
    const out = [];
    for (;;) {
      if (this.buf.length < 2) break;
      let len = 0, mul = 1, i = 1, ok = false;
      for (; i < 5 && i < this.buf.length; i++) {
        const v = this.buf[i];
        len += (v & 127) * mul; mul *= 128;
        if (!(v & 128)) { ok = true; i++; break; }
      }
      if (!ok) { if (this.buf.length >= 5) throw new Error('MQTTの長さが読めない'); break; }
      if (this.buf.length < i + len) break;
      out.push({ type: this.buf[0] >> 4, flags: this.buf[0] & 15, body: this.buf.subarray(i, i + len) });
      this.buf = this.buf.slice(i + len);
    }
    return out;
  }
}
export function parsePublish(pk) {
  const b = pk.body;
  const tl = (b[0] << 8) | b[1];
  const topic = dec.decode(b.subarray(2, 2 + tl));
  let off = 2 + tl;
  if (((pk.flags >> 1) & 3) > 0) off += 2; // QoS1/2 の番号（使わないが読み飛ばす）
  return { topic, payload: b.subarray(off) };
}

export class Mqtt {
  constructor(url, { id, onMsg, onClose, keepAlive = 30 } = {}) {
    this.url = url; this.id = id || ('m' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 12));
    this.onMsg = onMsg || (() => {}); this.onClose = onClose || (() => {});
    this.keepAlive = keepAlive; this.pid = 1; this.ok = false; this.closed = false;
    this.reader = new MqttReader();
    this.sent = 0; this.recv = 0;
  }
  open(timeoutMs = 6000) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      let done = false;
      const fail = (why) => { if (done) return; done = true; try { this.ws && this.ws.close(); } catch (e) { /* なし */ } reject(new Error(why)); };
      const timer = setTimeout(() => fail('接続が時間切れ'), timeoutMs);
      let ws;
      try { ws = new WebSocket(this.url, ['mqtt']); } catch (e) { clearTimeout(timer); fail(String(e.message || e)); return; }
      this.ws = ws;
      ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer';
      ws.onopen = () => { try { ws.send(mqttConnect(this.id, this.keepAlive)); } catch (e) { fail('送れない'); } };
      ws.onerror = () => fail('つながらない');
      ws.onclose = () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (!done) { fail('切れた'); return; }
        this._down('切れた');
      };
      ws.onmessage = (e) => {
        let pks;
        try { pks = this.reader.push(new Uint8Array(e.data)); } catch (err) { this._down('壊れたデータ'); return; }
        for (const pk of pks) {
          if (pk.type === 2) { // CONNACK
            clearTimeout(timer);
            if (pk.body[1] !== 0) { fail('断られた(' + pk.body[1] + ')'); return; }
            done = true; this.ok = true;
            this.ping = setInterval(() => this._raw(PINGREQ), Math.max(5, this.keepAlive * 0.6) * 1000);
            resolve(this);
          } else if (pk.type === 3) { // PUBLISH
            this.recv++;
            const { topic, payload } = parsePublish(pk);
            try { this.onMsg(topic, dec.decode(payload)); } catch (err) { console.warn('mqtt msg', err); }
          }
          // SUBACK(9)・PINGRESP(13) は特にすることがない
        }
      };
    });
  }
  _raw(bytes) {
    if (!this.ws || this.ws.readyState !== 1) return false;
    try { this.ws.send(bytes); return true; } catch (e) { return false; }
  }
  sub(...filters) { this.pid = (this.pid % 65000) + 1; return this._raw(mqttSubscribe(this.pid, filters)); }
  pub(topic, text) { if (!this.ok) return false; this.sent++; return this._raw(mqttPublish(topic, text)); }
  // 送れずにたまっている量（多すぎたら送るのを控える）
  backlog() { return this.ws ? this.ws.bufferedAmount : 0; }
  _down(why) {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.closed = true; this.ok = false;
    clearInterval(this.ping);
    try { this.onClose(why); } catch (e) { /* なし */ }
  }
  close() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this._raw(DISCONNECT);
    this.closed = true; this.ok = false;
    clearInterval(this.ping);
    try { this.ws && this.ws.close(); } catch (e) { /* なし */ }
  }
}

// 通信の取り決め（ロビー・開始・試合中・結果）。通信路（link）とは send/onMsg だけでつながる。
// ホストが正（ホスト権威）: エンジンはホストだけが動かす。ゲストは入力と動作（番号つき）を送り、ホストの写しを表示する。
import { VERSION, COMPAT } from '../engine/data/version.js';
import { WEAPONS } from '../engine/data/weapons.js';
import { GEAR, LONG, VEST, PLATE, HELMET, HEADWEAR } from '../engine/data/equipment.js';

export const MAX_PVE = 4, MAX_PVP = 8;
const nowMs = () => (typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now());
const clampS = (v, n = 12) => (typeof v === 'string' ? v.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f\u200b-\u200f\u2028-\u202e\u2060-\u206f\ufeff]/g, '').slice(0, n) : '');
const isNum = (v) => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v);
const clamp = (v, a, b) => v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v;

// 受け取った装備を検める（知らないidは捨てる）
function cleanWeapon(w) { if (!w || typeof w !== 'object' || !WEAPONS[w.id]) return null; const o = { id: w.id }; for (const k of ['sight', 'muzzle', 'grip', 'ammo']) if (typeof w[k] === 'string' && w[k].length < 12) o[k] = w[k]; if (typeof w.light === 'boolean') o.light = w.light; return o; }
export function cleanLoadout(lo) {
  if (!lo || typeof lo !== 'object') return null;
  const o = { primary: cleanWeapon(lo.primary), secondary: cleanWeapon(lo.secondary) };
  if (LONG[lo.long]) o.long = lo.long;
  o.gear = Array.isArray(lo.gear) ? lo.gear.filter(g => Array.isArray(g) && GEAR[g[0]] && isNum(g[1])).slice(0, 3).map(g => [g[0], clamp(Math.round(g[1]), 0, GEAR[g[0]].max)]) : [];
  for (const [k, T] of [['vest', VEST], ['plate', PLATE], ['helmet', HELMET], ['head', HEADWEAR]]) if (T[lo[k]]) o[k] = lo[k];
  if (lo.armor === 'light' || lo.armor === 'medium' || lo.armor === 'heavy') o.armor = lo.armor;
  if (lo.swat) o.swat = cleanLoadout(lo.swat);
  if (lo.sus) o.sus = cleanLoadout(lo.sus);
  return o;
}
// 動作（調べる・命令・持ち替えなど）を検める: 文字と数と小さな配列だけ
function cleanAct(ac) {
  if (!ac || typeof ac !== 'object' || typeof ac.a !== 'string' || ac.a.length > 16) return null;
  const o = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ac)) {
    if (k.length > 8) continue;
    if (typeof v === 'string' && v.length <= 24) o[k] = v;
    else if (isNum(v)) o[k] = v;
    else if (typeof v === 'boolean') o[k] = v;
  }
  return o;
}

class Pump {
  constructor(fn, ms) { this.id = setInterval(() => { try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('pump', e); } }, ms); }
  stop() { clearInterval(this.id); }
}

export class HostSession {

  _gone(cid) { const r = this.roster.find(x => x.cid === cid); if (r && r.on) { r.on = false; this.emit('roster', this.roster); } }
  _input(G, i) {
    G.input = {
      mx: isNum(i.mx) ? clamp(i.mx, -1, 1) : 0, mz: isNum(i.mz) ? clamp(i.mz, -1, 1) : 0,
      yaw: isNum(i.y) ? i.y : 0, pitch: isNum(i.p) ? clamp(i.p, -1.5, 1.5) : 0,
      fire: !!i.f, ads: !!i.a, low: !!i.l, stance: [0, 1, 2].includes(i.s) ? i.s : 0, lean: isNum(i.ln) ? clamp(Math.round(i.ln), -1, 1) : 0, sprint: !!i.sp, power: isNum(i.pw) ? clamp(i.pw, 0.1, 1) : 0.75,

  }
  // ホストのエンジンに渡す、その人の今の入力（たまった動作もここで渡す）
  remoteInput(pid, a) {

  waiting() { return this.phase === 'game' ? this.roster.filter(r => !r.host && !r.on && !r.gone && !r.skip) : []; }
  skipWaiting() { for (const r of this.waiting()) r.skip = true; }

  setTeam(cid, team) { if (this.phase !== 'lobby' || this.kind !== 'pvp') return; const r = this.roster.find(x => x.cid === cid); if (r) { r.team = team ? 1 : 0; this.emit('roster', this.roster); this._send(true); } }

  backToLobby() { this.phase = 'lobby'; this.results = null; this.match = null; this._repid(); this.emit('roster', this.roster); this._send(true); }
  _state() {
    const m = { t: 'h', v: VERSION, c: COMPAT, cid: this.cid, hs: this.hs, n: ++this.n, ph: this.phase, kind: this.kind, code: this.code };

  _pump() {

export class GuestSession {
  constructor({ link, cid, code, profile, lo, rate }) {

  on(k, fn) { this.listeners[k] = fn; }

  _onMsg(from, m) {

    if (m.code && m.code !== this.code) return;
    if (this.host && (m.cid !== this.host || m.hs !== this.hs)) { if (m.cid !== this.host && this.phase !== 'join') return; this.hostN = -1; this.evSeen = 0; }

      } else if (this.phase === 'join' && !inRoster && this.roster.length) this._fail('playing');

  _snap(g, t) {
    if (!isNum(g.T)) return;
    this.offs.push([t, t - g.T * 1000]);
    while (this.offs.length && t - this.offs[0][0] > 4000) this.offs.shift();

    if (this.snapQ.length > 40) this.snapQ.shift();

      if (!Array.isArray(x) || !isNum(x[0]) || !x[1] || typeof x[1] !== 'object') continue;
      if (x[0] <= this.evSeen) continue;
      this.evSeen = x[0]; this.evQ.push(x[1]);
    }
  }
  takeSnaps() { const q = this.snapQ; this.snapQ = []; return q; }
  takeEvents() { const q = this.evQ; this.evQ = []; return q; }
  // 人を描く時刻（ホストの時計で、少し過去）
  renderT() {
    const t = nowMs();
    if (!this.offs.length) return 0;
    let min = Infinity; for (const [, o] of this.offs) if (o < min) min = o;
    const d = this.offs.map(([, o]) => o - min).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const jit = d[Math.floor(d.length * 0.9)] || 0;
    this.delay = Math.max(70, Math.min(500, 50 * 1.5 + jit + 20));
    return (t - min - this.delay) / 1000;
  }
  setInput(i) { this.input = i; }
  // 動作は番号をつけて、受け取ったと返事が来るまで送り続ける
  pushAct(ac) { this.acts.push([++this.qN, ac]); if (this.acts.length > 30) this.acts.shift(); }

  _state() {
    const m = { t: 'g', v: VERSION, c: COMPAT, cid: this.cid, gs: this.gs, n: ++this.n, name: clampS(this.profile.name) || 'だれか', ph: this.phase };
    if (this.phase !== 'game' && this.lo) m.lo = this.lo;
    if (this.phase === 'game') { if (this.input) m.i = this.input; if (this.acts.length) m.q = this.acts.slice(-12); }
    if (this.bye) m.bye = 1;
    return m;
  }
  _pump() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    const t = nowMs();
    if (t - this.lastSend >= (this.rate[this.phase] || 500) - 3) { this.lastSend = t; try { this.link.send(this._state()); } catch (e) { console.warn('send', e); } }
    const since = t - (this.lastHost || this.startedAt);
    if (this.phase === 'join' && since > 15000) { this._fail('notfound'); return; }
    if (this.phase !== 'join' && since > 4000 && this.status === 'ok') { this.status = 'quiet'; this.emit('status', 'quiet'); }
    if (this.phase !== 'join' && since > 60000) this._fail('lost');
  }
  _fail(why, info) {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.closed = true; this.pump.stop();
    this.emit('error', why, info);
    try { this.link.close(); } catch (e) { /* なし */ }
  }
  leave() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.bye = true;
    try { this.link.send(this._state(), true); } catch (e) { /* なし */ }
    this.closed = true; this.pump.stop();
    setTimeout(() => { try { this.link.close(); } catch (e) { /* なし */ } }, 300);
  }
}

// 通信の中身: ホストのエンジンの状態 → 小さな写し（数を丸めた配列）。ゲストは写しから「見せるための状態」を作る。
// 静かな情報（名前・見た目・装備の種類・目的の一覧）は st、動く情報（位置・姿勢・扉・物・出来事）は g。
import { createActor, makeWeapon } from '../engine/actor.js';
import { makeDoorStates } from '../engine/doors.js';
import { WEAPONS } from '../engine/data/weapons.js';
import { ACT_POSE } from '../engine/data/acts.js';

const r2 = (v) => Math.round(v * 100);
const r3 = (v) => Math.round(v * 1000);
const isNum = (v) => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v);
// 送る出来事（見た目・音・HUDに要るもの）
export const NET_EV = new Set(['shot', 'imp', 'blood', 'hit', 'whiz', 'kill', 'down', 'cuffed', 'report', 'evidence', 'bombdone', 'soft', 'glass', 'block', 'reinf', 'door', 'deny', 'nade', 'boom', 'c2', 'flashed', 'stung', 'tase', 'spray', 'reload', 'reloaded', 'shell', 'pumped', 'dry', 'draw', 'fmode', 'lightsw', 'step', 'shout', 'cmd', 'mirror', 'act', 'trap', 'trapset', 'barset', 'c2set', 'barhit', 'barbreak', 'plant', 'disable', 'defpick', 'defdrop', 'spotted', 'drone', 'dronedead', 'phase', 'round', 'roundstart', 'swap', 'respawn', 'matchend', 'end', 'revive', 'bandaged', 'fall', 'throw', 'bounce', 'allbombs', 'trapoff', 'peek', 'peekend', 'launch', 'shieldhit', 'longsel', 'm320sel', 'gearhint', 'gearsel']);
// 出来事の数を丸める（小数2けた）
export function packEvent(e) {
  const o = {};
  for (const k in e) { const v = e[k]; if (k === 's') continue; o[k] = isNum(v) && !Number.isInteger(v) ? Math.round(v * 100) / 100 : v; }
  return o;
}
const FL = { alive: 1, dead: 2, down: 4, cuffed: 8, c1: 16, c2: 32, stun: 64, cower: 128, sprint: 256, ground: 512, light: 1024, nvg: 2048, carry: 4096, reported: 8192, blind: 16384, gas: 32768, spot: 65536 };
const SIDE = ['', 'swat', 'sus'];
function attKey(w) { return w ? [w.id, w.att.sight || 'iron', w.att.muzzle || 'none', w.att.grip || 'none', w.att.light ? 1 : 0, w.am] : null; }

// ---- ホスト: 静かな情報（始まり・入り直し・陣営の交代のとき）
export function packStatic(S) {
  const A = S.actors.filter(a => !a.isDrone).map(a => [a.id, a.kind, a.team, a.pid, a.name || '', a.look ? a.look.seed : 0, a.h || 1.8, a.pvpArmor || '', a.armor ? a.armor.vest : 'none', a.armor ? a.armor.helmet : 'none', a.armor ? a.armor.head : 'none', a.ai && a.ai.prof ? a.ai.prof : '', a.ai ? a.ai.squad || '' : '', a.ai ? a.ai.slot ?? -1 : -1, attKey(a.inv.w[0]), attKey(a.inv.w[1]), a.inv.long || 'none', a.maxHp]);
  const m = S.m || {};
  const M = m.kind === 'pve' ? { kind: 'pve', mission: m.mission, diff: m.diff, sus: m.sus, civ: m.civ, hostages: m.hostages, bombs: (m.bombs || []).map(b => [b.id, r2(b.x), r2(b.y), r2(b.z), b.L || 0]) }
    : m.kind === 'train' ? { kind: 'train' } : { kind: m.kind, sites: (m.sites || []).map(s => [s.id, s.name, r2(s.x), r2(s.y), r2(s.z), r2(s.r)]), winsNeeded: m.winsNeeded, limit: m.limit, timeLimit: m.timeLimit, roundTime: m.roundTime, prepTime: m.prepTime, sizes: m.sizes };
  return { map: S.map, mode: S.mode, pvp: S.pvp, dt: S.dt, rules: S.rules, A, M };
}
// ---- ホスト: 動く情報（毎回）。me: { pid: actorId } の人ごとの詳しい情報も付ける
export function packSnap(S, w, events, mePids, withBlocks) {
  const A = [];
  for (const a of S.actors) {
    if (a.isDrone) { A.push([a.id, r2(a.x), r2(a.y), r2(a.z), r3(a.yaw), r3(a.pitch || 0), -1, a.alive ? 1 : 0, a.owner, a.team]); continue; }
    let f = 0;
    if (a.alive) f |= FL.alive; if (a.dead) f |= FL.dead; if (a.down) f |= FL.down; if (a.cuffed) f |= FL.cuffed;
    if (a.comply === 1) f |= FL.c1; if (a.comply === 2) f |= FL.c2; if (a.stun > 0 || a.tased > 0) f |= FL.stun; if (a.ai && a.ai.cower) f |= FL.cower;
    if (a.sprint) f |= FL.sprint; if (a.ground) f |= FL.ground;
    const wi = a.inv.w[a.ws.slot] || null;
    if (wi && wi.lightOn) f |= FL.light; if (a.nvgOn) f |= FL.nvg; if (a.carry === 'defuser') f |= FL.carry; if (a.reported) f |= FL.reported;
    if (a.flash > 0.4) f |= FL.blind; if (a.gas > 0) f |= FL.gas; if (a.spot > 0) f |= FL.spot;
    const rel = a.ws.st === 'reload' && a.ws.rd ? Math.round((1 - a.ws.t / a.ws.rd) * 100) : -1;
    A.push([a.id, r2(a.x), r2(a.y), r2(a.z), r3(a.yaw), r3(a.pitch + (a.ws.rp || 0) * Math.PI / 180), r2(a.st), r2(a.lean), r2(a.mvx || 0), r2(a.mvz || 0), r2(a.phase || 0), r2(a.ads || 0), r2(a.low || 0), f, r2(a.stateT || 0), r2(a.fallYaw || 0), rel, r2(a.fireK || 0), r2(a.throwT || 0), a.ws.slot, Math.round(100 * a.hp / (a.maxHp || 100)), r2(a.spd || 0), SIDE.indexOf(a.pvpSide || ''), a.spotTeam ?? -1, a._lookV || 0, ...actRow(a)]);
  }
  const D = S.doors.map(d => { let fl = 0; if (d.locked) fl |= 1; if (d.lockBroken) fl |= 2; if (d.broken) fl |= 4; if (d.wedge) fl |= 8; if (d.bar > 0) fl |= 16; if (d.c2) fl |= 32; if (d.trapSeen) fl |= 64; if (d.trap && d.trap.armed) fl |= 128; return [d.ang.map(r2), fl, d.bar > 0 ? Math.round(d.bar) : 0, d.trap && d.trap.side ? d.trap.side : 0]; });
  const I = S.items.filter(it => !it.gone).map(it => [it.id, it.kind, r2(it.x), r2(it.y), r2(it.z), r2(it.yaw || 0), it.kind === 'weapon' ? attKey(it.w || { id: it.wid, att: {} }) : it.kind === 'evidence' ? it.ek : 0]);
  const N = S.nades.map(n => [r2(n.x), r2(n.y), r2(n.z), n.type]);
  const C = S.clouds.map(c => [r2(c.x), r2(c.y), r2(c.z), r2(c.r), c.type]);
  const m = S.m || {};
  let M;
  if (m.kind === 'pve') M = { ph: m.phase, soft: m.softDone ? 1 : 0, bt: m.bombT != null ? Math.round(m.bombT) : null, bd: (m.bombs || []).filter(b => b.done).map(b => b.id), bf: (m.bombs || []).filter(b => b.found).map(b => b.id), res: m.result || null, why: m.why || null, score: m.phase === 'end' ? m.score : undefined };
  else if (m.kind === 'train') M = { ph: 'play' };
  else M = { ph: m.phase, el: Math.round((S.t - m.phaseT) * S.dt * 10) / 10, rd: m.round, w: m.wins, sc: m.score, att: m.att, def: m.def, df: m.defuser ? [m.defuser.planted ? 1 : 0, m.defuser.disabled ? 1 : 0, Math.round((m.defuser.t || 0) * 10) / 10, r2(m.defuser.x || 0), r2(m.defuser.z || 0), m.defuser.site ?? -1] : null, over: m.over ? 1 : 0, win: m.winner ?? null, sw: m.swapped ? 1 : 0, rl: m.reinfLeft ?? 0 };
  const P = {};
  for (const [pid, id] of Object.entries(mePids || {})) {
    const a = S.byId[id]; if (!a) continue;
    P[pid] = meBlock(a);
  }
  const out = { T: Math.round(S.t * S.dt * 1000) / 1000, A, D, I, N, C, M, P, E: events };
  // 壊れた壁（ときどき全部）
  if (withBlocks) out.B = Object.keys(S.bdiff).map(k => { const b = +k * 4; return [+k, w.blocks[b], w.blocks[b + 1], w.blocks[b + 2], w.blocks[b + 3]]; });
  out.R = Object.keys(S.reinf || {}).map(Number);
  return out;
}
// 動作の見た目（ほかの人の拘束・作業・ノブ・押す）: 体の動きの種類・進み・手の行き先、拘束されている進み
const ACTS = ['', 'cuff', 'kneel', 'grab', 'place', 'radio', 'bandage', 'kick', 'knob', 'peek'];
function actRow(a) {
  const x = a.act, g = a.gest;
  const ap = x ? (x.pose || ACT_POSE[x.k] || '') : a.peek ? 'peek' : '';
  const tg = x && x.tgt ? x.tgt : a.peek ? [a.peek.x, a.peek.y, a.peek.z] : null;
  return [ACTS.indexOf(ap), x ? Math.round(100 * Math.min(1, x.t / Math.max(0.05, x.dur))) : 0, tg ? r2(tg[0]) : 0, tg ? r2(tg[1]) : 0, tg ? r2(tg[2]) : 0,
    g ? (g.k === 'push' ? 1 : 2) : 0, g ? Math.round(100 * Math.min(1, g.t / g.dur)) : 0, g && g.tgt ? r2(g.tgt[0]) : 0, g && g.tgt ? r2(g.tgt[1]) : 0, g && g.tgt ? r2(g.tgt[2]) : 0,
    Math.round(100 * (a.cuffK || 0))];
}
// 自分の詳しい状態（HUD・一人称の銃に使う）
function meBlock(a) {
  return {
    hp: Math.round(a.hp * 10) / 10, mh: a.maxHp, ar: [a.armor.pf, a.armor.pb, a.armor.helm], bl: a.bleed > 0 ? 1 : 0, inj: [a.inj.arm, a.inj.leg],
    ws: [a.ws.slot, a.ws.st, r2(a.ws.t || 0), r2(a.ws.rd || 0), a.ws.next ?? -1, a.ws.gear || null],
    w: a.inv.w.map(w => w ? [w.id, w.mags ? w.mags.slice() : null, w.mag, w.ch, w.res, w.mode, w.lightOn ? 1 : 0, w.am] : null),
    g: a.inv.gear.map(g => [g.id, g.n]), act: a.act ? [a.act.k, r2(a.act.t), r2(a.act.dur), a.act.tgt ? r2(a.act.tgt[0]) : null, a.act.tgt ? r2(a.act.tgt[1]) : 0, a.act.tgt ? r2(a.act.tgt[2]) : 0, a.act.pose || null, a.act.quick ? 1 : 0, a.act.kind || null] : null,
    m3: a.inv.m320 ? [a.inv.m320.sel, a.inv.m320.flash, a.inv.m320.stinger, a.inv.m320.cs] : null, lt: r2(a.ws.lt || 0),
    pk: a.peek ? [a.peek.k, r2(a.peek.x), r2(a.peek.y), r2(a.peek.z), r3(a.peek.yaw0), r2(a.peek.max), a.peek.door, a.peek.fov] : null,
    st: a.stance, db: a.dbno ? Math.round(a.dbno * 10) / 10 : 0, sp: a.spawnProt > 0 ? 1 : 0, s: [a.stats.k, a.stats.d, a.stats.a, a.stats.sh, a.stats.hi], dr: a.dronesLeft ?? null,
  };
}

// ================= ゲスト: 写しから見せるための状態を作る =================
export class Mirror {
  constructor(w, st) {
    this.w = w; this.st = st;
    const S = this.S = { v: 0, t: 0, dt: st.dt || 1 / 60, map: st.map, mode: st.mode, pvp: !!st.pvp, rules: st.rules || {}, actors: [], byId: {}, doors: makeDoorStates(w), items: [], nades: [], clouds: [], bullets: [], blasts: [], harms: [], orders: [], shouts: [], mines: [], bdiff: {}, reinf: {}, m: {}, nextId: 1, nextItem: 1, mirror: true };
    this.applyStatic(st);
    this.buf = []; // [{T, at, g}]
  }
  applyStatic(st) {
    const S = this.S;
    const keep = new Map(S.actors.map(a => [a.id, a]));
    S.actors = [];
    for (const r of st.A) {
      const [id, kind, team, pid, name, seed, h, pvpArmor, vest, helmet, head, prof, squad, slot, w0, w1, long, maxHp] = r;
      let a = keep.get(id);
      const lo = { primary: w0 && WEAPONS[w0[0]] ? { id: w0[0], sight: w0[1], muzzle: w0[2], grip: w0[3], light: !!w0[4], ammo: w0[5] } : null, secondary: w1 && WEAPONS[w1[0]] ? { id: w1[0], sight: w1[1], muzzle: w1[2], grip: w1[3], light: !!w1[4], ammo: w1[5] } : null, long, vest, helmet, head, plate: 'ceramic' };
      if (!a) {
        a = createActor(S, { kind, team, pid, name, x: 0, z: 0, hp: maxHp || 100, lo, look: { seed } });
        a.id = id;
      } else {
        a.inv.w = [makeWeapon(lo.primary), makeWeapon(lo.secondary)]; a.inv.long = long || 'none';
      }
      a.kind = kind; a.team = team; a.pid = pid; a.name = name; a.h = h || 1.8; a.pvpArmor = pvpArmor || undefined; a.maxHp = maxHp || 100;
      a.armor.vest = vest; a.armor.helmet = helmet; a.armor.head = head;
      a.ai = kind === 'swat' && pid == null ? { type: 'swat', squad, slot, prof } : prof ? { type: kind, prof } : (pid == null ? { type: kind } : null);
      a.look = { seed };
      S.actors.push(a);
    }
    S.byId = {}; for (const a of S.actors) S.byId[a.id] = a;
    const M = st.M || {};
    if (M.kind === 'pve') S.m = { kind: 'pve', mission: M.mission, diff: M.diff, sus: M.sus || [], civ: M.civ || [], hostages: M.hostages || [], bombs: (M.bombs || []).map(([id, x, y, z, L]) => ({ id, x: x / 100, y: y / 100, z: z / 100, L, done: false, found: false })), phase: 'play', bombT: null };
    else if (M.kind === 'train') S.m = { kind: 'train' };
    else S.m = { kind: M.kind, sites: (M.sites || []).map(([id, name, x, y, z, r]) => ({ id, name, x: x / 100, y: y / 100, z: z / 100, r: r / 100 })), winsNeeded: M.winsNeeded, limit: M.limit, timeLimit: M.timeLimit, roundTime: M.roundTime, prepTime: M.prepTime, sizes: M.sizes, wins: [0, 0], score: [0, 0], round: 1, phase: 'pre', phaseT: 0, defuser: null, att: 0, def: 1 };
  }
  push(g, at) {
    if (!g || !isNum(g.T)) return;
    if (this.buf.length && g.T <= this.buf[this.buf.length - 1].T) return;
    this.buf.push({ T: g.T, at, g });
    while (this.buf.length > 30) this.buf.shift();
  }
  // renderT（ホストの時計）で人を補間し、最新の写しで扉・物・目的を合わせる。meId: 自分（予測するので位置は触らない）
  apply(renderT, meId) {
    const S = this.S, B = this.buf;
    if (!B.length) return false;
    const last = B[B.length - 1].g;
    let a0 = B[0], a1 = B[0];
    for (let i = 0; i < B.length - 1; i++) if (B[i].T <= renderT && B[i + 1].T >= renderT) { a0 = B[i]; a1 = B[i + 1]; break; }
    if (renderT > B[B.length - 1].T) { a0 = a1 = B[B.length - 1]; }
    const k = a1.T > a0.T ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (renderT - a0.T) / (a1.T - a0.T))) : 1;
    const m0 = new Map(a0.g.A.map(r => [r[0], r]));
    S.t = Math.round(last.T / S.dt);
    for (const r1 of a1.g.A) {
      const a = S.byId[r1[0]];
      if (!a) continue;
      const r0 = m0.get(r1[0]) || r1;
      if (r1[6] === -1) { // ドローン
        a.isDrone = true; a.x = lerp(r0[1], r1[1], k) / 100; a.y = lerp(r0[2], r1[2], k) / 100; a.z = lerp(r0[3], r1[3], k) / 100; a.yaw = lerpA(r0[4], r1[4], k) / 1000; a.pitch = r1[5] / 1000; a.alive = !!r1[7]; a.owner = r1[8]; continue;
      }
      const f = r1[13];
      a.alive = !!(f & FL.alive); a.dead = !!(f & FL.dead); a.down = !!(f & FL.down); a.cuffed = !!(f & FL.cuffed);
      a.comply = f & FL.c2 ? 2 : f & FL.c1 ? 1 : 0; a.stun = f & FL.stun ? 0.5 : 0; a.tased = 0;
      if (a.ai) a.ai.cower = !!(f & FL.cower);
      a.sprint = !!(f & FL.sprint); a.ground = !!(f & FL.ground); a.nvgOn = !!(f & FL.nvg); a.carry = f & FL.carry ? 'defuser' : null; a.reported = !!(f & FL.reported);
      a.flash = f & FL.blind ? 1 : 0; a.gas = f & FL.gas ? 1 : 0; a.spot = f & FL.spot ? 1 : 0; a.spotTeam = r1[23];
      const side = SIDE[r1[22]] || undefined;
      if (side !== a.pvpSide || r1[24] !== a._lookV) { a.pvpSide = side; a._lookV = r1[24]; }
      if (a.id !== meId) {
        a.x = lerp(r0[1], r1[1], k) / 100; a.y = lerp(r0[2], r1[2], k) / 100; a.z = lerp(r0[3], r1[3], k) / 100;
        a.yaw = lerpA(r0[4], r1[4], k) / 1000; a.pitch = lerp(r0[5], r1[5], k) / 1000;
        a.st = lerp(r0[6], r1[6], k) / 100; a.lean = lerp(r0[7], r1[7], k) / 100; a.mvx = r1[8] / 100; a.mvz = r1[9] / 100;
        a.phase = lerpPhase(r0[10], r1[10], k) / 100; a.ads = lerp(r0[11], r1[11], k) / 100; a.low = lerp(r0[12], r1[12], k) / 100;
        a.stateT = r1[14] / 100; a.fallYaw = r1[15] / 100;
        a.ws.slot = r1[19];
        a.ws.st = r1[16] >= 0 ? 'reload' : 'ready'; a.ws.rd = r1[16] >= 0 ? 1 : 0; a.ws.t = r1[16] >= 0 ? 1 - r1[16] / 100 : 0; a.ws.rp = 0;
        a.fireK = r1[17] / 100; a.throwT = r1[18] / 100; a.spd = r1[21] / 100;
        const wi = a.inv.w[a.ws.slot]; if (wi) wi.lightOn = !!(f & FL.light);
        // 動作の見た目
        if (r1.length > 25) {
          const ap = ACTS[r1[25]] || '';
          a.act = ap && ap !== 'peek' ? { k: '_net', pose: ap, t: r1[26] / 100, dur: 1, tgt: [r1[27] / 100, r1[28] / 100, r1[29] / 100] } : null;
          a.peek = ap === 'peek' ? { x: r1[27] / 100, y: r1[28] / 100, z: r1[29] / 100, k: 'mirror' } : null;
          a.gest = r1[30] ? { k: r1[30] === 1 ? 'push' : 'grab', t: r1[31] / 100, dur: 1, tgt: [r1[32] / 100, r1[33] / 100, r1[34] / 100] } : null;
        }
      }
      if (r1.length > 35) a.cuffK = r1[35] / 100;
      a.hp = r1[20] / 100 * (a.maxHp || 100);
    }
    // 扉・物・投げ物・目的（最新）
    const D = last.D || [];
    for (let i = 0; i < D.length && i < S.doors.length; i++) {
      const ds = S.doors[i], [ang, fl, bar, tside] = D[i];
      const target = ang.map(v => v / 100);
      // 開閉は少しなめらかに
      ds.ang = ds.ang.map((v, j) => v + ((target[j] ?? 0) - v) * 0.35);
      ds.tgt = target; ds.locked = !!(fl & 1); ds.lockBroken = !!(fl & 2); ds.broken = !!(fl & 4); ds.wedge = fl & 8 ? 1 : 0; ds.bar = fl & 16 ? (bar || 1) : 0; ds.c2 = fl & 32 ? {} : null; ds.trapSeen = !!(fl & 64); ds.trap = fl & 128 ? { armed: true, side: tside || 0 } : null;
    }
    S.items = (last.I || []).map(([id, kind, x, y, z, yaw, ex]) => kind === 'weapon' ? { id, kind, x: x / 100, y: y / 100, z: z / 100, yaw: yaw / 100, wid: ex && ex[0], w: ex && WEAPONS[ex[0]] ? makeWeapon({ id: ex[0], sight: ex[1], muzzle: ex[2], grip: ex[3], light: !!ex[4] }) : null } : { id, kind, x: x / 100, y: y / 100, z: z / 100, yaw: yaw / 100, ek: ex, ev: kind === 'evidence' });
    S.nades = (last.N || []).map(([x, y, z, type]) => ({ x: x / 100, y: y / 100, z: z / 100, type }));
    S.clouds = (last.C || []).map(([x, y, z, r, type]) => ({ x: x / 100, y: y / 100, z: z / 100, r: r / 100, type }));
    // 壊れた壁と補強（変わったマスは描き直す）
    this.changed = this.changed || [];
    if (last.B && last !== this._lastB) {
      this._lastB = last;
      for (const [k, b0, b1, b2, b3] of last.B) { const b = k * 4, w = this.w; if (w.blocks[b] !== b0 || w.blocks[b + 1] !== b1 || w.blocks[b + 2] !== b2 || w.blocks[b + 3] !== b3) { w.blocks[b] = b0; w.blocks[b + 1] = b1; w.blocks[b + 2] = b2; w.blocks[b + 3] = b3; S.bdiff[k] = 1; this.changed.push(k); } }
    }
    if (last.R) { const R = {}; for (const k of last.R) { R[k] = 1; if (!S.reinf[k]) this.changed.push(k); } S.reinf = R; }
    const M = last.M || {}, m = S.m;
    if (m.kind === 'pve') { m.phase = M.ph; m.softDone = !!M.soft; m.bombT = M.bt; for (const b of m.bombs) { b.done = (M.bd || []).includes(b.id); b.found = (M.bf || []).includes(b.id); } m.result = M.res; m.why = M.why; if (M.score) m.score = M.score; }
    else if (m.kind && m.kind !== 'train') {

  }

function lerp(a, b, k) { return a + (b - a) * k; }
function lerpA(a, b, k) { let d = b - a; const T = 2000 * Math.PI; d = ((d + T / 2) % T + T) % T - T / 2; return a + d * k; }
function lerpPhase(a, b, k) { let d = b - a; if (d < -300) d += 628.3; if (d > 300) d -= 628.3; return a + d * k; }

function vaoSkin(gl, v, i) {
  const vao = gl.createVertexArray(); gl.bindVertexArray(vao);
  const vb = gl.createBuffer(); gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, vb); gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, v, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const st = SV * 4, at = (l, n, o) => { gl.enableVertexAttribArray(l); gl.vertexAttribPointer(l, n, gl.FLOAT, false, st, o * 4); };
  at(0, 3, 0); at(1, 3, 3); at(2, 2, 6); at(3, 1, 8); at(4, 1, 9); at(5, 1, 10); at(6, 1, 11);
  const ib = gl.createBuffer(); gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ib); gl.bufferData(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, i, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  gl.bindVertexArray(null);
  return { vao, n: i.length, type: i instanceof Uint32Array ? gl.UNSIGNED_INT : gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT };
}

export function roomOf(w, x, y, z) {
  const i = Math.floor(x / CS), j = Math.floor(z / CS);
  if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) return 0;
  const L = Math.max(0, Math.min(w.NL - 1, Math.floor((y + 0.05) / LH)));
  let r = w.roomAt[w.idx(L, i, j)];
  if (r < 0) {
    for (const [di, dj] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) { const ii = i + di, jj = j + dj; if (ii < 0 || jj < 0 || ii >= w.W || jj >= w.D) continue; const q = w.roomAt[w.idx(L, ii, jj)]; if (q >= 0) return q; }
    return 0;
  }
  return r;
}
