// 形を組み立てる道具（静的なメッシュ）。
// 頂点: pos3 nrm3 uv2 layer1 col3 ao1 room1 emit1 = 15 floats
// 面はすべて「法線の側から見て反時計回り」。背面は描かない（裏面カリング）。
export const WV = 15;

export class MeshBuilder {
  constructor() { this.v = []; this.i = []; this.n = 0; this.room = 0; this.emit = 0; this.xf = null; }
  // 変換（行列3x4: [ax,ay,az, bx,by,bz, cx,cy,cz, tx,ty,tz] = 列 X Y Z と移動）
  setXf(m) { this.xf = m; return this; }
  _p(x, y, z) {
    const m = this.xf; if (!m) return [x, y, z];
    return [m[0] * x + m[3] * y + m[6] * z + m[9], m[1] * x + m[4] * y + m[7] * z + m[10], m[2] * x + m[5] * y + m[8] * z + m[11]];
  }
  _n(x, y, z) {
    const m = this.xf; if (!m) return [x, y, z];
    const a = m[0] * x + m[3] * y + m[6] * z, b = m[1] * x + m[4] * y + m[7] * z, c = m[2] * x + m[5] * y + m[8] * z;
    const l = Math.hypot(a, b, c) || 1; return [a / l, b / l, c / l];
  }
  vert(p, n, u, v, layer, col, ao = 1) {
    const P = this._p(p[0], p[1], p[2]), N = this._n(n[0], n[1], n[2]);
    this.v.push(P[0], P[1], P[2], N[0], N[1], N[2], u, v, layer, col[0], col[1], col[2], ao, this.room, this.emit);
    return this.n++;
  }
  // 4点の面（法線の側から見て反時計回り: p0→p1→p2→p3）
  quad(p0, p1, p2, p3, n, uv, layer, col, ao) {
    const b = this.n;
    const A = ao || [1, 1, 1, 1];
    this.vert(p0, n, uv[0], uv[1], layer, col, A[0]);
    this.vert(p1, n, uv[2], uv[3], layer, col, A[1]);
    this.vert(p2, n, uv[4], uv[5], layer, col, A[2]);
    this.vert(p3, n, uv[6], uv[7], layer, col, A[3]);
    this.i.push(b, b + 1, b + 2, b, b + 2, b + 3);
  }
  tri(p0, p1, p2, n, layer, col, ao = 1) {
    const b = this.n;
    this.vert(p0, n, p0[0], p0[2], layer, col, ao); this.vert(p1, n, p1[0], p1[2], layer, col, ao); this.vert(p2, n, p2[0], p2[2], layer, col, ao);
    this.i.push(b, b + 1, b + 2);
  }
  // 軸にそった箱 [x0..x1, y0..y1, z0..z1]。faces: ビット(+x,-x,+y,-y,+z,-z)。uvは1mあたりs
  box(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, layer, col, o = {}) {
    const f = o.faces ?? 63, s = o.uv ?? 1, ao0 = o.aoBottom ?? 1, ao1 = o.aoTop ?? 1;
    const cols = o.cols || null; // 面ごとの色
    const c = (k) => (cols && cols[k]) || col;
    const ab = [ao0, ao0, ao1, ao1];
    const ox = o.uo ? o.uo[0] : 0, oy = o.uo ? o.uo[1] : 0;
    if (f & 1) this.quad([x1, y0, z1], [x1, y0, z0], [x1, y1, z0], [x1, y1, z1], [1, 0, 0], [z1 * s + ox, y0 * s + oy, z0 * s + ox, y0 * s + oy, z0 * s + ox, y1 * s + oy, z1 * s + ox, y1 * s + oy].map((q, k) => k % 2 ? q : -q), layer, c(0), ab);
    if (f & 2) this.quad([x0, y0, z0], [x0, y0, z1], [x0, y1, z1], [x0, y1, z0], [-1, 0, 0], [z0 * s + ox, y0 * s + oy, z1 * s + ox, y0 * s + oy, z1 * s + ox, y1 * s + oy, z0 * s + ox, y1 * s + oy], layer, c(1), ab);
    if (f & 4) this.quad([x0, y1, z1], [x1, y1, z1], [x1, y1, z0], [x0, y1, z0], [0, 1, 0], [x0 * s, z1 * s, x1 * s, z1 * s, x1 * s, z0 * s, x0 * s, z0 * s], layer, c(2), [ao1, ao1, ao1, ao1]);
    if (f & 8) this.quad([x0, y0, z0], [x1, y0, z0], [x1, y0, z1], [x0, y0, z1], [0, -1, 0], [x0 * s, z0 * s, x1 * s, z0 * s, x1 * s, z1 * s, x0 * s, z1 * s], layer, c(3), [ao0, ao0, ao0, ao0]);
    if (f & 16) this.quad([x0, y0, z1], [x1, y0, z1], [x1, y1, z1], [x0, y1, z1], [0, 0, 1], [x0 * s + ox, y0 * s + oy, x1 * s + ox, y0 * s + oy, x1 * s + ox, y1 * s + oy, x0 * s + ox, y1 * s + oy], layer, c(4), ab);
    if (f & 32) this.quad([x1, y0, z0], [x0, y0, z0], [x0, y1, z0], [x1, y1, z0], [0, 0, -1], [-x1 * s + ox, y0 * s + oy, -x0 * s + ox, y0 * s + oy, -x0 * s + ox, y1 * s + oy, -x1 * s + ox, y1 * s + oy], layer, c(5), ab);
  }
  // 角を落とした箱（面取り）。r = 面取りの幅。ローポリでも縁に光が乗って形が締まる（BattleBit の家具や銃のように）
  // o: box と同じ（faces・uv・cols・aoBottom・aoTop）。faces で省いた面の縁と角は、両側とも省いたときだけ消す
  bbox(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, r, layer, col, o = {}) {
    const dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0, dz = z1 - z0;
    r = Math.min(r, dx * 0.45, dy * 0.45, dz * 0.45);
    if (!(r > 1e-4)) return this.box(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, layer, col, o);
    const f = o.faces ?? 63, s = o.uv ?? 1, cols = o.cols || null;
    const ao0 = o.aoBottom ?? 1, ao1 = o.aoTop ?? 1;
    const aoY = (y) => ao0 + (ao1 - ao0) * ((y - y0) / dy);
    const lo = [x0, y0, z0], hi = [x1, y1, z1], ilo = [x0 + r, y0 + r, z0 + r], ihi = [x1 - r, y1 - r, z1 - r];
    // 面 a の、角 sg（各軸の±）の点
    const P = (a, sg) => [0, 1, 2].map(k => k === a ? (sg[k] > 0 ? hi[k] : lo[k]) : (sg[k] > 0 ? ihi[k] : ilo[k]));
    const bitOf = (a, sgn) => (a === 0 ? (sgn > 0 ? 1 : 2) : a === 1 ? (sgn > 0 ? 4 : 8) : (sgn > 0 ? 16 : 32));
    const faceCol = (a, sgn) => (cols && cols[a * 2 + (sgn > 0 ? 0 : 1)]) || col; // box と同じ並び: 0:+x 1:-x 2:+y 3:-y 4:+z 5:-z
    const uvOf = (p, n) => {
      const ax = Math.abs(n[0]), ay = Math.abs(n[1]), az = Math.abs(n[2]);
      if (ay >= ax && ay >= az) return [p[0] * s, p[2] * s];
      if (ax >= az) return [(n[0] > 0 ? -p[2] : p[2]) * s, p[1] * s];
      return [(n[2] > 0 ? p[0] : -p[0]) * s, p[1] * s];
    };
    const poly = (pts, n, c) => {
      // 法線の側から見て反時計回りにそろえる
      const e1 = [pts[1][0] - pts[0][0], pts[1][1] - pts[0][1], pts[1][2] - pts[0][2]], e2 = [pts[2][0] - pts[0][0], pts[2][1] - pts[0][1], pts[2][2] - pts[0][2]];
      const cr = [e1[1] * e2[2] - e1[2] * e2[1], e1[2] * e2[0] - e1[0] * e2[2], e1[0] * e2[1] - e1[1] * e2[0]];
      if (cr[0] * n[0] + cr[1] * n[1] + cr[2] * n[2] < 0) pts = pts.slice().reverse();
      const b = this.n;
      for (const p of pts) { const uv = uvOf(p, n); this.vert(p, n, uv[0], uv[1], layer, c, aoY(p[1])); }
      if (pts.length === 4) this.i.push(b, b + 1, b + 2, b, b + 2, b + 3); else this.i.push(b, b + 1, b + 2);
    };
    // 6つの面（内側の四角）
    for (let a = 0; a < 3; a++) for (const sg of [1, -1]) {
      if (!(f & bitOf(a, sg))) continue;
      const u = (a + 1) % 3, v = (a + 2) % 3;
      const pts = [[-1, -1], [1, -1], [1, 1], [-1, 1]].map(([su, sv]) => { const g = [0, 0, 0]; g[a] = sg; g[u] = su; g[v] = sv; return P(a, g); });
      const n = [0, 0, 0]; n[a] = sg;
      poly(pts, n, faceCol(a, sg));
    }
    // 12の縁（2つの面のあいだの斜めの帯）
    for (let a = 0; a < 3; a++) for (let b = a + 1; b < 3; b++) for (const sa of [1, -1]) for (const sb of [1, -1]) {
      if (!(f & bitOf(a, sa)) && !(f & bitOf(b, sb))) continue;
      const c = 3 - a - b;
      const pts = [];
      for (const sc of [-1, 1]) { const g = [0, 0, 0]; g[a] = sa; g[b] = sb; g[c] = sc; pts.push(P(a, g)); }
      for (const sc of [1, -1]) { const g = [0, 0, 0]; g[a] = sa; g[b] = sb; g[c] = sc; pts.push(P(b, g)); }
      const n = [0, 0, 0]; n[a] = sa * 0.7071; n[b] = sb * 0.7071;
      poly(pts, n, mixc(faceCol(a, sa), faceCol(b, sb), 0.5));
    }
    // 8つの角（3つの面の角を結ぶ三角）
    for (const sx of [1, -1]) for (const sy of [1, -1]) for (const sz of [1, -1]) {
      if (!(f & bitOf(0, sx)) && !(f & bitOf(1, sy)) && !(f & bitOf(2, sz))) continue;
      const g = [sx, sy, sz];
      const n = [sx * 0.5774, sy * 0.5774, sz * 0.5774];
      poly([P(0, g), P(1, g), P(2, g)], n, faceCol(1, sy));
    }
  }
  // 凸な多角形の面。点の並びは法線 n の側から見て反時計回りになるよう自動でそろえる
  poly(pts, n, layer, col, ao = 1) {
    const m = pts.length;
    if (m < 3) return;
    let nx = 0, ny = 0, nz = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) { const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % m]; nx += (a[1] - b[1]) * (a[2] + b[2]); ny += (a[2] - b[2]) * (a[0] + b[0]); nz += (a[0] - b[0]) * (a[1] + b[1]); }
    if (nx * n[0] + ny * n[1] + nz * n[2] < 0) pts = pts.slice().reverse();
    const ax = Math.abs(n[0]), ay = Math.abs(n[1]), az = Math.abs(n[2]);
    const base = this.n;
    for (const p of pts) {
      const uv = ay >= ax && ay >= az ? [p[0], p[2]] : ax >= az ? [n[0] > 0 ? -p[2] : p[2], p[1]] : [n[2] > 0 ? p[0] : -p[0], p[1]];
      this.vert(p, n, uv[0], uv[1], layer, col, ao);
    }
    for (let i = 1; i < m - 1; i++) this.i.push(base, base + i, base + i + 1);
  }
  // 横（X）へ押し出した凸な多角形。pts = [[z, y], ...]（z を右・y を上に見て反時計回り）。
  // o.edgeCols: 辺ごとの色（ガラスなど）、o.bevel: 両側の縁の面取り、o.capCol: 両側の面の色
  prismX(pts, x0, x1, layer, col, o = {}) {
    const m = pts.length, ec = o.edgeCols || [], bv = o.bevel || 0;
    let cu = 0, cv = 0; for (const q of pts) { cu += q[0]; cv += q[1]; } cu /= m; cv /= m;
    const shrink = (q) => { const du = q[0] - cu, dv = q[1] - cv, d = Math.hypot(du, dv) || 1; const k = Math.max(0, 1 - bv / d); return [cu + du * k, cv + dv * k]; };
    const xa = x0 + bv, xb = x1 - bv, capC = o.capCol || col;
    for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
      const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % m];
      const du = b[0] - a[0], dv = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(du, dv) || 1;
      this.poly([[xa, a[1], a[0]], [xb, a[1], a[0]], [xb, b[1], b[0]], [xa, b[1], b[0]]], [0, -du / L, dv / L], layer, ec[i] || col);
    }
    const S = bv > 0 ? pts.map(shrink) : pts;
    for (const [xs, xe, sg] of [[xb, x1, 1], [xa, x0, -1]]) {
      this.poly(S.map(q => [xe, q[1], q[0]]), [sg, 0, 0], layer, capC);
      if (bv > 0) for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % m], sa = S[i], sb = S[(i + 1) % m];
        const du = b[0] - a[0], dv = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(du, dv) || 1;
        this.poly([[xs, a[1], a[0]], [xs, b[1], b[0]], [xe, sb[1], sb[0]], [xe, sa[1], sa[0]]], nrm([sg, -du / L, dv / L]), layer, mixc(ec[i] || col, capC, 0.5));
      }
    }
  }
  // 中心と大きさの箱
  cbox(cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz, layer, col, o) { this.box(cx - sx / 2, cy - sy / 2, cz - sz / 2, cx + sx / 2, cy + sy / 2, cz + sz / 2, layer, col, o); }
  // 円柱（Y軸、y0..y1）。seg角形
  cyl(cx, cz, y0, y1, r0, r1, seg, layer, col, o = {}) {
    const capT = o.capT ?? true, capB = o.capB ?? false;
    const base = this.n;
    const slope = (r0 - r1) / Math.max(1e-6, y1 - y0);
    for (let k = 0; k <= seg; k++) {
      const a = (k / seg) * Math.PI * 2 + (o.rot || 0), x = Math.cos(a), z = Math.sin(a);
      const nl = Math.hypot(1, slope);
      const n = [x / nl, slope / nl, z / nl];
      const u = k / seg * Math.PI * 2 * Math.max(r0, r1);
      this.vert([cx + x * r0, y0, cz + z * r0], n, u, y0, layer, col, o.aoBottom ?? 1);
      this.vert([cx + x * r1, y1, cz + z * r1], n, u, y1, layer, col, 1);
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < seg; k++) { const a = base + k * 2; this.i.push(a, a + 1, a + 3, a, a + 3, a + 2); }
    if (capT && r1 > 0) { const c = this.n; this.vert([cx, y1, cz], [0, 1, 0], cx, cz, layer, col); for (let k = 0; k <= seg; k++) { const a = (k / seg) * Math.PI * 2 + (o.rot || 0); this.vert([cx + Math.cos(a) * r1, y1, cz + Math.sin(a) * r1], [0, 1, 0], cx + Math.cos(a) * r1, cz + Math.sin(a) * r1, layer, col); } for (let k = 0; k < seg; k++) this.i.push(c, c + 2 + k, c + 1 + k); }
    if (capB && r0 > 0) { const c = this.n; this.vert([cx, y0, cz], [0, -1, 0], cx, cz, layer, col); for (let k = 0; k <= seg; k++) { const a = (k / seg) * Math.PI * 2 + (o.rot || 0); this.vert([cx + Math.cos(a) * r0, y0, cz + Math.sin(a) * r0], [0, -1, 0], cx, cz, layer, col); } for (let k = 0; k < seg; k++) this.i.push(c, c + 1 + k, c + 2 + k); }
  }
  // 2点を結ぶ柱（任意の向き）。r0→r1、seg角形
  tube(a, b, r0, r1, seg, layer, col, o = {}) {
    const dx = b[0] - a[0], dy = b[1] - a[1], dz = b[2] - a[2], L = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) || 1e-6;
    const ax = [dx / L, dy / L, dz / L];
    const up = Math.abs(ax[1]) < 0.9 ? [0, 1, 0] : [1, 0, 0];
    let u = cross(ax, up); u = nrm(u); const w = cross(ax, u);
    const base = this.n;
    for (let k = 0; k <= seg; k++) {
      const t = (k / seg) * Math.PI * 2 + (o.rot || 0), c = Math.cos(t), s = Math.sin(t);
      const n = [u[0] * c + w[0] * s, u[1] * c + w[1] * s, u[2] * c + w[2] * s];
      this.vert([a[0] + n[0] * r0, a[1] + n[1] * r0, a[2] + n[2] * r0], n, k / seg, 0, layer, col);
      this.vert([b[0] + n[0] * r1, b[1] + n[1] * r1, b[2] + n[2] * r1], n, k / seg, L, layer, col);
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < seg; k++) { const q = base + k * 2; this.i.push(q, q + 2, q + 3, q, q + 3, q + 1); }
    if (o.caps) {
      for (const [P, r, sg] of [[a, r0, -1], [b, r1, 1]]) {
        if (r <= 0) continue;
        const c = this.n; const nn = [ax[0] * sg, ax[1] * sg, ax[2] * sg];
        this.vert(P, nn, 0, 0, layer, col);
        for (let k = 0; k <= seg; k++) { const t = (k / seg) * Math.PI * 2 + (o.rot || 0), cc = Math.cos(t), s = Math.sin(t); this.vert([P[0] + (u[0] * cc + w[0] * s) * r, P[1] + (u[1] * cc + w[1] * s) * r, P[2] + (u[2] * cc + w[2] * s) * r], nn, 0, 0, layer, col); }
        for (let k = 0; k < seg; k++) { if (sg > 0) this.i.push(c, c + 1 + k, c + 2 + k); else this.i.push(c, c + 2 + k, c + 1 + k); }
      }
    }
  }
  // 断面をつないだ形（ロフト）: rings = [{y, rx, rz, cx?, cz?}]、seg角形、Y軸にそって
  loft(rings, seg, layer, col, o = {}) {
    const base = this.n;
    const rows = rings.length;
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const R = rings[r];
      const prev = rings[Math.max(0, r - 1)], next = rings[Math.min(rows - 1, r + 1)];
      for (let k = 0; k <= seg; k++) {
        const t = (k / seg) * Math.PI * 2 + (o.rot || 0), c = Math.cos(t), s = Math.sin(t);
        const x = (R.cx || 0) + c * R.rx, z = (R.cz || 0) + s * R.rz;
        // 法線: 断面の外向き＋上下の傾き
        const drx = (next.rx - prev.rx), drz = (next.rz - prev.rz), dy = (next.y - prev.y) || 1e-6;
        let n = [c / R.rx * 1, 0, s / R.rz * 1]; n = nrm(n);
        const sl = -((drx * Math.abs(c) + drz * Math.abs(s)) / dy);
        n = nrm([n[0], sl * 0.8, n[2]]);
        this.vert([x, R.y, z], n, k / seg * 2, R.y, layer, R.col || col, R.ao ?? 1);
      }
    }
    for (let r = 0; r < rows - 1; r++) for (let k = 0; k < seg; k++) {
      const a = base + r * (seg + 1) + k, b = a + seg + 1;
      this.i.push(a, b, b + 1, a, b + 1, a + 1);
    }
    if (o.capTop) { const R = rings[rows - 1], c = this.n; this.vert([R.cx || 0, R.y, R.cz || 0], [0, 1, 0], 0, 0, layer, R.col || col); for (let k = 0; k <= seg; k++) { const t = (k / seg) * Math.PI * 2 + (o.rot || 0); this.vert([(R.cx || 0) + Math.cos(t) * R.rx, R.y, (R.cz || 0) + Math.sin(t) * R.rz], [0, 1, 0], 0, 0, layer, R.col || col); } for (let k = 0; k < seg; k++) this.i.push(c, c + 2 + k, c + 1 + k); }
    if (o.capBot) { const R = rings[0], c = this.n; this.vert([R.cx || 0, R.y, R.cz || 0], [0, -1, 0], 0, 0, layer, R.col || col); for (let k = 0; k <= seg; k++) { const t = (k / seg) * Math.PI * 2 + (o.rot || 0); this.vert([(R.cx || 0) + Math.cos(t) * R.rx, R.y, (R.cz || 0) + Math.sin(t) * R.rz], [0, -1, 0], 0, 0, layer, R.col || col); } for (let k = 0; k < seg; k++) this.i.push(c, c + 1 + k, c + 2 + k); }
  }
  get count() { return this.n; }
  arrays() { return { v: new Float32Array(this.v), i: this.n > 65535 ? new Uint32Array(this.i) : new Uint16Array(this.i) }; }
  // 別のビルダーの中身を足す
  append(b) {
    const off = this.n;
    for (let k = 0; k < b.v.length; k++) this.v.push(b.v[k]);
    for (let k = 0; k < b.i.length; k++) this.i.push(b.i[k] + off);
    this.n += b.n;
  }
}

export function cross(a, b) { return [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]]; }
export function nrm(a) { const l = Math.hypot(a[0], a[1], a[2]) || 1; return [a[0] / l, a[1] / l, a[2] / l]; }
// 変換を作る: 位置(x,y,z)、Y軸の回転、拡大
export function xfYaw(x, y, z, yaw, sx = 1, sy = 1, sz = 1) {
  const c = Math.cos(yaw), s = Math.sin(yaw);
  // 列 X=(c,0,-s)*sx, Y=(0,1,0)*sy, Z=(s,0,c)*sz
  return [c * sx, 0, -s * sx, 0, sy, 0, s * sz, 0, c * sz, x, y, z];
}
// 色: '#rrggbb' → [r,g,b]（0..1、線形に近い値）
export function hex(h) {
  const n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16);
  const f = (v) => Math.pow(v / 255, 2.2);
  return [f((n >> 16) & 255), f((n >> 8) & 255), f(n & 255)];
}
export function mixc(a, b, t) { return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t]; }
export function mulc(a, k) { return [a[0] * k, a[1] * k, a[2] * k]; }

  rnd() { this.seed = (this.seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0; return this.seed / 4294967296; }
  rs(a) { return (this.rnd() * 2 - 1) * a; }
  clear() { this.p.length = 0; this.decN = 0; this.decHead = 0; this.decDirty = true; this.tracers.length = 0; this.flashes.length = 0; }

  // 粒子1つ: {x,y,z, vx,vy,vz, life, t, s0, s1, c:[r,g,b,a], add, sh, g(重力), lit, drag, bounce}
  add(o) {
    // 量を減らす設定: 光る物（銃口の炎・火花）以外を間引く
    if (this.amount < 1 && !o.add && this.rnd() > this.amount) return o;
    if (this.p.length >= MAXP) this.p.shift(); o.t = 0; this.p.push(o); return o;
  }

  // ---- 発生
  impact(x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, mat) {
    const w = this.r.w0;
    const k = mat === M.METAL || mat === M.METALFURN || mat === M.CAR || mat === M.DOORMETAL || mat === M.REINF ? 'metal'
      : mat === M.WOOD || mat === M.DOORWOOD || mat === M.FURN || mat === M.BARRICADE ? 'wood'
        : mat === M.GLASS || mat === M.GLASSBROKEN ? 'glass' : mat === M.FABRIC ? 'fabric' : 'dust';
    const col = k === 'wood' ? [0.42, 0.3, 0.2] : k === 'fabric' ? [0.5, 0.48, 0.46] : mat === M.BRICK ? [0.5, 0.32, 0.25] : [0.62, 0.6, 0.57];
    if (k === 'metal') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) this.add({ x, y, z, vx: nx * 2 + this.rs(2.5), vy: ny * 2 + this.rs(2.5) + 1, vz: nz * 2 + this.rs(2.5), life: 0.15 + this.rnd() * 0.2, s0: 0.012, s1: 0.004, c: [4, 2.2, 0.8, 1], add: true, sh: SH.streak, g: 6, stretch: 0.04 });
      this.add({ x: x + nx * 0.02, y: y + ny * 0.02, z: z + nz * 0.02, vx: nx * 0.3, vy: 0.2, vz: nz * 0.3, life: 0.5, s0: 0.05, s1: 0.18, c: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.35], sh: SH.soft, g: 0, lit: true, drag: 2 });
    } else if (k === 'glass') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) this.add({ x, y, z, vx: this.rs(1.5) - nx, vy: this.rnd() * 1.5, vz: this.rs(1.5) - nz, life: 0.8, s0: 0.02, s1: 0.015, c: [0.7, 0.85, 0.9, 0.8], sh: SH.square, g: 9.8, lit: true, bounce: true });
    } else {
      // 粉じんのけむり＋かけら
      const n = Math.round((k === 'wood' ? 5 : 4) * Math.max(1, this.amount));
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) this.add({ x, y, z, vx: nx * (1.5 + this.rnd() * 2) + this.rs(1.2), vy: ny * 2 + this.rnd() * 1.6, vz: nz * (1.5 + this.rnd() * 2) + this.rs(1.2), life: 0.5 + this.rnd() * 0.4, s0: 0.012 + this.rnd() * 0.012, s1: 0.01, c: [col[0] * 0.8, col[1] * 0.8, col[2] * 0.8, 1], sh: SH.square, g: 9.8, lit: true, bounce: true });
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) this.add({ x: x + nx * 0.03, y: y + ny * 0.03, z: z + nz * 0.03, vx: nx * (0.4 + this.rnd() * 0.4) + this.rs(0.2), vy: 0.15 + this.rnd() * 0.2, vz: nz * (0.4 + this.rnd() * 0.4) + this.rs(0.2), life: 0.9 + this.rnd() * 0.5, s0: 0.06, s1: 0.32, c: [col[0], col[1], col[2], 0.42], sh: SH.soft, g: -0.05, lit: true, drag: 1.6 });
    }
    // 弾痕
    if (k !== 'glass' && k !== 'fabric') this.decal(x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, 0.022 + this.rnd() * 0.012, k === 'metal' ? [0.18, 0.18, 0.2, 0.95] : [0.1, 0.09, 0.08, 0.95], SH.hole, this.rnd() * 6.28);
  }
  bloodHit(x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, n = 1) {
    if (!this.blood) return;
    const m = Math.min(4, n);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4 + m * 2; i++) this.add({ x, y, z, vx: dx * (1 + this.rnd() * 2) + this.rs(0.8), vy: dy + this.rnd() * 1.2, vz: dz * (1 + this.rnd() * 2) + this.rs(0.8), life: 0.4 + this.rnd() * 0.3, s0: 0.02 + this.rnd() * 0.02, s1: 0.012, c: [0.35, 0.02, 0.02, 1], sh: SH.soft, g: 9.8, lit: true });
    this.add({ x, y, z, vx: dx * 0.6, vy: 0.1, vz: dz * 0.6, life: 0.35, s0: 0.08, s1: 0.25, c: [0.4, 0.03, 0.03, 0.45], sh: SH.soft, g: 0, lit: true, drag: 3 });
  }
  // 血の跡（後ろの壁や床）
  bloodSplat(x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, size) { if (this.blood) this.decal(x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, size, [0.22, 0.01, 0.01, 0.9], SH.soft, this.rnd() * 6.28); }
  muzzle(x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, scale = 1, supp = false) {
    if (supp) { this.add({ x: x + dx * 0.02, y: y + dy * 0.02, z: z + dz * 0.02, vx: dx * 0.4, vy: 0.1, vz: dz * 0.4, life: 0.25, s0: 0.03, s1: 0.1, c: [0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 0.25], sh: SH.soft, g: 0, lit: true, drag: 3 }); return; }
    this.add({ x: x + dx * 0.04, y: y + dy * 0.04, z: z + dz * 0.04, vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0, life: 0.045, s0: 0.09 * scale, s1: 0.12 * scale, c: [8, 5, 2, 1], add: true, sh: SH.soft });
    this.add({ x: x + dx * 0.1, y: y + dy * 0.1, z: z + dz * 0.1, vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0, life: 0.035, s0: 0.05 * scale, s1: 0.06 * scale, c: [10, 7, 3, 1], add: true, sh: SH.streak, dir: [dx, dy, dz], stretch: 0.16 * scale });
    this.add({ x: x + dx * 0.05, y: y + dy * 0.05, z: z + dz * 0.05, vx: dx * 0.6, vy: 0.15, vz: dz * 0.6, life: 0.5, s0: 0.04, s1: 0.2, c: [0.55, 0.55, 0.55, 0.28], sh: SH.soft, g: -0.1, lit: true, drag: 2.5 });
    this.flashes.push({ x: x + dx * 0.2, y: y + dy * 0.2, z: z + dz * 0.2, r: 5.5, col: [6.0, 3.6, 1.6], t: 0.05 });
  }
  shell(x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, big) {
    if (!this.shells) return;
    this.add({ x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, life: 1.6, s0: big ? 0.016 : 0.011, s1: big ? 0.016 : 0.011, c: [0.75, 0.55, 0.22, 1], sh: SH.square, g: 9.8, lit: true, bounce: true, shell: true });
  }
  tracer(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, col) { this.tracers.push({ x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, col: col || [9, 5, 2], t: 0 }); }
  smoke(x, y, z, r, col = [0.75, 0.75, 0.75], a = 0.4, life = 3) {
    this.add({ x: x + this.rs(r * 0.4), y: y + this.rs(r * 0.2), z: z + this.rs(r * 0.4), vx: this.rs(0.15), vy: 0.08 + this.rnd() * 0.1, vz: this.rs(0.15), life: life * (0.7 + this.rnd() * 0.6), s0: r * 0.5, s1: r * 1.1, c: [col[0], col[1], col[2], a], sh: SH.soft, g: 0, lit: true, drag: 0.6 });
  }
  explosion(x, y, z, r, kind) {
    const big = kind === 'c2' || kind === 'frame' || kind === 'frag';
    this.add({ x, y, z, vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0, life: 0.12, s0: r * 0.35, s1: r * 0.6, c: [20, 14, 8, 1], add: true, sh: SH.soft });
    if (big) for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) this.add({ x, y, z, vx: this.rs(3), vy: this.rnd() * 3, vz: this.rs(3), life: 0.35, s0: 0.3, s1: 0.6, c: [6, 2.5, 0.8, 0.8], add: true, sh: SH.soft, drag: 4 });
    for (let i = 0; i < (big ? 12 : 5); i++) this.add({ x, y, z, vx: this.rs(4), vy: this.rnd() * 4, vz: this.rs(4), life: 0.8, s0: 0.03, s1: 0.02, c: [0.25, 0.22, 0.2, 1], sh: SH.square, g: 9.8, lit: true, bounce: true });
    for (let i = 0; i < (big ? 10 : 6); i++) this.smoke(x, y + 0.3, z, big ? 1.4 : 0.8, big ? [0.35, 0.33, 0.32] : [0.85, 0.85, 0.85], big ? 0.55 : 0.45, big ? 4 : 2.5);
    this.flashes.push({ x, y: y + 0.3, z, r: big ? 12 : 9, col: kind === 'flash' ? [60, 60, 60] : [40, 22, 8], t: kind === 'flash' ? 0.09 : 0.14 });
    if (big) this.decal(x, Math.floor((y + 0.2) / 3) * 3 + 0.01, z, 0, 1, 0, r * 0.25, [0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.85], SH.soft, this.rnd() * 6);
  }
  glassBreak(x, y, z, along) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) this.add({ x: x + this.rs(0.25), y: y + this.rnd() * 1.3, z: z + this.rs(0.25), vx: this.rs(1.4), vy: this.rnd() * 0.8, vz: this.rs(1.4), life: 1.2, s0: 0.03, s1: 0.02, c: [0.75, 0.88, 0.95, 0.85], sh: SH.square, g: 9.8, lit: true, bounce: true });
  }
  debris(x, y, z, col) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) this.add({ x: x + this.rs(0.25), y: y + this.rs(0.3), z: z + this.rs(0.25), vx: this.rs(2), vy: this.rnd() * 2, vz: this.rs(2), life: 1.4, s0: 0.035 + this.rnd() * 0.04, s1: 0.03, c: [col[0], col[1], col[2], 1], sh: SH.square, g: 9.8, lit: true, bounce: true });
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.smoke(x, y, z, 0.5, [col[0] * 1.2, col[1] * 1.2, col[2] * 1.2], 0.45, 1.8);
  }
  decal(x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, size, col, sh, rot) {
    // 面にそった四角（法線の少し手前）
    const up = Math.abs(ny) > 0.9 ? [1, 0, 0] : [0, 1, 0];
    let ux = up[1] * nz - up[2] * ny, uy = up[2] * nx - up[0] * nz, uz = up[0] * ny - up[1] * nx;
    const ul = Math.hypot(ux, uy, uz) || 1; ux /= ul; uy /= ul; uz /= ul;
    let vx = ny * uz - nz * uy, vy = nz * ux - nx * uz, vz = nx * uy - ny * ux;
    const c = Math.cos(rot), s = Math.sin(rot);
    const ax = (ux * c + vx * s) * size, ay = (uy * c + vy * s) * size, az = (uz * c + vz * s) * size;
    const bx = (vx * c - ux * s) * size, by = (vy * c - uy * s) * size, bz = (vz * c - uz * s) * size;
    const px = x + nx * 0.004, py = y + ny * 0.004, pz = z + nz * 0.004;
    const o = this.decHead * 4 * FV;
    const put = (k, X, Y, Z, u, v) => { const q = o + k * FV; this.dec[q] = X; this.dec[q + 1] = Y; this.dec[q + 2] = Z; this.dec[q + 3] = col[0]; this.dec[q + 4] = col[1]; this.dec[q + 5] = col[2]; this.dec[q + 6] = col[3]; this.dec[q + 7] = u; this.dec[q + 8] = v; this.dec[q + 9] = sh; this.dec[q + 10] = 1; };
    put(0, px - ax - bx, py - ay - by, pz - az - bz, -1, -1);
    put(1, px + ax - bx, py + ay - by, pz + az - bz, 1, -1);
    put(2, px + ax + bx, py + ay + by, pz + az + bz, 1, 1);
    put(3, px - ax + bx, py - ay + by, pz - az + bz, -1, 1);
    this.decHead = (this.decHead + 1) % MAXD; this.decN = Math.min(MAXD, this.decN + 1); this.decDirty = true;
  }

  // ---- 進める
  update(dt) {
    const w = this.r.w0;
    for (let i = this.p.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const q = this.p[i];
      q.t += dt;
      if (q.t >= q.life) { this.p.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      if (q.drag) { const k = Math.exp(-q.drag * dt); q.vx *= k; q.vy *= k; q.vz *= k; }
      q.vy -= (q.g || 0) * dt;
      q.x += q.vx * dt; q.y += q.vy * dt; q.z += q.vz * dt;
      if (q.bounce && w) {
        const g = groundAt(w, q.x, q.z, q.y + 0.3);
        if (q.y < g + 0.005) { q.y = g + 0.005; if (q.vy < -0.5) { q.vy = -q.vy * 0.3; q.vx *= 0.5; q.vz *= 0.5; } else { q.vy = 0; q.vx *= 0.7; q.vz *= 0.7; } if (q.shell && !q.clink) { q.clink = true; if (this.onClink) this.onClink(q.x, q.y, q.z); } }
      }
    }
    for (let i = this.tracers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { this.tracers[i].t += dt; if (this.tracers[i].t > 0.03) this.tracers.splice(i, 1); }
    for (let i = this.flashes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { this.flashes[i].t -= dt; if (this.flashes[i].t <= 0) this.flashes.splice(i, 1); }
  }
  // 一瞬の光を動く光の一覧へ
  lights(out, roomsFor) {
    for (const f of this.flashes) out.push({ x: f.x, y: f.y, z: f.z, r: f.r, col: f.col, rooms: roomsFor(f.x, f.y, f.z, f.r) });
  }

  draw(f) {
    const r = this.r, gl = this.gl;
    const P = r.P.fx;
    r._bindLight(P, f);
    gl.uniformMatrix4fv(P.u.uVP, false, r.vp);
    gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.depthMask(false);
    // 弾痕・血の跡
    if (this.decN) {
      if (this.decDirty) { gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, this.db.vb); gl.bufferSubData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, this.dec, 0, this.decN * 4 * FV); this.decDirty = false; }
      gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
      gl.enable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL); gl.polygonOffset(-1, -2);
      gl.bindVertexArray(this.db.vao); gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, this.decN * 6, gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT, 0);
      gl.disable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);
    }
    // 粒子（カメラ向きの四角）
    const cam = r.camPos, V = r.view;
    const rx = V[0], ry = V[4], rz = V[8], ux = V[1], uy = V[5], uz = V[9];
    const v = this.verts;
    let nA = 0;
    const put = (q, n) => {
      const a = 1 - q.t / q.life, s = q.s0 + (q.s1 - q.s0) * (q.t / q.life);
      const al = q.c[3] * (q.add ? a : Math.min(1, a * 1.5));
      let ax = rx * s, ay = ry * s, az = rz * s, bx = ux * s, by = uy * s, bz = uz * s;
      if (q.sh === SH.streak) {
        // 進む向きに伸ばす
        let dx = q.dir ? q.dir[0] : q.vx, dy = q.dir ? q.dir[1] : q.vy, dz = q.dir ? q.dir[2] : q.vz;
        const L = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) || 1; dx /= L; dy /= L; dz /= L;
        const tx = q.x - cam[0], ty = q.y - cam[1], tz = q.z - cam[2];
        let px = dy * tz - dz * ty, py = dz * tx - dx * tz, pz = dx * ty - dy * tx; const pl = Math.hypot(px, py, pz) || 1; px /= pl; py /= pl; pz /= pl;
        const st = q.stretch || 0.05;
        ax = dx * st; ay = dy * st; az = dz * st; bx = px * s; by = py * s; bz = pz * s;
      }
      const o = n * 4 * FV;
      const w = (k, X, Y, Z, u, vv) => { const p = o + k * FV; v[p] = X; v[p + 1] = Y; v[p + 2] = Z; v[p + 3] = q.c[0]; v[p + 4] = q.c[1]; v[p + 5] = q.c[2]; v[p + 6] = al; v[p + 7] = u; v[p + 8] = vv; v[p + 9] = q.sh; v[p + 10] = q.lit ? 1 : 0; };
      w(0, q.x - ax - bx, q.y - ay - by, q.z - az - bz, -1, -1);
      w(1, q.x + ax - bx, q.y + ay - by, q.z + az - bz, 1, -1);
      w(2, q.x + ax + bx, q.y + ay + by, q.z + az + bz, 1, 1);
      w(3, q.x - ax + bx, q.y - ay + by, q.z - az + bz, -1, 1);
    };
    // 不透明に近いもの（アルファ）を先に、光るもの（加算）を後に
    for (const q of this.p) if (!q.add) put(q, nA++);
    let nB = nA;
    for (const q of this.p) if (q.add) put(q, nB++);
    // 曳光弾
    for (const t of this.tracers) {
      if (nB >= MAXP) break;
      const q = { x: (t.x0 + t.x1) / 2, y: (t.y0 + t.y1) / 2, z: (t.z0 + t.z1) / 2, dir: [t.x1 - t.x0, t.y1 - t.y0, t.z1 - t.z0], t: 0, life: 1, s0: 0.012, s1: 0.012, c: [t.col[0], t.col[1], t.col[2], 1], sh: SH.streak, add: true, stretch: Math.hypot(t.x1 - t.x0, t.y1 - t.y0, t.z1 - t.z0) / 2 };
      put(q, nB++);
    }
    if (nB) {
      gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, this.pb.vb); gl.bufferSubData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, v, 0, nB * 4 * FV);
      gl.bindVertexArray(this.pb.vao);
      if (nA) { gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, nA * 6, gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT, 0); }
      if (nB > nA) { gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE); gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, (nB - nA) * 6, gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT, nA * 12); }
    }
    gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  }
}

// WebGL2 の小さな道具
export function createGL(canvas, opts = {}) {
  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl2', {
    antialias: false, alpha: false, depth: true, stencil: false, premultipliedAlpha: false,
    preserveDrawingBuffer: !!opts.preserve, powerPreference: 'high-performance', desynchronized: false,
  });
  if (!gl) return null;
  const ext = {
    cbf: gl.getExtension('EXT_color_buffer_float'),
    cbhf: gl.getExtension('EXT_color_buffer_half_float'),
    aniso: gl.getExtension('EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic'),
    flin: gl.getExtension('OES_texture_float_linear'),
  };
  gl.ext = ext;
  gl.hdr = !!(ext.cbf || ext.cbhf);
  gl.maxSamples = gl.getParameter(gl.MAX_SAMPLES) || 0;
  return gl;
}

const PREC = 'precision highp float;\nprecision highp int;\nprecision highp sampler2DArray;\nprecision highp sampler2DShadow;\n';

export function compile(gl, type, src, name) {
  const sh = gl.createShader(type);
  gl.shaderSource(sh, src);
  gl.compileShader(sh);
  if (!gl.getShaderParameter(sh, gl.COMPILE_STATUS) && !gl.isContextLost()) {
    const log = gl.getShaderInfoLog(sh);
    const lines = src.split('\n').map((l, i) => (i + 1) + ': ' + l);
    const m = /ERROR: \d+:(\d+)/.exec(log || '');
    const near = m ? lines.slice(Math.max(0, +m[1] - 4), +m[1] + 2).join('\n') : '';
    throw new Error(`シェーダーのエラー(${name}): ${log}\n${near}`);
  }
  return sh;
}

export function program(gl, vs, fs, name = 'prog', defines = '') {
  const head = '#version 300 es\n' + defines + PREC;
  const p = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(p, compile(gl, gl.VERTEX_SHADER, head + vs, name + '.vs'));
  gl.attachShader(p, compile(gl, gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, head + fs, name + '.fs'));
  gl.bindAttribLocation(p, 0, 'aPos');
  gl.bindAttribLocation(p, 1, 'aNrm');
  gl.bindAttribLocation(p, 2, 'aUV');
  gl.bindAttribLocation(p, 3, 'aMat');
  gl.bindAttribLocation(p, 4, 'aCol');
  gl.bindAttribLocation(p, 5, 'aJoint');
  gl.bindAttribLocation(p, 6, 'aWeight');
  gl.linkProgram(p);
  if (!gl.getProgramParameter(p, gl.LINK_STATUS) && !gl.isContextLost()) throw new Error(`リンクのエラー(${name}): ${gl.getProgramInfoLog(p)}`);
  const u = {};
  const n = gl.getProgramParameter(p, gl.ACTIVE_UNIFORMS);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const info = gl.getActiveUniform(p, i);
    const nm = info.name.replace(/\[0\]$/, '');
    u[nm] = gl.getUniformLocation(p, info.name);
  }
  return { p, u, name };
}

// 頂点の並び: pos3 nrm3 uv2 mat1 col4(ao,tint..) = 13 floats
export const STRIDE = 13;

export function makeVAO(gl, data, index, layout = 'std') {
  const vao = gl.createVertexArray();
  gl.bindVertexArray(vao);
  const vb = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, vb);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, data, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  if (layout === 'std') {
    const st = STRIDE * 4;
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0); gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, st, 0);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1); gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, st, 12);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(2); gl.vertexAttribPointer(2, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, st, 24);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(3); gl.vertexAttribPointer(3, 1, gl.FLOAT, false, st, 32);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(4); gl.vertexAttribPointer(4, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, st, 36);
  }
  let ib = null, count = data.length / STRIDE, type = 0;
  if (index) {
    ib = gl.createBuffer();
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ib);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, index, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    count = index.length;
    type = index instanceof Uint32Array ? gl.UNSIGNED_INT : gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT;
  }
  gl.bindVertexArray(null);
  return { vao, vb, ib, count, type };
}

export function drawVAO(gl, m, first = 0, count = -1) {
  gl.bindVertexArray(m.vao);
  if (m.ib) gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, count < 0 ? m.count : count, m.type, first * (m.type === gl.UNSIGNED_INT ? 4 : 2));
  else gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, first, count < 0 ? m.count : count);
}

export function deleteVAO(gl, m) {
  if (!m) return;
  gl.deleteVertexArray(m.vao); gl.deleteBuffer(m.vb); if (m.ib) gl.deleteBuffer(m.ib);
}

export function tex2D(gl, w, h, { internal = gl.RGBA8, format = gl.RGBA, type = gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, data = null, filter = gl.LINEAR, wrap = gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE, mip = false } = {}) {
  const t = gl.createTexture();
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t);
  gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, internal, w, h, 0, format, type, data);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, mip ? gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR : filter);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, filter);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, wrap);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, wrap);
  if (mip) gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D);
  t.w = w; t.h = h;
  return t;
}

export function fbo(gl, color, depth) {
  const f = gl.createFramebuffer();
  gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, f);
  if (color) {
    const list = Array.isArray(color) ? color : [color];
    list.forEach((c, i) => {
      if (c instanceof WebGLRenderbuffer) gl.framebufferRenderbuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 + i, gl.RENDERBUFFER, c);
      else gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 + i, gl.TEXTURE_2D, c, 0);
    });
    if (list.length > 1) gl.drawBuffers(list.map((_, i) => gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 + i));
  } else {
    gl.drawBuffers([gl.NONE]); gl.readBuffer(gl.NONE);
  }
  if (depth) {
    if (depth instanceof WebGLRenderbuffer) gl.framebufferRenderbuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.DEPTH_ATTACHMENT, gl.RENDERBUFFER, depth);
    else gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.DEPTH_ATTACHMENT, gl.TEXTURE_2D, depth, 0);
  }
  const st = gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER);
  gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
  f.ok = st === gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE;
  return f;
}

export function depthTex(gl, w, h, compare = false) {
  const t = gl.createTexture();
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t);
  gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.DEPTH_COMPONENT24, w, h, 0, gl.DEPTH_COMPONENT, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, null);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, compare ? gl.LINEAR : gl.NEAREST);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, compare ? gl.LINEAR : gl.NEAREST);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  if (compare) {
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_COMPARE_MODE, gl.COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_COMPARE_FUNC, gl.LEQUAL);
  }
  t.w = w; t.h = h;
  return t;
}

// 面取りの幅: 部品の一番細い所の2割（0.6〜4mm）。小さな部品ほど細かく、縁に光が乗る
const bev = (a, b, c) => Math.max(0.0006, Math.min(0.004, Math.min(a, b, c) * 0.2));
// 向きのある箱（中心 c、軸 u v w、半分の長さ）。面取りつき
function obox(B, c, u, v, w, hu, hv, hw, layer, col) {
  const prev = B.xf;
  B.xf = [u[0], u[1], u[2], v[0], v[1], v[2], w[0], w[1], w[2], c[0], c[1], c[2]];
  B.bbox(-hu, -hv, -hw, hu, hv, hw, bev(hu * 2, hv * 2, hw * 2), layer, col);
  B.xf = prev;
}
// 傾いた握り: 上の点 (y0,z0) から下の点 (y1,z1) へ、厚さ x、前後 d
function grip(B, y0, z0, y1, z1, hx, hd, col, layer = LAYER.rubber) {
  const c = [0, (y0 + y1) / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2];
  let v = nrm([0, y0 - y1, z0 - z1]);
  const L = Math.hypot(y0 - y1, z0 - z1) / 2;
  const u = [1, 0, 0], w = cross(u, v);
  obox(B, c, u, v, w, hx, L, hd, layer, col);
}
const bx = (B, x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, col, layer = LAYER.paint) => { const a = Math.min(x0, x1), b = Math.min(y0, y1), c = Math.min(z0, z1), d = Math.max(x0, x1), e = Math.max(y0, y1), g = Math.max(z0, z1); B.bbox(a, b, c, d, e, g, bev(d - a, e - b, g - c), layer, col); };
const sbx = (B, hx, y0, z0, y1, z1, col, layer) => bx(B, -hx, y0, z0, hx, y1, z1, col, layer);
const tz = (B, z0, z1, r, y, col, seg = 8, r1, x = 0) => B.tube([x, y, z0], [x, y, z1], r, r1 ?? r, seg, LAYER.metal, col, { caps: true });
// 照門（のぞき穴の輪）: 照準の線 y を中心に、まわりの枠だけ
function peep(B, y, z, col = K.blk, base) {
  const h = 0.0105, t = 0.0028, d = 0.006;
  bx(B, h, y - h, z - d, h - t, y + h, z + d, col); bx(B, -h, y - h, z - d, -h + t, y + h, z + d, col);
  bx(B, -h, y + h - t, z - d, h, y + h, z + d, col); bx(B, -h, y - h, z - d, h, y - h + t, z + d, col);
  if (base != null) bx(B, -0.006, base, z - d, 0.006, y - h, z + d, col);
}
// 照門（切り欠き）: 2本の柱のすき間から見る（拳銃など）
function notch(B, y, z, col = K.blk, base) {
  const g = 0.0032, w = 0.0085, d = 0.005;
  bx(B, g, base ?? y - 0.007, z - d, w, y + 0.0015, z + d, col); bx(B, -g, base ?? y - 0.007, z - d, -w, y + 0.0015, z + d, col);
}
// 照星（細い柱）: 先が照準の線
function post(B, y, z, col = K.blk, base) { bx(B, -0.0016, base ?? y - 0.014, z - 0.003, 0.0016, y + 0.0004, z + 0.003, col); }

// 曲がった弾倉（上 z0..z1、y0 から下へ、段ごとに前へ）
function curvedMag(B, z0, z1, y0, len, curve, hx, col, segs = 3) {
  const h = len / segs;
  for (let s = 0; s < segs; s++) {
    const a = s / segs, b = (s + 1) / segs;
    const off0 = curve * a * a, off1 = curve * b * b;
    const ya = y0 - h * s, yb = y0 - h * (s + 1);
    // 前後の幅が下へ少し広がる
    const c = [0, (ya + yb) / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2 + (off0 + off1) / 2];
    const v = nrm([0, ya - yb, off0 - off1]);
    const u = [1, 0, 0], w = cross(u, v);
    obox(B, c, u, v, w, hx, Math.hypot(ya - yb, off1 - off0) / 2 + 0.001, (z1 - z0) / 2 * (1 + a * 0.08), LAYER.paint, col);
  }
}

    sbx(B, 0.02, -0.03, 0.02, -0.01, 0.15, K.woodL, LAYER.wood);
    grip(B, -0.015, -0.07, -0.11, -0.12, 0.016, 0.022, K.woodL, LAYER.wood);
    P.sightY = 0.018; P.eyeZ = -0.3; P.muzzle = 0.3; P.railZ = null; P.rail2 = null; P.foreY = -0.03;
    P.gripR = [0, -0.07, -0.09]; P.gripL = [0, -0.035, 0.1]; P.magWell = [0, 0.0, 0.0]; P.breakAction = true;

// ピストル用ドットサイト（スライドの後ろの上）
function addPistolDot(B, P) {
  const top = P.sightY - 0.005, z = -0.045;
  sbx(B, 0.011, top, z - 0.022, top + 0.006, z + 0.02, K.blk);
  for (const sx of [1, -1]) bx(B, sx * 0.0125, top + 0.004, z - 0.02, sx * 0.0095, top + 0.024, z + 0.016, K.blk);
  sbx(B, 0.0125, top + 0.02, z - 0.02, top + 0.025, z + 0.016, K.blk);
  sbx(B, 0.0095, top + 0.004, z + 0.012, top + 0.007, z + 0.016, K.dg);
  P.sightY = top + 0.015; P.optic = { kind: 'reddot', z, r: 0.008, y: top + 0.015 };
}
// アタッチメント
function addSight(B, P, kind) {
  const ry = P.railY ?? 0.052, z0 = P.railZ ? P.railZ[0] : -0.05, z1 = P.railZ ? P.railZ[1] : 0.05;
  if (kind === 'reddot') {
    const z = (z0 + z1) / 2 - 0.01;
    sbx(B, 0.012, ry, z - 0.02, ry + 0.012, z + 0.03, K.blk);
    B.tube([0, ry + 0.03, z - 0.022], [0, ry + 0.03, z + 0.032], 0.018, 0.018, 10, LAYER.metal, K.blk, { caps: false });
    B.tube([0, ry + 0.03, z - 0.024], [0, ry + 0.03, z - 0.02], 0.0185, 0.0185, 10, LAYER.metal, K.dg, { caps: false });
    P.sightY = ry + 0.03; P.eyeZ = z - 0.2; P.optic = { kind, z, r: 0.016, y: ry + 0.03 };
  } else if (kind === 'holo') {
    const z = (z0 + z1) / 2;
    sbx(B, 0.019, ry, z - 0.045, ry + 0.02, z + 0.04, K.blk);
    // 窓の枠（左右の柱と屋根）。中は空いている
    for (const sx of [1, -1]) bx(B, sx * 0.02, ry + 0.02, z - 0.045, sx * 0.0145, ry + 0.062, z + 0.04, K.blk);
    sbx(B, 0.02, ry + 0.056, z - 0.045, ry + 0.062, z + 0.04, K.blk);
    sbx(B, 0.0145, ry + 0.02, z + 0.034, ry + 0.024, z + 0.04, K.dg);
    P.sightY = ry + 0.04; P.eyeZ = z - 0.2; P.optic = { kind, z, r: 0.017, y: ry + 0.04 };
  } else if (kind === 'lpvo') {
    const z = (z0 + z1) / 2;
    for (const dz of [-0.04, 0.04]) sbx(B, 0.012, ry, z + dz - 0.01, ry + 0.03, z + dz + 0.01, K.blk);
    B.tube([0, ry + 0.04, z - 0.08], [0, ry + 0.04, z + 0.08], 0.015, 0.015, 10, LAYER.metal, K.blk, { caps: false });
    B.tube([0, ry + 0.04, z + 0.08], [0, ry + 0.04, z + 0.13], 0.016, 0.022, 10, LAYER.metal, K.blk, { caps: true });
    B.tube([0, ry + 0.04, z - 0.13], [0, ry + 0.04, z - 0.08], 0.021, 0.016, 10, LAYER.metal, K.blk, { caps: true });
    P.sightY = ry + 0.04; P.eyeZ = z - 0.13 - 0.085; P.optic = { kind, z, r: 0.014, y: ry + 0.04, scope: true };
  }
}
function addMuzzle(B, P, kind, cat) {
  const z = P.muzzle;
  if (kind === 'supp') {
    const len = cat === 'pistol' ? 0.15 : cat === 'smg' ? 0.16 : 0.17, r = cat === 'pistol' ? 0.016 : cat === 'smg' ? 0.018 : 0.02;
    B.tube([0, 0, z - 0.02], [0, 0, z + len], r, r, 10, LAYER.metal, K.dg, { caps: true });
    P.muzzle = z + len;
  } else if (kind === 'comp') {
    B.tube([0, 0, z - 0.03], [0, 0, z + 0.03], 0.013, 0.013, 8, LAYER.metal, K.blk, { caps: true });
    P.muzzle = z + 0.03;
  }
}
function addGrip(B, P, kind) {
  if (!P.rail2 || kind === 'none') return;
  const z = P.rail2[0] + (P.rail2[1] - P.rail2[0]) * 0.45, y = P.foreY ?? -0.032;
  if (kind === 'vert') { sbx(B, 0.014, y - 0.095, z - 0.016, y, z + 0.016, K.blk, LAYER.rubber); P.gripL = [0, y - 0.06, z]; P.vgrip = true; }
  else if (kind === 'angled') { grip(B, y - 0.005, z - 0.03, y - 0.04, z + 0.05, 0.013, 0.012, K.blk); P.gripL = [0, y - 0.03, z + 0.01]; }
}
function addLight(B, P) {
  if (P.pistol) {
    if (!P.rail2) return;
    const z = (P.rail2[0] + P.rail2[1]) / 2, y = (P.foreY ?? -0.02) - 0.018;
    sbx(B, 0.013, y - 0.012, z - 0.03, y + 0.012, z + 0.03, K.blk, LAYER.rubber);
    P.lightPt = [0, y, z + 0.03];
    return;
  }
  const z = P.rail2 ? P.rail2[1] - 0.04 : P.muzzle - 0.12;
  const x = -0.03, y = P.rail2 ? 0.005 : -0.01;
  B.tube([x, y, z - 0.04], [x, y, z + 0.05], 0.013, 0.016, 8, LAYER.metal, K.blk, { caps: true });
  P.lightPt = [x, y, z + 0.05];
}

export function longModel(kind) {
  const fn = LONG_MODELS[kind];
  if (!fn) return null;
  const key = 'long|' + kind;
  let g = cache.get(key);
  if (g) return g;
  const B = new MeshBuilder(), P = { sightY: 0.06, eyeZ: -0.25, muzzle: 0.3 };
  fn(B, P);
  g = { key, wid: null, long: kind, body: B, mag: null, pump: null, pts: P, len: P.muzzle };
  cache.set(key, g);
  return g;
}
// 防弾盾（中心が原点、前が +Z）。上にのぞき窓（穴）、前に白い帯、後ろに握り
export function shieldModel() {
  const key = 'shield';
  let g = cache.get(key);
  if (g) return g;
  const B = new MeshBuilder();
  const hw = 0.28, hh = 0.46, t = 0.012, c = hex('#33363b'), rim = hex('#1d1e21');
  const wx = 0.12, wy0 = 0.24, wy1 = 0.335;
  B.bbox(-hw, wy1, -t, hw, hh, t, 0.006, LAYER.paint, c);
  B.bbox(-hw, -hh, -t, hw, wy0, t, 0.006, LAYER.paint, c);
  B.bbox(wx, wy0, -t, hw, wy1, t, 0.004, LAYER.paint, c);
  B.bbox(-hw, wy0, -t, -wx, wy1, t, 0.004, LAYER.paint, c);
  // のぞき窓の枠と、縁のゴム
  B.bbox(-wx - 0.008, wy0 - 0.008, t - 0.002, wx + 0.008, wy0, t + 0.004, 0.002, LAYER.rubber, rim);
  B.bbox(-wx - 0.008, wy1, t - 0.002, wx + 0.008, wy1 + 0.008, t + 0.004, 0.002, LAYER.rubber, rim);
  B.bbox(-hw - 0.006, -hh - 0.006, -t - 0.004, hw + 0.006, -hh + 0.012, t + 0.004, 0.004, LAYER.rubber, rim);
  B.bbox(-hw - 0.006, hh - 0.012, -t - 0.004, hw + 0.006, hh + 0.006, t + 0.004, 0.004, LAYER.rubber, rim);
  B.bbox(-hw - 0.006, -hh, -t - 0.004, -hw + 0.012, hh, t + 0.004, 0.004, LAYER.rubber, rim);
  B.bbox(hw - 0.012, -hh, -t - 0.004, hw + 0.006, hh, t + 0.004, 0.004, LAYER.rubber, rim);
  // 前の白い帯（POLICE の表示の場所）と、ブロック状の文字
  B.bbox(-0.2, 0.06, t, 0.2, 0.135, t + 0.002, 0.001, LAYER.paint, hex('#e6e6e2'));
  for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { const x0 = -0.165 + k * 0.058; B.bbox(x0, 0.075, t + 0.002, x0 + 0.04, 0.12, t + 0.003, 0.0005, LAYER.paint, hex('#1b1c20')); }
  // 後ろの握りと腕の帯
  B.bbox(-0.02, -0.06, -t - 0.045, 0.02, 0.06, -t, 0.006, LAYER.rubber, rim);
  B.bbox(-0.09, -0.2, -t - 0.02, 0.09, -0.16, -t, 0.004, LAYER.nylon, hex('#26282b'));
  g = { key, body: B, pts: { hw, hh } };
  cache.set(key, g);
  return g;
}
export function gunModel(wid, att = {}) {
  const W = WEAPONS[wid];
  if (!W) return null;
  const key = wid + '|' + (att.sight || 'iron') + '|' + (att.muzzle || 'none') + '|' + (att.grip || 'none') + '|' + (att.light ? 1 : 0);
  let g = cache.get(key);
  if (g) return g;
  const B = new MeshBuilder(), P = { sightY: 0.06, eyeZ: -0.25, muzzle: 0.3 };
  const fn = MODELS[W.model] || MODELS.ar15;
  fn(B, P, { mdl: W.mdl || {}, fde: W.mdl && W.mdl.fde });
  if (att.sight === 'rmr' && P.pistol) addPistolDot(B, P);
  else if (att.sight && att.sight !== 'iron' && att.sight !== 'rmr' && (P.railZ || P.pistol === undefined)) addSight(B, P, att.sight);
  if (att.muzzle && att.muzzle !== 'none' && !W.integral) addMuzzle(B, P, att.muzzle, W.cat);
  if (att.grip) addGrip(B, P, att.grip);
  if (att.light) addLight(B, P);
  let mag = null, pump = null;
  if (P.mag) { mag = new MeshBuilder(); P.mag(mag); }
  if (P.pump) { pump = new MeshBuilder(); P.pump(pump); }
  g = { key, wid, body: B, mag, pump, pts: P, len: P.muzzle };
  cache.set(key, g);
  return g;
}
