  // ---- 作戦の準備（ひとり／ホストのロビーでも使う）
  _mission(opt = {}) {
    const a = this.app, s = opt.sel || this.sel;
    if (!PVE_MAPS.includes(s.map)) s.map = PVE_MAPS[0];
    const def = MAPS[s.map];
    const entries = (def.spawn.swat || []).map((e, i) => [i, e.name]);
    if (s.entry >= entries.length) s.entry = 0;
    const net = !!opt.net;
    const el = this._mk('mission', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head">${BACK}<h2>${net ? '作戦設定' : '作戦準備'}</h2><span class="hint">${esc(def.name)}</span></header>
      <div class="split">
        <div class="pane maps scroll">${PVE_MAPS.map(id => { const m = MAPS[id]; return `<button class="mapcard${id === s.map ? ' on' : ''}" data-map="${id}"><b>${esc(m.name)}</b><small>${esc(m.en)} · ${TIME_JA[m.time] || ''}${m.levels.length > 1 ? ` · ${m.levels.length}階` : ''}</small></button>`; }).join('')}</div>
        <div class="pane rows scroll">
          <div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>作戦</b></div><div class="rc" data-k="mission"></div></div>
          <p class="note mdesc">${esc(MISSIONS[s.mission].desc)}</p>
          <div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>難易度</b></div><div class="rc" data-k="diff"></div></div>
          <p class="note ddesc">${esc(DIFFS[s.diff].desc)}</p>
          ${net ? '' : `<div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>人数</b><small>自分＋AI隊員</small></div><div class="rc" data-k="team"></div></div>`}
          <div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>突入口</b></div><div class="rc" data-k="entry"></div></div>
          <p class="note">${esc(def.desc)}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="sc-foot"><button class="btn ghost" data-a="lo">装備</button><button class="btn primary" data-a="go">${net ? '決定' : 'ブリーフィング'}</button></div></div>`, 'dim');
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-map]').forEach(b => onTap(b, () => { s.map = b.dataset.map; s.entry = 0; this.app.audio.ui('tap'); this._mission(opt); }));
    chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="mission"]'), MISSION_LIST.filter(m => !def.missions || def.missions[m]).map(m => [m, MISSIONS[m].name]), s.mission, (v) => { s.mission = v; el.querySelector('.mdesc').textContent = MISSIONS[v].desc; });
    chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="diff"]'), Object.keys(DIFFS).map(d => [d, DIFFS[d].name]), s.diff, (v) => { s.diff = v; el.querySelector('.ddesc').textContent = DIFFS[v].desc; });
    if (!net) chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="team"]'), [[1, '1名'], [2, '2名'], [3, '3名'], [4, '4名']], s.team, (v) => { s.team = v; });
    chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="entry"]'), entries, s.entry, (v) => { s.entry = v; });
    this._acts(el, {
      lo: () => this.open('loadout', { kind: 'pve', team: net ? 1 : s.team }),
      go: () => { if (net) { if (opt.onDone) opt.onDone(s); this.back(); } else this.open('brief', s); },
    });
    this.show('mission'); a.scene('menu');
  }
  _brief(s) {
    const a = this.app, def = MAPS[s.map], M = MISSIONS[s.mission];
    const el = this._mk('brief', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head">${BACK}<h2>ブリーフィング</h2><span class="hint">${esc(def.name)} · ${esc(M.name)} · ${esc(DIFFS[s.diff].name)}</span></header>
      <div class="split brief">
        <div class="pane planbox"><canvas class="plan"></canvas><div class="plan-lv"></div></div>
        <div class="pane rows scroll">
          <h3>状況</h3><p>${esc(M.desc)}</p>
          <h3>目的</h3><ul class="obj">${objectives(s.mission).map(o => `<li>${esc(o)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>
          <h3>交戦規定</h3><p class="note">実弾は、相手が銃を向けた・撃った・抜こうとしたとき、または武装したまま警告に従わないときのみ。投降者・拘束者・丸腰の者・市民への発砲は重大な違反。警告 → 拘束 → TOCへ報告。</p>
          <h3>突入口</h3><p>${esc(def.spawn.swat[s.entry].name)}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="sc-foot"><button class="btn ghost" data-a="lo">装備</button><button class="btn primary" data-a="go">出動</button></div></div>`, 'dim');
    this._drawPlan(el.querySelector('.planbox'), s.map, { entry: s.entry, showEntries: true });
    this._acts(el, { lo: () => this.open('loadout', { kind: 'pve', team: s.team }), go: () => a.startPve({ ...s }) });
    this.show('brief'); a.scene('menu');
  }
  // 見取り図（階の切り替えつき）
  _drawPlan(box, mapId, o = {}) {
    const def = MAPS[mapId];
    let w;
    try { w = baseWorld(mapId); } catch (e) { box.innerHTML = '<p class="note">見取り図なし</p>'; return; }
    const plan = buildPlan(w, def, 5);
    const cv = box.querySelector('canvas'), lv = box.querySelector('.plan-lv');
    let L = o.level ?? 0;
    const draw = () => {
      const src = plan.levels[L];
      cv.width = src.width; cv.height = src.height;
      const x = cv.getContext('2d');
      x.drawImage(src, 0, 0);
      const s = plan.s / CS;
      x.font = 'bold 11px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif'; x.textAlign = 'center'; x.textBaseline = 'middle';
      for (const r of def.rooms || []) { const [nm, en, ri, rj, rL = 0] = r; if (rL !== L) continue; x.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)'; const t = nm; const tw = x.measureText(t).width + 8; x.fillRect(ri * plan.s - tw / 2, rj * plan.s - 8, tw, 16); x.fillStyle = '#f2f4f6'; x.fillText(t, ri * plan.s, rj * plan.s); }
      if (o.showEntries) (def.spawn.swat || []).forEach((e, i) => { if ((e.L || 0) !== L) return; x.fillStyle = i === o.entry ? '#ffd34a' : 'rgba(255,211,74,0.45)'; x.beginPath(); x.arc(e.x * plan.s, e.z * plan.s, i === o.entry ? 8 : 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); x.fill(); x.fillStyle = '#111'; x.fillText(String(i + 1), e.x * plan.s, e.z * plan.s + 0.5); });
      if (o.marks) for (const m of o.marks) { if ((m.L || 0) !== L) continue; x.fillStyle = m.col; x.beginPath(); if (m.sq) x.rect(m.x * s - 5, m.z * s - 5, 10, 10); else x.arc(m.x * s, m.z * s, m.r || 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); x.fill(); if (m.me) { x.strokeStyle = '#000'; x.lineWidth = 2; x.stroke(); } }
    };
    lv.innerHTML = plan.levels.length > 1 ? plan.levels.map((_, i) => `<button class="chip${i === L ? ' on' : ''}" data-l="${i}">${i + 1}階</button>`).join('') : '';
    lv.querySelectorAll('[data-l]').forEach(b => onTap(b, () => { L = +b.dataset.l; lv.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(c => c.classList.toggle('on', c === b)); draw(); }));
    draw();
  }

  // ---- 装備
  _loadout(o = {}) {
    const a = this.app;
    const el = this._mk('loadout', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head">${BACK}<h2>装備</h2><span class="hint">${o.kind === 'pvp' ? '対戦（陣営ごと）' : '自分とAI隊員'}</span></header><div class="lo-host"></div></div>`, 'dim');
    this.lo = new LoadoutEditor(a, el.querySelector('.lo-host'), o);
    this.show('loadout'); a.scene('menu');
  }

  // ---- 対戦の準備（ひとり／ホストのロビー）
  _pvpSetup(opt) {
    opt = opt || {};
    const a = this.app, s = opt.sel || this.pv, net = !!opt.net;
    const maps = MAP_LIST.filter(id => (PVP_MAPS.includes(id) || PVE_MAPS.includes(id)) && id !== 'training');
    if (!maps.includes(s.map)) s.map = maps[0];
    const def = MAPS[s.map];
    const el = this._mk('pvpSetup', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head">${BACK}<h2>${net ? 'ルーム設定' : '対戦設定'}</h2><span class="hint">${esc(MODE_INFO[s.mode].name)} · ${esc(def.name)}</span></header>
      <div class="split">
        <div class="pane maps scroll">${maps.map(id => { const m = MAPS[id]; return `<button class="mapcard${id === s.map ? ' on' : ''}" data-map="${id}"><b>${esc(m.name)}</b><small>${PVP_MAPS.includes(id) && !PVE_MAPS.includes(id) ? '対戦用' : '作戦と共用'} · ${TIME_JA[m.time] || ''}</small></button>`; }).join('')}</div>
        <div class="pane rows scroll">
          <div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>モード</b></div><div class="rc" data-k="mode"></div></div>
          <p class="note modedesc">${esc(MODE_INFO[s.mode].desc)}</p>
          ${net ? '' : `<div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>自チーム</b><small>自分を含む</small></div><div class="rc" data-k="t0"></div></div>
          <div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>敵チーム</b></div><div class="rc" data-k="t1"></div></div>
          <div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>陣営</b><small>前半</small></div><div class="rc" data-k="side"></div></div>`}
          <div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>ボットの強さ</b></div><div class="rc" data-k="bot"></div></div>
          <div class="row tdm-only"><div class="rl"><b>時間</b></div><div class="rc" data-k="time"></div></div>
          <div class="row rnd-only"><div class="rl"><b>勝利ラウンド</b><small>先に取った方の勝ち</small></div><div class="rc" data-k="wins"></div></div>
          <div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>エイムアシスト</b><small>タッチ操作のみ</small></div><div class="rc" data-k="aa"></div></div>
          <div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>味方撃ち</b></div><div class="rc" data-k="ff"></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="sc-foot"><button class="btn ghost" data-a="lo">装備</button><button class="btn primary" data-a="go">${net ? '決定' : '開始'}</button></div></div>`, 'dim');
    const vis = () => { el.querySelector('.tdm-only').style.display = s.mode === 'tdm' ? '' : 'none'; el.querySelector('.rnd-only').style.display = s.mode === 'tdm' ? 'none' : ''; };
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-map]').forEach(b => onTap(b, () => { s.map = b.dataset.map; this.app.audio.ui('tap'); this._pvpSetup(opt); }));
    chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="mode"]'), PVP_MODES.map(m => [m, MODE_INFO[m].name]), s.mode, (v) => { s.mode = v; el.querySelector('.modedesc').textContent = MODE_INFO[v].desc; vis(); });
    if (!net) {
      chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="t0"]'), [1, 2, 3, 4].map(n => [n, n + '名']), s.teams[0], (v) => { s.teams[0] = v; });
      chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="t1"]'), [1, 2, 3, 4].map(n => [n, n + '名']), s.teams[1], (v) => { s.teams[1] = v; });
      chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="side"]'), [[0, 'SWAT'], [1, '立てこもり犯']], s.side, (v) => { s.side = v; });
    }
    chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="bot"]'), [[1, '弱'], [2, '標準'], [3, '強']], s.botLevel, (v) => { s.botLevel = v; });
    chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="time"]'), [[5, '5分'], [8, '8分'], [10, '10分'], [15, '15分']], s.time, (v) => { s.time = v; });
    chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="wins"]'), [[2, '2'], [3, '3'], [4, '4'], [5, '5']], s.wins, (v) => { s.wins = v; });
    chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="aa"]'), [[0, 'オフ'], [1, '弱'], [2, '標準']], s.aimAssist, (v) => { s.aimAssist = v; });
    chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="ff"]'), [[false, 'オフ'], [true, 'オン']], s.ff, (v) => { s.ff = v; });
    vis();
    this._acts(el, {
      lo: () => this.open('loadout', { kind: 'pvp' }),
      go: () => { if (net) { if (opt.onDone) opt.onDone(s); this.back(); } else a.startPvp({ ...s, teams: s.teams.slice() }); },
    });
    this.show('pvpSetup'); a.scene('menu');
  }

  // ---- オンライン: ルームを作る／参加
  _multi(kind) {
    const a = this.app;
    const el = this._mk('multi', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head">${BACK}<h2>${kind === 'pvp' ? 'オンライン対戦' : '協力（オンライン）'}</h2></header>
      <div class="big-choice">
        <button class="bc" data-a="host"><b>ルーム作成</b><span>5文字のコードと招待リンクを発行。</span></button>
        <button class="bc" data-a="join"><b>コードで参加</b><span>5文字のコードを入力。招待リンクなら自動で参加。</span></button>
      </div>
      <p class="note center">${esc(a.netNote())}</p></div>`, 'dim');
    this._acts(el, {
      host: () => a.hostRoom(kind),
      join: async () => { const v = await textModal({ title: 'ルームコード', note: '5文字（例: KX7QM）', maxLength: 8, validate: (t) => a.normCode(t) ? '' : '5文字のコードを入力（使えない文字があります）' }); if (v) a.joinRoom(a.normCode(v)); },
    });
    this.show('multi'); a.scene('menu');
  }
  _join(code) { this.app.joinRoom(code); }
  netWait(msg, onCancel) {
    const el = this._mk('netwait', `<div class="ld"><div class="ld-name">${TITLE}</div><p class="nw-msg">${esc(msg)}</p><div class="spin"></div><button class="btn ghost" data-a="cancel">中止</button></div>`);

    const el = this._mk('neterr', `<div class="ld"><div class="ld-name">${TITLE}</div><p class="ld-err">${esc(msg)}</p><button class="btn primary" data-a="ok">タイトルへ</button></div>`);

    this.show('neterr');
  }
  // ロビー（ホストとゲスト共通。ホストだけ設定を変えられる）
  _lobby() {
    const a = this.app, N = a.net;
    if (!N) { this.reset('title'); return; }
    const host = N.role === 'host';
    const el = this._mk('lobby', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head"><button class="back" data-a="leave"><span>退出</span></button><h2>ロビー</h2><span class="hint code">ルーム <b>${esc(N.code)}</b></span><button class="btn small" data-a="share">招待</button></header>
      <div class="split lobby">
        <div class="pane roster scroll"></div>
        <div class="pane rows scroll lob-set"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="sc-foot"><span class="conn"></span>${host ? '<button class="btn ghost" data-a="set">設定</button><button class="btn primary" data-a="start">開始</button>' : '<span class="wait">ホストの開始待ち…</span>'}<button class="btn ghost" data-a="lo">装備</button></div></div>`, 'dim');
    this._acts(el, {
      leave: () => a.leaveRoom(),
      share: () => a.shareRoom(),
      set: () => { const S = N.sess; if (S.kind === 'pvp') this.open('pvpSetup', { net: true, sel: S.cfg, onDone: (v) => S.setCfg(v) }); else this.open('mission', { net: true, sel: S.cfg, onDone: (v) => S.setCfg(v) }); },
      start: () => a.hostStart(),
      lo: () => this.open('loadout', { kind: N.sess.kind === 'pvp' ? 'pvp' : 'pve', team: 1 }),
    });
    this.show('lobby'); a.scene('menu');
    this.netRoster();
  }
  netRoster() {
    if (this.cur !== 'lobby') return;
    const a = this.app, N = a.net; if (!N) return;
    const el = this.el.lobby, S = N.sess, host = N.role === 'host';
    const cfg = S.cfg || {};
    const pvp = S.kind === 'pvp';
    const ro = S.roster || [];
    const teamOf = (r) => r.team || 0;
    const rowHTML = (r) => `<div class="pl${r.on ? '' : ' off'}"><b>${esc(r.name)}</b>${r.host ? '<em>ホスト</em>' : ''}${r.cid === S.cid ? '<em class="me">自分</em>' : ''}${r.on ? '' : '<em class="bad">応答なし</em>'}${pvp && host ? `<button class="chip small" data-team="${esc(r.cid)}">${teamOf(r) ? '赤へ' : '青へ'}</button>` : ''}</div>`;
    let html;
    if (pvp) {
      const sizes = cfg.teams || [4, 4];
      html = [0, 1].map(t => { const list = ro.filter(r => teamOf(r) === t); return `<div class="team t${t}"><h4>${t === 0 ? '青チーム' : '赤チーム'} <small>${list.length}名＋ボット${Math.max(0, sizes[t] - list.length)}</small></h4>${list.map(rowHTML).join('')}</div>`; }).join('');
      if (host) html += `<div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>人数</b><small>空き枠はボット</small></div><div class="rc"><span class="mini">青</span><span data-k="s0"></span><span class="mini">赤</span><span data-k="s1"></span></div></div>`;
    } else html = `<h4>隊員 <small>${ro.length}名＋AI${Math.max(0, 4 - ro.length)}</small></h4>` + ro.map(rowHTML).join('');
    el.querySelector('.roster').innerHTML = html;
    if (pvp && host) {
      el.querySelectorAll('[data-team]').forEach(b => onTap(b, () => S.setTeam(b.dataset.team, teamOf(ro.find(r => r.cid === b.dataset.team)) ? 0 : 1)));
      const sizes = cfg.teams || [4, 4];
      chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="s0"]'), [1, 2, 3, 4].map(n => [n, String(n)]), sizes[0], (v) => { const c = { ...cfg, teams: [v, sizes[1]] }; S.setCfg(c); });
      chips(el.querySelector('[data-k="s1"]'), [1, 2, 3, 4].map(n => [n, String(n)]), sizes[1], (v) => { const c = { ...cfg, teams: [sizes[0], v] }; S.setCfg(c); });
    }
    // 設定の要約
    const set = el.querySelector('.lob-set');
    if (pvp) set.innerHTML = `<h3>${esc(MODE_INFO[cfg.mode] ? MODE_INFO[cfg.mode].name : '')}</h3><p>${esc(MAPS[cfg.map] ? MAPS[cfg.map].name : '')}</p><dl class="kv"><dt>ボット</dt><dd>${['', '弱', '標準', '強'][cfg.botLevel || 2]}</dd>${cfg.mode === 'tdm' ? `<dt>時間</dt><dd>${cfg.time}分</dd>` : `<dt>勝利ラウンド</dt><dd>${cfg.wins}</dd>`}<dt>エイムアシスト</dt><dd>${['オフ', '弱', '標準'][cfg.aimAssist ?? 1]}</dd><dt>味方撃ち</dt><dd>${cfg.ff ? 'オン' : 'オフ'}</dd></dl>`;
    else set.innerHTML = `<h3>${esc(MISSIONS[cfg.mission] ? MISSIONS[cfg.mission].name : '')}</h3><p>${esc(MAPS[cfg.map] ? MAPS[cfg.map].name : '')}</p><dl class="kv"><dt>難易度</dt><dd>${esc(DIFFS[cfg.diff] ? DIFFS[cfg.diff].name : '')}</dd><dt>突入口</dt><dd>${esc(MAPS[cfg.map] && MAPS[cfg.map].spawn.swat[cfg.entry || 0] ? MAPS[cfg.map].spawn.swat[cfg.entry || 0].name : '')}</dd></dl><p class="note">空き枠（最大4名）はAI隊員。</p>`;
    el.querySelector('.conn').textContent = a.connText(N.link.info && N.link.info());
    const st = el.querySelector('[data-a="start"]');
    if (st) st.classList.toggle('dis', !S.canStart());
  }

  // ---- 一時停止
  _pause() {
    const a = this.app, g = a.game;
    const pve = g && !g.S.pvp && g.S.m && g.S.m.kind === 'pve';
    const net = !!(g && g.net);
    const el = this._mk('pause', `<div class="pz"><h2>一時停止${net ? '<small>オンライン中は停止しません</small>' : ''}</h2>
      <nav class="t-menu">
        <button class="mi main" data-a="resume"><span class="mi-l">再開</span></button>
        <button class="mi" data-a="tablet"><span class="mi-l">地図・目的</span></button>
        <button class="mi" data-a="settings"><span class="mi-l">設定</span></button>
        <button class="mi" data-a="book"><span class="mi-l">資料室</span></button>
        ${pve && (!net || a.net.role === 'host') ? `<button class="mi" data-a="abort"><span class="mi-l">${g.S.m.softDone ? '作戦終了' : '撤収'}</span></button>` : ''}
        <button class="mi danger" data-a="quit"><span class="mi-l">${net ? '退出' : 'タイトルへ'}</span></button>
      </nav></div>`, 'dim');
    this._acts(el, {
      resume: () => a.resumeGame(),
      tablet: () => this.open('tablet'),
      settings: () => this.open('settings', 'ctrl'),
      book: () => this.open('book', 'play'),
    });
    const ab = el.querySelector('[data-a="abort"]');
    if (ab) confirmTap(ab, () => a.confirmMode(), () => a.abortMission(), '<span class="mi-l">もう一度押すと終える</span>');
    confirmTap(el.querySelector('[data-a="quit"]'), () => a.confirmMode(), () => net ? a.leaveRoom() : a.quitToTitle(), '<span class="mi-l">もう一度押すと出る</span>');
    this.show('pause'); a.scene('pause');
  }
  // ---- 地図（タブレット）
  _tablet() {
    const a = this.app, g = a.game;
    if (!g) { this.back(); return; }
    const S = g.S, p = g.p, def = MAPS[S.map];
    const ob = g._objectives();
    const el = this._mk('tablet', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head">${BACK}<h2>地図</h2><span class="hint">${esc(def.name)}</span></header>
      <div class="split brief"><div class="pane planbox"><canvas class="plan"></canvas><div class="plan-lv"></div></div>
      <div class="pane rows scroll"><h3>目的</h3><div class="tab-obj">${ob.html}</div>${!S.pvp && S.m.kind === 'pve' ? `<ul class="obj">${objectives(S.m.mission).map(o => `<li>${esc(o)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>` : ''}
      <p class="note">黄: 自分　青: 味方　赤: 容疑者　緑: 市民　黄土: 投降・拘束</p></div></div></div>`, 'dim');
    const marks = [];
    for (const b of S.actors) {
      if (b.isDrone || (!b.alive && !b.dead)) continue;
      const L = Math.max(0, Math.floor((b.y + 0.4) / 3));
      if (b === p) { marks.push({ x: b.x, z: b.z, L, col: '#ffd34a', r: 6, me: true }); continue; }
      const mate = S.pvp ? b.team === p.team : b.kind === 'swat';
      if (mate) marks.push({ x: b.x, z: b.z, L, col: b.alive ? '#4aa8ff' : '#666', r: 5 });
      else if (b.spot > 0 || g._visCache(b)) marks.push({ x: b.x, z: b.z, L, col: b.kind === 'civ' ? '#7be07b' : b.cuffed || b.comply ? '#d8b44a' : '#ff4a3a', r: 5 });
    }
    if (S.m && S.m.bombs) for (const b of S.m.bombs) if (b.found && !b.done) marks.push({ x: b.x, z: b.z, L: b.L || 0, col: '#ff9a20', sq: true });
    this._drawPlan(el.querySelector('.planbox'), S.map, { marks, level: Math.max(0, Math.floor((p.y + 0.4) / 3)) });
    this.show('tablet');
  }

  // ---- 結果
  _result(res) {
    const a = this.app;
    if (res.pvp) return this._resultPvp(res);
    const sc = res.score || { parts: [], total: 0, grade: 'F', viol: [], stats: {} };
    const M = MISSIONS[res.mission] || { name: '' };
    const why = { wiped: '部隊全滅', hostages: '人質全員死亡', bomb: '爆弾爆発', player: '', ai: 'AI部隊が任務終了' }[res.why] || '';
    const VN = { kill_unjust: '不当な殺傷', civkill: '市民の死亡', civhurt: '市民の負傷', civforce: '市民への実力行使', force: '不当な実力行使', ff: '味方への発砲' };
    const st = sc.stats || {};
    const acc = res.me && res.me.sh ? Math.round(100 * res.me.hi / res.me.sh) : 0;
    const el = this._mk('result', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head"><h2>${res.res === 'fail' ? '作戦失敗' : res.res === 'abort' && !res.soft ? '撤収' : '作戦完了'}</h2><span class="hint">${esc(MAPS[res.map].name)} · ${esc(M.name)} · ${esc(DIFFS[res.diff] ? DIFFS[res.diff].name : '')}${why ? ' · ' + why : ''}</span></header>
      <div class="split result">
        <div class="pane gradebox"><div class="grade" style="color:${GRADE_COL[sc.grade]}">${sc.grade}</div><div class="total">${sc.total}<small>/100</small></div>
          <dl class="kv"><dt>時間</dt><dd>${fmtTime(st.time || 0)}</dd><dt>逮捕</dt><dd>${st.arrested || 0}/${st.susTotal || 0}</dd><dt>容疑者の死亡</dt><dd>${st.killed || 0}</dd><dt>救出</dt><dd>${st.rescued || 0}/${st.civTotal || 0}</dd><dt>命中率</dt><dd>${acc}%</dd></dl></div>
        <div class="pane rows scroll"><table class="score"><tbody>${sc.parts.map(p => `<tr><th>${esc(p.name)}<small>${esc(p.note || '')}</small></th><td>${p.got}<small>/${p.max}</small></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>
          ${sc.viol.length ? `<h3>違反</h3><ul class="viol">${sc.viol.map(v => `<li><b>${esc(VN[v.v] || v.v)}</b>${v.byName ? `（${esc(v.byName)}）` : ''} −${v.pen}</li>`).join('')}</ul>` : '<p class="good">交戦規定違反なし</p>'}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="sc-foot">${res.net ? (a.net && a.net.role === 'host' ? '<button class="btn primary" data-a="again">ロビーへ</button>' : '<span class="wait">ホスト待ち…</span>') : '<button class="btn ghost" data-a="lo">装備</button><button class="btn primary" data-a="again">再出動</button>'}<button class="btn ghost" data-a="title">${res.net ? '退出' : 'タイトルへ'}</button></div></div>`, 'dim');
    this._acts(el, {
      again: () => res.net ? a.netAgain() : a.startPve(a.lastPve),
      lo: () => this.open('loadout', { kind: 'pve', team: a.lastPve ? a.lastPve.team : 4 }),
      title: () => res.net ? a.leaveRoom() : a.toTitle(),
    });
    this.show('result'); a.scene('pause');
  }
  _resultPvp(res) {
    const a = this.app;
    const mine = res.win === res.myTeam;
    const MODE = MODE_INFO[res.mode] || { name: '' };
    const rows = res.rows || [];
    const el = this._mk('result', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head"><h2 class="${res.win < 0 ? '' : mine ? 'good' : 'bad'}">${res.win < 0 ? '引き分け' : mine ? '勝利' : '敗北'}</h2><span class="hint">${esc(MODE.name)} · ${esc(MAPS[res.map].name)} · ${fmtTime(res.time || 0)}</span></header>
      <div class="pvp-score"><b class="t0">${res.score[res.myTeam]}</b><span>—</span><b class="t1">${res.score[1 - res.myTeam]}</b></div>
      <div class="pane scroll"><table class="board"><thead><tr><th>名前</th><th>キル</th><th>デス</th><th>アシスト</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map((r, i) => `<tr class="${r.team === res.myTeam ? 'ally' : 'enemy'}${r.me ? ' me' : ''}"><th>${i === 0 ? '<em>MVP</em>' : ''}${esc(r.name)}${r.bot ? '<small>ボット</small>' : ''}</th><td>${r.k}</td><td>${r.d}</td><td>${r.a}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>
      <div class="sc-foot">${res.net ? (a.net && a.net.role === 'host' ? '<button class="btn primary" data-a="again">ロビーへ</button>' : '<span class="wait">ホスト待ち…</span>') : '<button class="btn primary" data-a="again">再戦</button>'}<button class="btn ghost" data-a="title">${res.net ? '退出' : 'タイトルへ'}</button></div></div>`, 'dim');
    this._acts(el, { again: () => res.net ? a.netAgain() : a.startPvp(a.lastPvp), title: () => res.net ? a.leaveRoom() : a.toTitle() });
    this.show('result'); a.scene('pause');
  }

  // ---- 設定
  _settings(tab = 'ctrl') {
    const a = this.app, S = a.settings;
    const TABS = [['ctrl', '操作'], ['sens', '感度'], ['hud', 'HUD'], ['gfx', '画質'], ['snd', '音'], ['etc', 'その他']];
    const el = this._mk('settings', `<div class="sc-wrap"><header class="sc-head">${BACK}<h2>設定</h2><div class="tabs">${TABS.map(([k, n]) => `<button class="tab${k === tab ? ' on' : ''}" data-tab="${k}">${n}</button>`).join('')}</div></header><div class="pane rows scroll set-body"></div></div>`, 'dim');
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(b => onTap(b, () => { this.app.audio.ui('tap'); this.args = [b.dataset.tab]; this._noKeep = true; this._settings(b.dataset.tab); }));
    const body = el.querySelector('.set-body');
    const save = () => a.applySettings();
    const R = [];
    const row = (label, sub, k) => { R.push(`<div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>${label}</b>${sub ? `<small>${sub}</small>` : ''}</div><div class="rc" data-k="${k}"></div></div>`); };
    const note = (t) => R.push(`<p class="note">${t}</p>`);
    const binds = [];
    const ch = (k, list, path) => binds.push(() => chips(body.querySelector(`[data-k="${k}"]`), list, getP(S, path || k), (v) => { setP(S, path || k, v); save(); }));
    const sl = (k, min, max, step, fmt, path) => binds.push(() => slider(this.stage, body.querySelector(`[data-k="${k}"]`), { min, max, step, value: getP(S, path || k), fmt, label: k, onInput: (v) => { setP(S, path || k, v); save(); } }));
    const pct = (v) => Math.round(v * 100) + '%';
    if (tab === 'ctrl') {
      row('ADS', '照準ボタン', 'adsMode'); ch('adsMode', [['tap', '切替'], ['hold', '長押し'], ['mixed', '両方']]);
      row('リーン', '', 'leanMode'); ch('leanMode', [['toggle', '切替'], ['hold', '長押し']]);
      row('移動スティック', '', 'stickMode'); ch('stickMode', [['float', '可変'], ['fixed', '固定']]);
      row('スティックでダッシュ', '対戦のみ。上に倒しきる', 'stickSprint'); ch('stickSprint', [[true, 'オン'], [false, 'オフ']]);
      row('射撃ボタン（左）', '', 'leftFire'); ch('leftFire', [[true, '表示'], [false, '非表示']]);
      row('射撃ボタンで視点移動', '押したままドラッグ', 'fireLook'); ch('fireLook', [[true, 'オン'], [false, 'オフ']]);
      row('利き手', 'ボタンの左右を反転', 'handed'); ch('handed', [['right', '右'], ['left', '左']]);
      row('確認が必要な操作', '撤収・タイトルへ など', 'confirm'); ch('confirm', [['auto', '自動（タッチは2回）'], ['two', '常に2回'], ['one', '常に1回']]);
      note('キーボード: WASD 移動／マウス 視点（画面をクリック）／左クリック 射撃／右クリック ADS／Q・E リーン／C しゃがみ／Z 伏せ／R リロード（長押しで高速）／F 警告／V 調べる／H 命令／Tab 隊の切替／G 投げ物／1・2 武器／X 射撃モード／T ライト／N 暗視／B ローレディ／M 地図／Esc 一時停止');
    } else if (tab === 'sens') {
      row('視点', '', 'sens'); sl('sens', 0.2, 3, 0.05, (v) => v.toFixed(2));
      row('ADS', '等倍', 'sensAds'); sl('sensAds', 0.2, 1.5, 0.05, pct);
      row('スコープ', '倍率あり', 'sensScope'); sl('sensScope', 0.1, 1.2, 0.05, pct);
      row('射撃中', '射撃ボタンで視点移動', 'sensFire'); sl('sensFire', 0.3, 1.5, 0.05, pct);
      row('上下反転', '', 'invertY'); ch('invertY', [[false, 'オフ'], [true, 'オン']]);
      row('エイムアシスト', '作戦のみ（対戦はルーム設定）', 'aimAssist'); ch('aimAssist', [['off', 'オフ'], ['weak', '弱'], ['strong', '標準']]);
      row('ジャイロ', '端末の傾きで照準', 'gyro'); ch('gyro', [['off', 'オフ'], ['ads', 'ADS時'], ['always', '常時']]);
      row('ジャイロ感度', '', 'gyroSens'); sl('gyroSens', 0.2, 3, 0.05, (v) => v.toFixed(2));
      row('ジャイロ 左右', '', 'gyroInvX'); ch('gyroInvX', [[false, '標準'], [true, '反転']]);
      row('ジャイロ 上下', '', 'gyroInvY'); ch('gyroInvY', [[false, '標準'], [true, '反転']]);
      R.push('<div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>ジャイロの許可</b><small>iPhoneは初回に許可が必要</small></div><div class="rc"><button class="btn small" data-a="gyroPerm">許可</button></div></div>');
    } else if (tab === 'hud') {
      R.push('<div class="row"><div class="rl"><b>HUDの配置</b><small>ボタン・字幕などの位置・大きさ・濃さ</small></div><div class="rc"><button class="btn small" data-a="editHud">配置を編集</button></div></div>');
      row('全体の濃さ', '', 'hudOpacity'); sl('hudOpacity', 0.2, 1, 0.05, pct);
      row('全体の大きさ', '', 'hudScale'); sl('hudScale', 0.75, 1.3, 0.05, pct);
      row('照準', '腰だめ', 'crosshair'); ch('crosshair', [['cross', '十字'], ['dot', '点'], ['none', 'なし']]);
      row('照準の色', '', 'crossColor'); binds.push(() => chips(body.querySelector('[data-k="crossColor"]'), [['#ffffff', '白'], ['#7dff7a', '緑'], ['#ffe14a', '黄'], ['#4ae8ff', '水色'], ['#ff5ad2', '桃']], S.crossColor, (v) => { S.crossColor = v; save(); }, { swatch: true }));
      row('ミニマップ', 'タップで地図', 'minimap'); ch('minimap', [[true, '表示'], [false, '非表示']]);
      row('字幕', '無線と呼びかけ', 'subtitles'); ch('subtitles', [[true, '表示'], [false, '非表示']]);
      row('字幕の位置', '自由な位置は「配置を編集」', 'subPos');
      binds.push(() => { const H = S.hud || (S.hud = {}); const cur = H.i_subs && H.i_subs.ay === 't' ? 't' : (H.i_subs && (H.i_subs.x || H.i_subs.y != null) && !H.i_subs.preset ? 'free' : 'b'); chips(body.querySelector('[data-k="subPos"]'), [['b', '下'], ['t', '上'], ...(cur === 'free' ? [['free', '自由']] : [])], cur, (v) => { if (v === 'free') return; const o = H.i_subs || (H.i_subs = {}); o.ay = v; o.x = 0; o.y = v === 't' ? 84 : 78; o.preset = true; save(); }); });
      row('字幕の大きさ', '', 'subSize'); binds.push(() => { const H = S.hud || (S.hud = {}); slider(this.stage, body.querySelector('[data-k="subSize"]'), { min: 0.7, max: 1.6, step: 0.05, value: (H.i_subs && H.i_subs.s) || 1, fmt: pct, label: '字幕の大きさ', onInput: (v) => { const o = H.i_subs || (H.i_subs = {}); o.s = v; save(); } }); });
      row('字幕の濃さ', '後ろの帯', 'subBg'); sl('subBg', 0, 0.9, 0.05, pct);
      row('ヒットマーカー', '', 'hitMarker'); ch('hitMarker', [[true, '表示'], [false, '非表示']]);
    } else if (tab === 'gfx') {
      // まとめて選ぶ（低・中・高）と、細かい設定（変えるとカスタム）
      const G = gfxOf(S);
      row('画質', 'まとめて選ぶ。下の項目を変えるとカスタム', 'quality');
      binds.push(() => chips(body.querySelector('[data-k="quality"]'), Object.keys(QUALITY).map(k => [k, QUALITY[k].name]), S.quality, (v) => { S.quality = v; if (v !== 'custom') S.gfx = { ...GFX_PRESET[v] }; else S.gfx = { ...G }; save(); this._settings('gfx'); }));
      const gc = (k, label, sub, list) => { row(label, sub, 'g_' + k); binds.push(() => chips(body.querySelector(`[data-k="g_${k}"]`), list, G[k], (v) => { S.gfx = { ...gfxOf(S), [k]: v }; if (S.quality !== 'custom') { S.quality = 'custom'; save(); this._settings('gfx'); return; } save(); })); };
      gc('detail', '描画の細かさ', '画面の細かさの上限。高いほど重い', [['low', '低'], ['medium', '中'], ['high', '高'], ['max', '最高']]);
      row('解像度', '描画の細かさに対する割合', 'scale'); sl('scale', 0.5, 1, 0.05, pct);
      row('解像度の自動調整', '重いときに下げる', 'autoRes'); ch('autoRes', [[true, 'オン'], [false, 'オフ']]);
      row('フレームレート上限', '', 'fps'); ch('fps', [[30, '30'], [60, '60']]);
      gc('shadow', '影', '日の光の影（夜のマップでは出ない）', [['off', 'なし'], ['low', '低'], ['high', '高']]);

// 横向きのゲーム画面（ステージ）。縦持ちのときは90度回して表示し、座標を直す。
// 安全領域: 横向きのiPhoneはアイランドのない側にも同じ余白が来るので、反対側は16pxまで詰める（角の段は32px）。
export class Stage {
  constructor(el) {
    this.el = el;
    this.rotated = false;
    this.w = 0; this.h = 0;
    this.safe = { l: 0, r: 0, t: 0, b: 0 };
    this.probe = document.createElement('div');
    this.probe.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:0;height:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);padding-right:env(safe-area-inset-right);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom);padding-left:env(safe-area-inset-left)';
    document.body.appendChild(this.probe);
    this.listeners = [];
    const upd = () => this.layout();
    window.addEventListener('resize', upd);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', () => { upd(); setTimeout(upd, 300); });
    if (window.visualViewport) window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', upd);
    this.layout();
  }
  onLayout(fn) { this.listeners.push(fn); }
  deviceInsets() {
    // テストでは端末の安全領域を差し替えられる
    if (globalThis.__testInsets) { const t = globalThis.__testInsets; return { t: t.t || 0, r: t.r || 0, b: t.b || 0, l: t.l || 0 }; }
    const cs = getComputedStyle(this.probe);
    return { t: parseFloat(cs.paddingTop) || 0, r: parseFloat(cs.paddingRight) || 0, b: parseFloat(cs.paddingBottom) || 0, l: parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft) || 0 };
  }
  viewport() {
    // ホーム画面のアプリで、ステータスバーの分だけ高さが足りないとき（WebKit bug 301108）
    let W = window.innerWidth, H = window.innerHeight;
    const standalone = window.navigator.standalone === true || (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches);
    if (standalone && screen && screen.height && screen.width) {
      const portrait = H >= W;
      const sh = portrait ? Math.max(screen.width, screen.height) : Math.min(screen.width, screen.height);
      const ins = this.deviceInsets();
      const missing = sh - H;
      if (missing > 0 && Math.abs(missing - ins.t) < 2) H = sh;
    }
    return { W, H };
  }
  layout() {
    const { W, H } = this.viewport();
    const portrait = H > W;
    this.rotated = portrait;
    const ins = this.deviceInsets();
    let s;
    if (portrait) {
      // 回した後: 端末の上→ステージの左、端末の下→ステージの右
      s = { l: ins.t, r: ins.b, t: ins.r, b: ins.l };
      this.w = H; this.h = W;
      this.el.style.width = H + 'px'; this.el.style.height = W + 'px';
      this.el.style.transform = `translate(${W}px, 0px) rotate(90deg)`;
      s.l = Math.max(s.l, 16); s.r = Math.max(Math.min(s.r, 24), 12);
    } else {
      s = { l: ins.l, r: ins.r, t: ins.t, b: ins.b };
      this.w = W; this.h = H;
      this.el.style.width = W + 'px'; this.el.style.height = H + 'px';
      this.el.style.transform = 'none';
      // アイランドのない側は詰める（window.orientation: 90=アイランドは左、-90=右）
      const o = typeof window.orientation === 'number' ? window.orientation : null;
      if (s.l > 0 && s.r > 0 && Math.abs(s.l - s.r) < 2) {
        if (o === 90) s.r = 16; else if (o === -90) s.l = 16;
      }
    }
    this.safe = s;
    const st = this.el.style;
    st.setProperty('--sw', this.w + 'px'); st.setProperty('--sh', this.h + 'px');
    st.setProperty('--sl', s.l + 'px'); st.setProperty('--sr', s.r + 'px'); st.setProperty('--st', s.t + 'px'); st.setProperty('--sb', s.b + 'px');
    // 角の丸みにかかる上下の段は32px以上
    st.setProperty('--sl2', Math.max(s.l, 32) + 'px'); st.setProperty('--sr2', Math.max(s.r, 32) + 'px');
    const size = this.h < 360 ? 's' : this.h < 460 ? 'm' : 'l';
    this.el.dataset.size = size;
    this.el.dataset.wide = this.w / this.h > 1.9 ? '1' : '0';
    for (const fn of this.listeners) fn(this);
  }
  // 画面の座標 → ステージの座標
  toStage(cx, cy) {
    if (!this.rotated) return [cx, cy];
    return [cy, this.viewport().W - cx];
  }
}

// 画面の部品: 自前スクロール・スライダー・選択チップ・2段階確認・文字入力（回した画面の外）
import { onTap, onRepeat, tapGuard } from './input.js';

const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
export { esc };

// ステージの中の要素で、指の位置を 0..1 にする（回転していても横方向）
export function localX(stage, el, cx, cy) {
  const [sx] = stage.toStage(cx, cy);
  const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x0 = stage.rotated ? r.top : r.left, w = stage.rotated ? r.height : r.width;
  return (sx - x0) / (w || 1);
}

// 自前スクロール（回した画面でも指の向きどおりに動く）。慣性あり。
export class Scroller {
  // o.x: 横にスクロール（タブの列など）。回した画面でも指の動きは画面の座標で見る
  constructor(stage, el, o = {}) {
    this.stage = stage; this.el = el;
    const X = !!o.x;
    el.classList.add('scroller');
    if (X) el.classList.add('sx');
    let drag = null, v = 0, raf = 0, lastT = 0;
    const pos = (e) => { const p = stage.toStage(e.clientX, e.clientY); return X ? p[0] : p[1]; };
    const get = () => (X ? el.scrollLeft : el.scrollTop);
    const set = (n) => { if (X) el.scrollLeft = n; else el.scrollTop = n; if (X) this.edges(); };
    const stopAnim = () => { if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; };
    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      stopAnim();
      const p = pos(e);
      drag = { id: e.pointerId, p0: p, s0: get(), on: false, lp: p };
      v = 0; lastT = performance.now();
    });
    el.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!drag || drag.id !== e.pointerId) return;
      const p = pos(e);
      if (!drag.on && Math.abs(p - drag.p0) > 9) { drag.on = true; tapGuard.drag = true; try { el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (er) { /* なし */ } }
      if (drag.on) {
        const now = performance.now(), dt = Math.max(1, now - lastT);
        v = v * 0.6 + ((drag.lp - p) / dt) * 0.4;
        lastT = now; drag.lp = p;
        set(drag.s0 - (p - drag.p0));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    });
    const end = (e) => {
      if (!drag || drag.id !== e.pointerId) return;
      const was = drag.on; drag = null;
      setTimeout(() => { tapGuard.drag = false; }, 0);
      if (!was) return;
      // 慣性
      let vv = v * 16;
      const step = () => {
        vv *= 0.93;
        set(get() + vv);
        if (Math.abs(vv) > 0.4) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step); else raf = 0;
      };
      if (Math.abs(vv) > 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    el.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
    el.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
    el.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => { set(get() + (X ? (e.deltaX || e.deltaY) : e.deltaY)); e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
    if (X) { this.edges(); requestAnimationFrame(() => this.edges()); }
  }
  // 横のとき: まだ先がある側をぼかす
  edges() {
    const el = this.el;
    el.classList.toggle('fl', el.scrollLeft > 2);
    el.classList.toggle('fr', el.scrollLeft < el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth - 2);
  }
  // 子の要素が見えるように横へ寄せる
  reveal(child) {
    const el = this.el;
    if (!child) return;
    const l = child.offsetLeft - el.offsetLeft, r = l + child.offsetWidth;
    if (l < el.scrollLeft + 16) el.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, l - 24);
    else if (r > el.scrollLeft + el.clientWidth - 16) el.scrollLeft = r - el.clientWidth + 24;
    this.edges();
  }
}

// スライダー: [−] つまみ [+] 値。長押しで繰り返し。
export function slider(stage, host, o) {
  const { min, max, step } = o;
  let value = o.value;
  host.classList.add('slider');
  host.innerHTML = `<button class="sb dec" aria-label="${esc(o.label || '')}を下げる">−</button><div class="track" role="slider" aria-label="${esc(o.label || '')}" tabindex="0"><div class="fill"></div><div class="knob"></div></div><button class="sb inc" aria-label="${esc(o.label || '')}を上げる">+</button><span class="val"></span>`;
  const track = host.querySelector('.track'), fill = host.querySelector('.fill'), knob = host.querySelector('.knob'), val = host.querySelector('.val');
  const fmt = o.fmt || (v => String(v));
  const set = (v, fire = true) => {
    v = Math.max(min, Math.min(max, Math.round(v / step) * step));
    v = +v.toFixed(4);
    const changed = v !== value;
    value = v;
    const t = (v - min) / (max - min);
    fill.style.width = (t * 100) + '%'; knob.style.left = (t * 100) + '%';
    val.textContent = fmt(v);
    track.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', v);
    if (fire && changed && o.onInput) o.onInput(v);
  };
  set(value, false);
  onRepeat(host.querySelector('.dec'), () => set(value - step));
  onRepeat(host.querySelector('.inc'), () => set(value + step));
  let drag = null;
  track.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    drag = e.pointerId; tapGuard.drag = true;
    try { track.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (er) { /* なし */ }
    set(min + localX(stage, track, e.clientX, e.clientY) * (max - min));
  });
  track.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => { if (drag !== e.pointerId) return; e.stopPropagation(); set(min + localX(stage, track, e.clientX, e.clientY) * (max - min)); });
  const up = (e) => { if (drag !== e.pointerId) return; drag = null; setTimeout(() => { tapGuard.drag = false; }, 0); };
  track.addEventListener('pointerup', up); track.addEventListener('pointercancel', up);
  track.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') { set(value - step); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') { set(value + step); e.preventDefault(); }
  });
  return { set: (v) => set(v, false), get: () => value };
}

// 選択チップ（1つだけ選ぶ）。list: [[値, ラベル, 色?]]
export function chips(host, list, value, onChange, opt = {}) {
  host.classList.add('chips');
  if (opt.swatch) host.classList.add('swatches');
  host.innerHTML = list.map(([v, label, col]) => `<button class="chip${opt.swatch ? ' sw' : ''}" data-v="${esc(v)}" aria-label="${esc(label)}" aria-pressed="false">${opt.swatch ? `<i style="background:${esc(col || v)}"></i><span>${esc(label)}</span>` : esc(label)}</button>`).join('');
  const btns = [...host.querySelectorAll('.chip')];
  const mark = (v) => btns.forEach(b => { const on = b.dataset.v === String(v); b.classList.toggle('on', on); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false'); });
  mark(value);
  btns.forEach(b => onTap(b, () => { const raw = list.find(x => String(x[0]) === b.dataset.v)[0]; mark(raw); onChange(raw); }));
  return { set: mark };
}

// やり直せない操作: タッチは2回、マウスは1回（設定で切り替え）
export function confirmTap(btn, getMode, fn, armedLabel) {
  let armT = 0;
  const label = btn.innerHTML;
  const disarm = () => { armT = 0; btn.classList.remove('armed'); btn.innerHTML = label; };
  onTap(btn, (e) => {
    const mode = getMode();
    const one = mode === 'one' || (mode === 'auto' && e && e.pointerType === 'mouse');
    if (one || (armT && performance.now() - armT < 3500)) { disarm(); fn(); return; }
    armT = performance.now();
    btn.classList.add('armed');
    btn.innerHTML = armedLabel || 'もう一度押すと実行';
    setTimeout(() => { if (armT && performance.now() - armT >= 3400) disarm(); }, 3500);
  });
  return disarm;
}

// 文字入力: 回した画面の外に、端末の向きのまま出す
export function textModal(o) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'tmodal';
    wrap.innerHTML = `<div class="tm-panel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${esc(o.title)}">
      <div class="tm-title">${esc(o.title)}</div>
      ${o.note ? `<p class="tm-note">${esc(o.note)}</p>` : ''}
      ${o.multiline ? `<textarea id="tm-input" rows="4" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off"></textarea>` : `<input id="tm-input" type="text" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" enterkeyhint="done">`}
      <div class="tm-err" aria-live="polite"></div>
      <div class="tm-row"><button class="btn ghost tm-cancel">やめる</button><button class="btn primary tm-ok">${esc(o.ok || '決定')}</button></div>
    </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);
    const inp = wrap.querySelector('#tm-input'), err = wrap.querySelector('.tm-err');
    inp.value = o.value || '';
    if (o.maxLength) inp.maxLength = o.maxLength;
    if (o.placeholder) inp.placeholder = o.placeholder;
    if (o.readonly) { inp.readOnly = true; }
    const close = (v) => { wrap.remove(); resolve(v); };
    onTap(wrap.querySelector('.tm-cancel'), () => close(null));
    onTap(wrap.querySelector('.tm-ok'), () => {
      const v = inp.value;
      if (o.validate) { const msg = o.validate(v); if (msg) { err.textContent = msg; return; } }
      close(v);
    });
    inp.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !o.multiline) { e.preventDefault(); wrap.querySelector('.tm-ok').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter' })); } if (e.key === 'Escape') close(null); });
    setTimeout(() => { try { inp.focus(); if (o.readonly) inp.select(); } catch (e) { /* なし */ } }, 30);
  });
}

// クリップボードへ（失敗したら選んだ状態の入力欄を出す）
export async function copyText(text) {
  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); return true; } catch (e) { return false; }
}

// テスト用のブラウザ。ビルドしたページを開き、フォントは手元の同じ字幅のものに差し替える。
import { chromium } from '/opt/npm-tools/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs';

// Google Fonts の代わり（作業環境からは届かないため）。字幅が同じ Noto CJK を使う。
const FONT_CSS = `
@font-face{font-family:'Noto Sans JP';font-weight:400;src:local('NotoSansCJKjp-Regular');}
@font-face{font-family:'Noto Sans JP';font-weight:500;src:local('NotoSansCJKjp-Medium');}
@font-face{font-family:'Noto Sans JP';font-weight:700;src:local('NotoSansCJKjp-Bold');}
@font-face{font-family:'Noto Sans JP';font-weight:900;src:local('NotoSansCJKjp-Black');}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:400;src:local('Inter Regular'),local('Inter-Regular');}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;src:local('Inter SemiBold'),local('Inter-SemiBold');}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;src:local('Inter Bold'),local('Inter-Bold');}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:800;src:local('Inter ExtraBold'),local('Inter-ExtraBold');}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:900;src:local('Inter Black'),local('Inter-Black');}
`;

export const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname), '../..');

export async function launch() {
  const srv = await startServer(ROOT, 0);
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--ignore-gpu-blocklist', '--enable-webgl', '--enable-precise-memory-info', '--js-flags=--expose-gc'] });
  return { srv, browser, base: `http://127.0.0.1:${srv.port}/`, close: async () => { await browser.close(); await srv.close(); } };
}

// iPhone などを再現して開く
export async function openPage(env, url, o = {}) {
  const ctx = await env.browser.newContext({
    viewport: { width: o.w || 844, height: o.h || 390 },
    deviceScaleFactor: o.dpr || 1,
    hasTouch: !!o.touch, isMobile: !!o.mobile,
    userAgent: o.ua,
  });
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  const logs = [];
  page.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error' || m.type() === 'warning') logs.push(m.type() + ': ' + m.text()); });
  page.on('pageerror', e => logs.push('pageerror: ' + e.message));
  await page.route('https://fonts.googleapis.com/**', r => r.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/css', body: FONT_CSS }));
  await page.route('https://fonts.gstatic.com/**', r => r.abort());
  if (o.init) await page.addInitScript(o.init);
  if (o.safe) {
    // 安全領域（ノッチ・アイランド）を再現
    const cdp = await ctx.newCDPSession(page);
    try { await cdp.send('Emulation.setSafeAreaInsetsOverride', { insets: o.safe }); page.__safeOK = true; } catch (e) { page.__safeOK = false; page.__safeErr = e.message; }
  }
  await page.goto(env.base + url);
  return { ctx, page, logs };
}

// タイトルが出るまで待つ
export async function waitTitle(page, timeout = 120000) {
  await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__app && window.__app.screens && window.__app.screens.cur === 'title', null, { timeout });
}

// 見た目の自動検査（ページの中で動かす）: はみ出し・文字の切れ・重なり・安全領域
export function layoutCheck() {
  const app = window.__app, st = app.stage;
  const W = st.w, H = st.h, S = st.safe;
  const out = [];
  const VW = st.viewport().W;
  const rectOf = (el) => {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!st.rotated) return { x: r.left, y: r.top, w: r.width, h: r.height };
    return { x: r.top, y: VW - r.right, w: r.height, h: r.width };
  };
  const shown = (el) => {
    for (let p = el; p && p !== document.body; p = p.parentElement) {
      const c = getComputedStyle(p);
      if (c.display === 'none' || c.visibility === 'hidden') return false;
    }
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r.width > 0.5 && r.height > 0.5;
  };
  const label = (el) => {
    const cls = typeof el.className === 'string' ? el.className.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).join('.') : '';
    const t = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.textContent || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 18);
    return el.tagName.toLowerCase() + (cls ? '.' + cls : '') + (t ? `「${t}」` : '');
  };
  const roots = [];
  const scr = document.querySelector('.screen.on'); if (scr) roots.push(scr);
  const hud = document.querySelector('#hud.on'); if (hud) roots.push(hud);
  const tm = document.querySelector('.tmodal'); if (tm) roots.push(tm);
  for (const root of roots) {
    const els = [...root.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(shown);
    // 1) 文字の切れ・はみ出し
    for (const el of els) {
      if (el.closest('svg')) continue;
      const hasText = [...el.childNodes].some(n => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim());
      if (!hasText) continue;
      const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      const ell = cs.textOverflow === 'ellipsis';
      if (cs.writingMode.startsWith('vertical')) {
        // 縦書き: 行は縦に伸びる。縦方向のはみ出しだけ見る（字の幅のはみ出しは字形の都合なので見ない）
        if (el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 2) out.push({ kind: '縦書きが切れる', el: label(el), by: el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight });
        continue;
      }
      if (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1 && cs.display !== 'inline') out.push({ kind: ell ? '省略(…)' : '文字が横に切れる', el: label(el), by: el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth });
      if (el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 2 && cs.overflowY !== 'visible' && !el.classList.contains('scroller') && cs.display !== 'inline') out.push({ kind: '文字が縦に切れる', el: label(el), by: el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight });
    }
    // 2) 画面の外・安全領域の外（押すもの）
    const inter = els.filter(el => el.matches('button, input, textarea, [data-hud], .track'));
    for (const el of inter) {
      if (root === tm) continue; // 文字入力は回した画面の外
      const r = rectOf(el);
      const sc = el.closest('.scroller');
      if (sc) {
        const s = rectOf(sc);
        if (!sc.classList.contains('sx') && (r.x < s.x - 1 || r.x + r.w > s.x + s.w + 1)) out.push({ kind: 'スクロール枠の横にはみ出す', el: label(el) });
        if (sc.classList.contains('sx') && (r.y < s.y - 1 || r.y + r.h > s.y + s.h + 1)) out.push({ kind: '横スクロール枠の縦にはみ出す', el: label(el) });
        continue;
      }
      if (r.x < S.l - 1 || r.y < S.t - 1 || r.x + r.w > W - S.r + 1 || r.y + r.h > H - S.b + 1) {
        out.push({ kind: '安全領域の外', el: label(el), rect: [r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h].map(v => Math.round(v)), safe: [S.l, S.t, W - S.r, H - S.b].map(v => Math.round(v)) });
      }
    }
    // 3) 押すもの同士の重なり
    const rs = inter.filter(el => !el.closest('.scroller')).map(el => ({ el, r: rectOf(el) }));
    for (let i = 0; i < rs.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < rs.length; j++) {
      const a = rs[i], b = rs[j];
      if (a.el.contains(b.el) || b.el.contains(a.el)) continue;
      const ix = Math.min(a.r.x + a.r.w, b.r.x + b.r.w) - Math.max(a.r.x, b.r.x);
      const iy = Math.min(a.r.y + a.r.h, b.r.y + b.r.h) - Math.max(a.r.y, b.r.y);
      if (ix > 2 && iy > 2) out.push({ kind: '重なり', el: label(a.el) + ' × ' + label(b.el), by: Math.round(Math.min(ix, iy)) });
    }
    // 4) 表示（押さないもの）の重なり: HUDの表示とボタン
    if (root === hud) {
      const disp = [...root.querySelectorAll('.bars, .keys, .eye')].filter(shown).map(el => ({ el, r: rectOf(el) }));
      for (const a of disp) for (const b of rs) {
        const ix = Math.min(a.r.x + a.r.w, b.r.x + b.r.w) - Math.max(a.r.x, b.r.x);
        const iy = Math.min(a.r.y + a.r.h, b.r.y + b.r.h) - Math.max(a.r.y, b.r.y);
        if (ix > 2 && iy > 2 && !a.el.contains(b.el)) out.push({ kind: 'HUDの重なり', el: label(a.el) + ' × ' + label(b.el) });
      }
      for (const a of disp) {
        if (a.r.x < S.l - 1 || a.r.y < S.t - 1 || a.r.x + a.r.w > W - S.r + 1 || a.r.y + a.r.h > H - S.b + 1) out.push({ kind: 'HUD表示が安全領域の外', el: label(a.el), rect: [a.r.x, a.r.y, a.r.w, a.r.h].map(v => Math.round(v)) });
      }
    }
  }
  // 6) 読みやすさ: 小さすぎる文字（11px未満）
  // 7) 押しやすさ: 小さすぎるボタン（指で押すものは短い辺が36px未満なら×）
  for (const root of roots) {
    const els = [...root.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(shown);
    for (const el of els) {
      if (el.closest('svg')) continue;
      const hasText = [...el.childNodes].some(n => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim());
      if (!hasText) continue;
      const fs = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize) || 0;
      // HUDは大きさの設定（--s）で拡大縮小される
      const hs = el.closest('[data-hud]') ? (parseFloat(el.closest('[data-hud]').style.getPropertyValue('--s')) || 1) : 1;
      if (fs * hs < 11) out.push({ kind: '文字が小さい', el: label(el), px: +(fs * hs).toFixed(1) });
    }
    if (root === tm) continue;
    for (const el of els.filter(e => e.matches('button, [role=tab], .chip, .track'))) {
      if (el.closest('.hud-edit-panel') && el.matches('.track')) continue;
      const r = rectOf(el);
      const hs = el.closest('[data-hud]') ? 1 : 1;
      const m = Math.min(r.w, r.h) * hs;
      if (el.matches('.track')) { if (r.h < 28) out.push({ kind: '押しにくい（つまみの高さ）', el: label(el), px: Math.round(r.h) }); continue; }
      if (m < 36) out.push({ kind: '押しにくい（小さい）', el: label(el), px: Math.round(m) });
    }
  }
  // 8) 親に隠されて切れる文字（親が overflow:hidden で、文字がその外にはみ出している）
  for (const root of roots) {
    const els = [...root.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(shown);
    for (const el of els) {
      // 方位の帯は流れる目盛りを端で切って見せる作り
      if (el.closest('svg') || el.closest('.scroller') || el.closest('.hud-compass')) continue;
      const hasText = [...el.childNodes].some(n => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim());
      if (!hasText) continue;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      for (let a = el.parentElement; a && a !== root.parentElement; a = a.parentElement) {
        const cs = getComputedStyle(a);
        if (cs.overflow === 'visible' && cs.overflowX === 'visible' && cs.overflowY === 'visible') continue;
        if (a.classList.contains('scroller') || cs.overflowY === 'auto' || cs.overflowY === 'scroll') break;
        const q = a.getBoundingClientRect();
        const by = Math.max(r.bottom - q.bottom, r.right - q.right, q.top - r.top, q.left - r.left);
        if (by > 1.5) { out.push({ kind: '親に隠れて切れる', el: label(el), by: Math.round(by) }); break; }
      }
    }
  }
  // 5) ページ全体の横スクロール
  if (document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth + 1) out.push({ kind: 'ページが横にスクロールする', by: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth });
  return { screen: app.screens.cur, hud: !!hud, W, H, rotated: st.rotated, safe: S, problems: out };
}

@@@@ FILE tests/lib/t.mjs text 997
// 小さなテストの道具
const tests = [];
export function test(name, fn) { tests.push({ name, fn }); }
export class AssertError extends Error {}
export function ok(v, msg = '') { if (!v) throw new AssertError('ok失敗: ' + msg); }
export function eq(a, b, msg = '') {
  const sa = JSON.stringify(a), sb = JSON.stringify(b);
  if (sa !== sb) throw new AssertError(`eq失敗: ${msg}\n  実際: ${sa}\n  期待: ${sb}`);
}
export function near(a, b, eps, msg = '') { if (!(Math.abs(a - b) <= eps)) throw new AssertError(`near失敗: ${msg} ${a} vs ${b} (±${eps})`); }
export async function runTests(filter) {
  const res = [];
  for (const t of tests) {
    if (filter && !t.name.includes(filter)) continue;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    try { await t.fn(); res.push({ name: t.name, ok: true, ms: performance.now() - t0 }); }
    catch (e) { res.push({ name: t.name, ok: false, ms: performance.now() - t0, err: String(e && e.stack || e) }); }
  }
  tests.length = 0;
  return res;
}

  const sw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'dist/app/sw.js'), 'utf8');
  rec('アプリ版', 'SWはno-cacheで確かめ、ビルドごとのキャッシュ名、アイコンは横取りしない', /cache: 'no-cache'/.test(sw) && /miteru-[0-9a-f]{10}/.test(sw) && /png\|webmanifest/.test(sw));
  // ソース一式から復元できる
  const tmp = path.join(OUT, 'restore-check');
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
  execFileSync('node', [path.join(ROOT, 'tools/unbundle.mjs'), path.join(ROOT, 'dist/source-bundle.txt'), tmp]);
  const same = ['src/app/main.js', 'src/engine/creature.js', 'src/assets/creature.bin', 'DESIGN.md'].every(f => Buffer.compare(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f)), fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, f))) === 0);
  rec('ビルド', 'ソース一式から元どおり復元できる', same);
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
} catch (e) { rec('ビルド', 'ビルドできる', false, e.message.slice(0, 300)); }

// 4 自動対戦（簡易）
try {
  const N = QUICK ? 12 : 40;
  const rates = {};
  for (const diff of ['easy', 'normal', 'hard']) {
    const rows = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= N; i++) rows.push(runOne(String(1000 + i), diff, 'average', { maxTime: 1200 }));
    const sm = summarize(rows);
    rates[diff] = sm;
  }
  const esc = (d) => rates[d].escape;
  rec('自動対戦', `各難易度${N}試合が最後まで動く`, true, ['easy', 'normal', 'hard'].map(d => `${d} 脱出${Math.round(esc(d) * 100)}%`).join('・'));
  rec('自動対戦', '難しいほど脱出しにくい', esc('easy') >= esc('normal') && esc('normal') >= esc('hard') - 0.05);
} catch (e) { rec('自動対戦', '自動対戦', false, e.message); }

import { test, ok, eq, near } from '../lib/t.mjs';
import { createGame, step, dump, load } from '../../src/engine/engine.js';
import { WEAPONS } from '../../src/engine/data/weapons.js';
import { eyeOf } from '../../src/engine/combat.js';

function mk(o = {}) { return createGame({ map: 'training', mode: 'train', seed: 7, team: 1, house: false, ...o }); }

test('engine: 訓練場で試合を作れる', () => {
  const G = mk();
  ok(G.S.actors.length >= 1, '人がいる');
  const p = G.S.actors[0];
  eq(p.kind, 'swat'); ok(p.inv.w[0] && p.inv.w[0].id === 'mk18', '主武器');
});

test('engine: 前に歩くと進み、壁で止まる', () => {
  const G = mk();
  const p = G.S.actors[0];
  const z0 = p.z;
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 1, yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0, stance: 0 } });
  ok(z0 - p.z > 2.0, `北へ進む ${z0 - p.z}`);
  near(Math.hypot(p.vx, p.vz), 2.4 * 0.95, 0.15, '歩きの速さ（Mk18 0.95倍）');
});

test('engine: 撃つと弾が減り、反動で上を向く', () => {
  const G = mk();
  const p = G.S.actors[0];
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0, stance: 0 } });
  const before = p.inv.w[0].mag;
  let shots = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const ev = step(G, { [p.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0, stance: 0, fire: true } }); shots += ev.filter(e => e.e === 'shot').length; }
  ok(shots >= 6 && shots <= 9, `0.5秒で850発/分 → 7発前後: ${shots}`);
  eq(before - p.inv.w[0].mag, shots, '弾が減る');
  ok(p.ws.rp > 2, '反動で上を向く ' + p.ws.rp);
});

test('engine: dump と load で同じ状態に戻る', () => {
  const G = mk();
  const p = G.S.actors[0];
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: { mx: 0.3, mz: 1, yaw: p.yaw + 0.1, pitch: 0.05, stance: 0, fire: i % 7 === 0 } });
  const d = dump(G);
  const G2 = load(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d)));
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const inp = { mx: -0.3, mz: 1, yaw: p.yaw - 0.1, pitch: 0, stance: 1 }; step(G, { [G.S.actors[0].id]: inp }); step(G2, { [G2.S.actors[0].id]: inp }); }
  const a = G.S.actors[0], b = G2.S.actors[0];
  near(a.x, b.x, 1e-9, 'x'); near(a.z, b.z, 1e-9, 'z'); eq(a.inv.w[0].mag, b.inv.w[0].mag, '弾');
});

test('engine: 通常のリロードは弾倉を残し、速いリロードは捨てる', () => {
  const G = mk();
  const p = G.S.actors[0], wi = p.inv.w[0];
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: { yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0 } });
  wi.mag = 10;
  const n0 = wi.mags.length;
  step(G, { [p.id]: { yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0, act: [{ a: 'reload' }] } });
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: { yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0 } });
  eq(wi.mags.length, n0, '本数は同じ（10発の弾倉が残る）');
  ok(wi.mags.includes(10), '10発の弾倉');
  wi.mag = 5;
  step(G, { [p.id]: { yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0, act: [{ a: 'reload', fast: true }] } });
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: { yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0 } });
  eq(wi.mags.length, n0 - 1, '速いリロードは1本減る');
});

test('engine: 右のリーンで目が右へ、左のリーンで左へ動く（表記と向きが合う）', () => {
  const G = mk();
  const p = G.S.actors[0];
  const off = (lean) => { for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw: p.yaw, pitch: 0, stance: 0, lean } }); const e = eyeOf(G.S, p); return (e[0] - p.x) * -Math.cos(p.yaw) + (e[2] - p.z) * Math.sin(p.yaw); };
  ok(off(1) > 0.2, '右へ ' + off(1));
  ok(off(-1) < -0.2, '左へ ' + off(-1));
});

  eq(p.ws.slot, 3, 'M320を持つ');
  step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p, { act: [{ a: 'long' }] }) });
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p) });
  eq(p.ws.slot, 0, '主武器に戻る');
});

test('engine: M320 は撃つと弾が減り、装填のあいだは撃てない。射撃モードで弾を替える', () => {
  const G = mkLong('m320');
  const p = G.S.actors[0];
  step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p, { act: [{ a: 'long' }] }) });
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p) });
  const m = p.inv.m320;
  eq(m.sel, 'flash');
  let ev = step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p, { fire: true }) });
  ok(ev.some(e => e.e === 'launch' && e.type === 'flash'), '閃光弾を撃つ');
  eq(m.flash, 2, '残り2');
  ok(G.S.nades.some(n => n.impact), '当たると作動する弾');
  step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p) });
  ev = step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p, { fire: true }) });
  ok(!ev.some(e => e.e === 'launch'), '装填中は撃てない');
  step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p, { act: [{ a: 'mode' }] }) });
  eq(m.sel, 'stinger', '弾を替える');
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p) });
  ev = step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p, { fire: true }) });
  ok(ev.some(e => e.e === 'launch' && e.type === 'stinger'), '装填後はスティンガー弾');
});

test('engine: 盾は前からの拳銃弾を止め、横からは止めない', () => {
  const G = mkLong('shield');
  const S = G.S, w = G.w, p = S.actors[0];
  // 副武器へ（盾を構える）
  step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p, { act: [{ a: 'switch', slot: 1 }] }) });
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p) });
  eq(p.ws.slot, 1);
  // 前 4m に容疑者（拳銃）
  const fx = Math.sin(p.yaw), fz = Math.cos(p.yaw);
  const s = createActor(S, { kind: 'sus', team: 1, name: '的', x: p.x + fx * 4, y: p.y, z: p.z + fz * 4, yaw: p.yaw + Math.PI, hp: 100, h: 1.75, pid: 9, lo: { primary: null, secondary: { id: 'g17', ammo: 'jhp' } } });
  S.byId[s.id] = s;
  const hp0 = p.hp;
  let blocked = 0, hits = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
    const e = eyeOf(S, p); const se = eyeOf(S, s);
    const dx = e[0] - se[0], dy = (p.y + 1.2) - se[1], dz = e[2] - se[2];
    const yaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz), pitch = Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz));
    const ev = step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p), [s.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw, pitch, stance: 0, fire: i % 6 === 0 } });
    blocked += ev.filter(x => x.e === 'shieldhit').length; hits += ev.filter(x => x.e === 'hit' && x.id === p.id).length;
  }
  ok(blocked >= 4, '盾に当たる ' + blocked);
  eq(hits, 0, '体には当たらない');
  eq(p.hp, hp0, '体力は減らない');
  // 横に回る
  s.x = p.x + Math.cos(p.yaw) * 3; s.z = p.z - Math.sin(p.yaw) * 3;
  let side = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    const se = eyeOf(S, s);
    const dx = p.x - se[0], dy = (p.y + 1.25) - se[1], dz = p.z - se[2];
    const ev = step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p), [s.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw: Math.atan2(dx, dz), pitch: Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)), stance: 0, fire: i % 6 === 0 } });
    side += ev.filter(x => x.e === 'hit' && x.id === p.id).length;
  }
  ok(side >= 1, '横からは当たる ' + side);
});

test('engine: ミラー（人）は扉の向こうにカメラを置き、動くと終わる', () => {
  const G = mk();
  const S = G.S, w = G.w, p = S.actors[0];
  // いちばん近い閉じた扉の前へ
  let best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (const d of w.doors) { if (d.L !== 0) continue; const dist = Math.hypot(d.cx - p.x, d.cz - p.z); if (dist < bd) { bd = dist; best = d; } }
  ok(best, '扉がある');
  const side = 1;
  p.x = best.cx + best.nx * side * 0.8; p.z = best.cz + best.nz * side * 0.8;
  p.yaw = Math.atan2(-best.nx * side, -best.nz * side);
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p) });
  step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p, { act: [{ a: 'op', k: 'door', id: best.id, op: 'mirror' }] }) });
  let started = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < 80 && !started; i++) { const ev = step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p) }); started = ev.find(e => e.e === 'peek'); }
  ok(started, 'のぞき始める');
  ok(p.peek && p.peek.k === 'mirror', 'ミラーの視点');
  const s2 = (p.peek.x - best.cx) * best.nx + (p.peek.z - best.cz) * best.nz;
  ok(s2 * side < 0, '扉の向こう側にカメラ ' + s2);
  ok(p.peek.y - best.L * 3 < 0.15, '床の近く');
  let ended = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !ended; i++) { const ev = step(G, { [p.id]: idleIn(p, { mz: 1 }) }); ended = ev.find(e => e.e === 'peekend'); }
  ok(ended && ended.why === 'move', '動くと終わる');
  eq(p.peek, null);
});

// ---- 調べる・使う: 手が届く所でだけ（離れている・間に家具があるとできない）
import { reachOK, doAction } from '../../src/engine/interact.js';
import { addProp } from '../../src/engine/world.js';
function mkPve() {
  const G = createGame({ map: 'suburb', mode: 'pve', mission: 'barricade', diff: 'normal', team: 2, allAI: true, seed: 3 });
  const S = G.S, a = S.actors.find(b => b.kind === 'swat'), b = S.actors.find(x => x.kind === 'sus');
  for (const x of S.actors) x.ai = null;
  return { G, S, w: G.w, a, b };
}
// 何もない所（前庭の芝生の真ん中）に2人を置く
function openSpot(S, w, a, b) {
  a.x = 4.75; a.z = 25.75; a.y = 0; a.yaw = 0; a.pitch = -0.5; a.act = null;
  Object.assign(b, { x: a.x, z: a.z + 0.9, y: 0, yaw: 0, comply: 2, cuffed: false, down: false, alive: true, stateT: 5 });
  for (const o of S.actors) if (o !== a && o !== b) { o.x = 2; o.z = 2; }
}
test('interact: 拘束は手の届く1.0m以内でだけ。離れていると「届かない」で始まらない', () => {
  const { S, w, a, b } = mkPve();
  openSpot(S, w, a, b);
  ok(reachOK(S, w, a, 'person', b.id, 'restrain'), '0.9m: 届く');
  b.z = a.z + 1.3;
  ok(!reachOK(S, w, a, 'person', b.id, 'restrain'), '1.3m: 届かない');
  const ev = [];
  doAction(S, w, a, { a: 'op', k: 'person', id: b.id, op: 'restrain' }, ev);
  ok(!a.act && ev.some(e => e.e === 'deny' && e.why === 'far'), '始まらず「届かない」');
});
test('interact: 拘束は寄って背中から（相手は背を向けてひざをつき、手首を背中へ回される）。約2.8秒', () => {
  const { G, S, w, a, b } = mkPve();
  openSpot(S, w, a, b);
  b.comply = 1; b.yaw = Math.PI; // 手を上げてこちらを向いている
  const ev = [];
  doAction(S, w, a, { a: 'op', k: 'person', id: b.id, op: 'restrain' }, ev);
  ok(a.act && a.act.k === 'restrain' && a.act.pose === 'cuff', '拘束が始まる（手を伸ばす動き）');
  ok(b.comply === 2 && b.cuffBy === a.id, '相手はひざをつき、押さえられる');
  const inp = () => ({ [a.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw: Math.atan2(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z), pitch: -0.6, stance: 0, lean: 0 } });
  let t = 0, done = null;
  while (t < 4 && !done) { const e2 = step(G, inp()); t += S.dt; done = e2.find(e => e.e === 'cuffed'); if (t > 1.0 && t < 1.05) { ok(Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(b.yaw - Math.atan2(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z)), Math.cos(b.yaw - Math.atan2(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z)))) < 0.3, '相手は背中を向けた'); near(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z), 0.76, 0.12, '背中のすぐ後ろへ寄った'); ok(b.cuffK > 0.3 && b.cuffK < 0.45, '手首を背中へ回している ' + b.cuffK); } }
  ok(done && b.cuffed, '拘束できた');
  near(t, 2.8, 0.15, 'かかった時間');
  ok(b.cuffBy == null && !b.cuffK, '押さえは解ける');
});
test('interact: 拘束は途中で離れる・目をそらすと中断', () => {
  const { G, S, w, a, b } = mkPve();
  openSpot(S, w, a, b);
  doAction(S, w, a, { a: 'op', k: 'person', id: b.id, op: 'restrain' }, []);
  a.pid = 0; // 入力で向きを変える
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) step(G, { [a.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw: Math.atan2(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z), pitch: -0.6, stance: 0, lean: 0 } });
  ok(a.act, '続いている');
  let c = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < 30 && !c; i++) { const ev = step(G, { [a.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 0, yaw: Math.atan2(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z) + Math.PI, pitch: 0, stance: 0, lean: 0 } }); c = ev.find(e => e.e === 'actcancel'); }
  ok(c && !a.act && !b.cuffed && b.cuffBy == null, '後ろを向くと中断し、相手は押さえから外れる');
});
test('interact: 間に動かない家具（カウンター・テーブルの下のすき間）や人があると、近くても拘束できない', () => {
  const { S, w, a, b } = mkPve();
  openSpot(S, w, a, b);
  ok(reachOK(S, w, a, 'person', b.id, 'restrain'), '家具なし: 届く');
  const n0 = w.props.length;
  addProp(w, ['counter', a.x / 0.5, (a.z + 0.45) / 0.5, 0, 0, { w: 2.0, d: 0.3 }]);
  ok(!reachOK(S, w, a, 'person', b.id, 'restrain'), 'カウンター越し: 届かない');
  w.props[n0].alive = false;
  addProp(w, ['table', a.x / 0.5, (a.z + 0.45) / 0.5, 0, 0, { w: 1.4, d: 0.4 }]);
  ok(!reachOK(S, w, a, 'person', b.id, 'restrain'), 'テーブル越し（天板の下のすき間）: 届かない');
  w.props[n0 + 1].alive = false;
  ok(reachOK(S, w, a, 'person', b.id, 'restrain'), '家具をどけると届く');
  const c = S.actors.find(o => o !== a && o !== b);
  Object.assign(c, { x: a.x, z: a.z + 0.45, y: 0, alive: true, down: false });
  ok(!reachOK(S, w, a, 'person', b.id, 'restrain'), '間に人がいる: 届かない');
});
test('interact: 扉はノブに手が届く所（約1m）で開けられ、手を伸ばしてから開く。離れていると届かない', () => {
  const { G, S, w, a } = mkPve();
  const d = w.doors.find(q => q.L === 0 && !S.doors[q.id].locked && !q.double && S.doors[q.id].open < 0.05);
  const lf = d.leaves[0], kx = lf.hx + lf.dx * (lf.len - 0.12), kz = lf.hz + lf.dz * (lf.len - 0.12);
  const put = (dist, sg = 1) => { a.x = kx + d.nx * dist * sg; a.z = kz + d.nz * dist * sg; a.y = 0; a.act = null; };
  put(0.75); ok(reachOK(S, w, a, 'door', d.id, 'open'), 'ノブの前0.75m: 届く');
  put(1.6); ok(!reachOK(S, w, a, 'door', d.id, 'open'), '1.6m: 届かない');
  put(0.75, -1); ok(reachOK(S, w, a, 'door', d.id, 'open'), '反対側からも0.75mなら届く');
  put(0.7);
  for (const o of S.actors) if (o !== a) { o.x = 2; o.z = 2; }
  doAction(S, w, a, { a: 'op', k: 'door', id: d.id, op: 'open' }, []);
  ok(a.act && a.act.pose === 'knob', 'ノブへ手を伸ばす');
  ok(S.doors[d.id].tgt.every(v => v === 0), 'まだ開かない');
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) step(G, {});
  ok(!a.act && S.doors[d.id].tgt.some(v => Math.abs(v) > 0.3), '手が届いてから開き始める');
});
test('interact: 落ちている物は1m以内で拾える。テーブル越しは届かず、テーブルの上の物はそばからなら届く', () => {

test('interact: 半開きの扉は体で押すと開いていく（閉じた扉は押しても開かない）', () => {
  const { G, S, w, a } = mkPve();
  const d = w.doors.find(q => q.L === 0 && !S.doors[q.id].locked && !q.double);
  const ds = S.doors[d.id], lf = d.leaves[0];
  for (const o of S.actors) if (o !== a) { o.x = 2; o.z = 2; }
  a.pid = 0;
  // 閉じた扉の前から扉へ向かって歩く: 開かない
  const side = 1, kx = lf.hx + lf.dx * (lf.len * 0.6), kz = lf.hz + lf.dz * (lf.len * 0.6);
  const walkTo = (n) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) step(G, { [a.id]: { mx: 0, mz: 1, yaw: Math.atan2(-d.nx * side, -d.nz * side), pitch: 0, stance: 0, lean: 0 } }); };
  a.x = kx + d.nx * 0.6; a.z = kz + d.nz * 0.6; a.y = 0; a.vx = a.vz = 0;
  walkTo(60);
  ok(ds.ang.every(v => Math.abs(v) < 0.05), '閉じた扉は体で押しても開かない');
  // 少し開いた扉（向こうへ17°）: 押すと開いていく
  const s0 = Math.sign((a.x - d.cx) * d.nx + (a.z - d.cz) * d.nz) || 1;
  ds.ang[0] = ds.tgt[0] = -s0 * lf.s * 0.3;
  a.x = kx + d.nx * 0.6; a.z = kz + d.nz * 0.6; a.vx = a.vz = 0;
  const a0 = Math.abs(ds.ang[0]);
  walkTo(90);
  ok(Math.abs(ds.ang[0]) > a0 + 0.3, '押した分だけ開く ' + a0.toFixed(2) + ' → ' + Math.abs(ds.ang[0]).toFixed(2));
});

// 単体テストをまとめて流す: node tests/unit/run.mjs [絞り込み]
import { runTests } from '../lib/t.mjs';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
const dir = path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname);
const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.test.mjs')).sort();
let all = [];
for (const f of files) { await import(path.join(dir, f)); const r = await runTests(process.argv[2]); all = all.concat(r.map(x => ({ ...x, file: f }))); }
const bad = all.filter(r => !r.ok);
for (const r of all) console.log(`${r.ok ? 'ok  ' : 'FAIL'} ${r.name} (${r.ms.toFixed(1)}ms)${r.ok ? '' : '\n' + r.err}`);
console.log(`\n${all.length - bad.length}/${all.length} 合格`);
if (process.env.UNIT_JSON) fs.writeFileSync(process.env.UNIT_JSON, JSON.stringify(all, null, 1));
process.exit(bad.length ? 1 : 0);

  const bx0 = w.boxes[o], bz0 = w.boxes[o + 1], bx1 = w.boxes[o + 2], bz1 = w.boxes[o + 3];

test('world: 扉は閉じていると視線を止め、開くと通す', () => {
  const w = compileMap(tiny);
  const d = w.doors[0];
  const closed = [{ ang: [0], broken: false, bar: 0 }];
  const open = [{ ang: [Math.PI / 2 * d.leaves[0].s], broken: false, bar: 0 }];
  const a = [d.cx, 1.5, d.cz - 0.8], b = [d.cx, 1.5, d.cz + 0.8];
  eq(los(w, ...a, ...b, closed), false, '閉じた扉');
  eq(los(w, ...a, ...b, open), true, '開いた扉');
});

# 声が聞き取れるかの確認: Whisper（base.en, ONNX）で文字に起こす。
#   python3 -I tools/asr.py <モデルのフォルダ> <wav...>   → 1行ずつ「ファイル<TAB>聞き取った文」
# 外部のプログラムは使わず、numpy と onnxruntime（作業環境に入っているもの）だけで動かす。
import sys, os, wave, base64
import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort

SR = 16000; N_FFT = 400; HOP = 160; N_MELS = 80; N_FRAMES = 3000

def load_wav(p):
    w = wave.open(p); sr = w.getframerate(); ch = w.getnchannels(); sw = w.getsampwidth()
    x = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype={2: np.int16, 4: np.int32}[sw]).astype(np.float32)
    x /= 32768.0 if sw == 2 else 2147483648.0
    if ch > 1: x = x.reshape(-1, ch).mean(1)
    if sr != SR:
        t = np.arange(int(len(x) * SR / sr)) * sr / SR
        x = np.interp(t, np.arange(len(x)), x).astype(np.float32)
    return x

def mel_filters(sr=SR, n_fft=N_FFT, n_mels=N_MELS):
    # librosa の slaney 式（Whisper と同じ）
    def hz_to_mel(f):
        f = np.asarray(f, dtype=np.float64); m = f / (200.0 / 3)
        log = f >= 1000.0; m = np.where(log, 15.0 + np.log(np.maximum(f, 1e-10) / 1000.0) / (np.log(6.4) / 27.0), m); return m
    def mel_to_hz(m):
        m = np.asarray(m, dtype=np.float64); f = m * (200.0 / 3)
        log = m >= 15.0; f = np.where(log, 1000.0 * np.exp((np.log(6.4) / 27.0) * (m - 15.0)), f); return f
    fft_f = np.linspace(0, sr / 2, 1 + n_fft // 2)
    mel_f = mel_to_hz(np.linspace(hz_to_mel(0), hz_to_mel(sr / 2), n_mels + 2))
    fd = np.diff(mel_f); ramps = mel_f[:, None] - fft_f[None, :]
    w = np.zeros((n_mels, len(fft_f)))
    for i in range(n_mels):
        lo = -ramps[i] / fd[i]; hi = ramps[i + 2] / fd[i + 1]
        w[i] = np.maximum(0, np.minimum(lo, hi))
    enorm = 2.0 / (mel_f[2:n_mels + 2] - mel_f[:n_mels]); w *= enorm[:, None]
    return w.astype(np.float32)

MEL = mel_filters()
def log_mel(x):
    x = np.pad(x, (N_FFT // 2, N_FFT // 2), mode='reflect')
    win = np.hanning(N_FFT + 1)[:-1].astype(np.float32)
    n = 1 + (len(x) - N_FFT) // HOP
    fr = np.stack([x[i * HOP:i * HOP + N_FFT] * win for i in range(n)])
    spec = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(fr, axis=1)) ** 2
    spec = spec[:-1] if spec.shape[0] > 1 else spec
    mel = MEL @ spec.T
    lg = np.log10(np.maximum(mel, 1e-10))
    lg = np.maximum(lg, lg.max() - 8.0)
    lg = (lg + 4.0) / 4.0
    if lg.shape[1] < N_FRAMES: lg = np.pad(lg, ((0, 0), (0, N_FRAMES - lg.shape[1])), constant_values=lg.min() if lg.size else 0)
    return lg[:, :N_FRAMES].astype(np.float32)

class Whisper:
    def __init__(self, d):
        o = ort.SessionOptions(); o.intra_op_num_threads = 2
        self.enc = ort.InferenceSession(os.path.join(d, 'base.en-encoder.int8.onnx'), o, providers=['CPUExecutionProvider'])
        self.dec = ort.InferenceSession(os.path.join(d, 'base.en-decoder.int8.onnx'), o, providers=['CPUExecutionProvider'])
        meta = self.enc.get_modelmeta().custom_metadata_map
        self.sot = int(meta['sot']); self.eot = int(meta['eot']); self.nots = int(meta['no_timestamps'])
        self.tok = {}
        for line in open(os.path.join(d, 'base.en-tokens.txt'), encoding='utf8'):
            b, i = line.rsplit(' ', 1); self.tok[int(i)] = base64.b64decode(b)
    def __call__(self, x):
        mel = log_mel(x)[None]
        ck, cv = self.enc.run(None, {'mel': mel})
        kc = np.zeros((6, 1, 448, 512), np.float32); vc = np.zeros((6, 1, 448, 512), np.float32)
        toks = [self.sot, self.nots]
        logits, kc, vc = self.dec.run(None, {'tokens': np.array([toks], np.int64), 'in_n_layer_self_k_cache': kc, 'in_n_layer_self_v_cache': vc, 'n_layer_cross_k': ck, 'n_layer_cross_v': cv, 'offset': np.array([0], np.int64)})
        out = []; off = len(toks)
        for _ in range(60):
            t = int(np.argmax(logits[0, -1]))
            if t == self.eot or t >= 50257: break
            out.append(t)
            logits, kc, vc = self.dec.run(None, {'tokens': np.array([[t]], np.int64), 'in_n_layer_self_k_cache': kc, 'in_n_layer_self_v_cache': vc, 'n_layer_cross_k': ck, 'n_layer_cross_v': cv, 'offset': np.array([off], np.int64)})
            off += 1
        return b''.join(self.tok.get(t, b'') for t in out).decode('utf8', 'replace').strip()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    W = Whisper(sys.argv[1])
    for p in sys.argv[2:]:
        print(p + '\t' + W(load_wav(p)), flush=True)

// 自前の小さなバンドラ。src のESモジュールを1つのスクリプトにまとめる。
// 対応する書き方（これ以外は使わない）:
//   import { a, b as c } from './x.js';      （名前付きimport。複数行可）
//   import X from './x.js';  import X, { a } from './x.js';   （default）
//   export function f() / export const x = / export class C / export let y
//   export { a, b as c };
// 循環importは不可。export let は値のコピーになる（後から書き換えない）。
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const IMPORT_RE = /^\s*import\s*(?:([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*(?:,\s*)?)?(?:\{([\s\S]*?)\})?\s*from\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*;?/gm;
const EXPORT_DEFAULT_RE = /^export\s+default\s+/m;
const EXPORT_DECL_RE = /^export\s+(async\s+function\*?|function\*?|const|let|var|class)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)/gm;
const EXPORT_LIST_RE = /^export\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*;?/gm;

// 宣言の残り（最初の名前の後ろ）から、深さ0のカンマの後の名前を拾う（文の終わり ; か、深さ0の改行まで）
function extraDeclNames(s, i) {
  const out = [];
  let depth = 0, q = null;
  for (; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s[i];
    if (q) { if (c === '\\') { i++; continue; } if (c === q) q = null; continue; }
    if (c === '"' || c === "'" || c === '`') { q = c; continue; }
    if (c === '/' && s[i + 1] === '/') { while (i < s.length && s[i] !== '\n') i++; i--; continue; }
    if (c === '(' || c === '[' || c === '{') depth++;
    else if (c === ')' || c === ']' || c === '}') depth--;
    else if (depth === 0 && (c === ';' || c === '\n')) break;
    else if (depth === 0 && c === ',') { const m = /^\s*([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=/.exec(s.slice(i + 1, i + 80)); if (m) out.push(m[1]); }
  }
  return out;
}

function modId(file, root) {
  return '__m_' + path.relative(root, file).replace(/\.js$/, '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, '_');
}

export function bundle(entry, { root, defines = {} } = {}) {
  root = root || path.dirname(entry);
  const mods = new Map(); // file -> {id, deps, code}
  const order = [];
  const visiting = new Set();

  function load(file) {
    if (mods.has(file)) return;
    if (visiting.has(file)) throw new Error('循環import: ' + file);
    visiting.add(file);
    let src = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    const deps = [];
    const header = [];
    src = src.replace(IMPORT_RE, (m, def, names, spec) => {
      const depFile = path.resolve(path.dirname(file), spec);
      if (!fs.existsSync(depFile)) throw new Error(`import先がない: ${spec} (${file})`);
      deps.push(depFile);
      const parts = (names || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(s => {
        const mm = s.match(/^([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)(?:\s+as\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*))?$/);
        if (!mm) throw new Error(`importの書き方が対応外: "${s}" (${file})`);
        return mm[2] ? `${mm[1]}: ${mm[2]}` : mm[1];
      });
      if (def) parts.unshift(`default: ${def}`);
      header.push({ dep: depFile, parts });
      return '';
    });
    if (/^\s*import\s/m.test(src)) throw new Error('対応外のimport: ' + file);
    const exported = [];
    if (EXPORT_DEFAULT_RE.test(src)) { src = src.replace(EXPORT_DEFAULT_RE, 'const __default = '); exported.push('default: __default'); }
    // export const A = 1, B = 2; のように1つの文で複数の名前を出すときも、全部の名前を拾う
    src = src.replace(EXPORT_DECL_RE, (m, kind, name, off, whole) => {
      exported.push(name);
      if (/^(const|let|var)$/.test(kind)) for (const n of extraDeclNames(whole, off + m.length)) exported.push(n);
      return `${kind} ${name}`;
    });
    src = src.replace(EXPORT_LIST_RE, (m, list) => {
      for (const s of list.split(',').map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean)) {
        const mm = s.match(/^([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)(?:\s+as\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*))?$/);
        if (!mm) throw new Error(`exportの書き方が対応外: "${s}" (${file})`);
        exported.push(mm[2] ? `${mm[2]}: ${mm[1]}` : mm[1]);
      }
      return '';
    });
    if (/^export\s/m.test(src)) throw new Error('対応外のexport: ' + file);
    for (const d of deps) load(d);
    visiting.delete(file);
    const id = modId(file, root);
    const head = header.map(h => `const { ${h.parts.join(', ')} } = ${modId(h.dep, root)};`).join('\n');
    const code = `const ${id} = (() => {\n${head}\n${src}\nreturn { ${exported.join(', ')} };\n})();`;
    mods.set(file, { id, deps, code });
    order.push(file);
  }
  load(path.resolve(entry));
  const defs = Object.entries(defines).map(([k, v]) => `const ${k} = ${JSON.stringify(v)};`).join('\n');
  return `'use strict';\n${defs}\n` + order.map(f => `// ---- ${path.relative(root, f)}\n` + mods.get(f).code).join('\n');
}

export function listModules(entry, root) {
  const out = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  (function walk(file) {
    if (seen.has(file)) return; seen.add(file);
    const src = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    for (const m of src.matchAll(IMPORT_RE)) walk(path.resolve(path.dirname(file), m[3]));
    out.push(path.relative(root, file));
  })(path.resolve(entry));
  return out;
}
