// マップの点検: node tools/mapcheck.mjs [mapId ...]
//  - 世界の組み立ての誤り（部屋の名前・階段）
//  - 家具が壁・扉・窓にめり込んでいないか、扉の前をふさいでいないか、家具どうしが重なっていないか
//  - 出現位置（SWAT・容疑者・市民・人質・爆弾・PvP・TDM・目標地点）が歩ける床にあるか、家具の中でないか
//  - SWATの出現位置から、すべての出現位置と部屋へ歩いて行けるか（扉は通れるものとする）
import { compileMap, C, CS, nearestFloor } from '../src/engine/world.js';
import { MAPS } from '../src/engine/maps/index.js';
import { buildNav } from '../src/engine/ai/nav.js';

export function checkMap(id) {
  const def = MAPS[id];
  const w = compileMap(def);
  const nav = buildNav(w);
  const out = { id, errors: [...w.errors], warn: [] };
  const T = (L, i, j) => (L < 0 || L >= w.NL || i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) ? C.VOID : w.cell[w.idx(L, i, j)];
  const wallish = (t) => t === C.WALL || t === C.DOOR || t === C.WINDOW || t === C.GLASSWALL || t === C.LOW || t === C.FENCE;
  // 1) 家具
  const solid = w.props.filter(p => p.solid);
  for (const p of w.props) {
    const i0 = Math.floor((p.x - p.w / 2 + 0.03) / CS), i1 = Math.floor((p.x + p.w / 2 - 0.03) / CS);
    const j0 = Math.floor((p.z - p.d / 2 + 0.03) / CS), j1 = Math.floor((p.z + p.d / 2 - 0.03) / CS);
    let bad = null;
    for (let j = j0; j <= j1 && !bad; j++) for (let i = i0; i <= i1 && !bad; i++) {
      const t = T(p.L, i, j);
      if (t === C.VOID) bad = `外にはみ出し (${i},${j})`;
      else if (t === C.STAIR) bad = `階段の上 (${i},${j})`;
      else if (wallish(t) || t === C.OPEN) {
        // 壁の板はマスの中央に thick の幅。家具の箱が板に触れていなければよい
        const th = (w.thick[w.idx(p.L, i, j)] || 0.12) / 2, cx = (i + 0.5) * CS, cz = (j + 0.5) * CS;
        const arms = w.arms[w.idx(p.L, i, j)];
        // 板の範囲（腕のある向きはマスの端まで）
        const bx0 = (arms & 2) ? i * CS : cx - th, bx1 = (arms & 1) ? (i + 1) * CS : cx + th;
        const bz0 = (arms & 8) ? j * CS : cz - th, bz1 = (arms & 4) ? (j + 1) * CS : cz + th;
        const px0 = p.x - p.w / 2, px1 = p.x + p.w / 2, pz0 = p.z - p.d / 2, pz1 = p.z + p.d / 2;
        const ov = Math.min(px1, bx1) - Math.max(px0, bx0) > 0.02 && Math.min(pz1, bz1) - Math.max(pz0, bz0) > 0.02;
        if (ov) bad = `${t === C.DOOR ? '扉' : t === C.WINDOW ? '窓' : t === C.OPEN ? '開口' : '壁'}にめり込み (${i},${j})`;
      }
    }
    if (bad) out.errors.push(`家具 ${p.type}#${p.id} (${(p.x / CS).toFixed(1)},${(p.z / CS).toFixed(1)},${p.L}): ${bad}`);
    // 扉の前（両側1マス）をふさぐ
    if (p.solid && p.h > 0.3) {
      for (const d of w.doors) {
        if (d.L !== p.L) continue;
        // 扉の開口の両側 0.9m の範囲
        const ax = d.axis === 0;
        const x0 = ax ? d.a0 : d.c - 0.9, x1 = ax ? d.a1 : d.c + 0.9, z0 = ax ? d.c - 0.9 : d.a0, z1 = ax ? d.c + 0.9 : d.a1;
        const ox = Math.min(x1, p.x + p.w / 2) - Math.max(x0, p.x - p.w / 2), oz = Math.min(z1, p.z + p.d / 2) - Math.max(z0, p.z - p.d / 2);
        if (ox > 0.15 && oz > 0.15) out.warn.push(`家具 ${p.type}#${p.id} (${(p.x / CS).toFixed(1)},${(p.z / CS).toFixed(1)},${p.L}) が扉#${d.id} の前をふさぐ`);
      }
    }
  }
  for (let a = 0; a < solid.length; a++) for (let b = a + 1; b < solid.length; b++) {
    const p = solid[a], q = solid[b];
    if (p.L !== q.L) continue;
    const ox = Math.min(p.x + p.w / 2, q.x + q.w / 2) - Math.max(p.x - p.w / 2, q.x - q.w / 2);
    const oz = Math.min(p.z + p.d / 2, q.z + q.d / 2) - Math.max(p.z - p.d / 2, q.z - q.d / 2);
    if (ox > 0.06 && oz > 0.06) out.warn.push(`家具の重なり ${p.type}#${p.id} と ${q.type}#${q.id} (${(p.x / CS).toFixed(1)},${(p.z / CS).toFixed(1)},${p.L})`);
  }
  // 2) 歩けるつながり（4方向。扉・開口・階段は通れる）
  const N = w.NL * w.W * w.D, seen = new Uint8Array(N);
  const walkK = (k) => nav.walk[k] > 0;
  const cellK = (x, z, L) => { const i = Math.floor(x), j = Math.floor(z); if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= w.W || j >= w.D) return -1; return w.idx(L, i, j); };
  const sp = def.spawn || {};
  const starts = (sp.swat || []).map(e => cellK(e.x, e.z, e.L || 0)).filter(k => k >= 0);
  if (!starts.length) out.errors.push('SWATの出現位置がない');
  const q = [];
  for (const k of starts) if (walkK(k) && !seen[k]) { seen[k] = 1; q.push(k); }
  const WD = w.W * w.D;
  while (q.length) {
    const k = q.pop(); const L = Math.floor(k / WD), r = k % WD, j = Math.floor(r / w.W), i = r % w.W;
    for (const [di, dj] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) {
      const ni = i + di, nj = j + dj; if (ni < 0 || nj < 0 || ni >= w.W || nj >= w.D) continue;
      const k2 = w.idx(L, ni, nj); if (seen[k2] || !walkK(k2)) continue; seen[k2] = 1; q.push(k2);
    }
    const ln = nav.links.get(k); if (ln) for (const k2 of ln) if (!seen[k2]) { seen[k2] = 1; q.push(k2); }
  }
  // 出現位置の点検: 実際に置かれる位置（家具をよけた最寄りの床）で調べる
  const chk = (label, x, z, L, opt = {}) => {
    const k = cellK(x, z, L);
    if (k < 0) { out.errors.push(`${label} (${x},${z},${L}) がマップの外`); return; }
    const t = w.cell[k];
    if (!(t === C.FLOOR || t === C.OUT || t === C.STAIR)) { out.errors.push(`${label} (${x},${z},${L}) が床ではない`); return; }
    const p = nearestFloor(w, L, x * CS, z * CS, 4);
    if (!p) { out.errors.push(`${label} (${x},${z},${L}) の近くに空いた床がない`); return; }
    const k2 = cellK(p[0] / CS, p[1] / CS, L), d = Math.hypot(p[0] - x * CS, p[1] - z * CS);
    if (w.roomAt[k2] !== w.roomAt[k]) out.errors.push(`${label} (${x},${z},${L}) が別の部屋へずれる（家具でふさがっている）`);
    else if (d > 1.2 && !opt.onProp) out.warn.push(`${label} (${x},${z},${L}) が家具をよけて ${d.toFixed(1)}m ずれる`);
    if (!seen[k2]) out.errors.push(`${label} (${x},${z},${L}) へSWATの出現位置から行けない`);
  };
  for (const e of sp.swat || []) chk('SWAT出現 ' + e.name, e.x, e.z, e.L || 0);
  for (const key of ['sus', 'civ', 'hostage', 'bomb', 'tdm']) for (const e of sp[key] || []) chk(key, e[0], e[1], e[2] || 0);
  for (const e of sp.evidence || []) chk('evidence', e[0], e[1], e[2] || 0, { onProp: true });
  if (sp.pvp) for (const s of ['a', 'b']) for (const e of sp.pvp[s] || []) chk('pvp.' + s, e[0], e[1], e[2] || 0);
  for (const e of sp.sites || []) chk('目標地点 ' + e.name, e.x, e.z, e.L || 0);
  // 3) 部屋: 行けない部屋（屋外でない、4マス以上）
  for (const r of w.rooms) {
    if (r.out || r.cells.length < 4) continue;
    const ok = r.cells.some(k => seen[k]);
    if (!ok) out.warn.push(`部屋 ${r.name} (${r.L},${r.x0}-${r.x1},${r.z0}-${r.z1}) へ歩いて行けない`);
    if (/^部屋\d/.test(r.name) && r.cells.length >= 12) out.warn.push(`名前のない部屋 ${r.name} (${r.L},${r.x0}-${r.x1},${r.z0}-${r.z1}, ${r.cells.length}マス)`);
  }
  // 4) 明かり: 屋内の床の上か
  for (const lt of def.lights || []) {
    const [x, z, L = 0] = lt; const k = cellK(x, z, L);
    if (k < 0 || !(w.cell[k] === C.FLOOR || w.cell[k] === C.OUT || w.cell[k] === C.STAIR)) out.warn.push(`明かり (${x},${z},${L}) が床の上でない`);
  }
  // 5) 扉のオプションのキーが実在の扉か
  for (const key of Object.keys(def.doors || {})) {
    const [i, j, L] = key.split(',').map(Number);
    if (!w.doors.some(d => d.L === L && d.cells && d.cells.includes(w.idx(L, i, j))) && !w.doors.some(d => d.L === L && d.i0 === i && d.j0 === j)) out.warn.push(`扉の設定 ${key} に扉がない`);
  }
  out.stats = { W: w.W, D: w.D, NL: w.NL, rooms: w.rooms.filter(r => !r.out).length, doors: w.doors.length, props: w.props.length, reach: Math.round(100 * [...seen].filter(Boolean).length / Math.max(1, [...nav.walk].filter(Boolean).length)) };
  return out;
}

if (process.argv[1] && process.argv[1].endsWith('mapcheck.mjs')) {

    for (const e of r.warn) console.log('  △ ' + e);
    bad += r.errors.length;
  }
  process.exit(bad ? 1 : 0);
}

// マップの見取り図をPNGに: node tools/mapimg.mjs <mapId> [出力.png] [拡大]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import { compileMap, C, CS, LH } from '../src/engine/world.js';
import { MAPS } from '../src/engine/maps/index.js';
import { M } from '../src/engine/data/materials.js';

function png(w, h, rgb) {
  const crcT = new Int32Array(256); for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) { let c = n; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1; crcT[n] = c; }
  const crc = (b) => { let c = -1; for (const x of b) c = crcT[(c ^ x) & 255] ^ (c >>> 8); return (c ^ -1) >>> 0; };
  const chunk = (t, d) => { const len = Buffer.alloc(4); len.writeUInt32BE(d.length); const td = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(t), d]); const cr = Buffer.alloc(4); cr.writeUInt32BE(crc(td)); return Buffer.concat([len, td, cr]); };
  const raw = Buffer.alloc((w * 3 + 1) * h);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) { raw[y * (w * 3 + 1)] = 0; rgb.copy(raw, y * (w * 3 + 1) + 1, y * w * 3, (y + 1) * w * 3); }
  const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13); ihdr.writeUInt32BE(w, 0); ihdr.writeUInt32BE(h, 4); ihdr[8] = 8; ihdr[9] = 2;
  return Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]), chunk('IHDR', ihdr), chunk('IDAT', zlib.deflateSync(raw)), chunk('IEND', Buffer.alloc(0))]);
}

export function mapImage(id, s = 6) {
  const def = MAPS[id];
  const w = compileMap(def);
  const W = w.W * s, H = (w.D * s + 8) * w.NL;
  const buf = Buffer.alloc(W * H * 3, 20);
  const put = (x, y, c) => { if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= W || y >= H) return; const o = (y * W + x) * 3; buf[o] = c[0]; buf[o + 1] = c[1]; buf[o + 2] = c[2]; };
  const rect = (x0, y0, x1, y1, c) => { for (let y = Math.floor(y0); y < Math.ceil(y1); y++) for (let x = Math.floor(x0); x < Math.ceil(x1); x++) put(x, y, c); };
  const FC = { 1: [150, 150, 150], 2: [215, 215, 210], 3: [175, 135, 95], 4: [140, 110, 120], 5: [70, 70, 75], 6: [100, 150, 70], 7: [150, 125, 95], 8: [160, 165, 175] };
  for (let L = 0; L < w.NL; L++) {
    const oy = L * (w.D * s + 8);
    for (let j = 0; j < w.D; j++) for (let i = 0; i < w.W; i++) {
      const k = w.idx(L, i, j), t = w.cell[k];
      let c = null;
      if (t === C.FLOOR || t === C.OUT) c = FC[w.floorMat[k]] || [120, 120, 120];
      else if (t === C.STAIR) c = [200, 180, 60];
      else if (t === C.DOOR) c = w.wallMat[k] === M.DOORMETAL ? [90, 110, 140] : [160, 90, 40];
      else if (t === C.WINDOW || t === C.GLASSWALL) c = [80, 170, 230];
      else if (t === C.OPEN) c = [200, 200, 120];
      else if (t === C.LOW) c = [110, 110, 90];
      else if (t === C.FENCE) c = [140, 160, 160];
      else if (t === C.WALL) c = w.wallMat[k] === M.BRICK ? [120, 40, 30] : w.wallMat[k] === M.CONCRETE ? [60, 60, 60] : w.wallMat[k] === M.WOOD ? [120, 90, 50] : [35, 35, 35];
      if (!c) continue;
      if (t === C.WALL || t === C.DOOR || t === C.WINDOW || t === C.GLASSWALL || t === C.LOW || t === C.FENCE || t === C.OPEN) {
        // 床を下に
        rect(i * s, oy + j * s, (i + 1) * s, oy + (j + 1) * s, [90, 90, 90]);
        for (let n = 0; n < w.nbox[k]; n++) { const o = k * 8 + n * 4; rect(w.boxes[o] / CS * s, oy + w.boxes[o + 1] / CS * s, w.boxes[o + 2] / CS * s, oy + w.boxes[o + 3] / CS * s, c); }
        if (!w.nbox[k]) rect(i * s, oy + j * s, (i + 1) * s, oy + (j + 1) * s, c);
      } else rect(i * s, oy + j * s, (i + 1) * s, oy + (j + 1) * s, c);
    }
    for (const p of w.props) {
      if (p.L !== L) continue;
      rect((p.x - p.w / 2) / CS * s, oy + (p.z - p.d / 2) / CS * s, (p.x + p.w / 2) / CS * s, oy + (p.z + p.d / 2) / CS * s, p.solid ? [235, 200, 120] : [200, 200, 160]);
    }
    const dot = (x, z, c, r = 3) => rect(x * s - r, oy + z * s - r, x * s + r, oy + z * s + r, c);
    const sp = def.spawn || {};
    for (const e of sp.swat || []) if ((e.L || 0) === L) dot(e.x, e.z, [40, 120, 255], 5);
    for (const e of sp.sus || []) if ((e[2] || 0) === L) dot(e[0], e[1], [255, 40, 40]);
    for (const e of sp.civ || []) if ((e[2] || 0) === L) dot(e[0], e[1], [40, 230, 80]);
    for (const e of sp.hostage || []) if ((e[2] || 0) === L) dot(e[0], e[1], [255, 255, 0]);
    for (const e of sp.bomb || []) if ((e[2] || 0) === L) dot(e[0], e[1], [255, 140, 0]);
    for (const e of sp.evidence || []) if ((e[2] || 0) === L) dot(e[0], e[1], [200, 60, 255], 2);
    if (sp.pvp) { for (const e of sp.pvp.a || []) if ((e[2] || 0) === L) dot(e[0], e[1], [0, 255, 255], 2); for (const e of sp.pvp.b || []) if ((e[2] || 0) === L) dot(e[0], e[1], [255, 0, 255], 2); }
    for (const e of sp.sites || []) if ((e.L || 0) === L) { const r = (e.r || 3.2) / CS * s; rect(e.x * s - r, oy + e.z * s - 1, e.x * s + r, oy + e.z * s + 1, [255, 255, 255]); rect(e.x * s - 1, oy + e.z * s - r, e.x * s + 1, oy + e.z * s + r, [255, 255, 255]); }
    for (const lt of def.lights || []) if ((lt[2] || 0) === L) dot(lt[0], lt[1], [255, 250, 200], 1);
  }
  return { png: png(W, H, buf), w, errors: w.errors };
}

if (process.argv[1] && process.argv[1].endsWith('mapimg.mjs')) {

# HARD ENTRY のアイコン: 暗い地に、扉の枠と、開いた扉から差す青い光、下に HARD / ENTRY
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import sys
OUT = sys.argv[1]
BLACK = '/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-Black.otf'
def make(S, maskable=False):
    im = Image.new('RGB', (S, S), (7, 9, 12))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    # 縦のグラデーション
    for y in range(S):
        t = y / S
        c = (int(9 + 10 * t), int(12 + 13 * t), int(17 + 18 * t))
        d.line([(0, y), (S, y)], fill=c)
    k = 0.78 if maskable else 1.0   # maskable は中央に寄せる
    cx, cy = S / 2, S / 2
    def P(x, y): return (cx + (x - 0.5) * S * k, cy + (y - 0.5) * S * k)
    # 扉の枠（白）と、少し開いた扉（暗い板）、すき間から差す青い光
    glow = Image.new('RGBA', (S, S), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    g = ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
    x0, y0 = P(0.30, 0.13); x1, y1 = P(0.70, 0.62)
    g.polygon([P(0.47, 0.17), P(0.66, 0.17), P(0.86, 0.66), P(0.40, 0.66)], fill=(74, 168, 255, 120))
    glow = glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(S * 0.03))
    im.paste(glow, (0, 0), glow)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    fw = max(2, int(S * 0.028))
    d.rectangle([P(0.30, 0.13), P(0.70, 0.62)], outline=(232, 236, 240), width=fw)
    # すき間の光（明るい青）
    d.polygon([P(0.49, 0.16), P(0.67, 0.16), P(0.67, 0.6), P(0.49, 0.6)], fill=(110, 190, 255))
    # 扉の板（内側へ開いて斜めに見える）
    d.polygon([P(0.32, 0.155), P(0.49, 0.19), P(0.49, 0.575), P(0.32, 0.6)], fill=(28, 34, 44), outline=(60, 70, 84))
    d.ellipse([P(0.445, 0.38), P(0.47, 0.405)], fill=(200, 205, 210))
    # 床の線
    d.line([P(0.18, 0.62), P(0.82, 0.62)], fill=(232, 236, 240), width=fw)
    # 文字
    f1 = ImageFont.truetype(BLACK, int(S * 0.165 * k))
    for txt, yy, col in (('HARD', 0.665, (240, 242, 245)), ('ENTRY', 0.80, (74, 168, 255))):
        w = d.textlength(txt, font=f1)
        px, py = P(0.5, yy)
        d.text((px - w / 2, py), txt, font=f1, fill=col)
    return im
for s in (180, 192, 512):
    make(s).save(f'{OUT}/icon-{s}.png', optimize=True)
make(512, True).save(f'{OUT}/icon-512-maskable.png', optimize=True)

// テスト用の小さな MQTT ブローカー（WebSocketの上・QoS 0・自作）。
// 実際の公開サーバーの代わりに、ここで通信対戦の試験をする。遅延と取りこぼしも足せる。
//   node tools/mqttbroker.mjs --port 18830 [--delay 60] [--jitter 30] [--loss 0.05]
//   import { startBroker } from './mqttbroker.mjs'; const b = await startBroker({ port: 0 }); b.url; b.close();
import http from 'node:http';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { MqttReader, parsePublish, mqttPublish } from '../src/net/mqtt.js';

function wsAccept(key) { return crypto.createHash('sha1').update(key + '258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11').digest('base64'); }

// WebSocketの枠を読む（クライアントからは必ずマスクつき）
class WsReader {
  constructor() { this.buf = Buffer.alloc(0); this.frag = []; }
  push(chunk) {
    this.buf = Buffer.concat([this.buf, chunk]);
    const out = [];
    for (;;) {
      if (this.buf.length < 2) break;
      const b0 = this.buf[0], b1 = this.buf[1];
      let len = b1 & 127, off = 2;
      if (len === 126) { if (this.buf.length < 4) break; len = this.buf.readUInt16BE(2); off = 4; }
      else if (len === 127) { if (this.buf.length < 10) break; len = Number(this.buf.readBigUInt64BE(2)); off = 10; }
      const masked = !!(b1 & 128);
      const need = off + (masked ? 4 : 0) + len;
      if (this.buf.length < need) break;
      let data = this.buf.subarray(off + (masked ? 4 : 0), need);
      if (masked) { const mk = this.buf.subarray(off, off + 4); data = Buffer.from(data); for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= mk[i & 3]; }
      this.buf = this.buf.subarray(need);
      const op = b0 & 15, fin = !!(b0 & 128);
      if (op === 0 || op === 1 || op === 2) {
        this.frag.push(data);
        if (fin) { out.push({ op: op || 2, data: Buffer.concat(this.frag) }); this.frag = []; }
      } else out.push({ op, data });
    }
    return out;
  }
}
function wsFrame(op, data) {
  const len = data.length;
  let head;
  if (len < 126) head = Buffer.from([0x80 | op, len]);
  else if (len < 65536) { head = Buffer.alloc(4); head[0] = 0x80 | op; head[1] = 126; head.writeUInt16BE(len, 2); }
  else { head = Buffer.alloc(10); head[0] = 0x80 | op; head[1] = 127; head.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(len), 2); }
  return Buffer.concat([head, data]);
}

function match(filter, topic) {
  const f = filter.split('/'), t = topic.split('/');
  for (let i = 0; i < f.length; i++) {
    if (f[i] === '#') return true;
    if (i >= t.length) return false;
    if (f[i] !== '+' && f[i] !== t[i]) return false;
  }
  return f.length === t.length;
}

export function startBroker({ port = 0, delay = 0, jitter = 0, loss = 0, log = false } = {}) {
  const clients = new Set();
  const stats = { published: 0, delivered: 0, dropped: 0, conns: 0 };
  const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'text/plain' }); res.end('mqtt test broker'); });
  server.on('upgrade', (req, sock) => {
    const key = req.headers['sec-websocket-key'];
    if (!key) { sock.destroy(); return; }
    const proto = (req.headers['sec-websocket-protocol'] || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).includes('mqtt') ? 'Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: mqtt\r\n' : '';
    sock.write(`HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Accept: ${wsAccept(key)}\r\n${proto}\r\n`);
    sock.setNoDelay(true);
    const c = { sock, subs: [], id: null, ws: new WsReader(), mq: new MqttReader(), alive: true };
    clients.add(c); stats.conns++;
    const send = (bytes) => { if (!c.alive) return; try { sock.write(wsFrame(2, Buffer.from(bytes))); } catch (e) { /* なし */ } };
    c.send = send;
    const drop = () => { c.alive = false; clients.delete(c); try { sock.destroy(); } catch (e) { /* なし */ } };
    c.drop = drop;
    sock.on('data', (chunk) => {
      let frames;
      try { frames = c.ws.push(chunk); } catch (e) { drop(); return; }
      for (const fr of frames) {
        if (fr.op === 8) { drop(); return; }
        if (fr.op === 9) { try { sock.write(wsFrame(10, fr.data)); } catch (e) { /* なし */ } continue; }
        if (fr.op !== 2 && fr.op !== 1) continue;
        let pks;
        try { pks = c.mq.push(new Uint8Array(fr.data)); } catch (e) { drop(); return; }
        for (const pk of pks) {
          if (pk.type === 1) { send(Uint8Array.from([0x20, 2, 0, 0])); }
          else if (pk.type === 8) {
            const b = pk.body; const pid = (b[0] << 8) | b[1];
            let off = 2; const codes = [];
            while (off < b.length) { const l = (b[off] << 8) | b[off + 1]; c.subs.push(Buffer.from(b.subarray(off + 2, off + 2 + l)).toString('utf8')); off += 2 + l + 1; codes.push(0); }
            send(Uint8Array.from([0x90, 2 + codes.length, pid >> 8, pid & 255, ...codes]));
          } else if (pk.type === 3) {
            const { topic, payload } = parsePublish(pk);
            stats.published++;
            const bytes = mqttPublish(topic, payload);
            for (const o of clients) {
              if (!o.subs.some(f => match(f, topic))) continue;
              if (loss > 0 && Math.random() < loss) { stats.dropped++; continue; }
              const d = delay + (jitter ? Math.random() * jitter : 0);
              stats.delivered++;
              if (d > 0) setTimeout(() => o.send(bytes), d); else o.send(bytes);
            }
            if (log) console.log('pub', topic, payload.length);
          } else if (pk.type === 12) send(Uint8Array.from([0xd0, 0]));
          else if (pk.type === 14) { drop(); return; }
        }
      }
    });
    sock.on('close', () => { c.alive = false; clients.delete(c); });
    sock.on('error', () => { c.alive = false; clients.delete(c); });
  });
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    server.listen(port, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const p = server.address().port;
      resolve({
        port: p, url: `ws://127.0.0.1:${p}/mqtt`, stats, clients,
        set(o) { if ('delay' in o) delay = o.delay; if ('jitter' in o) jitter = o.jitter; if ('loss' in o) loss = o.loss; },
        // 全員の接続を切る（再接続の試験）
        kick() { for (const c of [...clients]) c.drop(); },
        close() { for (const c of [...clients]) c.drop(); return new Promise(r => server.close(() => r())); },
      });
    });
  });
}

if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const a = Object.fromEntries(process.argv.slice(2).reduce((acc, v, i, arr) => { if (v.startsWith('--')) acc.push([v.slice(2), arr[i + 1]]); return acc; }, []));
  const b = await startBroker({ port: +(a.port || 18830), delay: +(a.delay || 0), jitter: +(a.jitter || 0), loss: +(a.loss || 0), log: !!a.log });
  console.log('MQTT test broker:', b.url);
}

@@@@ FILE tools/music.py text 14042
# BGMを作る（外部の音素材は使わない）: python3 -I tools/music.py
#  menu … 署（タイトル・メニュー）: ノワールのベースと、もやの中のブレイクビーツ（88BPM・16小節）
#  op   … 作戦中: 低い持続音と工業的な質感、遠い金属音、心音のような脈（64秒）
#  pvp  … 対戦: 刻む低いシンセと緊張の弦（96BPM・16小節）
# Ready Or Not の音楽の評（ノワールの環境音楽・インダストリアル・ブレイクビーツ・明滅するシンセ、緊張と解放）を手がかりに、自前で合成。
# 前後に0.25秒の「のりしろ」を付けて書き出す（AACの頭の無音でループが切れないように）。
import json, os, subprocess
import numpy as np
from scipy import signal
from scipy.io import wavfile

SR = 32000
PAD = 0.25
ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..')
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'assets', 'music')
TMP = os.path.join(ROOT, 'build_tmp', 'music')
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True); os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)
rng = np.random.default_rng(2026)

def t_axis(L): return np.arange(int(round(L * SR))) / SR
def lp(x, fc, order=2): b, a = signal.butter(order, min(fc, SR * 0.45) / (SR / 2), 'low'); return signal.lfilter(b, a, x)
def hp(x, fc, order=2): b, a = signal.butter(order, fc / (SR / 2), 'high'); return signal.lfilter(b, a, x)
def bp(x, f0, f1, order=2): b, a = signal.butter(order, [f0 / (SR / 2), min(f1, SR * 0.45) / (SR / 2)], 'band'); return signal.lfilter(b, a, x)
def qf(f, L): return max(1, round(f * L)) / L
def circf(x, f):
    n = x.shape[-1]; y = f(np.concatenate([x, x, x], axis=-1)); return y[..., n:2 * n]
def saw(freq, t, phase=0.0):
    out = np.zeros_like(t); f = np.broadcast_to(np.atleast_1d(freq), t.shape)
    n = min(40, max(1, int((SR * 0.45) / float(np.max(f)))))
    ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR + phase
    for k in range(1, n + 1): out += np.sin(k * ph) / k * (-1) ** (k + 1)
    return out * (2 / np.pi)
def env_ar(n, a, d, curve=3.0):
    i = np.arange(n) / SR
    return np.where(i < a, i / max(a, 1e-4), np.exp(-(i - a) / max(d, 1e-4) * curve))
def add_circ(dst, src, at):
    n = len(dst); i0 = int(round(at * SR)) % n; k = 0
    while k < len(src):
        m = min(len(src) - k, n - i0); dst[i0:i0 + m] += src[k:k + m]; k += m; i0 = 0
def ir(sec, damp=4.0, seed=0):
    r = np.random.default_rng(seed); n = int(sec * SR); t = np.arange(n) / SR; out = []
    for ch in range(2):
        x = r.standard_normal(n) * np.exp(-t / sec * damp); x = lp(x, 5200 - 800 * ch)
        for k in range(6):
            d = int(r.uniform(0.008, 0.06) * SR)
            if d < n: x[d] += r.uniform(0.2, 0.5) * (1 if r.random() < 0.5 else -1)
        x[:int(0.004 * SR)] = 0; out.append(x / np.sqrt(np.sum(x ** 2)))
    return out
def reverb_circ(x, sec, wet, seed=0):
    L = len(x); h = ir(sec, seed=seed); outs = []
    for c in range(2):
        hh = h[c][:L] if len(h[c]) > L else np.pad(h[c], (0, L - len(h[c])))
        outs.append(np.real(np.fft.ifft(np.fft.fft(x) * np.fft.fft(hh))))
    return np.stack(outs) * wet
def pan(x, p): a = (p + 1) * np.pi / 4; return np.stack([x * np.cos(a), x * np.sin(a)])
def soft(x, drive=1.0): return np.tanh(x * drive) / np.tanh(drive)
def midi(m): return 440 * 2 ** ((m - 69) / 12)

def write(name, st, L, br='56k'):
    n = st.shape[1]; p = int(PAD * SR)
    full = np.concatenate([st[:, n - p:], st, st[:, :p]], axis=1)
    peak = float(np.max(np.abs(full)))
    wav = os.path.join(TMP, name + '.wav')
    wavfile.write(wav, SR, (np.clip(full, -1, 1).T * 32767).astype(np.int16))
    m4a = os.path.join(OUT, name + '.m4a')
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-y', '-i', wav, '-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', br, '-ar', str(SR), m4a], check=True)
    rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(st ** 2)))
    # 検査: 無音・異常値・ループのつなぎ目の跳び
    seam = float(np.max(np.abs(st[:, 0] - st[:, -1])))
    silent = float(np.mean(np.abs(st).max(0) < 1e-4))
    print(f'{name}: {L:.2f}s peak {peak:.2f} rms {20*np.log10(rms+1e-9):.1f}dBFS seam {seam:.3f} silent {silent:.3f} nan {int(np.isnan(st).sum())} size {os.path.getsize(m4a)//1024}KB')
    return {'pad': PAD, 'len': round(n / SR, 6)}

# ---- 打楽器
def kick(dec=0.28, tone=48):
    m = int(0.5 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
    f = tone + 110 * np.exp(-tt / 0.028)
    k = np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR) * np.exp(-tt / dec)
    k += bp(rng.standard_normal(m), 1200, 5000) * np.exp(-tt / 0.005) * 0.35
    return soft(k * 1.6, 1.8)
def snare(dec=0.16, bright=1.0):
    m = int(0.6 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
    body = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 190 * tt) * np.exp(-tt / 0.05) * 0.6
    nz = bp(rng.standard_normal(m), 1400, 7000 * bright) * np.exp(-tt / dec)
    return soft((body + nz) * 1.2, 1.4)
def hat(dec=0.02, g=1.0):
    m = int(0.12 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
    return hp(rng.standard_normal(m), 7000) * np.exp(-tt / dec) * g
def metal_hit(f0, dur=4.0):
    m = int(dur * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR; hit = np.zeros(m)
    for k, (r_, dk) in enumerate([(1, 2.2), (1.47, 1.7), (2.09, 1.3), (2.56, 1.0), (3.71, 0.7), (4.95, 0.5)]):
        fr = f0 * r_ * (1 - 0.008 * tt)
        hit += np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(fr) / SR + rng.uniform(0, 6)) * np.exp(-tt / dk) / (k + 1)
    return lp(hit, 2200) * env_ar(m, 0.003, dur * 0.6, 1.0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 署（メニュー）
def make_menu():
    bpm = 88; beat = 60 / bpm; bar = beat * 4; L = bar * 16
    t = t_axis(L); n = len(t); st = np.zeros((2, n)); mono = np.zeros(n)
    # 1 ブレイクビーツ（ブーンバップ寄り、少しはねる）。最初の4小節は控えめ
    for b in range(16):
        g = 0.55 if b < 4 else 1.0
        for q in ([0, 2.5] if b % 2 == 0 else [0, 1.75, 2.5]):
            add_circ(mono, kick() * 0.42 * g, b * bar + q * beat)
        for q in (1, 3):
            sn = snare(); ph = pan(sn * 0.2 * g, 0.05); add_circ(st[0], ph[0], b * bar + q * beat); add_circ(st[1], ph[1], b * bar + q * beat)
        if b % 4 == 3:
            gs = snare(0.06) * 0.06; add_circ(mono, gs, b * bar + 3.75 * beat)
        for e in range(8):
            sw = 0.08 * beat if e % 2 else 0
            ph = pan(hat(0.018 if e % 2 else 0.03, 0.055 if e % 2 == 0 else 0.03) * g, 0.35)
            add_circ(st[0], ph[0], b * bar + e * beat / 2 + sw); add_circ(st[1], ph[1], b * bar + e * beat / 2 + sw)
    # 2 ノワールのベース（Dマイナー）: D F A G | F E C A
    line = [(0, 38, 2), (2, 41, 1.5), (3.5, 45, 0.5), (4, 43, 2), (6, 41, 1), (7, 40, 1), (8, 36, 2), (10, 38, 1), (11, 33, 1), (12, 38, 2), (14, 41, 1.5), (15.5, 40, 0.5)]
    bass = np.zeros(n)
    for rep in range(4):
        for (s, mm, d) in line:
            at = (rep * 16 + s) * beat; m = int(d * beat * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
            f = midi(mm)
            v = (np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * tt) + 0.35 * saw(f, tt)) * env_ar(m, 0.012, d * beat * 0.9, 1.4)
            add_circ(bass, lp(v, 520), at)
    mono += soft(bass * 0.9, 1.3) * 0.32
    # 3 パッド（Dm9 → B♭maj7 → Gm9 → A7♭9 を4小節ずつ）。テープのゆれ
    chords = [[50, 53, 57, 60, 64], [46, 50, 53, 57, 62], [43, 46, 50, 53, 57], [45, 49, 52, 55, 58]]
    pad = np.zeros(n)
    for ci, ch in enumerate(chords):
        at = ci * bar * 4; m = int(bar * 4 * SR) + int(0.5 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
        wow = 1 + 0.0025 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.6 * tt)
        v = np.zeros(m)
        for mm in ch:
            f = midi(mm)
            for det in (-5, 5): v += saw(f * 2 ** (det / 1200) * wow, tt, rng.uniform(0, 6))
        e = np.minimum(1, tt / 1.2) * np.minimum(1, np.maximum(0, (bar * 4 + 0.5 - tt) / 0.8))
        add_circ(pad, lp(v, 900) * e, at)
    mono += pad * 0.014
    # 4 電子ピアノの和音（たまに、明滅する）
    for ci, ch in enumerate(chords):
        for k, off in enumerate([0.5, 2.5, 6.5, 10.5, 14.5]):
            if (ci + k) % 2: continue
            at = (ci * 16 + off) * beat; m = int(1.6 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
            v = np.zeros(m)
            for mm in ch[1:4]:
                f = midi(mm + 12); v += (np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * tt) + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * 3 * tt) * np.exp(-tt / 0.15)) * np.exp(-tt / 0.7)
            trem = 0.75 + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 4.5 * tt)
            ph = pan(v * trem * 0.03, rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5)); add_circ(st[0], ph[0], at); add_circ(st[1], ph[1], at)
    # 5 もや: レコードのかすれと、遠いサイレンのような音（ごく小さく）
    cr = np.zeros(n); idx = rng.integers(0, n, size=int(L * 18)); cr[idx] = rng.uniform(-1, 1, size=len(idx)); cr = circf(cr, lambda v: bp(v, 1200, 6000))
    mono += cr * 0.05
    for at in (bar * 5.3, bar * 13.1):
        m = int(5.0 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
        f = 620 + 160 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.45 * tt)
        si = np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR) * np.sin(np.pi * tt / 5.0) ** 2
        ph = pan(lp(si, 1400) * 0.012, 0.6); add_circ(st[0], ph[0], at); add_circ(st[1], ph[1], at)
    st += np.stack([mono, mono])
    st = st + reverb_circ(st.mean(0), 2.2, 0.22, seed=11)
    st = circf(st, lambda v: hp(v, 28))
    st /= np.max(np.abs(st)) / 0.7
    return write('menu', st, L, '56k')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 作戦中
def make_op():
    L = 64.0; t = t_axis(L); n = len(t); st = np.zeros((2, n)); mono = np.zeros(n)
    # 1 低い持続音（D1とわずかにずれた音）
    lfo = 0.65 + 0.35 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / L * 2)
    mono += (np.sin(2 * np.pi * qf(36.7, L) * t) + 0.8 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * qf(36.7 * 1.006, L) * t + 1) + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * qf(73.4, L) * t)) * lfo * 0.15
    # 2 工業的なざわめき（帯域を絞ったノイズがゆっくり明滅）
    nz = rng.standard_normal(n); hum = circf(nz, lambda v: bp(v, 180, 900))
    mono += hum * 0.03 * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / L * 5 + 1) ** 2)
    # 3 心音のような脈（1.5秒ごと）
    for k in range(int(L / 1.5)):
        for off, g in ((0.0, 1.0), (0.24, 0.55)):
            m = int(0.32 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
            th = np.sin(2 * np.pi * (46 + 26 * np.exp(-tt / 0.04)) * tt) * np.exp(-tt / 0.1)
            add_circ(mono, th * 0.16 * g, k * 1.5 + off)
    # 4 遠い金属音（配管・扉）
    for at, f0, pn in [(4.7, 112, -0.6), (15.9, 93, 0.5), (27.4, 140, -0.2), (39.2, 101, 0.7), (50.8, 128, -0.7), (59.6, 86, 0.3)]:
        ph = pan(metal_hit(f0) * 0.09, pn); add_circ(st[0], ph[0], at); add_circ(st[1], ph[1], at)
    # 5 不安な弦（ゆっくりふくらむ短2度）
    strings = np.zeros(n)
    for f in (146.83, 155.56, 220.0):
        for det in (-6, 6): strings += saw(qf(f * 2 ** (det / 1200), L), t, rng.uniform(0, 6))
    strings = circf(strings, lambda v: bp(v, 200, 1600))
    swell = (0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * t / (L / 2))) ** 2
    mono += strings * swell * 0.012
    # 6 無線の雑音（たまに）
    for at, pn in [(10.5, -0.4), (33.3, 0.5), (55.0, 0.1)]:
        m = int(0.7 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
        r = bp(rng.standard_normal(m), 900, 3200) * (np.sin(np.pi * tt / 0.7) ** 0.5) * (0.6 + 0.4 * np.sign(np.sin(2 * np.pi * 13 * tt)))
        ph = pan(r * 0.02, pn); add_circ(st[0], ph[0], at); add_circ(st[1], ph[1], at)
    # 7 高いハーモニクス（かすか）
    for at, f in [(21.0, 2350), (45.0, 2490)]:
        m = int(5.0 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
        w = np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f * (1 + 0.003 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 5 * tt))) / SR) * np.sin(np.pi * tt / 5.0) ** 2
        add_circ(st[0], w * 0.006, at); add_circ(st[1], w * 0.006, at + 0.011)
    st += np.stack([mono, mono])
    st = st * 0.85 + reverb_circ(st.mean(0), 3.0, 0.4, seed=13)
    st = circf(st, lambda v: hp(v, 24))
    st /= np.max(np.abs(st)) / 0.6
    return write('op', st, L, '48k')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 対戦
def make_pvp():
    bpm = 96; beat = 60 / bpm; bar = beat * 4; L = bar * 16
    t = t_axis(L); n = len(t); st = np.zeros((2, n)); mono = np.zeros(n)
    # 1 刻む低いシンセ（8分、D）
    seq = [38, 38, 38, 41, 38, 38, 36, 38]
    for b in range(16):
        for e in range(8):
            mm = seq[e] + (2 if b % 8 >= 6 else 0)
            m = int(beat / 2 * 0.9 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
            f = midi(mm)
            v = lp(saw(f, tt) + 0.5 * saw(f * 2.003, tt), 380 + 260 * (b % 4) / 3) * env_ar(m, 0.004, beat * 0.4, 2.0)
            add_circ(mono, v * 0.11, b * bar + e * beat / 2)
    # 2 ひかえめな4つ打ち・刻む金物
    for b in range(16):
        for q in range(4): add_circ(mono, kick(0.2, 44) * 0.3, b * bar + q * beat)
        for s16 in range(16):
            ph = pan(hat(0.012 if s16 % 4 else 0.025, 0.035 if s16 % 4 == 2 else 0.02), 0.4 if s16 % 2 else -0.3)
            add_circ(st[0], ph[0], b * bar + s16 * beat / 4); add_circ(st[1], ph[1], b * bar + s16 * beat / 4)
    # 3 4小節ごとに上がる緊張の弦
    for b0 in range(0, 16, 4):
        m = int(bar * 4 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
        f = 220 * 2 ** (tt / (bar * 4) * 0.5)
        v = np.zeros(m)
        for det in (-7, 0, 7): v += saw(f * 2 ** (det / 1200), tt, rng.uniform(0, 6))
        v = bp(v, 300, 3000) * (tt / (bar * 4)) ** 2
        add_circ(mono, v * 0.018, b0 * bar)
    # 4 2小節ごとの低い一撃
    for b in range(0, 16, 2):
        m = int(1.0 * SR); tt = np.arange(m) / SR
        br_ = saw(36.7, tt) + saw(55.0, tt) + 0.5 * saw(73.4, tt)
        add_circ(mono, lp(soft(br_ * 2.2, 2.2), 800) * env_ar(m, 0.01, 0.6, 2.0) * 0.12, b * bar)
    st += np.stack([mono, mono])
    st = st + reverb_circ(st.mean(0), 1.5, 0.2, seed=17)
    st = circf(st, lambda v: hp(v, 30))
    st /= np.max(np.abs(st)) / 0.7
    return write('pvp', st, L, '56k')

meta = {'menu': make_menu(), 'op': make_op(), 'pvp': make_pvp()}
with open(os.path.join(OUT, 'music.json'), 'w') as f: json.dump(meta, f, indent=1)
print(json.dumps(meta))

// テスト用の小さな静的サーバー: node tools/server.mjs [port] [root]
import http from 'node:http';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const MIME = {
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.mjs': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8', '.json': 'application/json', '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg',
  '.webp': 'image/webp', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.woff': 'font/woff', '.ttf': 'font/ttf',
  '.wav': 'audio/wav', '.mp3': 'audio/mpeg', '.m4a': 'audio/mp4', '.bin': 'application/octet-stream',
  '.webmanifest': 'application/manifest+json', '.txt': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
};

export function startServer(root, port = 0) {
  const srv = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const u = new URL(req.url, 'http://x');
      let p = decodeURIComponent(u.pathname);
      if (p.endsWith('/')) p += 'index.html';
      const fp = path.join(root, p);
      if (!fp.startsWith(path.resolve(root))) { res.writeHead(403); res.end(); return; }
      if (!fs.existsSync(fp) || fs.statSync(fp).isDirectory()) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('not found'); return; }
      const ext = path.extname(fp).toLowerCase();
      const headers = { 'Content-Type': MIME[ext] || 'application/octet-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache' };
      const st = fs.statSync(fp);
      const etag = '"' + st.size + '-' + st.mtimeMs + '"';
      headers.ETag = etag;
      if (req.headers['if-none-match'] === etag) { res.writeHead(304, headers); res.end(); return; }
      res.writeHead(200, headers);
      fs.createReadStream(fp).pipe(res);
    } catch (e) { res.writeHead(500); res.end(String(e)); }
  });
  return new Promise(resolve => srv.listen(port, '127.0.0.1', () => resolve({ srv, port: srv.address().port, close: () => new Promise(r => srv.close(r)) })));
}

if (process.argv[1] && process.argv[1].endsWith('server.mjs')) {
  const port = +(process.argv[2] || 8765);
  const root = process.argv[3] || process.cwd();
  startServer(root, port).then(({ port }) => console.log('serving', root, 'on', port));
}

// AIだけの試合をまとめて回す（バランスと、マップをAIが歩けるかの確認）。
//  node tools/sim.mjs pve <map|all> <mission|all> [回数=4] [シード=1] [--diff=normal] [--dt=30] [--max=900] [--log]
//  node tools/sim.mjs pvp <map|all> <tdm|elim|bomb|all> [回数=4] [シード=1] [--size=4v4] [--bot=2] [--swap]
//  --json=出力.json で1試合ずつの結果を書き出す。--md=出力.md で表にする（同じシードで前後を比べられる）
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { createGame, step } from '../src/engine/engine.js';
import { MAPS, PVE_MAPS, PVP_MAPS } from '../src/engine/maps/index.js';
import { MISSIONS } from '../src/engine/data/missions.js';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const flags = Object.fromEntries(args.filter(a => a.startsWith('--')).map(a => { const [k, v] = a.slice(2).split('='); return [k, v ?? true]; }));
const pos = args.filter(a => !a.startsWith('--'));
const kind = pos[0] || 'pve';
const N = +(pos[3] || 4), seed0 = +(pos[4] || 1);
const dt = 1 / +(flags.dt || 30);
const maxT = +(flags.max || (kind === 'pve' ? 900 : 1500));

export function runPve(map, mission, seed, o = {}) {
  const G = createGame({ map, mode: 'pve', mission, diff: o.diff || 'normal', team: o.team || 4, allAI: true, seed, dt: o.dt || dt });
  const S = G.S, w = G.w;
  if (o.log) S.debugLead = [];
  const steps = Math.round((o.max || maxT) / S.dt);
  let lastEv = 0, quietMax = 0, firstContact = -1;
  const t0 = Date.now();
  for (let i = 0; i < steps && S.m.phase === 'play'; i++) {
    const ev = step(G, {});
    for (const e of ev) {
      if (e.e === 'shot' || e.e === 'kill' || e.e === 'cuffed' || e.e === 'comply' || e.e === 'report' || e.e === 'breach' || e.e === 'evidence') {
        const t = S.t * S.dt; quietMax = Math.max(quietMax, t - lastEv); lastEv = t;
        if (firstContact < 0 && (e.e === 'shot' || e.e === 'comply')) firstContact = t;
      }
    }
  }
  const m = S.m, sc = m.score || null;
  const sus = m.sus.map(id => S.byId[id]).filter(Boolean), civ = m.civ.concat(m.hostages).map(id => S.byId[id]).filter(Boolean);
  const swat = S.actors.filter(a => a.kind === 'swat');
  const indoor = w.rooms.filter(r => !r.out && r.cells.length >= 4).length;
  const L = m.lead || {};
  return {
    map, mission, seed, res: m.result || 'timeout', why: m.why || '', grade: sc ? sc.grade : '-', score: sc ? Math.round(sc.total) : 0,
    t: Math.round(S.t * S.dt), wall: Date.now() - t0,
    sus: sus.length, susArrest: sus.filter(a => a.alive && a.cuffed).length, susDead: sus.filter(a => !a.alive).length,
    civ: civ.length, civSafe: civ.filter(a => a.alive && a.cuffed).length, civDead: civ.filter(a => !a.alive).length,
    swatDead: swat.filter(a => !a.alive || a.down).length, rooms: (L.seen || L.visited || []).filter(r => !w.rooms[r].out && w.rooms[r].cells.length >= 4).length, roomsAll: indoor,
    viol: sc ? sc.viol.length : 0, quiet: Math.round(quietMax), contact: Math.round(firstContact), log: o.log ? S.debugLead : undefined,
  };
}

export function runPvp(map, mode, seed, o = {}) {
  const sizes = (o.size || '4v4').split('v').map(Number);
  const G = createGame({ map, mode, teams: sizes, roster: [], rules: { botLevel: +(o.bot || 2), wins: o.wins ?? 3, time: 480, ff: false }, seed, dt: o.dt || dt });
  const S = G.S, m = S.m;
  const steps = Math.round((o.max || maxT) / S.dt);
  const kills = [0, 0], deaths = [0, 0];
  let lastKill = 0, gapMax = 0, gaps = [], rounds = [], roundStart = 0, plants = 0, defuses = 0;
  const t0 = Date.now();
  for (let i = 0; i < steps && !m.over; i++) {
    const ev = step(G, {});
    for (const e of ev) {
      if (e.e === 'kill' || (e.e === 'down' && mode === 'bomb')) {
        const a = S.byId[e.id], b = S.byId[e.by];
        if (a) deaths[a.team]++;
        if (b && a && b.team !== a.team) kills[b.team]++;
        const t = S.t * S.dt; gaps.push(t - lastKill); gapMax = Math.max(gapMax, t - lastKill); lastKill = t;
      }
      if (e.e === 'plant') plants++;
      if (e.e === 'round') { const t = S.t * S.dt; rounds.push({ win: e.win, why: e.why, len: Math.round(t - roundStart), att: m.att, swat: m.swapped ? 1 : 0 }); roundStart = t; lastKill = t; }
      if (e.e === 'defuse' || e.e === 'disabled') defuses++;
      if (e.e === 'phase' && e.p === 'action') roundStart = S.t * S.dt;
    }
  }
  const avgGap = gaps.length ? gaps.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / gaps.length : 0;
  return {
    map, mode, seed, size: o.size || '4v4', winner: m.over ? m.winner : 'timeout', wins: m.wins ? m.wins.slice() : null, score: m.score ? m.score.slice() : null,
    t: Math.round(S.t * S.dt), wall: Date.now() - t0, kills, deaths, rounds, plants, defuses, avgGap: Math.round(avgGap * 10) / 10, gapMax: Math.round(gapMax),
    timeRounds: rounds.filter(r => r.why === 'time').length,
  };
}

function summarize(rows, key) {
  const out = {};
  for (const r of rows) { const k = r[key]; (out[k] = out[k] || []).push(r); }
  return out;
}

if (process.argv[1] && process.argv[1].endsWith('sim.mjs')) {
  const rows = [];
  if (kind === 'pve') {
    const maps = pos[1] === 'all' || !pos[1] ? PVE_MAPS : [pos[1]];
    const missions = pos[2] === 'all' || !pos[2] ? Object.keys(MISSIONS) : [pos[2]];
    for (const map of maps) for (const mission of missions) {
      if (MAPS[map].missions && !MAPS[map].missions[mission]) continue;
      for (let s = 0; s < N; s++) {
        const r = runPve(map, mission, seed0 + s, { diff: flags.diff, log: !!flags.log });
        rows.push(r);
        console.log(`${map} ${mission} #${r.seed}: ${r.res}${r.why ? '(' + r.why + ')' : ''} ${r.grade} ${r.score}点 ${r.t}s 容疑者 ${r.susArrest}逮捕/${r.susDead}死/${r.sus} 市民 ${r.civSafe}/${r.civ}(死${r.civDead}) 隊員倒れ${r.swatDead} 部屋 ${r.rooms}/${r.roomsAll} 違反${r.viol} 静か最長${r.quiet}s [${r.wall}ms]`);
        if (r.log) console.log('   ' + r.log.join(' | '));
      }
    }
    const by = summarize(rows, 'mission');
    console.log('\n任務ごと:');
    for (const [k, rs] of Object.entries(by)) {
      const avg = (f) => (rs.reduce((a, r) => a + f(r), 0) / rs.length);
      console.log(`  ${k}: 完了 ${rs.filter(r => r.res === 'done').length}/${rs.length} 失敗 ${rs.filter(r => r.res === 'fail').length} 平均 ${avg(r => r.score).toFixed(0)}点 ${avg(r => r.t).toFixed(0)}s 隊員倒れ ${avg(r => r.swatDead).toFixed(2)} 部屋 ${(100 * avg(r => r.rooms / Math.max(1, r.roomsAll))).toFixed(0)}%`);
    }
  } else {
    const maps = pos[1] === 'all' || !pos[1] ? PVP_MAPS : [pos[1]];
    const modes = pos[2] === 'all' || !pos[2] ? ['tdm', 'elim', 'bomb'] : [pos[2]];
    for (const map of maps) for (const mode of modes) for (let s = 0; s < N; s++) {
      const r = runPvp(map, mode, seed0 + s, { size: flags.size, bot: flags.bot });
      rows.push(r);
      console.log(`${map} ${mode} #${r.seed} ${r.size}: 勝ち ${r.winner} ${r.wins ? 'R' + r.wins.join('-') : ''} ${r.score ? 'S' + r.score.join('-') : ''} ${r.t}s キル ${r.kills.join('-')} 設置${r.plants} 撃ち合いの間 平均${r.avgGap}s 最長${r.gapMax}s 時間切れR ${r.timeRounds}/${r.rounds.length} [${r.wall}ms]`);
    }
    const by = summarize(rows, 'mode');
    console.log('\nモードごと:');
    for (const [k, rs] of Object.entries(by)) {
      const w0 = rs.filter(r => r.winner === 0).length, w1 = rs.filter(r => r.winner === 1).length;
      const avg = (f) => (rs.reduce((a, r) => a + f(r), 0) / rs.length);
      console.log(`  ${k}: チーム0の勝ち ${w0} / チーム1 ${w1} / 他 ${rs.length - w0 - w1}  平均 ${avg(r => r.t).toFixed(0)}s  キルの間 ${avg(r => r.avgGap).toFixed(1)}s`);
    }
  }
  if (flags.json) fs.writeFileSync(flags.json, JSON.stringify(rows, null, 1));
}

// ソース一式の書き出しと復元
//   復元: node tools/unbundle.mjs source-bundle.txt <出力先>
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const TEXT_EXT = new Set(['.js', '.mjs', '.css', '.html', '.md', '.json', '.py', '.txt']);
const INCLUDE_DIRS = ['src', 'tools', 'tests', 'dev'];
const INCLUDE_FILES = ['DESIGN.md', 'package.json'];
const MARK = '@@@@ FILE ';

function walk(dir, out) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) { if (e.name !== 'node_modules') walk(p, out); } else out.push(p);
  }
}

export function makeSourceBundle(root) {
  const files = [];
  for (const d of INCLUDE_DIRS) walk(path.join(root, d), files);
  for (const f of INCLUDE_FILES) if (fs.existsSync(path.join(root, f))) files.push(path.join(root, f));
  files.sort();
  let text = `HARD ENTRY ソース一式（${new Date().toISOString()}）\n復元: node tools/unbundle.mjs source-bundle.txt <出力先>\n（tools/unbundle.mjs がない場合は、下の "${MARK}" の区切りごとにファイルへ書き出す。base64 と書かれたものはデコードする）\n\n`;
  for (const f of files) {
    const rel = path.relative(root, f).split(path.sep).join('/');
    const ext = path.extname(f).toLowerCase();
    const buf = fs.readFileSync(f);
    if (TEXT_EXT.has(ext)) text += `${MARK}${rel} text ${buf.length}\n${buf.toString('utf8')}\n`;
    else text += `${MARK}${rel} base64 ${buf.length}\n${buf.toString('base64')}\n`;
  }
  return { text, count: files.length };
}

export function restore(text, outDir) {
  const parts = text.split('\n' + MARK);
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) {
    const nl = parts[i].indexOf('\n');
    const [rel, kind, len] = parts[i].slice(0, nl).split(' ');
    const body = parts[i].slice(nl + 1);
    const fp = path.join(outDir, rel);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(fp), { recursive: true });
    // 長さ（バイト数）で切り出すので、末尾の改行も元どおり
    fs.writeFileSync(fp, kind === 'base64' ? Buffer.from(body, 'base64') : Buffer.from(body, 'utf8').subarray(0, +len));
    n++;
  }
  return n;
}

if (process.argv[1] && process.argv[1].endsWith('unbundle.mjs') && process.argv[2]) {
  const n = restore(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'), process.argv[3] || 'restored');
  console.log('復元したファイル:', n);
}

# 声を作る: src/audio/lines.js の台詞 → 話す人ごとに1つの m4a ＋ 目次（src/assets/voices/）。
#   1) node で台詞の表を build_tmp/lines.json に書き出す（tools/voices.sh がやる）
#   2) python3 -I tools/voices.py [Whisperのフォルダ]
# 声のもとは ffmpeg に入っている flite（rms・slt・awb・kal16）。rubberband で高さ・速さを変えて人ごとの声にし、
# 叫ぶ台詞は速く・高く・圧縮して張りを出す。最後に Whisper で聞き取れるか確かめ、まとめて書き出す。
import json, os, subprocess, sys, wave
import numpy as np

ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..')
TMP = os.path.join(ROOT, 'build_tmp', 'voices'); OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'assets', 'voices')
os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True); os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
SR = 24000
data = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'build_tmp', 'lines.json'), encoding='utf8'))
LINES = data['LINES']

# 話す人: もとの声、高さ（半音）、速さ、声の太さ（formant）
SPK = {
    'p':   dict(voice='rms', pitch=0.0, tempo=1.06, who='swat'),
    'o0':  dict(voice='rms', pitch=-2.5, tempo=1.0, who='swat'),
    'o1':  dict(voice='rms', pitch=2.0, tempo=1.03, who='swat'),
    'o2':  dict(voice='slt', pitch=-1.0, tempo=1.04, who='swat'),
    'o3':  dict(voice='awb', pitch=-1.5, tempo=1.0, who='swat'),
    'toc': dict(voice='slt', pitch=-2.5, tempo=0.98, who='toc'),
    's0':  dict(voice='rms', pitch=-4.5, tempo=1.05, who='sus', rough=True),
    's1':  dict(voice='awb', pitch=-3.0, tempo=1.08, who='sus', rough=True),
    's2':  dict(voice='awb', pitch=-5.0, tempo=1.0, who='sus', rough=True),
    'c0':  dict(voice='slt', pitch=1.5, tempo=1.08, who='civ'),
    'c1':  dict(voice='rms', pitch=2.0, tempo=1.1, who='civ'),
    'c2':  dict(voice='slt', pitch=-2.0, tempo=1.0, who='civ'),
}
# 自分（p）が言うのは呼びかけと投げ物・リロードだけ
P_LINES = {'swat_police', 'swat_hands', 'swat_drop', 'swat_ground', 'swat_civ', 'swat_flash', 'swat_stinger', 'swat_gas', 'swat_reload', 'swat_breaching'}
CALM = {'swat_copy', 'swat_locked', 'swat_cuffsus', 'swat_cuffciv', 'swat_mirror_sus', 'swat_mirror_civ', 'swat_mirror_clear', 'sus_fake', 'toc_start', 'toc_copy', 'toc_soft', 'toc_bomb', 'toc_fail'}

def ff(*args):
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-y', *args], check=True)

def load(p):
    w = wave.open(p); x = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768; return x

def save(p, x, sr=SR):
    x = np.clip(np.nan_to_num(x), -1, 1)
    w = wave.open(p, 'wb'); w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(sr); w.writeframes((x * 32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()); w.close()

def trim(x, thr=0.02):
    e = np.convolve(np.abs(x), np.ones(240) / 240, 'same'); m = e.max() or 1
    idx = np.where(e > thr * m)[0]
    if not len(idx): return x
    return x[max(0, idx[0] - 240): min(len(x), idx[-1] + 1200)]

def synth(text, spk, line, path, S=None):
    S = S or SPK[spk]
    tf = path + '.txt'; open(tf, 'w').write(text)
    raw = path + '.raw.wav'
    ff('-f', 'lavfi', '-i', f"flite=textfile='{tf}':voice={S['voice']}", '-ar', str(SR), '-ac', '1', raw)
    shout = line not in CALM and S['who'] != 'toc'
    pitch = S['pitch'] + (1.2 if shout else 0)
    tempo = S['tempo'] * (1.04 if shout else 1.0)
    chain = [f"rubberband=pitch={2 ** (pitch / 12):.5f}:tempo={tempo:.4f}:formant=preserved",
             'highpass=f=110', 'lowpass=f=7600']
    if shout: chain += ['equalizer=f=2600:t=q:w=1.2:g=5', 'equalizer=f=900:t=q:w=1:g=2', 'acompressor=threshold=0.08:ratio=6:attack=3:release=60:makeup=3']
    else: chain += ['equalizer=f=2200:t=q:w=1.2:g=2', 'acompressor=threshold=0.15:ratio=3:attack=5:release=80:makeup=1.5']
    if S.get('rough'): chain += ['asoftclip=type=tanh:threshold=0.6']
    out = path + '.fx.wav'
    ff('-i', raw, '-af', ','.join(chain), '-ar', str(SR), '-ac', '1', out)
    x = trim(load(out))
    x = x / (np.abs(x).max() or 1) * 0.89
    # 端をなめらかに
    a = min(len(x) // 4, 96); b = min(len(x) // 4, 960)
    if a: x[:a] *= np.linspace(0, 1, a)
    if b: x[-b:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, b)
    save(path, x)
    for f in (tf, raw, out):
        try: os.remove(f)
        except OSError: pass
    return x

def words(s):
    import re
    s = s.lower().replace('-', ' ').replace('c.s.', 'cs').replace("door's", 'door is').replace("it's", 'it is').replace("we've", 'we have').replace("i've", 'i have').replace("i'm", 'i am').replace("don't", 'do not').replace("didn't", 'did not').replace("can't", 'cannot').replace("they're", 'they are').replace('flash bang', 'flashbang')
    return [w for w in re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 ]", ' ', s).split() if w]

def score(ref, hyp):
    r, h = words(ref), words(hyp)
    if not r: return 1.0
    # 単語の一致率（編集距離）
    d = np.zeros((len(r) + 1, len(h) + 1), int); d[:, 0] = range(len(r) + 1); d[0, :] = range(len(h) + 1)
    for i in range(1, len(r) + 1):
        for j in range(1, len(h) + 1):
            d[i, j] = min(d[i - 1, j] + 1, d[i, j - 1] + 1, d[i - 1, j - 1] + (0 if r[i - 1] == h[j - 1] else 1))
    return max(0.0, 1 - d[len(r), len(h)] / len(r))

def main():
    asr_dir = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
    W = None
    if asr_dir:
        sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
        from asr import Whisper, load_wav
        W = Whisper(asr_dir)
    index = {'v': 1, 'sr': SR, 'spk': {}, 'clips': {}}
    report = []
    gap = np.zeros(int(SR * 0.15), np.float32)
    for spk, S in SPK.items():
        parts, t, clips = [gap], len(gap) / SR, {}
        for line, L in LINES.items():
            if L['who'] != S['who']: continue
            if spk == 'p' and line not in P_LINES: continue
            for i, text in enumerate(L['v']):
                path = os.path.join(TMP, f'{spk}_{line}_{i}.wav')
                x = synth(text, spk, line, path)
                acc = None
                if W:
                    hyp = W(load_wav(path)); acc = score(text, hyp)
                    # 聞き取りにくいときは、高さの変え方を弱めたり、もとの声を替えたりして、いちばん聞き取れるものを使う
                    if acc < 0.75:
                        best = (acc, x, hyp)
                        base = SPK[spk]
                        alts = [dict(base, pitch=base['pitch'] * 0.4), dict(base, voice='rms' if base['voice'] != 'rms' else 'awb', pitch=base['pitch'] * 0.4), dict(base, voice='slt' if spk in ('o2', 'toc', 'c0', 'c2') else 'rms', pitch=0.0, tempo=1.0)]
                        for k, alt in enumerate(alts):
                            p2 = path + f'.alt{k}.wav'
                            x2 = synth(text, spk, line, p2, alt)
                            h2 = W(load_wav(p2)); a2 = score(text, h2)
                            if a2 > best[0]: best = (a2, x2, h2); os.replace(p2, path)
                            else: os.remove(p2)
                            if a2 >= 0.75: break
                        acc, x, hyp = best
                    report.append((spk, line, i, text, hyp, acc))
                clips[f'{line}.{i}'] = [round(t, 4), round(len(x) / SR, 4)]
                parts += [x, gap]; t += (len(x) + len(gap)) / SR
        y = np.concatenate(parts)
        wpath = os.path.join(TMP, f'pack_{spk}.wav'); save(wpath, y)
        ff('-i', wpath, '-ar', str(SR), '-ac', '1', '-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', '32k', os.path.join(OUT, f'{spk}.m4a'))
        index['spk'][spk] = {'dur': round(len(y) / SR, 3), 'n': len(clips)}
        index['clips'][spk] = clips
        print(spk, len(clips), 'clips', round(len(y) / SR, 1), 's', flush=True)
    json.dump(index, open(os.path.join(OUT, 'index.json'), 'w'), ensure_ascii=False)
    if report:
        with open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'build_tmp', 'voices_asr.tsv'), 'w', encoding='utf8') as f:
            for r in report: f.write('\t'.join(str(v) for v in r) + '\n')
        accs = [r[5] for r in report]
        bad = [r for r in report if r[5] < 0.6]
        print('ASR: clips', len(accs), 'mean', round(float(np.mean(accs)), 3), 'below0.6', len(bad))
        for r in bad[:40]: print('  LOW', r[0], r[1], r[2], repr(r[3]), '→', repr(r[4]), round(r[5], 2))
    size = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(OUT, f)) for f in os.listdir(OUT) if f.endswith('.m4a'))
    print('bytes', size)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
